On the horizon of the undulating landscape the outlines of treetops can be seen, and in the middle part the silhouette of the ruins of a castle with a tower (Rakvere?). In the middle of the cloudy sky, cloud edges glowing with moonlight.

106.d: Mapi esikaanel Kristjan Raua autogramm ja reproduktsioon "Magav Kalevipoeg". Mapis reproduktsioonidega koos hallist kartongist leht inglisekeelse tekstiga Kristjan Raud (21. X 1865 - 19. V 1943) ja ülevaade kunstnik K. Raua elust ja loomingust, autor Juta Kivimäe, foto: Kristjan Raud oma aias Nõmmel. Lehe pöördel inglisekeelne nimekiri 12 reproduktsioonist. Raud, author Juta Kivimäe, photo: Kristjan Raud in his garden in Nõmme. On the verso of the sheet an English-language list of 12 reproductions. Reproductions on 12 sheets of chalk paper.

521.d: Esiplaanil paremal veoautol üles tõstetud kätega mees - kõneleja, auto ümber rühmiti sõdureid ja erariides mehi. Keskosas puude vahele tõmmatud punasel kangal loosung: KÕIK jõud Nõukogude Tallinna kaitseks! Vasemal inimesi kindlustuste ehitamisel. Keskel rannaäärse okaspuumetsa raba, selle järel Tallinna lahe veepind, mille teisel kaldal näha Tallinna. Merel siluettidena sõjalaevad.(eesti)
521.de: In the foreground on the right a man on a truck with raised hands - a speaker, around the truck groups of soldiers and men in civilian clothes. In the middle section, on a red cloth stretched between trees, a slogan: KÕIK jõud Nõukogude Tallinna kaitseks! On the left people building fortifications. In the middle a coastal coniferous bog forest, behind it the water surface of Tallinn Bay, on whose other shore Tallinn can be seen. On the sea warships as silhouettes.

522.d: Esiplaanil rannamaastikul rohkesti traattõkkeid; paremal kahe raagus puu vahel kõlkumas naise ja mehe laibad, vasakul ääres laudadest pantser, neli mehe figuuri. Eemal, üle vee näha Tallinna siluetti.(eesti)
522.de: In the foreground, on a beach landscape, numerous barbed-wire obstacles; on the right, the corpses of a woman and a man swinging between two bare trees, on the left edge a plank armour, four male figures. In the distance, across the water, the silhouette of Tallinn is visible.

524.d: Esialal paremal salk ambumehi muistses eesti sõjamehe rõivastuses, keskel ja tagapool, linnuse müüri ääres suurem osa mehi rünnakul - osa linnuse väravat lõhkumas-, kasutades müüri najale asetatud redeleid. Osa mehi müüril käsivõitluses ristirüütleist kaitsjatega. Võitlejate taga linnusest kerkivad leegid.
524.de: In the foreground on the right a group of archers in ancient Estonian warrior dress, in the middle and further back, by the fortress wall, a larger group of men in attack — some breaking down the fortress gate — using ladders placed against the wall. Some men on the wall in hand-to-hand combat with the crusader knights defending it. Behind the fighters, flames rising from the fortress.

831.d: Ees, maali keskel seisab peaaegu pildi ülemise servani ulatuv tüdruk profiilis paremale. Kleit tume, põll hele, rätik peas sinine. Karjuse taga ja mõlemal pool külgedel heledad lambad. Paremal all jalgade juures lilled. Tagaplaanil kaldariba ning selle taga kitsas veekogu, mis lõpeb silmapiiril metsaga. Silmapiir väga kõrge. Pinnad ümbritsetud tumedate kontuuridega.

The dress is dark, the apron light, the kerchief on her head blue. Behind the shepherd and on both sides light-coloured sheep. Below right, at her feet, flowers. In the background a strip of shore and beyond it a narrow body of water ending on the horizon in a forest. The horizon is very high. The surfaces are surrounded by dark contours.

832.d: Kaks tütarlapse täisfiguuri interjööris. Vasakpoolne, hallis kitlis ja punases pluusis tumedapäine tütarlaps toetub seljaga vastu rohelist ahju. 1940.d: Lihtsailmelises interjööris istuvate kolme mehe poolprofiilis. Vasakul mütsi kandev põskhabemega mees peaaegu täisprofiilis paremale, vasaku käega osutamas vastasistuvate suunas, kuna parem käsi hoiab põrandale toetuvat kaheraudset püssi. Paremal vanem mees läkiläki tüüpi mütsiga profiilis vasakule. Parem käsi hoiab hambus olevat kõverat piipu, vasak käsi põlvedel. Nende kahe vahel otsevaates noor talumees viltkaabus ja rahvarõivais.
1940.de: Three men sitting in a plain interior, shown in half-profile. On the left a man with a cap and side whiskers, almost in full profile to the right, pointing with his left hand towards those sitting opposite, while his right hand holds a double-barrelled shotgun resting on the floor. On the right an older man wearing a lakki-type cap, in profile to the left. His right hand holds a curved pipe in his teeth, his left hand rests on his knees. Between the two, seen frontally, a young peasant man in a felt hat and folk costume.

1954.d: Laua ümber viis meest, neist neli istuvad ja üks, vasakul kaabuga, seisab, toetudes parema käega tooli seljatoele.

4191.de: In a kitchen interior in greyish-brown tones, in the middle, facing frontally, a woman stands behind the stove. On the left, on the warming wall, grey socks and a black pan are hanging. In front, below, by the wall, stand rubber boots and an axe. Through the window, summer nature can be seen. Free, sketchy brushwork.

4377.d: Elo Tamul (portreemaal), dateerimata. Vanemuise teatri näitleja, ooperi- ja operetisolisti Elo Tamuli (1913 – 1994) portree kujutab näitlejannat end oma buduaaris peegli ees etenduseks valmis seadmas. Tamul seisab nõtkelt naiselikus poosis pilk kaugusesse suunatud ja käsi peeglilauale toetatud. Mahe valgus ja nikerdatud jalgadega ning vanaaegse lähivalgustuslambiga peeglilaual oleval vaasis paistvad neli punast roosi muudavad portree üldmulje sulniks ja romantiliseks. /tekst Liisi Aibel/
4377.de: Elo Tamul (portrait painting), undated. The portrait of Vanemuine Theatre actress, opera and operetta soloist Elo Tamul (1913–1994) depicts the actress preparing herself for a performance in front of a mirror in her boudoir. Tamul stands supplely in a feminine pose, her gaze directed into the distance, her hand resting on the dressing table. The soft light and the four red roses visible in a vase on the dressing table, which has carved legs and an old-fashioned close-up lighting lamp, give the overall impression of the portrait a gentle and romantic quality. /text by Liisi Aibel/

6064.dm: kujutise laius: 125.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 115.0 cm
6064.d: Jõemaastik ülalt alla vaates. Esiplaanil vasakpoolsest nurgast paremale taha kulgeva tee ääres (vaataja pool) aiamaa. Teiselpool teed, vasakul jõgi veskihoonetega ja hobustega lasipuu juures. Keskel ja paremal laienev veskijärv. Keskelt otse taha kulgeva jõe kallastel: paremal põllud üksikute hoonete gruppidega ja metsaga; vasakul lehtpuu metsaribaga. Taamal keskel kõrgenev maastik.
6064.de: A river landscape seen from above. In the foreground, along a road running from the left corner to the back on the right (on the viewer's side), a vegetable garden. On the other side of the road, on the left, a river with mill buildings and horses by a hitching post. In the middle and on the right, a widening mill pond. Along the banks of the river running straight back from the centre: on the right fields with individual groups of buildings and forest; on the left a strip of deciduous forest. In the distance in the middle, rising terrain.

6065.d: Ees põllud vasakult paremale jooksva katkendliku põõsaste reaga. Keskel vasakult paremale looklev jõgi. Vastaskaldal kõrgeneval maastikul põllud üksikute puude tukkadega. 1/3 tööst taeva all.
6065.de: In the foreground, fields with a broken row of bushes running from left to right. In the middle a river winding from left to right. On the opposite bank, rising terrain with fields dotted with clumps of trees. 1/3 of the work under sky.

6066.d: Ees peenramaa. Keskel kitsas, looklev jõgi. Vastaskaldal rida hajali taluhooneid. Tagapool, kergelt lainjal maastikul põllud üksikute hoonetega. Silmapiiril mets.
6066.de: In front a garden bed. In the middle a narrow, winding river. On the opposite bank a row of scattered farm buildings. Beyond, in a gently undulating landscape, fields with isolated buildings. Forest on the horizon.

6067.d: Ees paremal künka serv kuuskede ja üksikute lehtpuu latvadega. Keskel, orus eest vasakult taha paremale kulgev jõgi. Vastaskallas mägine, üksikute metsatukkadega.
6067.de: In front, right, the edge of a hill with spruces and the tops of a few deciduous trees. In the middle, in the valley, a river running from front left to back right. The opposite bank is mountainous, with isolated groves.

6068.d: Ees paremal, üksikute puude ja kaevuga rohumaa ääres, taraga piiratud aianurk. Taga vasakul aiaga piiratud maja. Kaugemal, rohumaa ääres rida maju.
6068.de: In front on the right, at the edge of a grassy area with individual trees and a well, a fenced corner of a garden. Behind on the left a house enclosed by a fence. Further away, along the edge of the grassy area, a row of houses.

6069.d: Ees kuni diagonaalselt paremalt taha vasakule kulgeva teeni põõsastik ja üksikud männid. Teiselpool teed taluhooned, mille taga laiuvad päikesekiirtest valgustatud põllud. 1/6 tööst taeva all.
6069.de: In front, up to a road running diagonally from the right to the back left, shrubbery and single pine trees. On the other side of the road farm buildings, behind which lie fields lit by sunbeams. 1/6 of the work under the sky.

6070.d: Eest vasakult taha keskele kulgev teekurv madala kiviaia ja ühekordete kivimajadega vasakul ja paremal.
6070.de: A road curving from the front left to the back centre, with a low stone wall and single-storey stone houses on the left and right.

6071.dm: lehe laius: 44.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.3 cm
6071.d: Laual klaasvaasis punased moonid, vaasist paremal sini-rohelise kirju klaaskausike, laual pudenenud mooni õielehti ja peegeldushelki.
6071.de: Red poppies in a glass vase on a table, to the right of the vase a blue-green patterned glass bowl, on the table scattered poppy petals and reflected light.

6074.d: Panoraammaastik: esiplaanil küngas ja pildi allservas põõsad, paremal servas punaka ja kollase lehestikuga puud. Taamal erksinine järv paari kuusega vasakus servas, edasi künkad kuni kõrge silmapiirini. Taevas hall, paksude valgete pilvedega.
6074.de: Panoramic landscape: in the foreground a hillock and bushes at the bottom edge of the picture, on the right edge trees with reddish and yellow foliage. In the background a bright blue lake with a couple of spruces at the left edge, further on hillocks up to a high horizon. Sky gray, with thick white clouds.

6075.d: Esiplaanil pruun mäeveer, mille servas kasvavad kollased kased ja rohelised põõsad eraldavad esiplaani kesk- ja tagaplaanist. Kaskede taga helesinine järv, silmapiiril künkad ja metsatukad. Ülal hall taevas.
6075.de: In the foreground a brown hillside, at whose edge yellow birches and green bushes separate the foreground from the middle and background. Behind the birches a light blue lake, on the horizon hills and copses. Above a grey sky.

6076.d: Panoraammaastik: esiplaanil ja tagaplaanil künkad, mille vahel helesinine veekogu. Vasakul, peamiselt kuuskedest metsatukk. Ülal kergelt pilvine hall taevas. Pildi vasak pool maalitud lühikeste tihedate pintslilöökidega, parem laseerivamalt.
6076.de: Panoramic landscape: hills in the foreground and background, between them a light blue body of water. On the left, a copse consisting mainly of spruces. Above, a slightly cloudy grey sky. The left side of the picture is painted with short dense brushstrokes, the right side more glazed.

6077.d: Kirju sügismaastik: esiplaanil rohelised niidud, vasakul ja paremal punaste lehtedega haavad ning kollaseks tõmbunud kroonidega kased. Täpselt pildi keskpunktis eriti säravkollases toonis puu. Tagaplaanil mäekallak põllu- ja heinamaasiiludega. Ülal tumesinine taevas valgete pilvedega. Pastoosselt maalitud.
6077.de: A colourful autumn landscape: in the foreground green meadows, on the left and right aspens with red leaves and birches with crowns turned yellow. Exactly at the picture's central point a tree of especially bright yellow tone. In the background a hillside with strips of field and hayfield. Above a dark blue sky with white clouds. Painted pastosely.

6121.d: Noore mehe rinnaportree veerandpöördes paremale. Kollakaspruunid juuksed, tumesinised silmad ja kulmud, sirge nina, teravapiirjooneline tumepunane suu. Näo-osa maalimisel kasutatud rohelist ja helelillat, kõrv lilla. Riided üldiselt markeeritud, täpselt antud valge krae ja rohelistes-oranžides toonides täpuline lips. Pea ümbruses foon lilla.
6121.de: Bust portrait of a young man in a quarter turn to the right. Yellowish-brown hair, dark blue eyes and eyebrows, straight nose, sharply outlined dark red mouth. Green and light purple used in painting the face area, the ear purple. Clothing generally indicated, white collar precisely rendered and a dotted tie in green-orange tones. Background around the head purple.

6150.d: Suviseslt ereda roosakaskollaka taeva all kivine rannaäärne maastik. Esiplaanil mererohune kaldaosa, vasakul keskel mürakas rändrahn poolenisti teava taustal. Kaugemal teine suurem kivi peegeldusega vees. Kirkad toonid, erksinised refleksid kividel. Meri ja maa jagatud silmapiiril peene metsatriibuga.
6150.de: Under a summery, bright pinkish-yellow sky, a rocky coastal landscape. In the foreground a sea-grassy shore area, on the left in the middle a massive erratic boulder half against the sky. Farther away another larger stone with a reflection in the water. Bright tones, bright blue reflections on the stones. The sea and land are divided at the horizon by a thin strip of forest.

6157.d: Laugjas panoraammaastik heleroheliste niitudega keskplaanis ning sinava mere ja küngastega tagaplaanil. Taevas valkjassinine. Keskel niidul markeeritud tumedamaga üksikud puud ja põõsad.
6157.de: A gently sloping panoramic landscape with pale green meadows in the middle ground and a bluish sea and hills in the background. The sky whitish-blue. In the centre, on the meadow, isolated trees and bushes marked in a darker tone.

6170.d: Keskplaanil kaks madalat, peaaegu maapinnani ulatuvate katustega, vana taluhoonet. Koloriit tume, taevaosas tugevad küps kollased viirud.
6170.de: In the middle ground, two low old farm buildings with roofs reaching almost to the ground. Dark colouring, with strong ripe yellow streaks in the sky area.

6175.d: Üle rohelise muru talumajade vahelt looklev tee. Esiplaanil vasakul vöödiline piiritulp.
6175.de: A path winding across green grass between farmhouses. In the foreground on the left a striped boundary post.

6180.d: Tumedates toonides künklik maastik. Esiplaanil kivimürakad. Keskel kaks kõveriku puud.
6180.de: A hilly landscape in dark tones. In the foreground, boulders. In the middle, two crooked trees.

6190.d: Vana mehe rindportree otsevaates. Valge juus ja habe. Must kuub, valge kaelus.
6190.de: Bust portrait of an old man, frontal view. White hair and beard. Black coat, white collar.

6191.d: Vana mehe rindportree kerges pöördes paremale. Paljas pea, habe ja vurrud. Must kuub, valge krae. Paremas käes pliiats, vasakus raamat.
6191.de: Bust portrait of an old man in a slight turn to the right. Bald head, beard and moustache. Black coat, white collar. A pencil in his right hand, a book in his left.

6192.d: Naise rindportree, pea kerge pöördega paremale. Blondid juuksed, must kleit sügava dekolteega. Kaelas kee, õlgadel valge karusnahk.
6192.de: A woman's bust portrait, head slightly turned to the right. Blond hair, black dress with deep décolletage. A necklace on the neck, white fur on the shoulders.

6194.d: Noore mehe poolfiguur seisvas asendis, otsevaates. Tumedad vurrud, tume kõrvadeni ulatuv juus. Sinine kõrge kaelusega särk. Tume taevas punase viiruga horisondil.
6194.de: Half-figure of a young man in standing position, frontal view. Dark moustache, dark hair reaching to the ears. Blue high-collared shirt. Dark sky with a red streak on the horizon.

6198.d: Noorema mehe rindportree kerge peapöördega vasakule. Kõrge valge kaelus, tume kuub, lõuani suletud vest.
6198.de: Bust portrait of a younger man with a slight turn of the head to the left. High white collar, dark coat, waistcoat buttoned up to the chin.

6204.dm: kõrgus: 41.6 cm; lehe laius: 24.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 31.0 cm; laius: 33.5 cm (paspartuu mõõt)
6204.d: Lõunamaine kaljune rannamaastik sinetavate meresoppidega, vasakul lopsakas roheline taimestik ning õitega viljapuu.
6204.de: Southern rocky coastal landscape with bluish inlets of the sea, on the left lush green vegetation and a flowering fruit tree.

6208.d: Mehe rinnapilt en face. Põskhabemega, üle kollase vesti ja täpilise rinnaesise ulatuv uurikett.
6208.de: Bust portrait of a man en face. With side-whiskers, a watch chain extending over a yellow waistcoat and a spotted shirt-front.

6226.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud liivane maapind, taga mets.
6226.de: Grassy sandy ground in the foreground, forest behind.

6269.d: All paremast nurgast diagonaalselt keskele suunduv katus, millest vasemal varemeis linn. Tagaplaanil paistab Tallinna raekoja torn, sellest vasakul Pühavaimu kiriku torni kiiver ja paremal Oleviste torn.
6269.de: A roof running diagonally from the lower right corner to the centre, to the left of which a ruined town. In the background the tower of Tallinn Town Hall is visible, to its left the spire of the Church of the Holy Spirit and to the right the tower of St. Olaf's Church.

6313.d: Maastik rohtukasvanud veekoguga esiplaanil. Paremal paistab puude seest talumaja katus vasakul põõsas ja paat ühe selgvaates inimfiguuriga.
6313.de: Landscape with a grass-grown body of water in the foreground. On the right, the roof of a farmhouse is visible through the trees; on the left a bush and a boat with one figure seen in profile.

6315.d: Esiplaanil keskel seljaga vaataja poole seisev mees, paremal puude vahelt nähtav majakatus,  taga järv ja vaade maastikule.
6315.de: In the foreground centre a man standing with his back to the viewer, on the right a house roof visible through the trees, behind it a lake and a view of the landscape.

6316.d: Esialal virvendaval merepinnal keskel paat kahe sõudjaga, kaugemal purjekaid. Üle vee paistab kogu pildi laiust haaravalt Tallinna panoraam. Kergelt pilvitatud taeva taustal lendavate lindude parv.
6316.de: On the shimmering surface of the sea in the foreground a boat with two rowers, further away sailing boats. Across the water, spanning the entire width of the picture, a panorama of Tallinn is visible. Against a slightly clouded sky a flock of flying birds.

6317.dm: lehe laius: 12.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 15.2 cm
6317.d: Keskealise ümmarguse näoga mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas sinakasmust kuub. Foon tumehall.
6317.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged, round-faced man in half-profile facing left. Wearing a dark bluish-black coat. Background dark grey.

6320.dm: lehe laius: 32.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 17.5 cm
6320.d: Esiplaanil Pezoldi maja õu kahe joova hobusega. Taga aiad põõsaste ja puudega, üle puude näha maja katuseid. Taga vasakul kõrgendikul Rakvere linnuse varemed.
6320.de: In the foreground the courtyard of the Pezold house with two trotting horses. Behind, gardens with bushes and trees, above the trees the roofs of the house can be seen. In the background on the left, on a height, the ruins of Rakvere Castle.

6321.d: Esiplaanil lehtpuude latvu ja mets, taga vasakul Tallinna panoraam, paremal meri.
6321.de: In the foreground treetops of deciduous trees and forest, behind on the left a panorama of Tallinn, sea on the right.

6332.d: Pikkajuukselise habemiku mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis pöördega vasakule, seljas must talaar, peas laiaääreline kaabu, vasak käsi toetub toolikorjule.
6332.de: Half-figure of a long-haired, bearded man in a seated position turned to the left, wearing a black gown, a wide-brimmed hat on his head, his left hand resting on the back of a chair.

6336.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Sinises kleidis, väikeste kõrvarõngastega.
6336.de: Bust portrait of a young woman, half-profile to the right. In a blue dress, with small earrings.

6393.d: Rohelises kleidis seisva naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Modelli vasakus käes pintsel.
6393.de: Half figure of a woman standing in a green dress, facing forward. The model holds a brush in her left hand.

6394.d: Seisva naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Mõlemas käes pintslid. Valge sviiter, sinine vest. Foon tumepunane.
6394.de: Half-figure of a standing woman in frontal view. Brushes in both hands. White sweater, blue vest. Background dark red.

6396.d: Esiplaanil tooli selg, millest üle visatud valge traperii. Tagapoolt punase ja rohelise riidega kaetud laud, millel madal vaas tulpidega ja kell. Fooniks roosa riie.
6396.de: In the foreground the back of a chair, over which a white drape is thrown. Behind it a table covered with a red and green cloth, on which a low vase with tulips and a clock. Background a pink cloth.

6468.d: Keskealise naise poolfiguur punase drapeeringu taustal. Peas väike peakate, seljas helerohekas dekolteeritud kleit kuldtikandiga rinnaesisel ja tumesinine, pruuni karusnahkse äärega ürp. Nähtavas vasemas käes mehe miniatuurportree. Ülal vasakul vapi kujutis.
6468.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman against a red drapery background. On her head a small headdress, wearing a light greenish low-necked dress with gold embroidery on the bodice, and a dark blue robe with a brown fur trim. In her visible left hand, a miniature portrait of a man. Upper left, a depiction of a coat of arms.

6469.de: Open grassland in the foreground. Forest behind.

6470.dm: kõrgus: 38.5 cm (tööm.); laius: 38.2 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 37.4 cm (vm.); laius: 40.2 cm (tööm.)
6470.d: Valgepäise poisikese põlvpilt kitarriga, poolprofiilis vasakule. Riietatud helebeeži kuube valge krae ja kätistega. Üldfoon tumepruun. Poisikese taga nelinurkne hele laik millele langeb poisi profiili tume vari.
6470.de: Knee-length portrait of a white-haired boy with a guitar, in half-profile to the left. Dressed in a light beige coat with a white collar and cuffs. Overall background dark brown. Behind the boy a rectangular light patch, onto which the dark shadow of the boy's profile falls.

6473.d: Keskealise, prillidega mehe poolfiguur peaaegu enface. Pruunikal taustal.
6473.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with glasses, almost en face. Against a brownish background.

6483.d: Veerandpöördes, pisut langetatud peaga naise rinnaportree, silmad maha vaatamas. Peas punakaspruuni lindiga väike must kübar, seljas beež jakk ning kirju pluus, mille kaeluses kiviga pross. Kübarast langeb laubale vari, varju jääb ka osa vasemast põsest. Jaki krae nurgas roheline lilleke. Valdavalt rohekaspruunides toonides.
6483.de: A quarter-turned bust portrait of a woman with her head slightly lowered, eyes looking down. On her head a small black hat with a reddish-brown ribbon, wearing a beige jacket and a patterned blouse with a brooch with a stone at the neckline. The hat casts a shadow on the forehead, and part of the left cheek is also in shadow. A green little flower at the corner of the jacket collar. Predominantly in greenish-brown tones.

6510.d: Esiplaanil kivisel küngastikul vasakul kolmeharaline puu, paremal künka tipul rida puid (mände), keskel veekogu. Vees peegelduvate puudega tagaplaanil täitvast metsast.
6510.de: In the foreground on a rocky hillock on the left a three-forked tree, on the right at the top of the hill a row of trees (pines), in the middle a body of water. In the background a forest filling the space with trees reflected in the water.

6525.d: Esiplaanil keskel, peaaegu küljega vaataja poole, seisab valges madrusekraega pluusis ja tumedas kitsas seelikus noor naine, käsi rohelisele rinnatisele toetatud. Naisel pisut püstjas nina, kergelt väljaulatuvad põsesarnad ja teravajooneline ülespoole nurkadega suu. Juuksed kuklal suures krunnis. Pluusi kaeluses must kunstlill. Fooni ülaosa lilla, paremal ülanurgas uduselt antud maastikumaal.
6525.de: In the foreground in the centre, almost with her side to the viewer, stands a young woman in a white blouse with a sailor collar and a dark narrow skirt, hand resting on a green bodice. The woman has a slightly upturned nose, slightly protruding cheekbones and a sharply lined mouth with upturned corners. Hair in a large bun at the nape. In the neckline of the blouse a black artificial flower. The upper part of the background is purple, in the upper right corner a hazily rendered landscape painting.

6589.d: Kompositsioon piibli ainetel. Ees keskel võlvistikus preester lapsukesega kätel. Paremal sinises rüüs naine (Maria) vasakul mees (Joosep) ja põlvitav vanaeit kepp käes.
6589.de: Composition on biblical themes. In the front centre, under a vault, a priest with a small child in his arms. On the right a woman in a blue robe (Mary), on the left a man (Joseph), and a kneeling old woman with a stick in her hand.

6593.d: Vaade maastikule ülalt alla: ees lehtpuu-metsa ladvad; üle nende tõuseb vasakul kaks kirik-ehitist kõrgete tornidega. Pilvistatud taevas ehapunas.
6593.de: View of a landscape from above downward: in front the tops of a deciduous forest; above them rise on the left two church buildings with tall towers. Clouded sky in sunset red.

6594.d: Noorepoolse mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule, mustade pikkade juuste ja valge kraega.
6594.de: A bust portrait of a youngish man in half-profile to the left, with black long hair and a white collar.

6595.d: Ees vasakul madal kallas, millelt paremal silmupüüdmise aed. Vastaskaldal vasakul kindlus, paremal lehtpuude taustal maju.
6595.de: In the front on the left a low bank, from which on the right an eel-trap fence extends. On the opposite bank on the left a fortress, on the right houses against a background of deciduous trees.

6596.d: Ees paremal õu kuivava pesuga ja ühekordse puuhoonega selle taga; vasakul suur raagus puu ja selle kõrval tünnid.
6596.de: In front on the right a yard with laundry drying and a single-story wooden building behind it; on the left a large bare tree and barrels beside it.

6598.d: Esiplaanil paremas nurgas veekogu. Taamal lumine kallas üksikute suurte puudega.
6598.de: In the foreground in the right corner a body of water. In the distance a snowy shore with solitary large trees.

6599.d: Esiplaanil vasakul raudaiaga piiritletud kivikõnnitee. Paremal vesi. Jõe vastaskaldal üksikuid hooneid ja puid. Taamal väljad.
6599.de: In the foreground on the left a stone pavement bounded by an iron fence. On the right water. On the opposite bank of the river individual buildings and trees. In the distance fields.

6600.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, paremal kaldal olevate suurte puude ja põõsaste tugeva vastupeegeldusega.
6600.de: In the foreground a body of water, on the right bank large trees and bushes with strong reflection.

6602.d: Paremal nurgas väike veekogu. Üle välja looklemas tee. Tagapool kaks üksikut kuuske. Horisondil mets.
6602.de: In the right corner a small body of water. A road winding across the field. Behind, two solitary spruces. On the horizon a forest.

6605.d: Esiplaanil veekogu paatidega, taga kõrgenev rand.
6605.de: Body of water with boats in the foreground, rising shore behind.

6606.d: Vasakul rohtunud kallas põõsastega. Paremal veekogu. Vastaskaldal hooneid.
6606.de: On the left a grassy bank with bushes. On the right a body of water. Buildings on the opposite bank.

6607.d: Paremal veekogu, vasakul ja taga madal rand liivaluidete ja madalate põõsastega.
6607.de: On the right a body of water, on the left and in the background a low shore with sand dunes and low bushes.

6608.d: Vasakul meri. Paremal kergelt rohtunud kallas.
6608.de: On the left, the sea. On the right, a slightly overgrown shore.

6609.d: Suvises maastikus ees vasakul grupp kuuski. Horisondil mets.
6609.de: In a summer landscape, in front on the left a group of spruces. A forest on the horizon.

6611.d: Rohekal veel kaks lotja. Vaskapoolsem väiksem, parempoolsem suurem.
6611.de: On the greenish water two more barges. The one on the copper side smaller, the one on the right larger.

6612.d: Kaheksa grupis seisva poisi ja tütarlapse poolfiguuri; parempoolsel naeratava näoga poisil käes helepruun õun. Värv pastoosne, eriti maali allosas.
6612.de: Half-figures of eight boys and girls standing in a group; the boy on the right, with a smiling face, holds a light brown apple. The paint is pasty, especially in the lower part of the painting.

6613.d: Keskealise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, keha täisprofiilis paremale. Taust kollane.
6613.de: A middle-aged woman's bust in three-quarter profile facing right, the body in full profile facing right. Background yellow.

6614.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv kääruline jõgi moodustab võsastunud heinamaal "s" tähe kuju. Ees vasakul väike heinaküün. Keskel talumaja. Taga lehtpuumets.
6614.de: A winding river running from the front left to the back right forms the shape of the letter "s" in an overgrown meadow. In the front left, a small hay barn. In the middle, a farmhouse. Behind, a deciduous forest.

6624.d: Esiplaanil algav ja taha vasakul suunduv mäeseljandik. Seljandiku külgedel puid ja põõsastikke. Paremal puude vahelt paistmas veekogu.
6624.de: A mountain ridge beginning in the foreground and receding to the left in the back. Trees and bushes on the sides of the ridge. On the right a body of water visible among the trees.

6625.d: Ees keskel rohumaa piiratud vasakult suurte lehtpuude grupiga. Tagapool paremal rida mesipuid ja õlgkatusega talumaja nurk paistmas puude tagant.
6625.de: In the front centre a meadow bordered on the left by a group of large deciduous trees. Behind on the right a row of beehives and the corner of a straw-roofed farmhouse visible behind the trees.

6626.d: Esiplaanil heinamaa, oja ja üle selle suunuva purdega. Keskel vasakul lehtpuid ja küün. Taamal mets.
6626.de: In the foreground a meadow, a brook with a footbridge crossing it. In the centre-left deciduous trees and a barn. In the background a forest.

6627.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kolm kaske, paremal kaks laiakroonilist vana lehtpuud, nende taga põõsastik. Puutüvede ja kroonide vahelt vaade veekogule (keskel ja paremal); vasakul kitsas, vette tungiv maariba. Taamal metsad.
6627.de: In the foreground on the left three birches, on the right two broad-crowned old deciduous trees, behind them shrubbery. Between the tree trunks and crowns a view of a body of water (in the middle and on the right); on the left a narrow strip of land reaching into the water. In the distance forests.

6628.d: Paremal ja vasakul ääres heinasoo serv, vasakpoolses ääres tihedasti teineteise kõrval naise ja mehe figuurid. Taamal loomad.
6628.de: On the right and left edge the border of a hay marsh, in the left edge closely side by side the figures of a woman and a man. In the background animals.

6629.d: Keskel puude vahel niit heinasaatudega, esiplaanil puude vari; vasakul saatude taga õhtuses poolvalguses mets.
6629.de: In the middle among trees a strip of meadow with haystacks, in the foreground the shadow of trees; on the left, behind the haystacks, a forest in evening half-light.

6630.d: Esialal lausik heinamaa, millel rida heinasaade. Tagapool, lattaia taga, paremal lehtpuude salu, vasakul põllud, millede tagant paistab metsamassiiv. Taevas hallis pilves.
6630.de: In the foreground flat hayfield with a row of haystacks. Further back, behind a picket fence, at right a grove of deciduous trees, at left fields, behind which a forest mass is visible. The sky is grey and cloudy.

6631.d: Vasakul taluhooned, mille taga kõrge puu ja kaugemal mets. Esiplaanil tee, mis läheb otse pildi sügavusse. Teest paremal põõsad ja järv.
6631.de: On the left, farm buildings behind which a tall tree and further away a forest. In the foreground a road going straight into the depth of the picture. To the right of the road bushes and a lake.

6632.d: Esiplaanil õitsev aas, selle taga heledam riba. Taga vasakul ja ees paremal suured puud. Õhtune valgustus.
6632.de: In the foreground a blooming meadow, behind it a lighter strip. Behind on the left and in front on the right large trees. Evening lighting.

6633.d: Esiplaanil oja purdega. Tagapoolt paistab puude vahelt küün. Looduses õhtune hämarus, kerge uduvine, taevas horisondi kohal roosatab. Pruunikas üldtoon, õhuke värvkate.
6633.de: In the foreground a stream with a footbridge. Behind, a barn is visible through the trees. Evening dusk in nature, a light haze, the sky glows pink above the horizon. Brownish overall tone, thin paint layer.

6634.d: Paremal jõgi, vasakule tõuseb nõlvak viljapõlluga, keskplaanile jääb õlgkatusega talumaja ja kõrged puud.
6634.de: On the right a river, on the left a slope rises with a grain field, in the middle ground a thatched-roof farmhouse and tall trees.

6635.d: Vasakul kääruline oja, paremal kaks heinarõuku. Keskplaanil puude varjus pikk talumaja suitsva korstnaga.
6635.de: On the left a winding brook, on the right two haystacks. In the middle ground a long farmhouse with a smoking chimney in the shade of trees.

6636.d: Paremal külavahetee, mille ääres puuderida ja majad, vasemal ülaservaga läbilõigatud männid, tahapoole jääb viljapõld.
6636.de: On the right a village road with a row of trees and houses along it, on the left pines cut off by the upper edge, behind lies a grain field.

6637.d: Maastik jõega, mis suundub diagonaalselt vasakult alt paremale üles. Käänukohal paremal kaldal puudegrupp ning heledamas toonis põlluviirg.
6637.de: Landscape with a river running diagonally from lower left to upper right. At the bend, on the right bank, a group of trees and a lighter-toned strip of field.

6638.d: Esiplaanil oja, mille kaldail heinamaa ja kaugemal viljapõld. Keskel puude vahel maja, keskplaanil vasakul puudegrupp.
6638.de: In the foreground a stream, with meadows on its banks and a grain field further away. In the middle, a house among trees, in the middle ground on the left a group of trees.

6639.d: Suvine maastik: keskosas suur lehtpuu, tumeda varjuga, mille all paremal väike veekogu. Puust vasakule - rohumaa, paremale rohumaa väikese ojaga. Tagaplaanil vasakul väike küün üksiku kase kõrval.
6639.de: A summer landscape: in the central part a large deciduous tree with a dark shadow, beneath which at right a small body of water. To the left of the tree - meadow, to the right meadow with a small stream. In the background at left a small barn next to a solitary birch.

6640.d: Esiplaanil paremal osa rohtunud müürist, mille ääres kasvab lehtpuude salu. Vasakul kitsas tee, mis kaob puude vahele. Tagapool kõrged puud ning punase katusega maja. Silmapiiril paistab meri.
6640.de: In the foreground on the right part of a grass-grown wall, along which grows a grove of deciduous trees. On the left a narrow path disappearing among the trees. Further back tall trees and a house with a red roof. The sea is visible on the horizon.

6641.d: Esiplaanil vasakul pildi ülaservani kolm kaske. Keskplaanil viljapõld, paremale jäävad heinasaod. Kaugemal vanad taluhooned puude vahel.
6641.de: In the foreground on the left, three birches reaching to the upper edge of the picture. In the middle ground a grain field, haystacks to the right. Further away old farm buildings among trees.

6642.d: Esiplaanil paremalt vasakule kalduv nõlvak, selle taga kahe taluhoone katused ja kooguga kaev. Tagaplaanil üksikud suured puud, vasemal metsaviirg. Sinises taevas üksikud pilved.
6642.de: In the foreground a slope inclining from right to left, behind it the roofs of two farm buildings and a well with a sweep. In the background solitary large trees, on the left a row of forest. In the blue sky solitary clouds.

6643.d: Puudega kaetud künklik maastik: vasakus servas männid, nende tagant laskub pildi esiplaanile tee, teispool teed küngas puudesaluga, paremal puude rühm.
6643.de: Hilly landscape covered with trees: in the left edge pines, from behind which a road descends into the foreground of the picture, on the other side of the road a hill with a grove of trees, on the right a group of trees.

6644.d: Esiplaanil keskelt algab tee, mis kitsenedes jõuab taluhoonete grupini. Kahelpool teed kivid. Paremal paralleelselt teega kulgev oja; mõlemal kaldal kasvavad üksikud kased.
6644.de: In the foreground a road begins in the middle, narrowing as it reaches a group of farm buildings. Stones on both sides of the road. On the right a stream runs parallel to the road; single birches grow on both banks.

6645.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm mändi, vasakul kaks kaske, mille taga paistab veekogu. Siinpoolsel kaldal näha kaks majakatust. Paremal puude vahel küün.
6645.de: In the foreground on the right three pines, on the left two birches, behind which a body of water is visible. On the near shore two roofs of houses can be seen. On the right, among the trees, a barn.

6646.d: Esiplaanil neli rukkihakki, nende taga põimitud pihtaed. Keskplaanil pikk talumaja kõrvalhoonetega.
6646.de: Four rye stooks in the foreground, behind them a woven wattle fence. A long farmhouse with outbuildings in the middle ground.

6647.d: Pildi keskosas järv, milles peegeldub mets. Esiplaanil kaldariba, kus kasvavad männid, poolitatud pildi ülaservaga.
6647.de: In the middle of the picture a lake, in which a forest is reflected. In the foreground a strip of shore where pines grow, bisected by the upper edge of the picture.

6648.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kolm viljahakki ja aed. Keskplaanil talumaja, paremal suured kased.
6648.de: In the foreground on the left three stooks of grain and a garden. In the middle ground a farmhouse, on the right large birches.

6649.d: Esiplaanil kollakas rohumaa, kus kasvavad sarapuu puhmad, heites tumedaid varje. Taga küün ja  sinetav veepiir.
6649.de: In the foreground a yellowish meadow where hazel bushes grow, casting dark shadows. In the background a barn and a bluish waterline.

6650.d: Esiplaanil neli heinasaadu; oja purdega. Kaugemalt paistab talu koos kõrvalhoonetega.
6650.de: In the foreground, four haystacks; a stream with a footbridge. In the distance, a farm with outbuildings can be seen.

6651.d: Õhtumaastik: esiplaanil tee, tagaplaanil põõsastik ja metsaviirg. Taevas tume, metsa kohal roosatav.
6651.de: Evening landscape: in the foreground a road, in the background shrubbery and a strip of forest. The sky dark, growing pinkish above the forest.

6652.d: Hilissuvine maastik; esiplaanil heinasaod kollakal maapinnal. Pildi keskel taluhooned kõrgete puude varjus.
6652.de: Late-summer landscape; haystacks on yellowish ground in the foreground. In the middle of the picture farm buildings in the shade of tall trees.

6653.d: Esiplaanil paremal kõrge puu tumeda varjuga rohelisel maapinnal. Vasakul oja. Keskplaanil maju ja puudegruppe. Kauguses sinetab veekogu.
6653.de: In the foreground on the right, a tall tree with a dark shadow on green ground. On the left a stream. In the middle ground houses and groups of trees. In the distance a body of water shows blue.

6654.d: Esiplaanil tükike niidust ja viljapõld. Selle taga suurte puude ning põõsaste vahel talu paari kõrvalhoone ja kaevuga.
6654.de: In the foreground a patch of meadow and a grain field. Behind it, among large trees and bushes, a farm's outbuilding and a well.

6655.d: Paremas ääres esiplaanil heinasaad ja küün, vasakus ääres osa lehtpuude grupist. Kaugemal paistavad veel kolm heinakuhja, viljapõld ning taluhoone.
6655.de: On the right edge in the foreground a haystack and a barn, on the left edge part of a group of deciduous trees. Further away three more haystacks, a grainfield and a farmhouse can be seen.

6656.d: Pildil keskel suurte puude all vana, rookatusega taluhoone. Tagaplaanil paremas servas paistab teise sarnase hoone ots.
6656.de: In the middle of the picture, under large trees, an old farmhouse with a thatched roof. In the background on the right edge the end of a similar building can be seen.

6657.d: Pruunikates ja pruunikaskollastes toonides pastoosselt maalitud puisniidumaastik. Keskplaanil vasakust pildiäärest keskosani puudesalu, selles vasakus kuldlõikes madal palktare kõrge katusega. Esiplaanil vasakul üksik puu tumerohelisetes toonides, paremal äärel osa suurest lehtpuudt ja selle taga kaarjalt paremast äärest keskele horisondini ulatuv salu.
6657.de: A wooded meadow landscape painted in a pastose manner in brownish and brownish-yellow tones. In the middle ground, from the left edge of the picture to the middle, a grove of trees, in which, at the left golden section, stands a low log cottage with a high roof. In the foreground on the left a solitary tree in dark green tones, at the right edge part of a large deciduous tree, and behind it a grove curving from the right edge to the middle, reaching the horizon.

6658.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, tumerohelisel kanarbikuga künkal neli kõrget mändi väikese kuusega nende vahel. Keskplaanil massiivsemalt ning üldistatumalt antud puud ja põõsad, vasakul servas jupike sinist merd, ülal hallikassinine taevas. Domineerivad rohelised, lillad ja pruunid toonid. Mändide latvades loojuva päikese kuma.
6658.de: In the foreground on the left, on a dark green hillock with heather, four tall pines with a small spruce between them. In the middle ground, more massively and generally rendered trees and bushes, on the left edge a small patch of blue sea, above a greyish-blue sky. Green, purple and brown tones dominate. In the tops of the pines the glow of the setting sun.

6659.d: Esiplaanil keskel pildi sügavusse suubuv väike jõgi. Jõe ääres vasakul tilluke punase katusega maja, millel suured põlised puud ja pruuni katuse ning valge korstnaga suurem maja. Jõest paremal põõsad, tagaplaanis karjamaad ja metsaviirg. Ülal tihedalt hallikate pilvedega kaetud taevas. Maalitud summutatud rohelistes ja kollastes toonides.
6659.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a small river flowing into the depth of the picture. By the river on the left a tiny house with a red roof, with large old trees, and a larger house with a brown roof and white chimney. To the right of the river bushes, in the background pastures and a strip of forest. Above, the sky densely covered with greyish clouds. Painted in muted green and yellow tones.

6689.d: Esiplaanil, pooleldi seljaga vaataja poole istuv heleda juustekrunniga valges pluusis ja hallis seelikus tütarlaps toolil (istumas), parem käsi villakoonlal. Tüdrukust vasakul triibulises rahvariideseelikus, pruunis jakis ja tumepunases pottmütsis vanem naine, käsi tütarlapse õlal, tema kohale kummardumas. Foon tumehall.
6689.de: In the foreground, a girl with a light-coloured hair bun, in a white blouse and grey skirt, sitting half turned with her back to the viewer on a chair, her right hand on a skein of wool. To the left of the girl, an older woman in a striped folk-costume skirt, a brown jacket and a dark red pot-shaped cap, her hand on the girl's shoulder, bending over her. The background is dark grey.

6694.d: Sinise pastelliga visandatud maastik. Vasakul paar suuremat puud, paremal oja ning üks kõrgem puu. Ees paremal all pikas rõivas naisfiguur hoidmas selja taga keppi. Tagaplaanil ülal pilvine taevas.
6694.de: A landscape sketched with blue pastel. On the left a couple of large trees, on the right a brook and one taller tree. In front, lower right, a female figure in a long garment holding a stick behind her back. In the background above a cloudy sky.

6695.d: Lilla kontuuriga raamistatud roheline maastik. Esiplaanil keskel kollased suuremad kivid. All vasakul ja paremal lillakad kivid. Paremal küljel markeeritud metsaserv, keskel kuni silmapiirini killakates rohelistes toonides rohumaa. Silmapiiril markeeritud lillaga üksikud puud. Taevas rohekas-lilla. Ülaservas keskel kollane kuu.
6695.de: A green landscape framed by a purple contour. In the foreground in the middle, larger yellow stones. Below on the left and right, purplish stones. On the right side a stylised forest edge, in the middle up to the horizon a meadow in patchy green tones. On the horizon, individual trees marked in purple. The sky is greenish-purple. At the top in the middle a yellow moon.

6696.d: Esiplaanil sinistes toonides veeväli kuu kollase peegeldusega. Taamal madal rohekas kollakas kallas. Vasakul eemal rohekad-sinakad puud, sekka mõned pruunid. Metsatuka peegeldus hägusalt ka veepinnal. Taevas tuhmjas heledam sinine. Impressionistlikus laadis romantiline suvemaastik.
6696.de: In the foreground a body of water in blue tones with the yellow reflection of the moon. Beyond, a low greenish-yellowish shore. Far away on the left greenish-bluish trees, among them a few brown ones. The reflection of the grove is hazy also on the water's surface. The sky a dull lighter blue. A romantic summer landscape in an impressionistic manner.

6697.d: Tugevate mustade kontuuridega raamistuses lillal taustal ovaalne stiliseeritud tammelehtedest pärg. Pärja keskel valge (paberi värvi) päikese taustal lendu tõusmas pika nokaga lind. Nii lilla lind kui ka päike stiliseeritud. All mustas raamistuses tekst SIURU III. Lehe paremal allserval punased, mustad, pruunid kriidiproovid.
6697.de: Within a frame of strong black contours on a purple background an oval stylised wreath of oak leaves. In the centre of the wreath a bird with a long beak rising in flight against a white (paper-coloured) sun. Both the purple bird and the sun are stylised. Below, in a black frame, the text SIURU III. At the lower right edge of the sheet, red, black, brown chalk trials.

6698.d: Sinise pastellkriidiga joonistatud ovaalne kompositsioon. Ülal keskel stiliseeritud suurem hoone puude vahel. Kummalgil küljel suured puulehed. Hoone ees tiik. Ovaali alumises osas samuti veesilm aimatavate peegeldustega majast ning puudest.
6698.de: An oval composition drawn with blue pastel chalk. At the top centre, a stylised larger building among trees. Large leaves of trees on either side. A pond in front of the building. In the lower part of the oval, likewise a body of water with discernible reflections of the house and trees.

6702.d: Istuv tüdruk punaka riide taustal. Valge pluus, rohekashall seelik. Vasakule pööratud pea toetatud käele.
6702.de: A seated girl against a reddish cloth background. White blouse, greenish-grey skirt. Head turned to the left, resting on her hand.

6711.d: Esiplaanil laud valge kattega. Laual puukirn puulusika ja võiga. Laua kõrval paremal sinise jaki, pruuni kuue ja valge pearätiga vanem naine suurt leiba lõikamas. Paremal nurgas tool, fooniks tume talutoa palksein.
6711.de: In the foreground a table with a white cloth. On the table a wooden butter dish with a wooden spoon and butter. Beside the table on the right an older woman in a blue jacket, brown coat and white headscarf cutting a large loaf of bread. In the right corner a chair, background a dark log wall of a farmhouse room.

6741.dm: lehe laius: 27.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.5 cm
6741.d: Ees risti alusel kivisambale toetuv noor naine. Temast vasakul istuv koer, paremal laps. Vasakul lainetav meri kahe kajakaga.
6741.de: In front, a young woman leaning on a stone pillar on the base of a cross. To her left a sitting dog, to the right a child. On the left a wavy sea with two seagulls.

6742.d: Punast pottmütsi kandev vana naise rinnapilt, poolprofiilis vasakule. Valge pluusi kaelus kinnitatud sõelaga.
6742.de: Bust portrait of an old woman wearing a red pot hat, in half-profile to the left. The collar of the white blouse fastened with a brooch.

6743.d: Vana naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, peas sinine pottmüts.
6743.de: A bust portrait of an old woman in half-profile to the right, wearing a blue pot hat.

6763.dm: lehe laius: 51.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 39.5 cm
6763.d: Vasakul, eest taha suunduva jõe kaldal mängivad lapsed. Taga vasakul kõrgel rohtunud kaldal lehtpuid. Taamal, keskel, asula kirikuga.
6763.de: On the left, children playing on the bank of a river running from front to back. Behind, on the left, on a high grassy bank, deciduous trees. In the distance, in the centre, a settlement with a church.

6768.d: Rida vanu hooneid punaste kivikatustega. Ees rohelisega ääristatud tänav. Tänava vasakpoolses nurgas ümmargune lillepeenar.
6768.de: A row of old buildings with red tile roofs. In front a street lined with greenery. In the left corner of the street a round flower bed.

6769.d: Vaade kõrgete punaste katustega vanalinna majadele. Vasakul Oleviste kiriku ja raekoja tornid, keskplaanil uusehituse alusmüür tornkraanaga vasakul.
6769.de: View of the old town houses with high red roofs. On the left the towers of St. Olaf's Church and the Town Hall, in the middle ground the foundation wall of a new building with a tower crane on the left.

6773.dm: lehe laius: 13.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 27.8 cm
6773.d: Lühikeses tantsu riietuses naise täisfiguur. Parem jalg ülestõstetud, vasak käsi üles parem taha sirutatud.
6773.de: Full figure of a woman in short dance attire. Right leg raised, left arm stretched up, right arm stretched back.

6774.dm: lehe laius: 25.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 35.7 cm
6774.d: Laual purk vee ja vette pistetud pintsliga. Veidike taga pool taskukell.
6774.de: On the table a jar with water and a brush dipped in it. A little further back a pocket watch.

6786.dm: lehe laius: 15.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 18.5 cm
6786.d: Palvetava hallipäise habemiku mungarüüs rauga rindpilt. Pea kohal oreool. Vaade suunatud üles. Kujutis ovaalses raamistikus.
6786.de: Bust of an old man with grey hair and a beard, in a monk's robe, praying. A halo above his head. Gaze directed upward. The image is in an oval frame.

6787.d: Esiplaanil lausik muru, millel paremal neli kalkunit, keskel õlgkatusega maja, mille trepil ülespoole astuv mehekogu. Trepi ees naine lapsega. Taamal puiestik.
6787.de: In the foreground a flat lawn, on the right four turkeys, in the centre a thatched-roof house, on whose steps a male figure is ascending. In front of the steps a woman with a child. Further away a grove of trees.

6793.d: Istuva vanema mehe poolfiguurportree: seljas tume ülikond, valge särk kõva kraega ja tume kaelaside. Juuksed hallid, vuntsid ja tilluke lõuahabe, pilk suunatud otse vaatajale. Foon rohekashall.
6793.de: Half-length portrait of a seated elderly man: wearing a dark suit, a white shirt with a stiff collar and a dark necktie. Grey hair, a moustache and a tiny chin beard, gaze directed straight at the viewer. Background greenish-grey.

6795.d: Heledas pluusis ja hallis pikas seelikus, ligi pead kammitud juustega heledapäine naine, käed süles, istumas. Pea poolpöördes paremale. Foon kohati markeeritud laiade pruuni ja rohelise värvi pintslitõmmtega. Alusjoonistust katab värvikiht vaid kohati ja õhukeselt.
6795.de: A fair-haired woman in a light blouse and a grey long skirt, hair combed close to the head, hands in lap, sitting. Head turned half-way to the right. Background marked in places with broad brown and green brushstrokes. The paint layer covers the underdrawing only in places and thinly.

6813.dm: kõrgus: 10.1 cm (vm); kujutise laius: 16.3 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 9.3 cm; laius: 17.2 cm (vm)
6813.d: Vasakul valges tanus vanema naise täisprofiilis rinnapilt paremale; paremal umbes samaealise, patsparukat kandva mehe täisprofiil vasakule.
6813.de: On the left, a full-profile bust of an older woman in a white bonnet, facing right; on the right, the full profile of a man of about the same age wearing a pigtail wig, facing left.

6815.d: Keskel valges rüüs Kristus hauaplaadil. Ümber ehmunud sõdurid - valvurid - kaks eespoolset on kummuli laskunud. Taga väänistega kattunud müüriosa, taevas, üleval serval koiduvalgus.
6815.de: In the centre Christ in a white robe on the tombstone slab. Around him startled soldiers - guards - the two in front have sunk down prostrate. Behind, a section of wall covered with tendrils, the sky, at the upper edge the light of dawn.

6838.d: Esiplaanil osaliselt jääga kaetud jõgi. Taga keskel sild, paremal hoonete siluetid, vasakul puudegrupp.
6838.de: In the foreground a river partly covered with ice. Behind, in the middle, a bridge, on the right silhouettes of buildings, on the left a group of trees.

6862.d: Lahesopis ranna ääres paadisildade vahel viis kaluripaati. Ees paremal, kalakastide, korvide vahel istuvad mehed. Pilvise taeva all kauge sinkjas metsatriip. Hoogne skitseeriv maalilaad.
6862.de: In a bay by the shore, among boat jetties, five fishing boats. In front on the right, men sitting among fish crates and baskets. Under a cloudy sky a distant bluish strip of forest. Vigorous, sketchy painting style.

6866.d: Vasakul ja keskel väljak üksikute inimfiguuridega. Paremal tellingutes ehitatav hoone. Taga keskel suur sammastega kivihoone.
6866.de: On the left and in the middle a square with individual human figures. On the right a building under construction with scaffolding. In the background in the middle a large stone building with columns.

6883.d: Vasakul pliidil küünlajalgu, nurgas poolavatud vakk, paremal aken, seintele riputatud rõivaid.
6883.de: On the left, on the stove, candlesticks, in the corner a half-open chest, on the right a window, clothes hung on the walls.

6893.d: Esiplaanil rohtmaa, üksikute sügistuules kõverdunud kaskedega. Keskel vasakult kaarjalt paremale kulgev, tahapoole järsult langev paeranniku äär. Taamal lainetav meri.
6893.de: In the foreground grassland, with solitary birches bent by the autumn wind. In the middle, curving from left to right and dropping steeply backward, the edge of a limestone coast. In the distance a rolling sea.

6894.d: Lagedas maastikus vasakul, ebamääraste jalgadega naise akt, mille ümber põimunud kaks madu.
6894.de: In an open landscape on the left, a female nude with indistinct legs, around which two snakes are entwined.

6895.d: Ees ristküliku kujulisel maa-alal aktiivsed varemed. Taustaks suitsev Vesuuv.
6895.de: In front, on a rectangular piece of land, active ruins. In the background, smoking Vesuvius.

6898.d: Istuva naise põlvportree profiilis, vaatega vasakule, käed süles. Peas kitsas, äärteta kübar. Taustaks lehtpuude oksad.
6898.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated woman in profile, facing left, hands in her lap. On her head a narrow, brimless hat. Background of deciduous tree branches.

6909.dm: kõrgus: 245.0 cm; kujutise laius: 171.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 243.5 cm; laius: 179.0 cm
6909.d: Alevivaade tiigi ja punase katusega majadega vasakul. Paremal kõrge tara ja üksik maja. Esiplaanil inimesi. Kaugemal põõsad, majad, metsad punakas valguses.
6909.de: View of a small town with a pond and red-roofed houses on the left. On the right a tall fence and a single house. People in the foreground. Further away bushes, houses, forests in reddish light.

6920.d: Ees paremal grupp noori kuuski. Paar okaspuud vasakus servas. Puude vahelt avaneb vaade silmapiiril metsaga piiratud lagendikule. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
6920.de: In front on the right a group of young spruces. A couple of conifers on the left edge. Between the trees a view opens onto a clearing bordered by forest on the horizon. Sketch-like manner of painting.

6936.d: "Rukkililled. A. Promet" Asukoht objektil: tagaküljel pliiatsikirjas.
6936.de: "Rukkililled. A. Promet" Location on object: on the reverse, in pencil.

6937.d: Vaiba all lamava habemiku mehe ees istuv naise figuur, parem käsi tõstetud sirutatult ette.
6937.de: A seated female figure in front of a bearded man lying under a carpet, right hand raised and extended forward.

6940.d: Veekogu kaldal, ees vasemal ja tagapool paremal tuules paindunud kasepaarid. Taevas tugevais sinistes toonides.
6940.de: On the shore of a body of water, in front on the left and further back on the right pairs of birches bent by the wind. The sky in strong blue tones.

6941.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, mille vasakul kaldal kivi ja üksik leinakask. Taga lagendik.
6941.de: In the foreground a body of water, on the left bank of which a rock and a solitary weeping birch. Behind it an open field.

6950.d: ... S. Rida ... Lilled köögilaual Asukoht objektil: tagaküljel all vasakul lipik.
6950.de: ... S. Rida ... Flowers on a kitchen table. Location on object: label at lower left on the back.

6951.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt peaaegu profiilis paremale. Seljas tume kuub rohekas toonis vestiga ja rohekas-musta narmaliste otstega kaelasidemega.
6951.de: Chest portrait of an older man almost in profile to the right. Wearing a dark coat in a greenish tone with a vest and a greenish-black necktie with fringed ends.

6952.d: Pikkade, sassis, heledate juustega habemiku vanamehe rinnapilt. Õlad kerge pöördega paremale, pea peaaegu en face.
6952.de: Bust portrait of an old bearded man with long, tousled, light-coloured hair. Shoulders slightly turned to the right, head almost en face.

6953.d: Interjööris nikerdatud laua ümber kolm mungarüüs meest. Vasakpoolne sileda lõuaga mees osutab tema ees olevasse raamatusse, kuna paremal pool lauda asuv valge pika habemega, kirjutamisega tegelenud munk seletab midagi, vasak käsi osutavas asendis ülespoole suunatud. Kolmas, noor mees laua taga istub mõtlikus poosis,  pea toetatud paremale käele.
6953.de: In an interior, around a carved table, three men in monks' robes. The clean-shaven man on the left points into the book in front of him, while the monk on the right side of the table, with a long white beard, who has been writing, explains something, his left hand raised upward in a gesturing position. The third, young man, sits behind the table in a pensive pose, his head resting on his right hand.

6956.d: Habemiku mehe täisfiguur, pool profiilis paremale, vasem käsi toetunud mõõgale, mundris, ordenitega, interjööris.
6956.de: Full figure of a bearded man, half profile to the right, left hand resting on a sword, in uniform, with orders, in an interior.

6960.d: Esiplaanil plats kaubitsejate telkidega, kahel pool puud ja paremal lossivaremed. Ostjaid ja jalutajaid.
6960.de: In the foreground a square with vendors' tents, trees on both sides and castle ruins on the right. Buyers and strollers.

6962.d: Keskealise naise rinnapilt peapöördega vasemale. Kõrgel soengul keisrikroon, hermeliinmantlil orden. Portreed ümbritseb ovaal.
6962.de: Bust of a middle-aged woman with head turned to the left. On her high coiffure an imperial crown, on her ermine mantle an order. The portrait is surrounded by an oval.

6963.d: Keskealise daami keha poolfiguur, poolprofiilis paremale, pea pöördega vasakule, vanaroosas, pitsidega ja seostega kleidis, parem käsi hoiab rohelist mantlit.
6963.de: The half-figure body of a middle-aged lady, in half-profile facing right, head turned to the left, in an old-rose dress with lace and ties, her right hand holding a green coat.

6964.d: Keskealise daami poolfiguur, kolmveerand profiilis vasakule, vanaroosas kuldtikandiga ja valge pits-garnituuriga kleidis, kaela ümber pael.
6964.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged lady, in three-quarter profile facing left, in an old-rose dress with gold embroidery and white lace trimming, a ribbon around the neck.

7003.d: Esiplaanil - ... mäelõhendikult küpressidega oruks muutuv maa-ala. Paremal värvirikas lagendik kividega. Taamal kogu silmapiiril sinetavad kõrgmäed lumiste tippudega.
7003.de: In the foreground - ... an area of land changing from a mountain gorge with cypresses into a valley. On the right a colourful clearing with stones. In the distance on the whole horizon, bluish high mountains with snowy peaks.

7024.d: Esiplaanil kivine rannariba, taga kuni madala horisondini laiuv meri üksiku purjekaga. Paremal kaks kolmandikku pildipinnast pilves taevaga.
7024.de: In the foreground a rocky strip of shore, behind it the sea extending to a low horizon with a single sailboat. On the right two-thirds of the picture surface is a cloudy sky.

7078.d: Esiplaanil muru üksikute põõsapuhmastega. Keskel hooneid. Nende taga puude grupid.
7078.de: In the foreground grass with single bushes. In the middle buildings. Behind them groups of trees.

7080.dm: lehe laius: 26.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 26.5 cm
7080.d: Lokkispäise, põskhabemega, sinises ohvitseri trentšis noormehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Üle vasaku õla visatud kasukas.
7080.de: Half-figure of a curly-haired, side-whiskered young man in a blue officer's trench coat, in half-profile to the right. A fur coat thrown over his left shoulder.

7081.dm: lehe laius: 26.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 26.3 cm
7081.d: Punases, õlgu vabaks jätvas sügavadekolteelises kleidis noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Taustaks pilvine taevas.
7081.de: Bust of a young woman in three-quarter profile to the left, in a red, deep-décolleté dress leaving the shoulders bare. Background of cloudy sky.

7082.d: Valges parukas keskealise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale.
7082.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in a white wig, in half-profile to the right.

7093.d: Punakajuukselise, terava lõuahabemega mehe täisfiguur, poolprofiilis vasakule. Vasak käsi mõõga käepidemel, parem kübarat hoidev käsi toetumas vasakul asuva laua nurgale. Rikkaliku tikandiga 17. sajandi riietuses pitskrae ja kätistega. Vasakul üleval asuva vapi all kiri.
7093.de: Full figure of a reddish-haired man with a pointed chin beard, in half profile to the left. His left hand rests on the hilt of a sword, his right hand, holding a hat, rests on the corner of a table located on the left. He wears richly embroidered 17th-century dress with a lace collar and cuffs. Below a coat of arms located upper left, an inscription.

7094.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, tagapool veepinnal peegelduv sild, ebamäärane ratsamonumendi siluett ja pargipuud.
7094.de: In the foreground a body of water, behind it a bridge reflecting on the water surface, an indistinct silhouette of an equestrian monument and park trees.

7095.d: Põlvpilt, peaaegu enface, pea kallutatud paremale, punases pitsidega kleidis, vasakus käes liilia; taustal Keila-Joa mõisa vaade.
7095.de: Knee-length portrait, almost en face, head tilted to the right, in a red lace dress, a lily in her left hand; in the background a view of Keila-Joa manor.

7108.d: Ovaalse näoga noore naise portree otsevaates, lõigatud õlgade kohalt. Naisel pikad tumedad juuksed seljal, kõrvas ripatsiga kõrvarõngad, seljas erkpunane ovaalse dekolteega kleit.
7108.de: Portrait of a young woman with an oval face, in frontal view, cropped above the shoulders. The woman has long dark hair on her back, earrings with pendants in her ears, wearing a bright red dress with an oval décolletage.

7123.d: Ees paremal telk. Taga üle oru sild, puud ja hooned.
7123.de: A tent in front on the right. Behind, a bridge over a valley, trees and buildings.

7124.d: Rinnapilt, enface, pikkade õlgadele laskuvate juustega. Nägu paremalt poolt teravalt valgustatud.
7124.de: Bust portrait, en face, with long hair falling onto the shoulders. The face is sharply lit from the right side.

7126.d: Noore sinises vormikuues mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale.
7126.de: Half-figure of a young man in a blue uniform coat, in half-profile to the right.

7149.d: Vaade taraga piiratud raagus puudega lumisele aiale. Vasakul ja tagaplaanil läbi puuvõrade paistmas lumiste katustega pruunikad majad. Maalitud hoogsalt, õhuliselt sinakais, pruunides toonides.
7149.de: View of a snowy garden with bare trees enclosed by a fence. On the left and in the background, brownish houses with snowy roofs showing through the tree crowns. Painted vigorously, airily, in bluish, brown tones.

7163.d: Heledas pluusis noore brüneti naise portree otsevaates.
7163.de: Frontal portrait of a young brunette woman in a light-coloured blouse.

7182.d: Noore naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule, valges riietuses, parem käsi viinamarjakobaraga rinnale kallutatud pea peal.
7182.de: Half-figure of a young woman in profile facing left, dressed in white, her right hand holding a bunch of grapes tilted toward her head.

7183.d: Triibulise riidega kaetud diivanil istuva, maani ulatuvas purpurses kleidis, raamatut lugeva noore naise poolprofiilis vasemale täisfiguur. Peas tume punane kübar.
7183.de: Full figure in half-profile facing left of a young woman seated on a sofa covered with striped fabric, reading a book, wearing a purple dress reaching to the floor. A dark red hat on her head.

7184.d: Esiplaanil vesi, millest keskel ulatuvad välja üksikud raagus puud. Tagaplaanil auva metsa veerel näha lund.
7184.de: Water in the foreground, from which solitary bare trees rise in the middle. In the background snow can be seen at the edge of a dense forest.

7185.d: Seisva mehe poolfiguur, kolmveerandis paremale, täishabeme ja vuntsidega, püstkraes, pikas kuues, helehalli kaelasidemega. Taust mustades ja hallides toonides.
7185.de: Half-figure of a standing man, in three-quarter view to the right, with full beard and moustache, in a stand-up collar, a long coat, and a light grey neckcloth. Background in black and grey tones.

7186.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, millel kolm lootsikut. Taamal mõlemal pool veekogu kallastega piiratud. Parempoolset rohtunud kaldalt paistavad majade katused. Vasakpoolne järsk kallas kaetud metsaga.
7186.de: In the foreground a body of water with three boats on it. Beyond, the water is bordered by banks on both sides. On the grassy right bank the roofs of houses are visible. The steep left bank is covered with forest.

7187.d: Naise poolfiguur pöördega vasakule seljas must kleit eest sügava dekolteega. Kaelas sametpael medaljoniga, vasakul õlal orden lindiga.
7187.de: Half-figure of a woman turned to the left, wearing a black dress with a deep décolletage in front. A velvet ribbon with a medallion around her neck, an order with a ribbon on her left shoulder.

7188.d: Vanema mehe rindportree, kerges pöördes paremale. Vuntsid, habe ja üle pea kammitud hallid juuksed. Sinine, punase püstkrae ja kuldtikandiga kuub. Valge kuldnööpidega vest ja krae. Taust tume pruun.
7188.de: Bust portrait of an older man, in a slight turn to the right. Moustache, beard, and grey hair combed over the head. Blue coat with a red stand-up collar and gold embroidery. White vest and collar with gold buttons. Dark brown background.

7189.d: Ees paremal näha istuva naise nägu ja jalgu. Istuja kõrval lähker ja riidesse seotud pamp. Taga põllul viljakoristajad.
7189.de: In front on the right, the face and legs of a seated woman are visible. Beside her a canteen and a bundle tied in cloth. Behind, harvesters in a field.

7190.d: Ees paremal mere ääres kaks pesu loputavat naist. Taga rannaviirg, vasakul äärel avameri.
7190.de: In front on the right, by the sea, two women rinsing laundry. Behind, the coastline, on the left edge the open sea.

7191.d: Ees vasakul rohumaal suur kivi. Kivist paremal (keskel) sihvakas kasetüvi. Taga mets.
7191.de: In the foreground on the left, on grassland, a large stone. To the right of the stone (in the middle), a slender birch trunk. Behind, forest.

7199.d: Rehe all eesti rahvarõivais (sinine seelik) naine istuvas asendis. Vasemas käes nõu, parem aga poetab teri.
7199.de: Woman in Estonian folk costume (blue skirt) seated under the threshing barn. A vessel in her left hand, scattering grain with her right.

7200.d: Tumerohelises vormikuues mehe põlvpilt - keha poolprofiilis paremale, pea vasakule. Vasakus, küünarnukiga barjäärile toetuvas käes mõõk; parem asetatud barjäärile laotatud paberile.
7200.de: Knee-length portrait of a man in a dark green uniform coat - body in three-quarter profile to the right, head to the left. In his left hand, resting elbow on the barrier, a sword; the right hand placed on paper spread on the barrier.

7206.d: Esiplaanil paremal itaalia rahvarõivastes neiu nõjatumas kaevu äärisele, lopsakate lehtpuude varjus asuvast lõvipea kujulisest fontäänist suuga veejuga püüdes, taga paremal Rooma Peetri kiriku siluett.
7206.de: In the foreground on the right a girl in Italian folk costume leaning on the rim of a well, catching a jet of water with her mouth from a lion-head-shaped fountain set in the shade of lush deciduous trees, behind on the right the silhouette of St. Peter's Church in Rome.

7207.d: Keskealise mehe rinnapilt, kõrge punase krae ja rinnaesisega munderkuues.
7207.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man, in a uniform coat with a high red collar and chest piece.

7208.d: Valges pitstanus ja -kraega keskealise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Üle õlgade punane rüü.
7208.de: Chest-length portrait of a middle-aged woman in a white lace bonnet and collar, in half-profile facing left. A red robe over her shoulders.

7212.d: Mehe rinnakujutis en face, pea kibuvitsakrooni ja oreooliga vasemale kallutatud, seljas punane rüü.
7212.de: Frontal bust of a man, head tilted to the left with a crown of thorns and a halo, wearing a red robe.

7215.d: Noore naise täisfiguur läbi portaalehituse paistva maastiku taustal. Naisel käes vaas. Pea ümber valgusoreool. Kordustöö Moskva Lunastaja kiriku jaoks maalitud teosest.
7215.de: Full figure of a young woman against a landscape visible through a portal structure. The woman holds a vase in her hand. A halo of light around her head. A repeat of a work painted for the Church of the Redeemer in Moscow.

7216.d: Keskel grupp inimesi Kristust ristilt maha võtmas Kristuse ristilt vabastamise momendil. Surnukeha haaravad mitmed käed, vasemast käest hoiavad ülal redelil seisvad kaks mehefiguuri. Paremal grupp inimesi, kes toetavad kokkuvarisevat Mariat. Vasemal surilina laotavad naised. Ees selgvaates mehefiguur. Hele valgus kaugel maali keskel - Kristuse kehale ja seda hoidvale mehefiguurile.
7216.de: In the centre a group of people taking Christ down from the cross, at the moment of Christ's release from the cross. Several hands grasp the body, on the left hand two male figures standing on a ladder hold it up. On the right a group of people supporting the collapsing Mary. On the left women spreading a shroud. In front, a male figure in clear view. Bright light far in the centre of the painting - on Christ's body and the male figure holding it.

7220.d: Noore mehe rinnapilt peapöördega vasemale. Lühikesed lokkis juuksed, vurrud. Seljas lahtise kaelusega valge särk ja punase ääristusega must vest.
7220.de: Bust of a young man with head turned to the left. Short curly hair, moustache. Wearing a white shirt with open collar and a black waistcoat with red trim.

7223.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv jõgi. Ees paremal ja tagapool vasemal rohtunud jõekaldad. Tagapool vasakul üksikuid puid, keskel kivisild, sellest üle sõitva leinakoormaga. Taga paremal künkad ja mäed.
7223.de: A river running from front left to back right. In front right and further back left grassy riverbanks. Further back on the left a few solitary trees, in the middle a stone bridge, with a funeral procession crossing over it. Further back on the right hills and mountains.

7224.d: Eest taha suunduv jõgi kollane loojuvast päikesest. Vasakul ja paremal kuldne lehtpuu.
7224.de: A river running from front to back, yellow from the setting sun. Golden deciduous tree on the left and right.

7225.d: Ees küngaste vahel allapoole laskuv tee. Üle tiheda põõsastiku vaade linnakatustele ja valgele kirikule.
7225.de: In front, a road descending among hills. Over dense shrubbery a view of city rooftops and a white church.

7227.d: Kaljul istuv mungarõivais mees, kellele linnud ulatavad toitu. Paremal oja.
7227.de: A man in monk's robes sitting on a rock, to whom birds bring food. A stream on the right.

7230.d: Esiplaanil jõgi madala kaldaga ja üksiku suure puuga. Taga paremal sild. Fooniks mets.
7230.de: In the foreground a river with a low bank and a single large tree. Behind it on the right a bridge. Forest as background.

7241.d: Kivises rannamaastikus grupp naisi ja mehi aerudega õlgadel.
7241.de: In a rocky coastal landscape, a group of women and men with oars on their shoulders.

7249.dm: kõrgus: 29.7 cm (vineeri mõõt); laius: 18.9 cm (vm); kõrgus: 25.8 cm (vm); laius: 23.0 cm (vineeri mõõt)
7249.d: Tumedajuukselise keskealise mehe pea kerge pöördega paremale.
7249.de: The head of a dark-haired middle-aged man turned slightly to the right.

7253.d: Esiplaanil vasakul noor heledajuukseline tütarlaps valge pikakäiselise pluusi ja tumeda seelikuga, vemmal käes, tema kõrval raagus lehtpuud. Kaugemal kollendavate puudega ääristatud lagendikul kari söömas. Silmapiiril tume sinine metsamüür. Taevas sügiseselt pilves. Maastik luituvate värvitoonidega.
7253.de: In the foreground on the left, a young fair-haired girl in a white long-sleeved blouse and a dark skirt, with a stick in her hand, beside her bare deciduous trees. Further away, in a clearing bordered by yellowing trees, a herd is grazing. On the horizon a dark blue wall of forest. The sky autumnally overcast. The landscape in fading colour tones.

7254.d: Esiplaanil suur kartuliväli lahtiaetud vagudega, vasakul vagusid lahtiajav mees hobusega, kartulivõtjad grupeerunud vasakul 3-kesi, keskel 2-kesi ja paremal äärel üks kummardunud korvi kohale. Ülal sünkjais pilvis keerlevad linnud, paremal silmapiiril hoonete ähmased kontuurid, mets, avar lage väli selle ees. Inimfiguurid ja maapind maalitud laiade pintslitõmmetega rohekais-pruunides toonides.
7254.de: In the foreground a large potato field with opened-up furrows, on the left a man with a horse opening up the furrows, potato pickers grouped in threes on the left, in twos in the middle, and on the right edge one bent over above a basket. Above, in gloomy clouds, birds circling, on the right on the horizon the hazy contours of buildings, a forest, a wide open field in front of it. The human figures and the ground are painted with broad brushstrokes in greenish-brown tones.

7304.d: Noore tumedajuukselise naise figuur suunaga vasemale. Paremas käes mõõk, vasemas Holofernese pea. Paremal taga teine naise figuur.
7304.de: The figure of a young dark-haired woman facing left. A sword in the right hand, Holofernes's head in the left. Behind on the right another female figure.

7306.d: Keskel istuv heledajuukseline nainepaljastatud ülakeha otse vaates, pea pöördega paremale, peegli suunas, mida hoiab väike Amor.
7306.de: In the middle a seated fair-haired woman with bared upper body seen frontally, head turned to the right, towards a mirror held by a small Cupid.

7308.d: Antiikses rõivastuses noore, heledajuukselise naise põlvpilt vasakul asuvale härjale nõjatumas. Naise nägu poolprofiilis paremale, vaade suunatud üles. Härjal sarvede ümber lillepärg.
7308.de: Knee-length portrait of a young, fair-haired woman in antique dress leaning against a bull on the left. The woman's face is in three-quarter profile to the right, gaze directed upward. The bull has a wreath of flowers around its horns.

7311.d: Laua ääres istuva noore naise põlv pilt poolprofiilis paremale. Peas valge lihtsajooneline tanu, seljas tumedast riidest kleit laia sileda valge krae ja kätistega. Vasak käsi nõjatub küünarnukiga lauale, paremas käes punane nelgiõis. Ermitaažis asuval originaalil ülal paremal signatuur: Rembrandt f. 1656.
7311.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman sitting at a table, in half-profile to the right. On her head a white, simply shaped bonnet, wearing a dark cloth dress with a broad smooth white collar and cuffs. Left hand resting elbow on the table, in the right hand a red carnation flower. On the original, located in the Hermitage, upper right, the signature: Rembrandt f. 1656.

7312.d: Istuva naise figuur põlvini, poolprofiilis vasemale 16. saj. riietuses. Naise kõrval all vasakul laps.
7312.de: Figure of a seated woman to the knees, in half-profile to the left, in 16th-century dress. A child beside the woman at lower left.

7314.d: Keskealise habemiku mehe rinnapilt, õlal rist.
7314.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged bearded man, a cross on the shoulder.

7315.d: Noore sammuva naise täisfiguur, suunaga vasemale, jalas sandaalid, seljas roheline seelik, roosakas pluus. Üleval taga romantiline maastik.
7315.de: Full figure of a young walking woman, facing left, wearing sandals, a green skirt, a pinkish blouse. In the background above, a romantic landscape.

7322.d: Vasak käsi: peopesa välja pööratud, sõrmed kergelt kõverdatud.
7322.de: Left hand: palm turned outward, fingers slightly bent.

7323.d: Parem käsi randmeni, sõrmed kergelt kõverdatud.
7323.de: right hand to the wrist, fingers slightly bent.

7324.d: Parem käsi selgvaates. Sõrmed kõverdatud. Kavand.
7324.de: Right hand in clear view. Fingers bent. Sketch.

7325.de: Crossed arms to the wrist. Sketch.

7326.de: Left hand clenched into a fist. Oil sketch.

7327.d: Magav lapsefiguur lamavas asendis, poolkaetult. Figuuri paigutus diagonaalselt vasemalt üles paremale.
7327.de: Sleeping child figure in a lying position, half-covered. The figure is placed diagonally from lower left to upper right.
