7328.d: Habemiku mehe rinnapilt peapöördega vasemale, pilk suunatud üles.
7328.de: Chest portrait of a bearded man with his head turned to the left, gaze directed upward.

7330.de: Vague figures of three playing children.

7331.d: Triibulisel vaibal istuv paljastatud ülakehaga noor, tumedajuukseline naine, suunaga profiilis paremale, kusjuures pea on pööratud vaatega parema õla suunas. Naisel peakatteks turban, kõrvas kõrvarõngas. Põlvil lebavas vasakus käes paabulinnusulgedest lehvik, paremal käel ümber randme kaks pärlkäevõru; jalas idamaise lõikega tuhvlid. Vasakul naise kõrval gitarrilaadne keelpill.
7331.de: A young, dark-haired woman with a bared upper body sits on a striped rug, facing right in profile, with her head turned looking towards her right shoulder. The woman wears a turban as headwear, an earring in her ear. In her left hand, resting on her knee, a fan of peacock feathers, on her right wrist two pearl bracelets; on her feet slippers of oriental cut. To the woman's left a guitar-like stringed instrument.

7332.d: Naise täisfiguur kolme lapsega. Üks alasti laps süles; teine parema käe kõrval; kolmas laps valge lühikese särgiga paremal, profiilis vasakule. Grupist paremal taamal kaks puud.
7332.de: Full figure of a woman with three children. One naked child in her lap; a second beside her right hand; a third child wearing a short white shirt on the right, in profile to the left. To the right of the group, in the distance, two trees.

7336.d: Fragment: tumedasse ovaali maalitud naisepea ülestõstetud pilguga, pikkadel juustel lillevanik.
7336.de: Fragment: a woman's head painted into a dark oval, with an upturned gaze, a wreath of flowers on long hair.

7338.d: Tondoformaadis maal kahe lendleva putoga. Neil käes avatud raamatud, parempoolsel tiivad kirjud.
7338.de: A tondo-format painting with two flying putti. They hold open books, the one on the right has spotted wings.

7339.d: Tondoformaadis maal kahe lendleva putoga. Neil käes avatud raamatud, vasakpoolsel tiivad kirjud.
7339.de: A tondo-format painting with two flying putti. They hold open books in their hands, the one on the left has colourful wings.

7341.d: Keskelt lahku, üle pea kammitud juustega noore naise rinnapilt poolprof. paremale. Seljas hall, eest nööbitud kleit.
7341.de: Chest portrait of a young woman with her hair parted in the middle and combed over the head, in half-profile to the right. Wearing a grey dress buttoned in front.

7343.d: Esiplaanil kivirahnudega tasandik. Kärestikulise ojaga, taga mets ja silmapiiril lumised mäetipud.
7343.de: In the foreground a plain with boulders. With a rapid stream, behind it a forest and snowy mountain peaks on the horizon.

7347.d: Esiplaanil kivimüüris trepiga uks, astmeil punases riietuses vanamehe figuur hellebardiga käes, kõrval kruus. Treppiastmeil vallatlevaid rotte.
7347.de: In the foreground a door with steps in a stone wall, on the steps the figure of an old man in red clothing holding a halberd, with a jug beside him. Rats frolicking on the steps.

7348.d: Ees lumine lagendik, vasemal üksikuid kaski. Taga raagus lehtpuumets.
7348.de: A snowy clearing in front, single birches on the left. Bare deciduous forest behind.

7365.d: Linal ees vasakul klaaskann vedelikuga. Paremal leivapäts taldrikul, kaks klaasi ja ümmarik savikann.
7365.de: On the canvas in front, on the left a glass jug with liquid. On the right a loaf of bread on a plate, two glasses and a round clay jug.

7377.d: Noormehe rinnapilt peapöördega poolprofiilis paremale. Peas parukas, tumedale ülikonnale pööratud pruunikas toonis krae, ees kaks samavärvilist nööpi.
7377.de: Bust portrait of a young man with his head turned in half-profile to the right. Wearing a wig, a brownish-toned collar turned over a dark suit, with two buttons of the same colour in front.

7379.d: Tugevatele tugisammastele toetuvate lavade võlvkaartega ruumis kireb seltskond. Ees vasakul keelpillidega ja üks laulja ettekandel; keskel, kaetud laua ümber istuvaid ja seisvaid mehi veini rüüpamas; paremal ees pingil istuv tüse naine juurvilja koorimas, tema kõrval mustas mungarüüs mees. Paremal äärel rida aame püsti, nende ees tütarlaps ja noormes. Kõigil isikuil 17. sajandi rõivastus.
7379.de: A lively company in a room with vaulted arches resting on sturdy supporting pillars. In front on the left, a performance with string instruments and a singer; in the middle, men sitting and standing around a set table sipping wine; on the right in front, a stout woman sitting on a bench peeling vegetables, next to her a man in a black monk's robe. Along the right edge a row of barrels standing upright, in front of them a girl and a young man. All persons wear 17th-century clothing.

7381.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduval teel rändur; paremal kivirahnud, tagaplaanil mets.
7381.de: In the foreground on a road leading from left to right a wanderer; on the right boulders, in the background a forest.

7382.d: Noore naise, peaaegu enface, laiaäärelises mustas kübaras ja mustas mantlis. Kõrvas kõrvarõngas.
7382.de: A young woman, almost en face, in a wide-brimmed black hat and a black coat. An earring in her ear.

7383.d: Ees kaljuküngaste vahel poollamavas asendis püssi sihtiv kasakas. Tema taga, vasakul, seisev vana habemik kasakas, püss käes.
7383.de: In front, between rocky hills, a Cossack in a half-lying position aiming a rifle. Behind him, on the left, a standing old bearded Cossack, with a rifle in hand.

7388.d: Esiplaanil lumelagendik, keskel ja taamal raagus puuderühmi.
7388.de: In the foreground a snowy expanse, in the middle and beyond groups of bare trees.

7392.d: Esiplaanil metsatukk küüniga, taamal lumeväljade keskel majad, mets.
7392.de: In the foreground a copse with a barn, in the distance houses and forest amid snowy fields.

7419.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand. Taamal lahesopi taga kaldal ehitusel olev kaljas, selle lähedal üksik mänd. Paremal madal hoone.
7419.de: Rocky shore in the foreground. In the distance, beyond an inlet, a schooner under construction on the shore, a solitary pine near it. A low building on the right.

7427.d: Võlvitud laega ruumi sisemus, rikkaliku laemaaliga, paremal seinal maal ja keskel sammas.
7427.de: The interior of a vaulted room, with a rich ceiling painting, on the right wall a painting and in the middle a column.

7432.d: Esiplaanil kitsas tänavalaik, mis läbi võlvialuse suundudes teeb käänaku vasemale. Vanade majade keskelt tõuseb torn, mille tipu lõikab maali ülaserv. Katused kaetud lumega. Rohekas üldgamma.
7432.de: In the foreground a narrow strip of street which, passing through an archway, turns to the left. Among the old houses a tower rises, its tip cut off by the upper edge of the painting. Roofs covered with snow. Overall greenish gamut.

7434.d: Järve rand üksikute hoonete ja suurte kividega. Eemal vasakul saar.
7434.de: Lake shore with individual buildings and large stones. In the distance on the left an island.

7436.d: Esiplaanil pildi sügavusse pöörduv jõekäär, millest paremal väike saareke või maanukk põõsaste ja kahe lehtpuuga. Jõe vasak, liivane kallas tõuseb mäkke, mis kaetud mändidega. Esiplaanil vasakul, pea otse veepiirilt välja kasvav lepp, mille peegeldus paistab vees. Taamal keskel, mändide vahel valge viilkatusega maja. Ülal sinine, pisut pilvine taevas. Maalitud väikeste, lopsakate pintslilöökidega.
7436.de: In the foreground a river bend turning into the depth of the picture, to the right of which a small island or spit of land with bushes and two deciduous trees. The left, sandy bank of the river rises into a hill covered with pines. In the foreground on the left, an alder growing almost right out of the waterline, its reflection visible in the water. Further back in the centre, among the pines, a house with a white gable roof. Above, a blue, slightly cloudy sky. Painted with small, lush brushstrokes.

7438.d: Esiplaanil, kujutise laiuselt raagus puid, vasakul üks puu teistest jämedam, ülal hargneb kaheks. Puude taga Niguliste kiriku pikihoone osaliselt ja torn, mille ülaosa kujutise servaga ära lõigatud. Taevas helesinine.
7438.de: In the foreground, across the width of the image, bare trees, on the left one tree thicker than the others, branching into two above. Behind the trees the nave of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) partially visible and the tower, whose upper part is cut off by the edge of the image. Sky pale blue.

7441.dm: lehe laius: 49.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 62.5 cm
7441.d: Avatud pildiraamatu ees kükitav poisike. Parem käsi asetatud pallile.
7441.de: A boy crouching in front of an open picture book. Right hand placed on a ball.

7492.d: Tumedate, kuklasse kammitud juustega naise rinnapilt pooprofiilis vasakule. Krae asemel kaela seotud valge rätik.
7492.de: Bust portrait of a woman with dark hair combed into a bun, in half profile to the left. Instead of a collar a white scarf tied around her neck.

7496.d: Paremal kivine mererand, tagapool künkal varemed, mille otsaküljel mehefiguurid lõkke ümber. Vasemal purjedega kaluripaadid ankrus, taamal meri. Ülal vasemal kuu (pastoosne), kust langeb valgushelk merele. Tumedad, sünged värvitoonid.
7496.de: On the right a rocky seashore, further back on a hillock ruins, on the end wall of which are men's figures around a bonfire. On the left fishing boats with sails at anchor, beyond them the sea. Upper left the moon (pastose), from which a gleam of light falls onto the sea. Dark, sombre colour tones.

7497.d: Eest vasakult taha keskele künka taha kaduv tee hoonetegrupiga vasakul. Paremal, lagendikul grupp inimesi ja üksik kits. Tagapool üksiku palkhoone katus ja otsviil. Selle taga põõsastik. Taustaks järsuküljelised mäed. Keskelt vaade kaugemalolevale veekogule.
7497.de: A road disappearing from the front left to the back center behind a hill, with a group of buildings on the left. On the right, in a clearing, a group of people and a solitary goat. Further back, the roof and gable end of a single log building. Behind it, shrubbery. In the background, steep-sided mountains. In the center, a view of a distant body of water.

7505.d: Esiplaanil rühm mände, tagaplaanil soomaastik üksikute puudega, veeloikudega; madal horisondijoon, taevas valgustatud paremast servast.
7505.de: In the foreground a group of pines, in the background a marshland landscape with isolated trees, pools of water; low horizon line, the sky lit from the right edge.

7506.d: Varasügisene maastik. Esiplaanil kitsas jalgrada, mis viib taamal paistva veekogu äärde. Kahelpool teed lehtpuude grupp. Vasakpoolse puudegrupi vahelt paistab väike punase katusega maja.
7506.de: Early autumn landscape. In the foreground a narrow footpath leading to a body of water visible in the distance. On both sides of the path a group of deciduous trees. Between the trees of the left-hand group a small house with a red roof can be seen.

7542.dm: kõrgus: 31.2 cm; kujutise laius: 21.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 29.7 cm; laius: 23.5 cm
7542.d: Vanamehe pea poolprofiilis paremale. Pikk blond habe ja juuksed. Pead ümbritseb pruunikas toonis ovaal mustal taustal.
7542.de: Head of an old man in half-profile to the right. Long blond beard and hair. The head is surrounded by a brownish oval on a black background.

7543.d: Esiplaanil paremal kadale kinnitatud lootsik. Vasakul puudesalk. Tagaplaanil paremal meri pilvedega selle kohal.
7543.de: In the foreground on the right a boat tied to a juniper. On the left a grove of trees. In the background on the right the sea with clouds above it.

7556.d: Vanema hallipäise mehe rinnapilt peaaegu otsevaates. Ristsideme tagantulatuvad krae nurgad vastu lõuga.
7556.de: Chest portrait of an older grey-haired man, almost in a direct view. The corners of the collar, coming from behind on a cross-tie, touch the chin.

7559.d: Esiplaanil aia ääres seisva tütarlapse põlvpilt profiilis paremale; peas rätik, käes vits, vasem küünarnukk toetub tara latile, paremal äärel sügavasse suunduv tee, tee ääres lehm ja lehtpuid, taamal mets.
7559.de: In the foreground a knee-length portrait, in profile to the right, of a girl standing by a fence; a kerchief on her head, a switch in her hand, left elbow resting on a fence rail, on the right edge a road leading into the distance, by the road a cow and deciduous trees, a forest in the distance.

7580.d: Vasakul, ees oleva lagendiku serval kindlusehituse varemed. Taamal, paremal üksik hoone. Taustaks mäed.
7580.de: On the left, at the edge of a clearing in front, the ruins of a fortification. In the distance, on the right, a single building. Mountains as the background.

7581.d: Ees lage künklik maastik. Tagapool vasakul, keskel ja paremal puude ja põõsastike vööndi vahel hooned.
7581.de: In the foreground a bare hilly landscape. Behind, at left, centre and right, buildings between a belt of trees and shrubs.

7582.d: Ees lõunamaa taimedest ja väänkasvudest ümbritsetud terrassil kükitav naine väikese lapsega. Vasakult, terrassilt avaneb vaade merele.
7582.de: In front, on a terrace surrounded by southern plants and climbing vines, a crouching woman with a small child. From the left, from the terrace, a view opens onto the sea.

7584.d: Ees keskel sügavale merre tungiv kai inimgruppidega ja randuva sõudepaadi ja purjekaga. Vasakul näha järsuseinalise kaljuse kalda serva. Paremal, suunaga taha keskele vulkaaniliste mägede ahelik.
7584.de: In the centre foreground a pier reaching deep into the sea with groups of people and a rowing boat and a sailing boat coming ashore. On the left the edge of a steep, rocky shore is visible. On the right, receding toward the centre, a chain of volcanic mountains.

7586.d: Liivasel mäestikurajal kolm kasakarõivais, relvastatud ratsanikku. Taustaks roosaka helgiga mäeahelik.
7586.de: On a sandy mountain path three armed horsemen in Cossack dress. In the background a mountain range with a pinkish glow.

7623.d: Kivise ranna juures paat. Teisel pool paati punase särgiga, rohelise vestiga nokkmütsiga mees. Paadist paremale ranna poole sammuv mees. Vasaku käega hoiab pütti, paremaga toetab õlal kandvat esey. Merel kolm purjekat.
7623.de: A boat by a stony shore. On the other side of the boat a man with a red shirt, green waistcoat and a peaked cap. A man walking from the boat towards the shore. He holds a pail in his left hand, supports a shoulder-carried burden with his right. Three sailing boats at sea.

7625.d: Esiplaanil kõrkjatega veepind. Tagapool rohelised kaldad puudegruppidega.
7625.de: In the foreground a water surface with sedges. Behind it green banks with groups of trees.

7627.d: Esiplaanil paremal vanamees koeraga, keskel torn ja vana linnamüür.
7627.de: In the foreground on the right an old man with a dog, in the middle a tower and an old town wall.

7629.d: Ees vasakul kivimüüri nurk, millest üle paistab okaspuulatvu. Keskel ja paremal lage rohtunud maa. Kaugemal üksikud puude salgad. Taamal mets.
7629.de: In front on the left a corner of a stone wall, over which conifer treetops can be seen. In the middle and on the right open grassy land. Further away isolated groups of trees. In the background a forest.

7630.d: Mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Peas laiaääreline kübar, seljas pikk kuub, käte vahel kitarr mängimise asendis.
7630.de: Half-figure of a man in half-profile facing right. On his head a broad-brimmed hat, wearing a long coat, holding a guitar between his hands in playing position.

7631.d: Esialal keskel tüse, jändrik kadakas, selle kõrval üksikuid kive. Taamal üle lageda rohumaa võsaviirg.
7631.de: In the middle of the foreground a stout, gnarled juniper, beside it a few stones. In the distance a strip of scrub across open grassland.

7636.d: Mustas, laiaäärelises kübaras vana, kortsusnäolise, apelsinikorvi süles hoidva naise rinnapilt (en face).
7636.de: Bust portrait (en face) of an old woman with a wrinkled face, wearing a black, wide-brimmed hat, holding a basket of oranges in her lap.

7639.dm: kõrgus: 76.0 cm (arm); laius: 56.2 cm (lm); kõrgus: 72.3 cm (lm); laius: 60.0 cm (arm)
7639.d: Poisikese alasti täisfiguur istuvas asendis, poolprofiilis pöördega vasakule.
7639.de: Full nude figure of a boy in a seated position, in three-quarter profile turned to the left.

7640.d: Pruunijuukselise noore naise rinnapilt täisprofiilis vasakule. Ümber õlgade kaela ja osaliselt rinda paljaks jättev õhuline valge rüü.
7640.de: Bust of a young brown-haired woman in full profile to the left. An airy white robe around her shoulders, leaving her neck and part of her breast bare.

7641.d: Pea peale kammitud juustega noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas tume, kõrge kaelusega kleit. Taust tumepruun.
7641.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with hair combed up, in half-profile to the left. Wearing a dark, high-collared dress. Background dark brown.

7642.d: Pruunide juustega, otsaesisele kammitud tukaga noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas kõrge kaelusega tume kleit.
7642.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with brown hair combed into a fringe on the forehead, in three-quarter profile to the right. Wearing a dark dress with a high collar.

7643.d: Hallipäise habemiku mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas tume ülikond.
7643.de: Bust of a grey-haired bearded man in half-profile facing right. Wearing a dark suit.

7645.d: Ees teekurv suunaga vasakule. Vasakule suunduva tee ääres aiaga piiratud taluhooned, (paremat kätt teed ja vasakul pool) puuderida. Horisondil metsad.
7645.de: In front, a bend in the road heading to the left. Along the road leading to the left, farm buildings enclosed by a fence, (on the right side of the road and on the left) a row of trees. Forests on the horizon.

7648.d: Kolmveerandis paremale mehe poolfiguur, kurrude ja habemesalguga alumise huule all, lühikeste vastu pead pruunide juustega, kollakas-pruunil foonil mustas kuues.
7648.de: A three-quarter view to the right of a man's half-figure, with wrinkles and a beard growth beneath the lower lip, with short brown hair against his head, on a yellowish-brown background, in a black robe.

7654.d: Esiplaanil vasemal ja paremal jämedad puud. Tagapool vasemal mets, paremal lagendik mäesiluettidega kauguses.
7654.de: In the foreground, on the left and right, thick trees. Behind, on the left a forest, on the right a clearing with mountain silhouettes in the distance.

7655.d: Pikkade juustega, vurrude ja habemega keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Üle õlgade keebitaoline mantel ristiga vasakul hõlmal, puusal mõõk.
7655.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with long hair, moustache and beard, in half-profile to the left. A cloak-like mantle over the shoulders with a cross on the left flap, a sword at the hip.

7656.d: Violetselt helendava maastiku taustal mäeveerel karvamütsiga tšigiti riietuses ja relvastuses ratsanik hobuste kõrval.  Lipul on rippumas kaks tupsu. Nurgas poolkuu. Detailitäpne kujutamisviis.
7656.de: Against a background of a violet-glowing landscape on a mountain slope, a rider in fur hat and Chiguit dress and armament next to horses. Two tassels are hanging from the banner. A crescent moon in the corner. A detailed manner of depiction.

7657.d: Esiplaanil kivine lagendik üksiku madala põõsaga vasakul. Taga roosakad ja valged mäed. Vasakul taeval lindude kolmnurk.
7657.de: Rocky clearing in the foreground with a single low bush on the left. Pinkish and white mountains behind. A triangle of birds in the sky on the left.

7658.d: Esiplaanil tagurpidi pööratud pingist "kelgul" istuv poiss ja teda vedav tütarlaps. Nende taga lumememm. Pisut kaugemal lumine müür ja üle müüri paistvad puudekroonid.
7658.de: In the foreground a boy sitting on an upturned bench as if on a "sledge", pulled by a girl. Behind them a snowman. A little further off a snowy wall and treetops visible above the wall.

7660.d: Püti otsas istuv eesti talumees, torupilli puhumas.
7660.de: An Estonian peasant man sitting on a barrel, playing the bagpipes.

7670.d: Ees paremal väikesest müürinurgast osaliselt varjatud väljak. Vasakul müür mida katkestab taga keskel kõrgemale terrassile viiv trepp. Taga hooned. Üle hoonete näha ümartorni.
7670.de: In front, on the right, a square partially hidden by a small corner of a wall. On the left a wall interrupted in the back centre by a staircase leading up to a higher terrace. Buildings behind. Above the buildings a round tower is visible.

7706.d: Ees künka harjal kännustik seenelistega. Paremalt alla vasakule suunduva teega. Horisondil mäed.
7706.de: In front, on the crest of a hill, a cluster of tree stumps with mushroom pickers. With a path leading from the right down to the left. Mountains on the horizon.

7709.d: Lapse rinnapilt otsevaates, vasak õlg ettepoole pööratud, peal kerge kallak paremale.
7709.de: Chest portrait of a child in frontal view, left shoulder turned forward, head slightly tilted to the right.

7713.d: Ees keskel veekogu. Vasakul, kergelt kõrgenev kallas põõsastiku ja puude reaga. Kaugemal väike osmik. Keskel ja paremal viljapõllud koristajatega. Taamal, horisondil, üksik tuuleveski.
7713.de: In the front centre a body of water. On the left, a slightly rising bank with a row of bushes and trees. Further away a small hut. In the centre and on the right grain fields with harvesters. In the distance, on the horizon, a solitary windmill.

7714.d: Esiplaanil müüriäärsel rohuplatsil kaks figuuri koeraga, tagapool tõusval maapinnal puud ja punaste kivikatustega majad ning keskaegne ümmarik kindlustorn, kaugemal kerkib Oleviste kiiver.
7714.de: In the foreground on a grassy plot by the wall two figures with a dog, further back on rising ground trees and houses with red tile roofs and a medieval round fortification tower, further away the spire of Oleviste rises.

7718.d: Vasakul rannaliival suuri kive. Paremal, merel, üksik purjekas. 2/3 tööst pilvise, loojuva päikesega taeva all.
7718.de: On the left large stones on the beach sand. On the right, at sea, a lone sailboat. 2/3 of the work a cloudy sky with a setting sun.

7720.d: Esiplaanil vasemal jõekallas puude, paadi ja figuuridega, keskel jõgi kaluritega, taga mäed ja loss, loojuva päikese valguses.
7720.de: In the foreground left a riverbank with trees, a boat and figures, in the middle a river with fishermen, behind mountains and a castle, in the light of the setting sun.

7728.d: Tinahallides toonides merevaade kahe väikese paadiga paremal serva ees ja hulga suuremate kalapaatidega (purjepaatidega) keskplaanis. Silmapiiril tumehall viirg. Ülal helehallide pilvedega kaetud kahvatusinine taevas.
7728.de: In tin-grey tones a sea view with two small boats at the front edge on the right and a number of larger fishing boats (sailboats) in the middle ground. On the horizon a dark grey streak. Above, a pale blue sky covered with light grey clouds.

7734.d: Vaipadega kaetud põrandaga toa nurk: ees paremal ümmargune laud. Samas seinas kahe tooli vahel raamaturiiul, sellel lilli, kell ja keraamikat. Nurgas kapp. Seinal maalid.
7734.de: A corner of a room with a carpeted floor: in front, on the right, a round table. On the same wall, between two chairs, a bookshelf with flowers, a clock and ceramics on it. A cupboard in the corner. Paintings on the wall.

7735.d: Kirjul kattel asuvas tumedas kõrvaga kruusis kirevad (heledais punastes, kollastes, lillades toonides) lilled. Kõrval vasakul pokaal. Värv kohati väga pastoosne.
7735.de: On a mottled saucer, in a dark jug with a handle, colourful flowers (in light red, yellow, lilac tones). To the left, a goblet. The paint is in places very pastose.

7736.d: Tallinna vaade "Paksu Margarite" juures, esiplaanil end. Rosengarteni küngas, taga linnamajad Paksu Margareta ja Bremeni torniga, keskel Oleviste kirik.
7736.de: A view of Tallinn near "Paks Margareeta", in the foreground the former Rosengarten hill, behind city buildings with Paks Margareeta and the Bremen Tower, in the middle St. Olaf's Church.

7738.d: Rohke rüüžiga äärestatud tanus keskealise naise poolfiguur peaaegu en face. Taga vasakul ja paremal stiliseeritud kuused.
7738.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman almost en face, in a bonnet trimmed with abundant ruching. Behind, on the left and right, stylised spruces.

7741.d: Ees paremal kõrge kaljurahn. Keskel ja vasakul rohtunud maa-ala hiigelsuure kiviga vasakpoolses osas. Taga kaljuahelik.
7741.de: In front on the right a tall rocky crag. In the middle and on the left a grassy area with a huge stone in its left part. Behind, a mountain range.

7742.d: Vasakul esiplaanil kolm tugevat mändi - lillakashallis toonis tagaplaanis päikesest valgustatud mets paremal ees valguslaikudega teerada.
7742.de: On the left in the foreground three sturdy pine trees - in the background a sunlit forest in lilac-grey tones, on the right in front a forest path with patches of light.

7743.d: Eest taha paremale suunduv ja tõusev teekurv ääristatud kivimüüriga. Üle vasakpoolse müüri näha kellatorni. Taamal kõrged mäed.
7743.de: A road curve, walled with stone, running from front to back and rising to the right. Over the wall on the left a bell tower is visible. High mountains in the distance.

7744.d: Paremal kivihoone sein uksega, millest tagapool eendub väljaehitus. Vasakul plank, millest üle ulatuvad õitsevad sireli puhmad. Risti üle õue nöör kuivava pesuga. Pisut eespool, keset õue korv pesuga.
7744.de: On the right a stone building's wall with a door, behind which an extension projects. On the left a fence, over which blooming lilac bushes reach. A line with drying laundry stretched across the yard. A little further forward, in the middle of the yard, a basket with laundry.

7746.d: Molberti ees istuva keskealise, tumedajuukselise habemiku mehe põlvpilt, veerandprofiilis paremale. Vasakus käes palett ja pintsleid, parem pintsliga värvi segamas.
7746.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged, dark-haired bearded man sitting in front of an easel, in quarter-profile to the right. A palette and brushes in his left hand, the right hand mixing paint with a brush.

7747.d: Eest paremalt nurgast taha, keskel läbi teivasaia värava suunduv, rohumaasse tallatud teerada. Keskel, paremal, aia ääres kaks suurt puud.
7747.de: In front, from the right corner, a footpath trodden into the grass leads towards the back through a gate in a pole fence in the centre. In the centre, on the right, by the fence, two large trees.

7748.d: Esiplaanil liivane küngas kolme suurema männiga selle keskel. Taga männik.
7748.de: In the foreground a sandy hill with three large pines in its middle. Behind, a pine forest.

7750.d: Keskel kahe suure puu all istumas grupp inimesi. Vasakul naine rehaga üle õla sammumas grupi poole, pisut kaugemal naine riisumas. Horisondil mets.
7750.de: In the middle, under two large trees, a group of people sitting. On the left a woman walking with a rake over her shoulder towards the group, a little further away a woman raking. On the horizon a forest.

7751.d: Kuus ukraina rahvarõivais last esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes profiilis paremale istuva, karusnahkse mütsiga ja pikka pruuni mantlisse riietatud jutustava ja žestikuleeriva meje ümber. Tema ees, kompositsiooni paremal poolel, istuvad kaks tumesinisesse riietatud tütarlast, nende selja taga seisavad vitstest punutud aiale toetuv valges pluusis vanem, ja kompositsiooni paremas servas väravapostile nõjatuv pika patsiga noorem tütarlaps. Jutustaja vasakul käel kaks poissi pruunides poolpikkades kuubedes, karusnahksetes mütsides. Nende taga avaneb jõemaastik.
7751.de: Six children in Ukrainian folk costume in the foreground, on the left in golden section, around a narrator gesturing while seated in profile facing right, wearing a fur cap and a long brown coat. In front of him, on the right side of the composition, sit two girls dressed in dark blue, behind them stand an elder in a white blouse leaning on a wicker fence, and at the right edge of the composition a younger girl with a long braid leaning against a gatepost. To the narrator's left hand are two boys in brown half-length coats and fur caps. Behind them a river landscape opens up.

7752.d: Esiplaanil nõlvaku all lehtpuude keskel kahe hoone katused. Tagapool laiad lagedad aasad. Taamal üle vee mets ja hoonete grupp. Maastik kujundatud ovaali.
7752.de: In the foreground, under a slope, amid deciduous trees, the roofs of two buildings. Further back, broad open meadows. In the distance, across the water, a forest and a group of buildings. The landscape is composed in an oval.

7754.d: Tütarlaps otsevaates toolil, rohelise lehestiku taustal istumas. Süles avatud raamat. Sinisekirju kleit, kaks patsi roosa paelaga.
7754.de: A girl in frontal view sitting on a chair, against a background of green foliage. An open book in her lap. A blue-patterned dress, two braids with a pink ribbon.

7786.d: Naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Kaelus kõrge, heleda krookega ja tumeda laia pitsiga. Kaelas ripub medaljon.
7786.de: Half-figure of a woman in semi-profile to the right. High collar, with a light ruff and a dark wide lace. A medallion hangs from her neck.

7792.d: Tormisel, lainetaval merel keskel aurik, süngelt tumedais pilveis taeva taustal.
7792.de: On a stormy, wavy sea, a steamship in the middle, against a background of gloomily dark clouds in the sky.

7796.d: Punase pearätikuga ümarat pesukorvi käes hoidva vana naise täisfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule.
7796.de: Full figure of an old woman in half-profile to the left, holding a round laundry basket, wearing a red headscarf.

7798.d: Eest, keset okaspuu metsa, taha paremale suunduv kitsas lagendik. Tagapoolsed männikroonid ja taevas lillaka varjundiga.
7798.de: In front, in the middle of a coniferous forest, a narrow clearing leading away to the right. Pine crowns further back and a sky with a purplish tinge.

7799.d: Ees lagedal jääväljal kaks selgvaates meest ja hobune vankril istuva mehega. Horisondil (vasakul) asula siluett. Üle maastiku päikeseloojandust punetav taevas.
7799.de: In front, on an open ice field, two men in clear view and a horse with a man sitting on a cart. On the horizon (left) the silhouette of a settlement. Over the landscape a sky reddening with sunset.

7800.d: Ees veekogu. Tagapool kallas hoonete ja puudegrupiga.
7800.de: In front a body of water. Behind, a bank with buildings and a group of trees.

7802.d: Ees paremal nurgas paremale tõusvad trepiastmed. Ülal kõrgemal kaldal teivasaia taga lumme mattunud hooned.
7802.de: In front, in the right corner, steps rising to the right. Higher up on the bank, behind a picket fence, buildings buried in snow.

7803.d: Esiplaanil lillelise muru keskel looklev tee. Keskel, vasakul ja paremal, kuni töö ülaservani, näha suurte lehtpuude ladvaoksi. Taamal keskel, puude ja põõsaste vahel torniga maja katus.
7803.de: In the foreground, amid flowery grass, a winding path. In the middle, left and right, up to the top edge of the work, the crowns of large deciduous trees can be seen. In the distance, in the middle, between trees and bushes, the roof of a house with a tower.

7804.d: Mustajuukselise punases kleidis naise poolfiguur pruunil taustal. Keha poolprofiilis, pea täisprofiilis paremale.
7804.de: Half-figure of a dark-haired woman in a red dress against a brown background. Body in half profile, head in full profile to the right.

7805.d: Mustas laiaäärses kübaras heledapäise tütarlapse täisprofiil paremale (rinnapilt). Taust pruun.
7805.de: Full profile to the right of a fair-haired girl in a black wide-brimmed hat (bust portrait). Brown background.

7806.d: Noorepoolse naise rinnapilt en face, õhukese, looritaoliselt seljale langeva rätikuga juustel.
7806.de: The bust portrait of a young woman en face, hair with a thin, veil-like kerchief falling down her back.

7807.d: Noore naise alasti täisfiguur, en face, lehvikuga paremas käes, vasak käsi toetumas ebamäärase kujuga postamendile.
7807.de: Full figure of a young nude woman, en face, with a fan in her right hand, her left hand resting on a vaguely shaped pedestal.

7808.d: Lühikestes rohelistes pükstes mehe täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Ettepoole kummardunult hoiab käes pikavarrelist piiki.
7808.de: Full figure of a man in short green trousers, in profile to the right. Bent forward, holding a long-shafted pike in his hands.

7810.d: Ees väike, rohtunud platsike eest otse taha suunduva teerajaga. Tagapool, kahel pool teerada üksikud kõrged, vanad puud. Nende taga võsastik.
7810.de: In the foreground a small, grassy patch with a path leading straight into the distance. Further back, on both sides of the path, single tall old trees. Behind them a thicket.

7812.d: Esiplaanil veekogu kivisillaga keskel, paremal hoone palkoniga ja kirik, vasakul võsastunud kallas. Päikesepaisteline hommik.
7812.de: In the foreground a body of water with a stone bridge in the middle, on the right a building with a balcony and a church, on the left an overgrown shore. A sunny morning.

7814.d: Esiplaanil puudest ümbritsetud üksiku onni ees kolm mehefiguuri tulelõkke ümber. Vasemal söemiil, mille tagant tõuseb suitsusammas. Eemal lumine mets kuuvalgel.
7814.de: In the foreground, three male figures around a fire in front of a lone hut surrounded by trees. On the left a charcoal kiln, behind which a column of smoke rises. In the distance a snowy forest in moonlight.

7816.d: Esiplaanil keskel aiaga piiratud tee, vasakul ja paremal puudega kaetud künkad, taga keskel Tallinna siluett kaugvaates.
7816.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a fenced path, hills covered with trees on the left and right, in the background in the centre a distant view of the Tallinn skyline.

7819.d: Tumedajuukselise noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas sinine valgete rüüžidega kleit. Kõrvas kõrvarõngad. Portree kujutatud ovaalis.
7819.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired young woman in half-profile facing left. Wearing a blue dress with white ruffles. Earrings in her ears. The portrait depicted in an oval.

7820.d: Paremal tiik, milles neli hani. Vasakul tiigi kaldal neli hani. Taga puud ja hooned.
7820.de: On the right a pond with four geese in it. On the left, on the pond's shore, four geese. Behind, trees and buildings.

7824.d: Noore mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, valges rokokoo parukas. Karusnahkse krae ja äärestusega mantel, suur ordenitäht, üle rinna lai punane ordenipael, nööpaugus sinivalge lindi otsas rist. Kujutus ovaalis.
7824.de: Half-figure of a young man in three-quarter profile to the left, in a white rococo wig. Coat with fur collar and trimming, large order star, wide red order ribbon across the chest, cross on the end of a blue-white ribbon in the buttonhole. Depiction in an oval.

7827.d: Ees, keset lumelagendikku, veeloik. 2/3 tööst päikese loojangust punetava taeva all.
7827.de: In front, in the middle of a snowy expanse, a puddle. 2/3 of the work under a sky reddening from the sunset.

7828.d: Eest tahapoole kõrgeneval kallakul hõredate raagus puude all ees paremal roheline sammaldunud kivi. Taga vasakul, kallaku harjal, sammaldunud kivirahnud.
7828.de: On a slope rising from front to back, under sparse bare trees, a green mossy stone in the foreground on the right. Behind on the left, on the ridge of the slope, mossy boulders.

7831.d: Esiplaanil madalas kaldavees grupp suuri kive. Tagapool vahutav meri. Horisondil loojuvast päikesest punetav taevas.
7831.de: In the foreground, in shallow shore water, a group of large stones. Behind it, a foaming sea. On the horizon, a sky reddened by the setting sun.

7832.d: Keset lagedat heinamaad vasakult paremale voolav jõgi. Vastaskaldal kari. Taamal üksik hoone. Silmapiiril mets.
7832.de: In the middle of an open meadow a river flowing from left to right. On the opposite bank a herd. In the distance a lone building. On the horizon a forest.

7833.d: Keset peegeltasast merd purjelaev. Horisondil aurik.
7833.de: In the middle of a mirror-smooth sea a sailing ship. On the horizon a steamer.

7835.d: Aopunas merelaht, kaugemal sadamahooned, suitsevad korstnad vasakul. Esiplaanil kai, paremal ankrus seisev punase-musta triibuline laev külgvaates. Selle taga laevamaste. Maal pruunikasbeežis, sinakashallis toonis.
7835.de: Sea bay at sunset glow, further away harbour buildings, smoking chimneys on the left. In the foreground a quay, on the right a red-and-black striped ship at anchor seen from the side. Behind it ship masts. Painting in brownish-beige, bluish-grey tones.

7836.d: Ees kalda ääres rida paate ja purjepaat. Vastaskallas lage rohtunud liivamaa. Horisondil mets.
7836.de: In front by the shore a row of boats and a sailboat. The opposite shore bare grassy sandy land. Forest on the horizon.

7837.d: Esiplaanil kivine rannik, vasemal laht purjekatega, paremal kõrgendik. Koloriit tume.
7837.de: In the foreground, a rocky coastline, on the left a bay with sailing boats, on the right an elevation. Dark colouring.

7839.d: Esiplaanil paremal kallas, vasakul veekogu, keskplaanil veekogus üksikute suurte kividega. Tagaplaanil maastik.
7839.de: In the foreground on the right a shore, on the left a body of water, in the middle ground a body of water with individual large stones. In the background a landscape.

7846.d: Naise poolfiguur peaga poolprofiilis paremale. Rõivastuseks rohekassinine kleit avara dekolteega, punane mantel õlgadel.
7846.de: Half-figure of a woman with her head in three-quarter profile to the right. Dressed in a greenish-blue dress with a wide décolletage, a red coat over her shoulders.

7848.d: Hallijuukselise põskhabemega mehe rinnapilt en face. Vasakus sõrmustatud käes pruun portsigar.
7848.de: Bust portrait en face of a grey-haired man with side-whiskers. In his left ringed hand a brown cigarette case.

7850.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Selle tagumisel kaldal, paremalt äärelt kuni keskosani ulatuva võsastiku taga taluhooned mäekuplite taustal.
7850.de: In the foreground a body of water. On its far shore, behind bushes extending from the right edge to the middle, farm buildings against a background of hill peaks.

7854.de: A bouquet of purple lilacs in a golden glass vase.

7865.d: Tumehallil taustal roosakaspunase näoga tõsise-karmi ilmega vanema mehe portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Juuksed, lopsakas habe, vuntsid hallid. Seljas tume kuub, valge kaelus. Maalitud ühtlaste siledate pintslilöökidega, näo osas pastoossemalt, detaili jälgivalt.
7865.de: Portrait of a serious-stern-faced elderly man with a pinkish-red face against a dark grey background, in a quarter-turn to the left. Hair, luxuriant beard, moustache grey. Wearing a dark coat, white collar. Painted with even smooth brushstrokes, more pastose and detail-attentive in the face area.

7871.d: Paremal meri. Vasakul kivine rand ja põõsas. Keskel vees suur kivi.
7871.de: Sea on the right. Rocky shore and bush on the left. A large stone in the water in the middle.

7885.d: Esiplaanil (karjamaal) üksik kõrge tamm. Vasakul ja taga keskel ja paremal lehtpuu mets.
7885.de: In the foreground (on a pasture) a solitary tall oak. On the left and in the background, middle and right, a deciduous forest.

7904.d: Eest otse taha suunduv puude ja põõsastega ääristatud teerada, mis suundub läbi kõrges müüris oleva võlvitud kaarvärava.
7904.de: A path bordered with trees and bushes leading straight from the front to the back, passing through an arched gate in a high wall.

7910.d: Esialal vasakul müüritud kaldaäär, mis ulatub kaarjalt kaugusse. Samas aiamüür üleulatuva lehtpuude latvadega. Kaugemal kuni parema ääreni ulatuv ehitiste rida siin-seal esilekerkivate tornidega. Ees paremal tasane veepind, millel kaugemal näha rida laevu ja lootsikuid. Keskel veepinna kohal üksik kajakas.
7910.de: In the foreground on the left a walled shoreline, curving into the distance. In the same area a garden wall with the tops of deciduous trees rising above it. Further away, reaching to the right edge, a row of buildings with towers rising here and there. In front on the right a calm water surface, on which further away a row of ships and boats can be seen. In the middle above the water surface a lone seagull.

7912.d: Ees kivine rannavesi. Tagapool kallas liivale tõmmatud paatidega ja kuivavate võrkudega. Taga vasakul kaks võrgukuuri.
7912.de: In front, stony coastal water. Behind it a shore with boats drawn up on the sand and drying nets. Behind on the left two net sheds.

7916.d: Paremal tormine meri. Vasakul poolrohtunud kivine rand üksikute paatide ja purjekatega. Tagapool väikene hoone.
7916.de: On the right a stormy sea. On the left a partly overgrown stony shore with individual boats and sailboats. Further back a small building.

7917.d: Ees niit põõsastikuga vasakul ja veekoguga paremal. Tagapool keskel kaks talumaja väikese kõrvalhoonega. Vasakpoolse maja otsas kask, majade vahel kooguga kaev. Paremal metsasalu, vasakul põllud.
7917.de: In front, a meadow with bushes on the left and a body of water on the right. Behind, in the centre, two farmhouses with a small outbuilding. At the end of the left-hand house a birch, between the houses a well with a sweep. On the right a copse, on the left fields.

7926.d: Esiplaanil paremal kõrgenev kallas, raagus puude ja põõsastega, vasakul jääkattes veekogu. Taga kirik ja valgustatud akendega majad.
7926.de: In the foreground on the right a rising bank with bare trees and bushes, on the left a body of water covered in ice. Behind, a church and houses with lit windows.

7929.d: Polügonaalse torniga kirik roheliste puude vahel, tugipiitadega kiviaiaga esiplaanil jalgrada rohus. Põhitoonid: roheline, sinakas hall.
7929.de: A church with a polygonal tower among green trees, a stone wall with buttresses, a footpath in the grass in the foreground. Main tones: green, bluish grey.

7931.d: Ees õhtupäikesest valgustatud jõgi, vasakul kaldaäärel paadid. Taga metsasalud ja üksikud majad, paremalt näha tuuleveski.
7931.de: In the front a river lit by the evening sun, on the left along the bank boats. Behind, groves of trees and solitary houses, on the right a windmill can be seen.

7932.dm: kõrgus: 50.0 cm (lm); laius: 64.3 cm (arm); kõrgus: 46.0 cm (arm); laius: 67.0 cm (lm)
7932.d: Esiplaanil lumiste kallastega jõgi paadiga vastaskaldal, taga metsalagenikul poolkelpaga maja üksikute kuuskedega.
7932.de: In the foreground a river with snowy banks, with a boat on the opposite bank, behind it in a forest clearing a house with a half-hip roof and single fir trees.

7936.d: Esiplaanil vasakul tugeva kehaehitusega alasti mehefiguur kaljukünkal istumas; mehel käes paaniflööt. Paremal veekogu kolme alasti naisefiguuriga delfiini ümber. Keskmine naistest istub suures merekarbis, roosakat tooni riidekangas lehvimas kaarjalt pea kohal.
7936.de: In the foreground on the left a strongly built nude male figure sitting on a rocky hillock; the man holding a pan flute. On the right a body of water with three nude female figures around a dolphin. The middle woman sits in a large seashell, a pinkish fabric fluttering in an arc above her head.

7937.d: Räpakas riietuses mehe täisfiguur. Peas vormitu, laiaäärega kübar. Katkiste varrukatega ruuduline pluus, paigatud püksid. Vööl padrunivöö revolvritega.
7937.de: Full figure of a man in scruffy clothing. On his head a shapeless, wide-brimmed hat. A checked shirt with torn sleeves, patched trousers. On his belt a cartridge belt with revolvers.

7938.d: Harkisjalu, käed puusas seisva mehe figuur poolprofiilis paremale. Jalas kintspüksikud. Vööl padrunivöö revolvriga. Kaela sõlmitud kolmnurkne punane rätik, nurgaga rinnal.
7938.de: Figure of a man standing with legs apart, hands on hips, in half-profile to the right. Wearing breeches. A cartridge belt with a revolver at the waist. A triangular red kerchief tied around the neck, with the point on the chest.

7949.d: Paremal tormine meri purjekatega, vasakul rand hoonetega ja figuurigruppidega piki rannikut.
7949.de: On the right, a stormy sea with sailboats, on the left a shore with buildings and groups of figures along the coastline.

7954.d: Rohelisega polsterdatud toolil istuva noore naise täisfiguur. Tumedad, keskelt lahuga siledad juuksed; punases sügava dekolteega kleidis. Käed süles.
7954.de: Full figure of a young woman sitting on a chair upholstered in green. Dark hair, parted in the middle and smooth; wearing a red dress with a deep décolleté. Hands in her lap.

7957.dm: lehe laius: 37.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 46.0 cm
7957.d: Karvamütsiga keskealise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Üle parema õla kasukas.
7957.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with a fur hat, in half-profile to the left. A fur coat over the right shoulder.

7978.d: Toolil istuv tütarlapse täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Käes avatud raamat. Taustaks balustraad ja puid.
7978.de: Full figure of a girl sitting on a chair, in profile to the right. An open book in her hands. Background with a balustrade and trees.

7980.d: Naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, paljastatud õlgadega, milledest alla libisenud must mantel.
7980.de: Half-figure of a woman in profile facing left, with bared shoulders, from which a black coat has slipped down.

7992.d: Pilvine taevas katab sügiseselt kirjut võsamaastikku, millest kerkivad esile vasakul pool maali osas paar suuremat puud. Keset maali näha võsastikust taeva poole tõusev suits. Vasakul kauge lagendik.
7992.de: A cloudy sky covers an autumnally colourful shrubland, from which a couple of larger trees rise in the left part of the painting. In the middle of the painting smoke can be seen rising from the shrubland towards the sky. On the left, a distant clearing.

7994.d: Paremal liivane rannariba, vasakul meri. Esiplaanil suured kivid, millede vahel keskel paistab paat.
7994.de: On the right a sandy strip of beach, on the left the sea. In the foreground large stones, between which in the centre a boat is visible.

7995.d: Esiplaanil madal vesi kividega. Vasakul kaldariba üksiku hoone ja puudega.
7995.de: In the foreground shallow water with stones. On the left a strip of shore with a solitary building and trees.

7997.de: 28 Location on object: on the reverse, below the label

7999.d: Hallikasvalgete seintega ja pruuni värvitud põrandaga toas pikas roosas kleidis tütarlaps viiulit mängimas. Kleidi kaeluses ja laiade küünarnukkideni ulatuvate varrukate otstes pits. Tütarlapse satäänid juuksed on kuklasse seatud. Paremal maalimispukki meenutav noodipult noodivihikuga, viimase kohal seinal on näha poolt kuldses raamis pildist.
7999.de: In a room with grayish-white walls and a floor painted brown, a girl in a long pink dress is playing the violin. Lace at the neckline of the dress and at the ends of the wide sleeves reaching to the elbows. The girl's satiny hair is gathered at the nape of the neck. On the right a music stand resembling an easel with a sheet music book, above which part of a picture in a gilded frame can be seen on the wall.

8008.d: Vasakul järsk paekallas väikeste põõsastega, paremal lahtine meri õhtuse pilvistaevaga. Põhitoonis rohekashall, sinine, oranž.
8008.de: On the left a steep limestone bank with small bushes, on the right the open sea with an evening cloudy sky. Main tones greenish-grey, blue, orange.

8027.d: Kahe sõduri poolfiguurid seisvas asendis poolprofiilis paremale. Peas kiivrid, käes raamat. Õhus näha kuus lennukit.
8027.de: Half-figures of two soldiers in standing position, in half-profile to the right. Helmets on their heads, a book in hand. Six aeroplanes visible in the air.

8064.d: Maali keskplaanil pildivälja parempoolses osas sinakashall supelmaja kahe musta ukseavaga selle vasakpoolses osas, mõlemast väljuva suplejaga. Äärmise ukse kohal vette ulatuv trepp. Fooniks rohelised puud. Esiplaanil vees kaks vaia paatide kinnitamiseks; parempoolse juures kaks paati. Supelmaja ees vees kaks suplejat.
8064.de: In the middle ground of the painting, in the right-hand part of the picture field, a bluish-grey bathhouse with two black door openings in its left-hand part, with a bather emerging from each. Above the outermost door a stairway reaching down into the water. Green trees form the background. In the foreground in the water two posts for mooring boats; by the right-hand one two boats. In front of the bathhouse in the water two bathers.

8065.d: Ookrikarva toolil istub poolprofiilis sügavsinises kleidis naine. Naisel vasekarva pikemad juuksed, parem käsi süles, pea toetub vasakule käele. Tooli käetoel roheline rätik. Foon vasakul ülal hallikassinine, paremal servas ja allosas valge. Maalitud eskiisilikult.
8065.de: On an ochre-coloured chair sits, in half-profile, a woman in a deep blue dress. The woman has longer copper-coloured hair, right hand in lap, head resting on left hand. A green scarf on the armrest of the chair. Background greyish-blue at upper left, white at the right edge and lower part. Painted in a sketch-like manner.

8067.d: Esiplaanil jõgi üksiku sõudjaga. Paremal lage, sügavale vette tungiv kaldariba. Tagapool, vastaskaldal, üsna vee ligi puude-põõsaste vöönd. Kaugemal lagedad heinamaad. Taamal mets ja mäeahelik.
8067.de: In the foreground a river with a solitary rower. On the right an open strip of shore reaching deep into the water. Further back, on the opposite bank, a belt of trees and bushes quite close to the water. Further away open meadows. Beyond that forest and a mountain range.

8082.de: A colourful hill bounded by a pale blue expanse of sky, an orange cypress-like tree on the left. At the top of the hill a white building with a red roof.

8083.d: Türkiisroheka taeva all hõõguvpunased leekivad puumotiivid kollakal pinnal. Silmapiiril sinjasmustad kujundid.
8083.de: Under a turquoise-green sky, glowing red flaming tree motifs on a yellowish ground. On the horizon bluish-black shapes.

8085.de: Against a dark surface, reddish, brown, greenish bush shapes with jagged edges stand out under an ultramarine-blue sky.

8113.de: Bust portrait of a young brown-haired man with longer curly hair and a moustache

8114.d: Pruunikal põllul keskel kaks noort talumeest külvamas, seemnenõu rinnal. Eespool pikajuukseline pika pruuni kuue ja põlvpükstega, taga heledas rõivas kaabuga mees. Taustal maastik küdjate ja paremal rukkihakkidega pilvise kõrge taeva all.
8114.de: On a brownish field, in the centre, two young peasant men sowing, seed vessel on the chest. In front, a long-haired man in a long brown coat and knee breeches, behind him a man in light clothing with a hat. In the background a landscape with bonfires and, on the right, rye stooks under a high cloudy sky.

8116.d: Kongus nina, lopsaka alahuulega pikajuukselise habemiku  mehe portree õlgadeni veerandpöördes vasakule. Tume rõivas seljas. Lillakaspruun koloriit, pilditaust ühtlaselt värvi sulanduv.
8116.de: A hooked nose, a portrait of a long-haired bearded man with a full lower lip, shown to the shoulders in a quarter-turn to the left. Wearing dark clothing. Purplish-brown colouring, the picture background blending evenly into the colour.

8121.d: Narmendavate servadega naturaalset tooni tekstiilitükkidest geomeetriline kompositsioon. Valdavalt neljakandiliste kujundite seas ülal paremal must ketas heledal taustal.
8121.de: A geometric composition made of natural-toned textile pieces with frayed edges. Among predominantly quadrangular shapes, a black disc on a light background at the top right.

8132.d: Esiplaanil (talvemaastik) vasakul lõhkev mürsk ja sõdur püssiga paremas käes. Paremal kaevikus üks seisev, püssisihtiv, teine põlvitav sõdur. Põlvitava sõduri ees laskemoon. Kaugemal olevast kaevikust paistmas sõdurite päid. Taamal lõhkevad mürsud.
8132.de: In the foreground (a winter landscape) on the left an exploding shell and a soldier with a rifle in his right hand. On the right, in a trench, one standing soldier aiming a rifle, another kneeling. In front of the kneeling soldier, ammunition. Heads of soldiers appear from a more distant trench. In the distance, exploding shells.

8183.d: Tallinna Toomkiriku põhjapoolse külglöövi vaade ida suunas. Esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal pingistiku nurgad, vasakpoolsel seinal ja tagaseinas lippude rivi.
8183.de: View of the north side aisle of Tallinn Cathedral towards the east. In the foreground on the left and right the corners of the pew rows, on the left wall and back wall a row of flags.

8187.d: Esialal vasakul lahesopp, mida paremalt ja tagant piirab madal rand. Lahesopis ankrus rida ühe- ja kahemastilisi purjekaid-kaljaseid; enamik allalastud purjedega. Paremal kaldale veetuna üks kahemastiline kaljas ja paate. Nende ees kaks meest väikese aerupaadi juures. Keskel vabal veepinnal üksik sõudja.
8187.de: In the foreground on the left a bay, bordered on the right and behind by a low shore. In the bay a row of one- and two-masted sailing boats-galliots at anchor; most with sails lowered. On the right a two-masted galliot and boats pulled up onto the shore. In front of them two men by a small rowing boat. In the middle, on the open water, a solitary rower.

8191.d: Esiplaanil hoov vanalinnas kahe sirelipõõsaga, mille vahel nööridel kirjupesu kuivamas. Sirelipõõsast paremal madal ühekordne kivimaja, selle juures puust kuur. Kaugemal kahekordne katuseta kõrge telliskivi korstnaga maja sarikatega. Vasakul vana-aegse punase kõrgekatuselise maja ees kuurid ja hütid. Päikesepaiste.
8191.de: In the foreground a courtyard in the old town with two lilac bushes, between which colourful laundry is drying on lines. To the right of the lilac bush a low single-storey stone house, next to it a wooden shed. Further away a two-storey roofless building with a tall brick chimney and rafters. On the left, in front of an old-fashioned red house with a high roof, sheds and huts. Sunshine.

8210.d: Iisaku kiriku altarimaali kavand, ees keskel Madonna Kristuslapsega ja rätikut hoidev Joosep, ümber karjused, taga vasakul hoone nurk.

8216.de: Bust portrait of a man with a moustache and a short red beard. Head in half-profile to the left, hair parted on the left, wearing a black coat with an open front and a black waistcoat. High cravat, white shirt front.

8223.de: Four stylised armed horsemen, against a golden background with coloured circles.

Painted in grey-brown tones, the face modelled with light and shadow.

8310.de: In front, before an arcade resting on a colonnade, a group of Roman soldiers and two standing female figures. Through the right-hand arch the scene of Christ's judgement is visible; through the left-hand one an open landscape with a palm tree.

8349.de: The left part is taken up by 1/4 with a large rock, on which sit a downcast dark-haired girl and a nude male figure. Waves around the rock, in the centre foreground and to the right in the background, female figures with their upper bodies emerging from the water.

8350.dm: lehe laius: 27.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 34.0 cm
8350.d: Mereelukal istuv alasti naisfiguur. Ümber niuete roheline riie.
8350.de: A nude female figure sitting on a sea creature. Green cloth around the hips.

8351.dm: lehe kõrgus: 25.3 cm; lehe laius: 40.0 cm
8351.d: Vasakul troonil istuv figuur. Trooni ees seisev naisakt. Tema taga paremal kaks paljastatud ülakehaga naisfiguuri.
8351.de: A figure seated on a throne on the left. A female nude standing in front of the throne. Behind her on the right, two female figures with exposed upper bodies.

8352.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 39.1 cm
8352.d: Vasakul astmestikul istuv figuur. Paremal õitsvate puude all kolm figuuri.
8352.de: A figure sitting on a flight of steps on the left. On the right, three figures under blossoming trees.

8353.dm: lehe kõrgus: 29.2 cm; lehe laius: 20.5 cm
8353.d: Keskealise naise pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Juuksed patsina keeratud pealaele, seljas kõrge kaelusega pruun kleit.
8353.de: Head of a middle-aged woman in half-profile to the left. Hair twisted into a braid on top of the head, wearing a brown dress with a high collar.

8354.d: Osa tänavast viilkatustega majadega selle ääres. Ärklikorrusega kollase kivimaja tagant paistmas koonusekujuline katus ristiga otsas.
8354.de: Part of a street with gable-roofed houses along it. Behind a yellow brick house with an attic floor, a cone-shaped roof with a cross on top is visible.

8361.d: Istuva noormehe poolfguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Paljas pea, must mantel, punakas kaelaside ja pruunikirju sall.
8361.de: Half-figure of a seated young man in a slight turn to the left. Bare head, black coat, reddish necktie and brownish patterned scarf.

8365.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides kompositsioon, mille horisontaalsel keskteljel punakaspruunidest kividest linnamüür. Paremal servas keskel on viis väheldast meest ametis kivide kandmise ja ladumisega. Müüri taga tumehallist paekivist vanalinna majad, tornid ja kirikud. Kompositsiooni alumises nurgas, linnamüüri ees neli meest (ühel neist kollane turban, teisel baretid) kuulamas punase laubapaela ja viipeks tõstetud parema käega ookrikarva rüüs meest.(eesti)
8365.de: A composition in grey and brown tones, with a city wall of reddish-brown stones along the horizontal central axis. On the right edge, in the middle, five smallish men are occupied with carrying and laying stones. Behind the wall, old-town houses, towers and churches of dark grey limestone. In the lower corner of the composition, in front of the city wall, four men (one of them with a yellow turban, another with berets) are listening to a man in an ochre-coloured robe with a red headband, gesturing with his raised right hand.

8367.dm: lehe kõrgus: 11.0 cm; lehe laius: 11.3 cm
8367.d: Paljastatud õlgadega maani ulatuvas rüüs peegli ees istuva nainse täisfiguur en face. Käed tõstetud rinnale.
8367.de: Full figure of a woman en face, sitting before a mirror, in a floor-length robe with bared shoulders. Hands raised to the chest.

8368.dm: lehe laius: 30.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 22.2 cm
8368.d: Vasakul veest välja ulatuval kaljurünkal kolm sireeni (naise kehaga, linnu jalgadega). Tagaplaanil merel laeva siluett.
8368.de: On a rocky cliff jutting out of the water on the left, three sirens (with a woman's body, bird's legs). In the background, the silhouette of a ship at sea.

8369.d: Rohtunud künka harjal kollakad linnuse varemed. Üle vasakpoolse müüri paistmas lehtpuu latv. Taustaks helesinine taevas.
8369.de: Yellowish castle ruins on the grassy crest of a hill. The crown of a deciduous tree visible above the wall on the left. Background of pale blue sky.

8370.d: Esiplaanil murul koer, kukk ja kass.
8370.de: In the foreground on the grass a dog, a rooster and a cat.

8375.de: On the right five apples, on the left a banana.

8377.d: Visand kuuest õunast: neli punast õuna ja kaks kollast.
8377.de: Sketch of six apples: four red apples and two yellow ones.

8378.d: Heledais toonides hortensia õitekobarad tumedas lehestikus.
8378.de: Clusters of hydrangea flowers in light tones amid dark foliage.

8381.d: Lamava tütarlapse poolfiguur, pea üleval vasakus nurgas, rinnale kokku pandud käed all paremal. Punane jakk, käte all valge vaiba äär.
8381.de: Half-figure of a reclining girl, head at the upper left corner, hands folded on her chest at the lower right. A red jacket, the edge of a white blanket under the hands.

8382.d: Neljaosaline, igal osal erivärvilises lahenduses sarnastest kujunditest kompositsioon: keskel lainelise äärega ülalt ahenev kujund, selle tipus ring.
8382.de: Four-part composition, each part in a different colour solution of similar forms: in the centre a shape narrowing upward with a wavy edge, a circle at its tip.

8384.d: Koosneb neljast võrdsest kõrvuasetatud tahvlist, kruntimata lõuend. Maali alumisel osal, valdavalt valgel taustal musta kontuuriga mitmesuguse suurusega ruudud, rombid, vabakäejooned. Maali ülapoolsel, puhtal lõuendil mustad, kollased, sinised abstraktsed pinnad vaheldumisi väiksemate geomeetriliste kujundite ja märkidega. Nelja tahvlit läbib keskpaigast lainekujuline põikisuunaline, tuubist vajutatud valge värviga väga reljeefne pind.
8384.de: Consists of four equal side-by-side panels, unprimed canvas. In the lower part of the painting, predominantly on a white background, black-outlined squares, rhombi and freehand lines of various sizes. In the upper part of the painting, on clean canvas, black, yellow, blue abstract surfaces alternating with smaller geometric shapes and signs. Through the middle of the four panels runs a wave-shaped transverse, highly relief surface pressed from a tube in white paint.

8391.d: Vasakul puude all istuv naisfiguur. Paremal seisev ja istuv figuur. Keskel valges rüüs ülestõstetud kätega naisfiguur.
8391.de: On the left a female figure sitting under trees. On the right a standing and a sitting figure. In the middle a female figure in a white robe with raised hands.

8392.d: Ees keskel istuva, punases rüüs, õnnistamiseks ülestõstetud käega mehe jalge juures põlvele laskunud alasti meesfiguur. Õnnistaja taga kolm naisfiguuri. Taustaks õitsvad puud.
8392.de: In front, in the centre, a naked male figure kneeling at the feet of a man in a red robe with his hand raised for blessing. Behind the one giving the blessing, three female figures. In the background, flowering trees.

8393.dm: kujutise laius: 8.3 cm; lehe laius: 11.3 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 8.6 cm; lehe laius: 12.5 cm
8393.d: Kohe jõekaldal istuva kahe tütarlapse figuurid. Üks neist sinises, teine roosas rüüs.
8393.de: Figures of two girls sitting right on the riverbank. One of them in a blue robe, the other in a pink one.

8394.de: Two sitting children on a footbridge over water.

8395.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres joova kitse seljas alasti lapse figuur. Tagapool suurte puude vahel ettepoole ruttav naine.
8395.de: In the foreground, by a body of water, the figure of a naked child on the back of a drinking goat. Behind, among large trees, a woman hurrying forward.

8396.d: Esiplaanil grupp kahest lamavast täiskasvanust ja kahest istuvast lapsest. Nende kohal õhus fantastilised, kihutavas ratsanikud.
8396.de: In the foreground a group of two reclining adults and two sitting children. Above them in the air, fantastic, galloping horsemen.

8397.d: Vasakul ja paremal suur puu, mille kroonid ülal keskel kokkuulatuvad. Vasakpoolse puu ääres alasti naisfiguur peaaegu en face; parempoolse puu all profiilis seisev inimfiguur.
8397.de: On the left and on the right a large tree, their crowns meeting at the top centre. Beside the tree on the left a nude female figure almost en face; under the tree on the right a human figure standing in profile.

8398.d: Vasakul ebamääraste tõmmude inimfiguuride keskel paremal, pikas tumedas rüüs seisvale mehele karikat ulatav alasti naisfiguur.
8398.de: On the left, amidst vaguely sketched human figures, on the right a naked female figure offers a goblet to a man standing in a long dark robe.

8399.d: Punakal vaibal selili lamav naisakt, parem käsi rätikuga tõstetud.
8399.de: A female nude lying on her back on a reddish carpet, right hand raised with a scarf.

8405.d: Kaks alasti ratsurit lillakatel hobustel (profiilis). Taustaks rohelisel aasal lehtpuid.
8405.de: Two nude riders on purplish horses (in profile). Deciduous trees on a green meadow in the background.

8406.d: Esiplaanil kaks supelpükstes ratsurit valgetel hobustel. Taustaks metsaviirg.
8406.de: In the foreground two riders in swimming trunks on white horses. Forest strip in the background.

8408.d: Valkjal taustal kolm banaani, nende taga kaks apelsini. Apelsinide vahel õun. Taga banaan.
8408.de: Three bananas on a whitish background, behind them two oranges. An apple between the oranges. A banana behind.

8409.d: Esiplaanil lagendik, taga puude vahel kahekordne hoone.
8409.de: In the foreground a clearing, behind among trees a two-storey building.

8418.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Paremalt ulatub veekogusse metsaga kaetud kallas; vasakult küngas, millel puude vahel rida hooneid. Taga künklik kallas, millel metsatihnikute tukad.
8418.de: A body of water in the foreground. From the right a forest-covered bank extends into the water; from the left a hill on which stands a row of buildings among trees. Behind, an undulating bank with clumps of dense forest.

8426.d: Esiplaanil suured hallid pahklikud palgid roosakal rannaliival. Paremal seisab rannas valges särgis langetatud peaga mees, käed rohekate pükste taskus. Taamal silmapiirini rohekas sillerdav meri. Ülal rohekashall taevas läbi pilvehämu paistva päikesega.
8426.de: In the foreground, large grey knotty logs on pinkish beach sand. On the right stands a man on the beach in a white shirt with lowered head, hands in the pockets of greenish trousers. Further back, a greenish shimmering sea reaching the horizon. Above, a greenish-grey sky with the sun shining through a haze of clouds.

8427.d: Sügavsinisel foonil paremal kahvatu, otsekui öises kuuvalguses antud aktifiguur, tumedate ripsmetega silmad langetatud, naeratus huultel, valge rätik niude ümber. Naisefiguurist vasakul pildi all servas roheline pudel ja pruun nõu. Vasakul servas, pildi servaga läbilõigatud profiilis mees, lillepärg peas. Foonil keskel aknaava, millest paistab öine tähistaevas, aknalaual väike punane öis. Paremas servas lillakas-valge draperii.(eesti)
8427.de: On a deep blue background on the right, a pale nude figure as if given in nocturnal moonlight, eyes with dark lashes lowered, a smile on the lips, a white cloth around the hips. To the left of the female figure, at the bottom edge of the picture, a green bottle and a brown vessel. At the left edge, a man in profile cut off by the edge of the picture, wearing a wreath of flowers on his head. In the centre of the background a window opening through which the night starry sky is visible, on the windowsill a small red blossom. At the right edge a purplish-white drapery.

8432.d: Esiplaanil aiaga piiratud teel ratsanik ja jalakäija jahivarustuses ning koertega. Tagapool (primitiivses perspektiivis) nõlvakul pargi servas mõisahooned. Paremal kõrts; vasakul korstnata õlgkatustega majad. Samas sillakese kõrval künkal mingi mälestustähis - sale ja valge ampiirstiilis.
8432.de: In the foreground, on a fenced road, a horseman and a pedestrian in hunting gear with dogs. Further back (in primitive perspective) on a slope at the edge of a park, manor buildings. On the right an inn; on the left thatched-roof houses without chimneys. By the same small bridge, on a hillock, some kind of memorial - slender and white, in Empire style.

8434.d: Naise poolfiguur istuvas asendis. Süles Kristuslaps, keda toetab vasema käega. Paremal lapse poolfiguur profiilis vasemale.
8434.de: A half-figure of a woman in a sitting position. The Christ Child on her lap, supported with her left hand. On the right a half-figure of a child in profile to the left.

8435.d: Rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, langetatud silmadega, roheline kleit.
8435.de: Bust in three-quarter profile to the right, with lowered eyes, green dress.

8436.d: Noore naise rinnapilt. Peas valge rätik, selle all tanu. Seljas valge pikkkuub. Pealmine hõlm ääristatud punase, valge ja musta triibuga.
8436.de: Bust portrait of a young woman. On her head a white headscarf, beneath it a bonnet. Wearing a white long coat. The upper flap trimmed with a red, white and black stripe.

8437.d: Kolmes osas figuraalne kompositsioon. Keskel pasunat puhuv karjane. Vasakul külvaja. Paremal naine sirbiga ja mees vikatiga üle õla.
8437.de: A figurative composition in three parts. In the centre a shepherd blowing a horn. On the left a sower. On the right a woman with a sickle and a man with a scythe over his shoulder.

8439.d: Lehe keskel ratsanik valgel hobusel kahe suure puu all. Tagaplaanil vasakul taluhoone. Esiplaanil paremal murdunud puutüvi.
8439.de: In the centre of the sheet a horseman on a white horse under two large trees. In the background on the left a farm building. In the foreground on the right a broken tree trunk.

8442.d: Esiplaanil vana kaluri poolfiguur aerudega õlal. Keskel mees ja vana naine pukile asetatud kangi tõukamas. Taga figuure, paadi - ja mastisiluette.
8442.de: In the foreground the half-figure of an old fisherman with oars on his shoulder. In the middle a man and an old woman pushing a lever placed on a trestle. Behind, figures, boat and mast silhouettes.

8444.d: Esiplaanil metsatukk, taga vasakul metsastunud mäeveerg, mis kõrgemal muutub lagendikuks; keskel ja paremal samasugused kaljud, mille vahelt paistavad kaugemal lumised mäetipud ja jääliustikud.
8444.de: In the foreground a small forest, behind it on the left a forested mountain slope, which higher up turns into open ground; in the centre and on the right similar rocks, between which further away snowy mountain peaks and glaciers are visible.

8445.d: Vasakul kõrgem, paremal madalam lillakaspunane kaljurahn.
8445.de: On the left a higher, on the right a lower purplish-red rock boulder.

8446.dm: lehe kõrgus: 32.2 cm; lehe laius: 48.0 cm
8446.d: Ees paremal veekogu, lehtpuumetsaga vastaskaldal. Vasakul visand põõsastikust (punase pliiatsiga). Üle maastiku pilvine taevas.
8446.de: A body of water in the foreground on the right, with deciduous forest on the opposite bank. On the left a sketch of shrubbery (in red pencil). Over the landscape a cloudy sky.

8447.dm: lehe kõrgus: 37.5 cm; lehe laius: 52.7 cm
8447.d: Ees paremalt taha vasakule suunduv majaderida (pliiastiga), taustaks lumiste harjadega mäed (õlimaal).
8447.de: In the front a row of houses (in pencil) receding from right to left, background mountains with snowy ridges (oil painting).

8448.dm: lehe kõrgus: 15.2 cm; lehe laius: 23.4 cm
8448.d: Ees veekogu. Tagapool paremalt pooldiagonaalis taha vasakule suunduv mäeahelik.
8448.de: In the foreground a body of water. Behind it, a mountain range running in a half-diagonal from right to left into the distance.

8451.d: Paremal grupp jämedatüvelisi puid künkal, keskel looklev oja, vasakul üksik puu.
8451.de: On the right a group of thick-trunked trees on a hillock, in the middle a winding brook, on the left a solitary tree.

8459.dm: kõrgus: 46.5 cm (tervik, vm.   ); laius: 58.0 cm (tervik, vm.   )
8459.d: Kõrges vaasis kollased ja roosakad daalia õied.(eesti)
8459.de: Yellow and pinkish dahlia flowers in a tall vase.

8461.d: Esiplaanil lumine väljak. Paremal tänav majadega. Kaugemal paistavad katused ja tornid. Vasakul raagus puud.
8461.de: A snowy square in the foreground. On the right a street with houses. Roofs and towers visible in the distance. Bare trees on the left.

8470.d: Lage maapind silmapiiril punava taevaga. Esiplaanil paremal tume purjeka siluett, vasakul vette ulatuv paadisild.
8470.de: Bare ground on the horizon with a reddish sky. In the foreground on the right the dark silhouette of a sailboat, on the left a boat pier reaching into the water.

8471.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe rinnapilt profiilis paremale; pilvedes. Seljas väikesed tiivad.
8471.de: Caricature of the artist: bust portrait of a man in profile to the right; in the clouds. Small wings on his back.

8472.d: Siledapinnalisel merel kaks purjekat longus purjedega. Pilvine taevas silmapiiril loojuva punase päikesega, mis peegeldub meres.
8472.de: On a smooth-surfaced sea, two sailboats with drooping sails. Cloudy sky with a red setting sun on the horizon, reflected in the sea.

8474.d: Ees kivine kallas paatidega. Paremal veekogu. Taga keskel laevade siluetid (kirjeldus poolik, kuna töö on kattunud läbipaistmatu valkja kihiga).
8474.de: In front, a stony shore with boats. On the right, a body of water. In the back, centre, silhouettes of ships (description incomplete, as the work is covered with an opaque whitish layer).

8490.d: Rannamaastik kahe alasti naisfiguuriga, kellest vasakpoolne tumedajuukseline kummardunud rohust põgenevat päkapikku püüdmas; parempoolne blond naine imestunult teist jälgimas. Vasakul puu, naiste taga keelikuna maasse ulatuv lahesopp, selle taga ähmane rannaviirg.(eesti)
8490.de: A seaside landscape with two nude female figures, the dark-haired one on the left bending down in the grass trying to catch a fleeing gnome; the blonde woman on the right watching the other in astonishment. On the left a tree, behind the women a cove reaching into the ground like a string, behind that a hazy shoreline.

8493.d: Noore tõmmu naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, kollasele padjale nõjatuv. Ehitud idamaiselt.
8493.de: Half-figure of a young dark-haired woman in half-profile to the left, leaning on a yellow pillow. Adorned in an oriental manner.

8496.d: Helesinise, õrna lillaka vinega taeva all lõunamere lahesopp. Esiplaanil hele rand, mere ääres kaks alasti seisvat naist, kaugemal paremal kaks istuvat figuuri. Pildil paremal kõrge lehtpuu, põõsad. Teispool lahte madalate puudega kaetud lausik mägi. Silmapiiril lillakas mägeda harjad. Maalitud lühikeste pintslilöökidega, esiplaanil pastoossemalt.
8496.de: Under a light blue sky with a delicate purplish tinge, a bay of a southern sea. In the foreground a light-coloured beach, by the sea two women standing naked, further away on the right two seated figures. On the right of the picture a tall leafy tree, bushes. On the other side of the bay, a flat mountain covered with low trees. On the horizon, purplish mountain ridges. Painted with short brushstrokes, more impasto in the foreground.

8498.d: Esiplaanil tänav, mille ääres vasakul väike kollane hoone. Kaugemal, terashalli taeva taustal tara taga kolmekorruseline telliskivi värvi katusega maja.
8498.de: In the foreground a street, along which on the left stands a small yellow building. Further away, against a steel-grey sky, behind a fence a three-storey house with a brick-coloured roof.

8499.de: In the foreground a smooth water surface, forest in the distance.

8500.d: Ümar roheline vaas kirjude lilledega rohekaspruunil taustal.
8500.de: A round green vase with colourful flowers on a greenish-brown background.

8502.d: Esiplaanil vasakul väike rohtunud kallastesse uppuv jõeke, paremal mäekünkale tõusev jalgrada. Künkal neli maja. Siin-seal väikesi puid ja põõsaid, ülal sünge äikseline taevas. Töö ümbritsetud tindiga joonistatud ornamentaalse raamistusega.(eesti)
8502.de: In the foreground on the left a small stream sinking into overgrown banks, on the right a footpath rising to a hillock. Four houses on the hillock. Here and there small trees and bushes, above a gloomy, thundery sky. The work is surrounded by an ornamental frame drawn in ink.

8503.d: Hallid, punased, kollased kolme  - ja neljakorruselised majad telliskivipunaste korstendega. Taevas valkjas - hall.
8503.de: Grey, red, yellow three- and four-storey houses with brick-red chimneys. The sky whitish-grey.

8504.d: Noore tumedajuukselise naise rinnapilt veerandprofiilis paremale, mustas valge kaelarüüsidega kleidis, kõrvas kõrvarõngad.
8504.de: Bust portrait of a young dark-haired woman in a quarter-profile to the right, in a black dress with white collar frills, wearing earrings.

8506.d: Tumedas riietuses kaabuga ja heleda salliga vanema mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates. Vasak käsi rinnale tõstetud.
8506.de: Frontal chest-length figure of an older man in dark clothing with a hat and a light-coloured scarf. Left hand raised to the chest.

8508.d: Keskel palkidega vanker, mille otsas istub kaabuga talumees. Temast vasakul kaks hobust, kellest ühel ratsamees piitsaga paremas käes. Taga paremal sepikoda. Maali vasakus osas esiplaanil aia juures lambakari, nende taga vaataja poole sammuv naine vaati madalal vankril vedamas.(eesti)
8508.de: In the centre a cart loaded with logs, on the end of which sits a farmer wearing a hat. To his left two horses, one of which is ridden by a horseman with a whip in his right hand. Behind on the right a smithy. In the left part of the painting, in the foreground by a fence, a flock of sheep, behind them a woman walking towards the viewer, hauling a barrel on a low cart.

8509.d: Madal poolsoostunud maastik veeloiguga ees keskel ja taga paremal. Silmapiiril põõsastik, millest tõusevad esile männid. 3/4 tööst loojuva päikesega taeva all.
8509.de: Low, partly marshy landscape with a puddle of water in the middle foreground and at the back on the right. On the horizon, shrubbery, from which pines rise above. 3/4 of the work under a setting sun sky.

8511.d: Ergastes toonides punakas-oranži maapinnaga loodusvaade, mille esiplaanil paiknevad kolm pruunides toonides suurt puud. Tausta moodustavad lillad, kollased ja rohelised toonid. Kõrgemal helesinise ja roosaga pilved.
8511.de: A landscape in vivid tones with reddish-orange ground, in the foreground of which are three large trees in brown tones. The background is formed by purple, yellow and green tones. Higher up clouds in light blue and pink.

8513.d: Esiplaanil paremal ja vasakul puud ja põõsad, taamal põllud ja mets.(eesti)
8513.de: In the foreground right and left trees and bushes, in the distance fields and forest.

8514.d: Pealtvaade üksikute lumiste katustega majadele, nende vahel raagus puud, silmapiiril keskel suitsev korsten. Hooned tihketes hallikaspruunides ja sinakas-rohelistes tooonides beežikashalli taeva all. Maalitud laiade pintslitõmmetega, kohati pastoosselt.
8514.de: A view from above of scattered snow-roofed houses, bare trees between them, a smoking chimney in the middle of the horizon. Buildings in dense grayish-brown and bluish-green tones under a beigish-grey sky. Painted with broad brush strokes, in places impasto.

8516.d: Sarvedega olevused lamajal kõhtu lõhki lõikamas. Teos tumedal taustal pruunis koloriidis.
8516.de: Horned beings cutting open the belly of a lying figure. The work in a dark background with brown coloring.

8517.dm: kujutise laius: 41.1 cm (km.); lehe kõrgus: 38.4 cm (lm.); kujutise kõrgus: 28.0 cm (km.); lehe laius: 55.2 cm (lm)
8517.d: Ees lai, lumine väli (3/4 kogu tööst), silmapiiril, metsariba taustal, lumine hooneterühm.(eesti)
8517.de: In front, a wide, snowy field (3/4 of the whole work), on the horizon, against the background of a strip of forest, a snowy group of buildings.

8519.d: Süngetes sinistes ja lillades toonides temaatiline kompositsioon. Esiplaanil lapivad neli talvemütsides kalurit võrku. Nende taga vasakul seisab pearätikus naine, kalakast kummaski käes. Naise tagant paistavad kalalaeva mast ja vaierid. Paremas servas all hunnik puust kalakaste, ülal osa võrgukuurist, mille lävel seisab mees küljega vaataja poole. Taamal tumesinine meri ja taevas, mida teineteisest eraldab tõusva päikese erkpunane viirg.(eesti)
8519.de: A thematic composition in gloomy blue and purple tones. In the foreground, four fishermen in winter caps mend a net. Behind them on the left stands a woman in a headscarf, holding a fish crate in each hand. Behind the woman, the mast and rigging of a fishing boat are visible. Lower right, a pile of wooden fish crates; upper right, part of a net shed, in whose doorway a man stands sideways to the viewer. In the distance, a dark blue sea and sky, separated from each other by a bright red streak of the rising sun.

8527.d: Ees lagedal rohtmaal kaks seisvat ja üks lamav lehm ja vasikas. Ees paremal laialeheliste taimede keskel jänes. Horisondil Tallinna siluett. Taevas pilvine.
8527.de: In the foreground on open grassland two standing cows and one lying cow, and a calf. In the foreground on the right, among broad-leaved plants, a hare. On the horizon the silhouette of Tallinn. Sky cloudy.

8532.d: Tumedal taustal, toolil istuva hallipäise, vurrudega mehe kolveerandfiguur kerge pöördega paremale, vasaku jala peale pandud parema jalaga, toolikorjule toetuva vasema käega. Seljas sinakas-hall kuub, hallid püksid ja vest. Rinnaesine valge, kaelaside tume, mille üle valge krae nurgad.(eesti)
8532.de: Against a dark background, a three-quarter figure of a grey-haired, moustached man seated on a chair, in a slight turn to the right, right leg crossed over the left, left hand resting on the arm of the chair.
