He wears a bluish-grey coat, grey trousers and a waistcoat. The shirt front is white, the necktie dark, over which the corners of a white collar show.

8533.d: Kaks rahvarõivais raamatuid lugevat tütarlast. Ees, parempoolne, toolil istuv profiilis vasakule, tagapool, vasakul olev, seisev, poolprofiilis vasakule.
8533.de: Two girls in folk costume reading books. In front, the right-hand one, sitting on a chair in profile to the left; behind, the one on the left, standing, in three-quarter profile to the left.

8535.d: Hallikais-pruunides toonides puud erksinise veekogu kaldal. Ees vasakul kollakas heinamaa kahe kuhjaga. Puude kohal hall taevas. Laia pintsliga hoogsalt maalitud.
8535.de: Trees in greyish-brown tones on the shore of a bright blue body of water. In the foreground on the left a yellowish meadow with two haystacks. Grey sky above the trees. Painted vigorously with a broad brush.

8536.d: Rohtunud tänavanurk kahekordsete majadega. Üle esiplaanil oleva ärklikorrusega majakatuse paistmas puulatv.
8536.de: A grassy street corner with two-storey houses. A treetop visible above the mansard roof of the house in the foreground.

8537.d: Kimp valgeid ja punaseid kibuvitsaõisi, üksik suure punase õiega keskel.(eesti)
8537.de: Bouquet of white and red dog-rose blossoms, a single large red bloom in the center.

8538.d: Tänavanurk madalate majadega, mille tagant paistmas osa koonusekujulisest tornist. Pildil vasakul liiklusmärk, paremal kõrged lehtpuud.
8538.de: A street corner with low houses, behind which part of a cone-shaped tower is visible. On the left of the picture a traffic sign, on the right tall deciduous trees.

8548.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalis paremalt vasakule sügavusse suunduvate telliskivi katuste rida kõrgete korstnatega. Vasakul näha elumaja seinad akendega. Katuste tagant paistavad Tallinna linna tornid, millest tagapool näha ähmaseid elumajade siluette.
8548.de: In the foreground a row of brick roofs with tall chimneys running diagonally from the right into the depth toward the left. On the left the walls of a dwelling house with windows are visible. Behind the roofs the towers of the city of Tallinn appear, behind which blurred silhouettes of dwelling houses can be seen.

8550.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv jõgi. Keskel kivisild. Taga vasakul näha puulatvu ja hoonete katuseid.
8550.de: A river running from the front left to the back right. A stone bridge in the middle. In the background on the left, treetops and roofs of buildings can be seen.

8557.d: Etüüdilikult antud, tumedates  sinistes ja pruunides toonides vnema mehe rinnaportree. Mehel pikk sirge nina, endasse pööratud pilk ja õlgadeni ulatuvad hallid juuksed. Suu tugevaks kriipsuks kokku pigistatud.
8557.de: A study-like bust portrait, in dark blue and brown tones, of an older man. The man has a long straight nose, an inward-turned gaze and grey hair reaching to his shoulders. His mouth is pressed firmly into a line.

8558.d: Ees taha majade vahele suunduva kanali ääres oleval kail naised pesu loputamas.
8558.de: Women rinsing laundry on a quay beside a canal running between houses from front to back.

8560.d: Oranži sakilise lagipea, pikliku venitatud näoga keppjalgadel figuur mustjas-sinises ümbruses. Üks käsi kõverdatult pea juures, teises pikk nupuga kepp suunatud ette paremale, aimatavasse sinisesse loiku. Figuuriga läbi põimunud mitmesugused kujundid, vasakul pea ja käelaba konditaolise moodustisega. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
8560.de: An orange jagged-crowned, elongated-face figure on stilt-like legs in a blackish-blue setting. One hand bent near the head, the other holding a long knobbed staff pointed forward to the right, into a suggested blue puddle. Various shapes intertwined with the figure, on the left a head and a hand with a bone-like formation. Expressive painting style.

8563.d: Kitsas tumedas vaasis mitmevärvilised põllulilled koos gladioolidega.
8563.de: Multicoloured field flowers with gladioli in a narrow dark vase.

8566.d: Esiplaanil vasakult taha paremale suunduva plangu ääres laasipuu ees kaks hobust regedega. Taga keskel plangu taga ühekordne hoone ja puid.
8566.de: In the foreground, by a fence running from left to back to right, a woodpile in front of which are two horses with sledges. In the background centre, behind the fence, a single-storey building and trees.

8567.d: Pastelsel rohekal foonil blondi tüdruku rinnaportree otsevaates, pea pistut pööratud paremale, pilk suunatud paemale küljele. Tüdrukul seljas roosakas pluus, parem, heleroosa lehviga pats rinnal, vasak seljal. Maalitud siledalt rohekasroosades toonides.(eesti)
8567.de: Frontal bust portrait of a blonde girl on a pastel greenish background, the head turned slightly to the right, the gaze directed to the right. The girl wears a pinkish blouse, a light pink bow-tied plait on her chest on the right, on her back on the left. Painted smoothly in greenish-pink tones.

8578.d: Kaks tumedas riides kolmveerandfiguuri istumas, vasakul naine, paremal mees. Mehe ees taldrik küünlaga ja roheline pärg.
8578.de: Two three-quarter figures dressed in dark clothing seated, a woman on the left, a man on the right. In front of the man a plate with a candle and a green wreath.

8585.d: Paremal meri paatidega rannal, vasakul kallas metsaga, kuuriga ja üksikute inimfiguuridega.
8585.de: On the right, the sea with boats on the shore, on the left a bank with a forest, a shed and solitary human figures.

8592.d: Kaks istuvat naist, neist vasakpoolne heleda kleidi ja punaka kübaraga.
8592.de: Two seated women, the one on the left in a light-coloured dress and a reddish hat.

8594.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu, selle kaldal vasakul hurtsik suitseva korstnaga. Tagakaldal lehtpuuvõsa. Taamal kaugemal mets.
8594.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water, on its bank on the left a hovel with a smoking chimney. On the opposite bank deciduous scrub. In the distance further away a forest.

8595.d: Ees lage rohumaa. Keskel põõsastike vöönd. Taamal põõsaste vahelt näha põlde ja horisondil olevat metsa.
8595.de: Open grassland in the foreground. A belt of bushes in the middle. Beyond, fields and a forest on the horizon are visible through the bushes.

8596.d: Ees keskel madalas merevees suur hulk kokkukuhjatud suuri kive. Keskel rannikuribal lehtpuumets. Taamal vasakul vaade üle meresopi kauguses olevale metsajoonele.
8596.de: In the front centre, in shallow sea water, a large number of piled-up large stones. In the centre, on the coastal strip, a deciduous forest. In the distance on the left, a view across a bay to a distant forest line.

8598.d: Tänavanurk lameda - astmelise katusega ja rõdudega kollase kivimajaga. Esiplaanil paremal palm.
8598.de: Street corner with a yellow stone house with a flat, stepped roof and balconies. In the foreground on the right a palm tree.

8601.d: Sinakashallides ja lillakais toonides maastik hoonetegrupi ja suure kahvatukollase kuuga. (eesti)
8601.de: Landscape in bluish-grey and purplish tones with a group of buildings and a large pale yellow moon.

8603.d: Istuva, rohelise baretiga mehe portree kerges pöördes paremale.
8603.de: Portrait of a seated man with a green beret, in a slight turn to the right.

8605.dm: laius: 23.8 cm (lm.); laius: 17.5 cm (km.); kõrgus: 27.1 cm (km.); kõrgus: 32.5 cm (lm.)

8608.d: Lillas, lühikeste käistega kleidis istuva noore naise poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule.
8608.de: Half-length figure of a young woman sitting in a lilac, short-sleeved dress, in half-turn to the left.

8614.dm: lehe kõrgus: 29.7 cm; lehe laius: 53.5 cm
8614.d: Seilili asendis, alasti naise figuur. Käed asetatud kukla alla.
8614.de: A nude female figure lying supine. Hands placed under the back of the head.

8615.dm: lehe kõrgus: 62.6 cm; lehe laius: 45.6 cm
8615.d: Istuva akti poolfiguur vasakule. Käed lebamas jalgadele tõmmatud vaibal.
8615.de: Half-figure of a seated nude, to the left. Hands resting on the legs, over which a rug is drawn.

8616.dm: lehe laius: 30.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 37.2 cm
8616.d: Ees vasaku põlvega kõrgele kaldapervele toetuv alasti naisfiguur. Tema vastu liibunud laiali laotatud tiibadega luik.
8616.de: In front, a nude female figure resting on her left knee on a high riverbank. Pressed against her a swan with outspread wings.

8617.dm: lehe kõrgus: 40.0 cm; lehe laius: 32.2 cm
8617.d: Põlvedele laotatud musta rätikuga istuv poolprofiilis akt vasakule. Pea pöördega paremale. Parem käsi tõstetud kuklasse.
8617.de: A nude seen in half-profile to the left, sitting with a black cloth spread over the knees. Head turned to the right. Right hand raised to the nape of the neck.

8618.dm: lehe kõrgus: 27.3 cm; lehe laius: 23.0 cm
8618.d: Pruunijuukselise noorema naise pea pooplprofiilis paremale. Kleidil kõrge kaelus.
8618.de: Head of a younger brown-haired woman in half-profile to the right. High collar on the dress.

8619.dm: lehe laius: 43.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.0 cm
8619.d: Vasakul istuv figuur, kes vasaku jalaga surub tema ees lebavat naisfiguuri. Paremal mõõgaga hiiliv alasti meesfiguur. Taustaks tammik.
8619.de: On the left a seated figure pressing down with his left leg on a female figure lying before him. On the right a naked male figure sneaking with a sword. An oak grove as background.

8620.dm: lehe laius: 38.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 27.1 cm
8620.d: Vasakul veekogu. Keskel kaldapervel lamav naisakt meesakti embuses. Taustaks tumeroheline lehestik.
8620.de: A body of water on the left. In the middle, a female nude lying on the bank in the embrace of a male nude. Dark green foliage as background.

8621.dm: lehe kõrgus: 32.5 cm; lehe laius: 30.9 cm
8621.d: Alt vasakult diagonaalselt üles paremale suunduva vee kohal puu, mille tüvel istuvad kaks alasti inimfiguuri.
8621.de: Above water flowing diagonally from lower left to upper right, a tree on whose trunk sit two naked human figures.

8622.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 27.6 cm; lehe laius: 21.7 cm
8622.d: Ees keskel puu varjus pingil istuva naise figuur. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule, pea poolprofiilis paremale.
8622.de: In the centre foreground, the figure of a woman sitting on a bench in the shade of a tree. Body slightly turned to the left, head in profile to the right.

8623.d: Tänav madalate majadega. Esiplaanil läbi rohelise avatud värava avaneb vaade õuele. Tagaplaanil keskel sinise taeva taustal kollane vabrikukorsten.
8623.de: A street with low houses. In the foreground, a view of a courtyard opens through a green open gate. In the background, in the middle, a yellow factory chimney against a blue sky.

8630.dm: lehe kõrgus: 16.6 cm; lehe laius: 13.0 cm
8630.d: Ees keskel interjööris seisev alasti naisfiguur, käed tõstetud üles. Taga akna juures kolm inimfiguuri.
8630.de: In the front centre a standing nude female figure in an interior, hands raised upward. Behind, by the window, three human figures.

8642.d: Vasakult paremale suunduv tänav väikeste vanade majadega. Tänaval vasakul ees tütarlaps, tagapool vanem naine koeraga.
8642.de: A street running from left to right with small old houses. On the street, in front on the left a girl, behind an older woman with a dog.

8645.dm: laius: 151.0 cm (kaks osa koos  ); kõrgus: 190.0 cm
8645.d: Punasest, kollasest, rohelisest ja sinisest pinnast koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon valgel foonil. Värvilised pinnad ümbritsetud musta kontuurjoonega. Musta joonega on antud fooniosas väikesed ruudud ja abstraktsed pinnad, üksikud jooned ja katkendlikud kriipsud.
8645.de: Abstract composition consisting of red, yellow, green and blue surfaces on a white background. The coloured surfaces are surrounded by a black contour line. In the background area small squares and abstract surfaces, individual lines and broken dashes are given with a black line.

8646.d: Tumedal foonil rohekal alusel vaas suure kimbu karikakardega.
8646.de: A vase with a large bunch of daisies on a greenish stand, against a dark background.

8649.d: Esiplaanil kollakas põld seitsme viljarõuguga. Tagapool künkad, mida vasakul katab mets.(eesti)
8649.de: In the foreground a yellowish field with seven grain stacks. Behind, hills, covered by forest on the left.

8653.d: Paremal looklev jõgi; vasakul jõekaldal suure puu oksal ettepoole kummarduv ja puu all istuv alasti inimfiguur, jalad vees.
8653.de: On the right a winding river; on the left riverbank, on the branch of a large tree leaning forward, and under the tree a seated naked human figure, feet in the water.

8654.d: Ees mererannal lebav figuur. Samas meesfiguuri maast tõstev ingel. Taga meri.
8654.de: In front a figure lying on the seashore. Also an angel lifting a male figure from the ground. Behind, the sea.

8655.d: Vasakul tõmmunahksete figuuride grupp, millest eendub paremal istuvale mehele karikat ulatav naine.
8655.de: A group of tanned figures on the left, from which a woman handing a goblet to a seated man on the right stands out.

8656.d: Keskealise, taha kuklasse kammitud juustega naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Foon roheline.
8656.de: Bust of a middle-aged woman with hair combed back into a bun, in half-profile to the left. Green background.

8657.d: Ees paremal veekogu. Vasakul kaldapervel istuv alasti naisfiguur, vasak jalg vees.
8657.de: In front on the right a body of water. On the left a nude female figure sitting on the bank, left leg in the water.

8658.d: Tagant paremalt ette vasemale suunduv rühm lauldes rändavaid mehi värvirõõmsas riietuses. Eelsammuja mängib kitarri. Taga paremal suur puu pingiga selle all ja inimfiguure. Taga vasemal paistavad orust punased majakatused ja kirik ning taamal oru taga mäestik.
8658.de: A group of men travelling and singing, moving from the back right towards the front left, in colourfully joyous clothing. The one leading the way plays a guitar. In the back on the right a large tree with a bench beneath it and human figures. In the back on the left, red roofs of a valley and a church can be seen, and beyond, mountains behind the valley.

8666.dm: laius: 14.0 cm (km); laius: 17.7 cm (vm  ); laius: 15.0 cm (km ); kõrgus: 20.7 cm (vm )
8666.d: Heledapäise, keskelt lahku kammitud juustega keskealise naine ümarpilt poolprofiilis paremale.
8666.de: Round portrait of a middle-aged woman with fair hair parted in the middle, half-profile to the right.

8668.d: Paremal all osa jõest. Ülejäänud pildipinna võtab enda alla künklik maastik paari madala majaga kaldapealsel. Värv kantud lõuendile laiade pintslilöökide ja pahtliga.
8668.de: Lower right part of a river. The rest of the picture surface is taken up by a hilly landscape with a couple of low houses on the bank. Paint applied to canvas with broad brushstrokes and palette knife.

8676.d: Esiplaanil ree ette rakendatud hobune ja reel istuv inimesekuju selgvaates. Vasemal puuaed ja pikk hoone. Tagaplaanil puu, maja ja veski.
8676.de: In the foreground a horse harnessed to a sled and a human figure sitting on the sled, seen in profile. On the left a wooden fence and a long building. In the background a tree, a house and a mill.

8677.d: Esiplaanil madal kivine rand paadisillaga ja veekogu.
8677.de: In the foreground a low stony shore with a boat pier and a body of water.

8678.d: Vasakul tormine meri. Paremal eest astmeliselt tahapoole kõrgenev kaljukallas metsatukaga alumisel platool. Ees, paremal kaks raudrüüs ratsanikku; vasakult neile vastu tulev tumehalli linikusse mähkunud meeste kolmik ehmatatud, tõrkuvail hobusteil.
8678.de: On the left a stormy sea. On the right a rocky shore rising in tiers, with a patch of forest on the lower plateau. In front, on the right, two armoured horsemen; from the left, coming toward them, a trio of men wrapped in dark grey cloths, startled, on rearing horses.

8679.d: Linnamotiiv (Müürivahe tänav Tallinnas) esiplaanilt majade vahel sügavusse suunduva kitsa tänavaga.
8679.de: An urban motif (Müürivahe Street in Tallinn) with a narrow street receding into the depth between houses in the foreground.

8680.d: Kolmest küljest kivimajadega ümbritsetud platsil töötamas inimesed ja ekskavaator. Esiplaanil raagus puu.
8680.de: People working with an excavator on a site surrounded on three sides by stone buildings. In the foreground a bare tree.

8681.d: Naise stiliseeritud poolakt, pea profiilis paremale. Naise nahk oranžikas-punane. Peas stiliseeritud kollased, punaste südamikega lilled. Keha meenutab viiuli kõlakasti. Taust kirevates sinistes likkakates ning pehmes ooker-toonis.
8681.de: Stylised female half-nude, head in profile facing right. The woman's skin is orangish-red. On her head, stylised yellow flowers with red centres. Her body resembles the sound box of a violin. The background is in vivid blue lilac-ish tones and a soft ochre tone.

8685.d: Ovaali paigutatud noore naise poolfiguur, keha pöördes paremale, pea vasemale, pilk alla suunatud. Pea mähitud pruunikasse rätti, paremal õlal heleroheline rüü. Käes rinna kohale tõstetud madal vaas.
8685.de: The half-figure of a young woman placed in an oval, body turned to the right, head to the left, gaze directed downward. Head wrapped in a brownish scarf, light green robe on the right shoulder. Holding a low vase raised to chest level.

8690.d: Keskel, puude latvade vahelt avaneb vaade veekogule, mille madalaid kaldaid piirab paremal võsastik, vasakul mets. Metsas valge maja. Horisondil paremal sinetav mets.
8690.de: In the centre, between the treetops, a view opens onto a body of water whose low banks are bordered by shrubbery on the right, forest on the left. In the forest a white house. On the horizon on the right a bluish forest.

8695.d: Kolmveerandprofiilis paremale tugitoolis istuv tütarlaps, sinise kübara ja seelikuga, sini - punases vöödilises pluusis; vasak käsi tooli korjul, parem toolitoel; rohekas - karmiin foon. Tüdrukul rüpes astrid ja kollased lilled.
8695.de: A girl seated in three-quarter profile to the right in an armchair, with a blue hat and skirt, in a blue-red striped blouse; left hand on the armrest of the chair, right hand on the chair back; greenish-carmine background. The girl has asters and yellow flowers in her lap.

8696.d: Paremalt vasakule kerge tõusuga lagedal rohtmaal vasakul rõhtpalkidest, ristnurkadega kolmejärguline ehitus, mille keskmine osa katuseta, kuna mõlemaid otsmisi osi katab püstlaudadest katus. Vasakpoolses osas tõuseb katuse küljelt välja madal korsten. Kogu ehitis tundub mahajäetud. Paremal taga näha merd. Taevas kerges rünkpilves.
8696.de: On open grassland rising gently from right to left, on the left a three-part building of horizontal logs with cross-corners, whose middle section is without a roof, while both end sections are covered by a roof of upright boards. In the left section a low chimney rises from the side of the roof. The whole structure appears abandoned. In the background on the right, the sea is visible. The sky has light cumulus clouds.

8699.d: Esiplaanil vasakul taluhoone nurk avatud uksega ja nooleotstega ukse kõrval ja ees. Hoone ees vasakul talupoja rõivastatud meesfiguur vibu pingutamas. Temast paremal mõõgaga varustatud seisev talupoja figuur. Paremal keskel mees vibuga üle õla ja nooltega käes seljaga vaataja poole. Taga paremal taluhoone nurk ja kõrge värav suurema grupi meesfiguuridega.(eesti)
8699.de: In the foreground on the left, the corner of a farm building with an open door, with arrowheads beside and in front of the door. In front of the building on the left, a male figure in peasant dress drawing a bow. To his right, a standing peasant figure equipped with a sword. In the centre right, a man with a bow over his shoulder and arrows in hand, his back to the viewer. Behind, on the right, the corner of a farm building and a tall gate with a larger group of male figures.

8700.d: Rohtunud kaldakallak, vasakul puud ja põõsad, paremal üksik puu, tagaplaanil meri kajakatega, rünkpilvedega taevas.
8700.de: A grassy slope of the shore, trees and bushes on the left, a solitary tree on the right, in the background the sea with gulls, cumulus clouds in the sky.

8702.d: Esiplaanil valged, punaste põhjade ja kajutitega suured paadid, kahel neist mastid purjede tarvis. Vasakul tagaplaanil tume, vaid markeeritud akendega maja. Esiplaanil paremal kuni silmapiirini vesi, ülal sinine taevas. Hallikassinised, valged ja mustad toonid, maalitud ekspressiivsete laiade, asjade mahtusid vaid üldiselt määravate pintslilöökidega.
8702.de: In the foreground, large white boats with red hulls and cabins, two of them with masts for sails. In the background on the left, a dark house marked only by its windows. In the foreground on the right, water extending to the horizon, blue sky above. Greyish-blue, white and black tones, painted with expressive broad brushstrokes that only generally define the volumes of things.

8704.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.2 cm; lehe laius: 51.4 cm
8704.d: Ees paremal mäeahelike vahel org kiriku ja hoonetega. Silmapiiril kaljumäed.
8704.de: In front on the right, between mountain ranges, a valley with a church and buildings. On the horizon, rocky mountains.

8706.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 20.8 cm; lehe laius: 23.4 cm
8706.d: Pildi alumine osa kaetud ühtlase roosaka tooniga. Ülaosas mäeahelikke ja pilves taevas.
8706.de: The lower part of the picture is covered with a uniform pinkish tone. Mountain ranges and a cloudy sky above.

8708.d: Punase põhja ja ribidest seljatoega toolil istub tütarlaps, kelle mõlemad käed toetuvad toolipõhjale ning vaade on suunatud vaatlejale. Kõrvu katavad kollakaspruunid juuksed, seljas punase-mustaruuduline seelik, mis jätab põlved osalt katmata ning roheline laiade revääridega pluus. Foon sinistes ja pruunides toonides, tiheda nähtava pintslitööga maaliline käsitlus, domineerivad külmad toonid.
8708.de: On a chair with a red seat and a ribbed backrest sits a girl, both of her hands resting on the seat of the chair, her gaze directed at the viewer. Her ears are covered by yellowish-brown hair, she is wearing a red-and-black checked skirt, which partly leaves the knees uncovered, and a green blouse with wide lapels. Background in blue and brown tones, a painterly treatment with dense visible brushwork, cold tones dominating.

8712.d: Punakaspruunides toonides metsamotiiv teega esiplaanil. Taga keskel, heleda õhtutaeva foonil haralise puu tume siluett, millest vasakul punetav päikeseketas. Spontaanne maalilaad, pastoosselt maalitud.
8712.de: A forest motif in reddish-brown tones with a road in the foreground. Behind in the middle, against a light evening sky, the dark silhouette of a branching tree, to the left of which a reddening disc of the sun. Spontaneous painterly style, painted in impasto.

8717.d: Esiplaanil meri, kaldaäärsete valgete murdlainetega. Vasakul taeva kohal neli lendavat kajakat.
8717.de: In the foreground the sea, with white breaking waves along the shore. On the left, above the sky, four flying gulls.

8719.d: Väga keeruliselt liigendatud, tiheda geomeetrilise struktuuriga kompositsioon, milles kasutatud kõiki geomeetrilisi kujundeid. Värvidest domineerivad sinine, punane, hall, must, valge ja kollane.
8719.de: A very intricately articulated composition with a dense geometric structure, in which all kinds of geometric forms are used. Among the colours, blue, red, grey, black, white and yellow dominate.

8730.d: Tuhkjal veekogul esiplaanil kaks paati. Paremal osa kollasest hoonest, mille vari langeb vee pinnale. Taamal kallas majadega.
8730.de: On an ashen body of water in the foreground two boats. On the right part of a yellow building, whose shadow falls on the surface of the water. In the background a shore with houses.

8736.d: Esiplaanil osa laevast ja seitse meest võrkude ning nööridega.(eesti)
8736.de: Part of a ship and seven men with nets and ropes in the foreground.

8737.d: Esiplaanil võitlevate sõjameeste poolfiguurid, keskel linnus, taga talvine maastik.(eesti)
8737.de: In the foreground half-figures of fighting warriors, in the middle a fortress, behind a winter landscape.

8739.d: Esiplaanil paremal meri, vasakul kallas purjekatega.
8739.de: In the foreground on the right the sea, on the left the shore with sailboats.

8740.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis, peapöördega vasaku õla suunas. Täishabemes halli vinet. Riietus tumedat värvi.
8740.de: Bust portrait of an elderly man in half-profile, head turned towards the left shoulder. Full grey beard. Dark-coloured clothing.

8744.d: Pildi keskel lai liivane maantee kaugusesse suundumas. Vasakul teeservas puud, paremal maanteekraav tükikese rohelise aasaga. Taevas hallikasinine. Pildi paremas ülanurgas üksik valge pilvetutt. Pastoossed tugevad pintslilöögid, mitmes rohelises toonis üldkoloriit.
8744.de: In the centre of the picture a wide sandy road heading into the distance. On the left edge of the road trees, on the right a road ditch with a small piece of green meadow. Sky greyish-blue. In the upper right corner of the picture a single tuft of white cloud. Pastose strong brushstrokes, overall colouring in several shades of green.

8748.d: Paremal asetseva laua kõrval oleval toolil istuv poisike poolprofiilis paremale. Jalad jalgpingil. Vasakus, küünarnukiga kõrvalolevale lauaservale toetatud käes keedetud vähk.(eesti)
8748.de: A boy sitting in half-profile to the right on a chair beside a table on the right. Feet on a footstool. In his left hand, with the elbow resting on the edge of the adjoining table, a boiled crayfish.

8752.d: Beežika maja ees seisavad kaks eakat naist. Vasakpoolne seisab ukselävel, peas punane rätik, seljas kollakas pluus, sinine vest ja sinakas toonis sitsseelik; jalas mustad sokid ja rohelised kingad. Naise käsi on küünarnukist tõstetud ning peos hoiab pikka, pliiatsilaadset eset. Teine naine seisab maali keskosas. Tema käed on kõhul, peod koos. Seljas kannab ta helesinist pluusi, punast vesti, sinist seelikut ning rohekat põlle. Jalas sinised kingad. Maalitud naiiv-realistlikus laadis.
8752.de: In front of a beige house stand two elderly women. The one on the left stands in the doorway, a red kerchief on her head, wearing a yellowish blouse, a blue vest and a bluish-toned chintz skirt; black socks and green shoes on her feet. The woman's arm is raised at the elbow and her hand holds a long, pencil-like object. The other woman stands in the centre of the painting. Her hands are on her stomach, palms together. She wears a light blue blouse, a red vest, a blue skirt and a greenish apron. Blue shoes on her feet. Painted in a naive-realist style.

8754.d: Roosakas taevas peegeldumas veekogule, millel esiplaanil paadisild paatidega. Taamal paremal purjekas. Vastaskallas laugjas.
8754.de: A pinkish sky reflected on a body of water, on which in the foreground a boat dock with boats. In the distance on the right a sailboat. The opposite shore is gently sloping.

8761.d: Lapsed ümber tüseda, suurte rindadega naise, kelle süles laps rinda imemas. Tagapõhi tume, naise paljale ülakehale langeb valgus.
8761.de: Children around a stout woman with large breasts, a child at her breast suckling. The background dark, light falling on the woman's bare upper body.

8765.d: Sinisel taustal esiplaanil üleval neli inimpeadega olevust. Keskel vasakul sinistes toonides aasiapäraselt riietatud naisolevus. Tema taga kollakas toonis vanem nägu, kõrval kaks väikesemat figuuri roosakates rõivastes. Olendid on grupina vesikasvude (?) vahel. All keskel roosakates ja hallides toonides abstraktne kujutis.
8765.de: Against a blue background, in the upper foreground, four beings with human heads. In the centre left, a female being in blue tones, dressed in an Asian-like manner. Behind her an older face in yellowish tones, beside it two smaller figures in pinkish garments. The beings are grouped among aquatic plants (?). At the bottom centre, an abstract image in pinkish and grey tones.

8768.d: Tumedajuukselise tõmmunahalise naise seisev täisfiguur keha en face, pea kerge pöördega vasakule. Seljas tume maani ulatuv seelik, üle õlgade roheline vöö vahele kinnitatud õlarätt. Peas valge seljale langev rätik.
8768.de: Standing full figure of a dark-haired, dark-skinned woman, body en face, head turned slightly to the left. Wearing a dark ankle-length skirt, over the shoulders a green sash fastening a shoulder shawl. On the head a white kerchief falling onto the back.

8770.d: Ees paremal tiigi nurk partidega. Vasakul, kaldal, kintspükstes, sabakuues ja kõvas kübaras, seljapaunaga turjal, "graatsilises" poosis mees partidele toitu pakkumas. Taga paremal üksik eluhoone.
8770.de: In front, on the right, a corner of a pond with ducks. On the left, on the bank, a man in knee-breeches, a tailcoat and a top hat, with a knapsack on his back, in a "graceful" pose, offering food to the ducks. Behind, on the right, a solitary dwelling house.

8773.dm: laius: 11.3 cm; kõrgus: 15.8 cm; kõrgus: 17.1 cm; laius: 10.9 cm
8773.d: Kurruline maastik, esiplaanil nõos seisvate palkmajadega kerkib keskplaanil liivase mäenõlvakuna kõrgendikuks. Sellel paistab taamal õigeusu kiri ja lehtpuude salu.
8773.de: A folded landscape, in the foreground log houses standing in a hollow, rising in the middle ground as a sandy hillside into an elevation. On it, in the distance, an Orthodox church and a grove of deciduous trees can be seen.

8775.d: Pildil esiplaanil lumine tänav. Paremale jääb osa müürist ning madal, punase katusega maja; vasakule kollaseks värvitud maja nurk. Tänava otsas avaneb vaade Toomkirikule.
8775.de: A snowy street in the foreground of the picture. On the right is part of a wall and a low house with a red roof; on the left the corner of a house painted yellow. At the end of the street, a view of Toomkirik (the Dome Church) opens up.

8779.d: Bordoopunasel ja sinistes toonides draperiidel istuv aktifiguur; sääred ristatud, käed toetavad külgedel peopesadega toolile. Pruunide lokkis juustega pea pisut vasemale kallutatud, lõug tõstetud. Foon sinakashall, ookrikarva õrnade triipidega. Aktifiguur maalitud kollastes ja lillaes toonides.(eesti)
8779.de: A nude figure sitting on burgundy-red and blue-toned drapery; legs crossed, hands resting on the chair at the sides with palms down. The head with brown curly hair tilted slightly to the left, chin raised. The background is bluish-grey, with delicate ochre-coloured stripes. The nude figure is painted in yellow and lilac tones.

8782.d: Tumedajuukselise valges õlgu pljaks jätvas kleidis noore naise poolfiguur peaaegu en face. Üle õlgade õhuline sall.
8782.de: Half-figure, almost en face, of a young dark-haired woman in a white off-the-shoulder dress. A light scarf across her shoulders.

8784.d: a) Esiplaanil külatänav, paremal kaks rookatusega talumaja. Vasakul suur tiibadega kiviveski ja selle kõrval madal punase katusega hoone. Kolmveerand pildipinnast võtab enda alla pilvine taevas.
8784.de: a) In the foreground a village street, on the right two thatched-roof farmhouses. On the left a large stone windmill with wings and next to it a low building with a red roof. Three-quarters of the picture surface is taken up by a cloudy sky.

8787.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, halli habeme ja turbaniga.(eesti)
8787.de: Bust portrait of a man in half-profile to the right, with a grey beard and a turban.

8788.d: Tumedajuukselise poisikese rinnapilt. Pea kerge pöördega paremale. Seljas kõrge kraega koolipoisi vormikuub.
8788.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired boy. Head turned slightly to the right. Wearing a high-collared schoolboy's uniform coat.

8791.dm: laius: 39.4 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 28.3 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 29.6 cm (arm.   ); laius: 37.7 cm (vm.   )
8791.d: Esiplaanil puude ja põõsaste vahel asuvad majad. Vasakul suurel kivil kaks meest istumas. Keskel veekogu - lahesopp paari ankrus purjekaga. Taamal üle vee mäejalal asula, mille parempoolseks piiriks mäel asuva linnuse varemed.
8791.de: In the foreground houses among trees and bushes. On the left two men sitting on a large rock. In the centre a body of water - a bay inlet with a sailing boat at anchor. In the distance, across the water, a settlement at the foot of a mountain, its right-hand boundary the ruins of a fortress on the mountain.

8793.d: Keskel neli hirve põõsastiku keskel. Ülal linnud okstel.
8793.de: In the centre four deer amid bushes. Birds on branches above.

8797.d: Esiplaanil parempoolsete madalate kaljurüngaste vahel puudesalu ja väike onn. Pisut tagapool, vasakul kuuskede rida. Taustaks kõrged mäeahelikud.
8797.de: In the foreground, among low rocky crags on the right, a grove of trees and a small hut. A little further back, on the left, a row of spruces. High mountain ranges in the background.

8798.d: Esiplaanil kolmest küljest madala, avadega müüriga piiratud plats, mille taga sinise taeva taustal kellatornidega hoone.
8798.de: In the foreground a square enclosed on three sides by a low wall with openings, behind it against a blue sky background a building with bell towers.

8801.d: Pikkade looklevate pintslilöökidega maalitud panoraamne maastikuvaade. Esiplaanist jookseb pildi sügavusse looklev jõgi, mille kaldail ookritoonides luht. Keskplaanis tihe põõsastik, mille taga laiuvad silmapiirini kollased põllud. Silmapiiril väikesed lillades ja sinistes toonides antud puud ja põõsad, ülal erksinine taevas kollaka pilvesäbruga.(eesti)
8801.de: A panoramic landscape view painted with long winding brushstrokes. A winding river runs from the foreground into the depth of the picture, its banks a meadow in ochre tones. In the middle ground dense bushes, behind which yellow fields extend to the horizon. On the horizon small trees and bushes given in purple and blue tones, above a bright blue sky with a yellowish fringe of clouds.

8803.d: Halli juuste ja põskhabemega vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Peas kalott. Parem käsi rinnal.
8803.de: Bust of an elderly man with grey hair and side-whiskers, in half-profile facing right. Wearing a skullcap. Right hand on chest.

8804.d: Esiplaanil plats inimfiguuridega, vasakul park, paremal ja taga majad, tagaplaanil vasakul veeriba ja mäed.
8804.de: In the foreground a square with human figures, on the left a park, on the right and behind houses, in the background on the left a strip of water and mountains.

8812.d: Ees Tartumaa rahvarõivais seisva mehe ja naise täisfiguurid. Ülal paremal nurgas taluhoone.
8812.de: In front, full figures of a man and a woman standing in Tartumaa folk costume. In the upper right corner, a farm building.

8813.d: Võrumaa rahvarõivais seisva mehe (en face) ja selgvaates naise täisfiguurid. Ülal paremal nurgas jõesuudme motiiv kahe kuusega.
8813.de: Full figures of a man standing (en face) and a woman seen from the side, in the folk costume of Võrumaa. In the upper right corner a motif of a river mouth with two spruces.

8814.d: Esiplaanil ümarakaareliste aknaorvadega lossi varemed. Vasakul sammastik. Kaugemal lage maastik, silmapiiril laugjad mäed. Maal osaliselt katmata, alusjoonis kumab läbi.
8814.de: In the foreground ruins of a castle with round-arched window bays. Colonnade on the left. Farther away an open landscape, gently sloping mountains on the horizon. The painting is partly unfinished, the underdrawing shows through.

8815.dm: laius: 60.5 cm (b); kõrgus: 60.5 cm (a); kõrgus: 37.7 cm (b); laius: 37.7 cm (a)
8815.d: a) sinakasmustal taustal helekollane ülalt ahenev vaas suure punastes-roosades õites kimbuga. Maalitud hoogsalt, pastoosselt.
8815.de: a) against a bluish-black background a light yellow vase narrowing at the top with a large bouquet of red-pink flowers. Painted vigorously, pastose.

8816.d: b) Kaks naist. Etüüd. Keskosas heledas kleidis seisev naine, pea profiilis, tõstetud. Paremal, tema taga teine naine kallutab üle esimese õla. Maal pruunikasrohelises koloriidis, figuurid sulavad tausta.
8816.de: b) Two women. Study. In the centre a woman standing in a light-coloured dress, her head in profile, raised. On the right, behind her, another woman leans over her shoulder. The painting is in a brownish-green colour scheme, the figures merging into the background.

8829.d: Laual, vasakul punutud korv täis viinamarju. Paremal, korvi kõrval lahtilõigatud arbuus.
8829.de: On a table, on the left a woven basket full of grapes. On the right, next to the basket, a cut-open watermelon.

8838.dm: lehe kõrgus: 18.1 cm; lehe laius: 14.0 cm
8838.d: Ampiir soengus ja riietuses seisva noore naise poolfiguur. Taustaks süngetes toonides mägine maastik.
8838.de: Half-figure of a young woman standing, in an Empire-style hairdo and dress. Background a mountainous landscape in sombre tones.

8841.d: Keskel, paksust klaasist, ülasuunas kooniliselt ahenevas vaasis, suur kimp värviliste sügislehtedega oksi, mõne küljes musta aroonia kobarad. Vaasi taga vasakul beez keraamiline kauss, arooniaoks üle ääre rippumas. Esiplaanil paremal mõned lauale pudenenud punased lehed. Foon hallikasroheline.
8841.de: In the centre, in a thick glass vase tapering conically upward, a large bunch of branches with colourful autumn leaves, some with clusters of black chokeberries. Behind the vase on the left a beige ceramic bowl, with a chokeberry branch hanging over its rim. In the foreground on the right some red leaves fallen onto the table. The background greyish-green.

8843.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree en face. Must ülikond valge rinnaesise ja ristlipsuga, hall habe ja pruunikad juuksed.
8843.de: Bust portrait of an elderly man en face. Black suit with white shirt front and cross tie, grey beard and brownish hair.

8844.d: Esiplaanil vesi, all keskel näha paadinina. Vasakul tagapool majad.
8844.de: Water in the foreground, a boat's bow visible below in the middle. Houses further back on the left.

8857.d: Ees veekogu. Tahapoole kõrgeneval kaldal üksik hoone.
8857.de: In front a body of water. On the bank rising towards the back, a single building.

8858.d: Ees ( ca 1/2 lõuendist) veekogu keskel oleva silla peegeldus. Vasakult silla alt vaade rohtunud põõsastikuga kaldale.
8858.de: In front (ca 1/2 of the canvas) the reflection of a bridge in the middle of a body of water. From the left, under the bridge, a view of a bank overgrown with bushes.

8859.d: Ees vasakul eest taga kulgev voore taoline küngas raudtee ja kaubavagunitega selle harjal. Paremal veekogu. Taamal linna siluett.
8859.de: In front on the left a ridge-like hill running from front to back with a railway and freight wagons on its crest. On the right a body of water. In the distance the silhouette of a town.

8860.d: Esiplaanil paremalt nurgast vasakule keskele suunduval veekogul vesiveski (ratasveski). Vasakul, kaldal näha palkhoone nurka ja õlgkatust. Taga vastaskaldal, roigastega piiratud põllunurk, selle taga lehtpuumets.
8860.de: In the foreground, on a body of water running from the right corner to the centre-left, a water mill (wheel mill). On the left, on the bank, the corner of a log building and a thatched roof are visible. Behind, on the opposite bank, a corner of a field enclosed by poles, behind it a deciduous forest.

8861.d: Keskaelise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Seljas pruun kleit valge pitskraega.
8861.de: Bust of a middle-aged woman in half-profile to the left. Wearing a brown dress with a white lace collar.

8865.d: Paremal meri. Keskel ja vasakul madal liivane rand pooleldi veest välja tõmmatud paatidega, kuivavate köitega ja askeldava inimgrupiga. Tagapool vasakul kõrge paekallas lehtpuudega.
8865.de: On the right the sea. In the centre and on the left a low sandy beach with boats half pulled out of the water, drying ropes and a group of people busy at work. Further back on the left a high limestone bank with deciduous trees.

8867.d: Esiplaanil murul kaks tütarlast ja poiss lamavad seljaga vaataja poole. Nende tähelepanu on pööratud tagapool künka otsas istuvale vanamehele, kes vasakus käes hoiab kannelt, parem käsi on üles tõstetud. Vanamehest vasakul puud.
8867.de: In the foreground on the grass, two girls and a boy lie with their backs to the viewer. Their attention is directed toward an old man sitting further back on top of a hill, holding a kannel in his left hand, his right hand raised. To the left of the old man, trees.

8870.d: Istuva noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Käed süles olevas muhvis. Punane jakk, mille all must kleit.
8870.de: Half-figure of a seated young woman in a frontal view. Hands in a muff on her lap. Red jacket, under which a black dress.

8874.dm: lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm; lehe laius: 39.0 cm
8874.d: Istuva naise poolakt poolprofiilis vasemale, pea kerge pöördega paremale. Põlvedele laotatud hall riie. Parem käsi tõstetud kuklasse, vasem toetatud kõrvale.
8874.de: A half-length nude of a seated woman in half-profile to the left, head turned slightly to the right. A grey cloth spread over her knees. Right hand raised to the nape of the neck, left hand resting beside her.

8875.dm: lehe kõrgus: 39.1 cm; lehe laius: 30.5 cm
8875.d: Ees lehe all servas taevas tume, ebamääraste vormidega inimese figuur. Ülal poolistuvas asendis allapoole kummarduv naisefiguur.
8875.de: In front, at the lower edge of the sheet, a dark sky, a human figure of indeterminate forms. Above, a female figure in a half-sitting position, bending downward.

8876.dm: kujutise laius: 44.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 34.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 31.0 cm; lehe laius: 46.2 cm
8876.d: Ees paremal künkal istuv paljastatud ülakehaga tumepunases maani seelikus naise figuur. Vasakul nurgas diagonaalselt paremale kasvanud vana lehtpuu ääres kaks ebamäärast figuuri.
8876.de: In front on the right, on a hillock, a seated female figure with bared upper body in a dark red floor-length skirt. In the left corner, by an old deciduous tree growing diagonally to the right, two indistinct figures.

8877.dm: lehe kõrgus: 29.3 cm; lehe laius: 14.5 cm
8877.d: Ees paremal puusammas. Taamal kõrguvad rohuplatsi ääres üksikud puud.
8877.de: A wooden pillar on the right in front. Single trees rise beyond the edge of the grass area in the distance.

8878.dm: lehe kõrgus: 46.1 cm; lehe laius: 35.0 cm
8878.d: Seisev täisfiguur. Nägu peaaegu en face, keha poolprofiilis paremale, käes ristatud seljale. Taustaks lehtpuud.
8878.de: Standing full figure. Face almost en face, body in half-profile to the right, hands crossed behind the back. Leafy trees as background.

8883.dm: kujutise laius: 9.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 11.3 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 10.4 cm; lehe laius: 9.9 cm
8883.d: Künkal suure puu all istuv ja seisev figuur.
8883.de: A figure sitting and standing under a large tree on a hill.

8884.de: In the foreground a road, behind it a lawn with trees.

8887.d: Ees neli punast ja taga kaks rohekat õuna.
8887.de: in front four red and behind two greenish apples

8894.d: Kasvuhoone katuse all pottides valged ja roosakad lilled.
8894.de: White and pinkish flowers in pots under a greenhouse roof.

8897.dm: lehe kõrgus: 21.0 cm; lehe laius: 26.0 cm
8897.d: Vasakul merest väljaulatuval kivil istuv alasti naisfiguur. Paremal vees kaks inimfiguuri.
8897.de: On the left, a nude female figure sitting on a rock protruding from the sea. On the right, two human figures in the water.

8898.d: Kuusirbist valgustatud järveäärsete põõsastike taustal (paremal) seisev alasti naisfiguur. Vasakul suurel kivil teine alasti naisfiguur.
8898.de: A standing female nude figure illuminated by the crescent moon against a background of lakeside bushes (on the right). On the left, on a large rock, a second female nude figure.

8899.d: Kõrgel mereäärsel kaldalnõlval suure puu all poolalasti naisfiguur.
8899.de: A half-naked female figure under a large tree on a high slope by the sea.

8900.d: Ees madalale tarale toetuv musta riietatud, kompsu õlal hoidva naise figuur. Taga metsatukad, põllud ja heinamaad.
8900.de: In front, a figure of a woman dressed in black, leaning against a low fence, holding a bundle on her shoulder. Behind, groves, fields and hayfields.

8901.d: Vasakul astmestikul istuv õuna käes hoidev figuur (Molok); tema ees seisev alasti naisfiguur. Tema taga paremal katmata ülakehaga kaks naisfiguuri. Astmestiku kõrval kolm alasti figuuri.
8901.de: On the left, seated on a stepped platform, a figure holding an apple (Moloch); before him a standing nude female figure. Behind him, to the right, two female figures with bare upper bodies. Beside the platform three nude figures.

8902.d: Kompositsioon kahe ebamäärase jooksva figuuriga. Tagaplaanil lossi kujutis.
8902.de: Composition with two indistinct running figures. In the background a depiction of a castle.

8909.d: Paremal kõrge merekallas põõsastikega; vasemal meri.
8909.de: On the right a high sea shore with bushes; on the left the sea.

8911.d: Keskel veekogu ääres istuv alasti naisfiguur; jalad vees. Taga  seisev alasti naisfiguur profiilis vasakule.
8911.de: A nude female figure sitting by a body of water in the centre; feet in the water. Behind, a standing nude female figure in profile to the left.

8916.d: Selgepiirilistest, üksteisega põimuvatest abstraktsetest värvipindadest kompositsioon, kus domineerib oliivkollane, must, punane, helesinine, roosa toon. Sakiliste ja kumerate servadega pinnad eraldatud ühtlase, ca 1 cm laiuse kontrastse kontuurjoonega. Dünaamiline kompositsioon meenutab värvilistest paberitest kollaaži.
8916.de: A composition of clearly delineated, interlocking abstract colour surfaces dominated by olive-yellow, black, red, light blue and pink tones. The surfaces, with jagged and curved edges, are separated by a uniform contrasting contour line about 1 cm wide. The dynamic composition resembles a collage of coloured papers.

8918.d: Tormine meri kõrgete vahuste lainetega. Vasakul rannakaljud. Paremal merehädas laev, mille ees paat inimestega.(eesti)
8918.de: Stormy sea with high foamy waves. Rocky shore on the left. On the right a ship in distress, with a boat full of people in front of it.

8920.d: Gooti stiilis hoone; paremal varemeis torn. Tagaplaanil paremal paistab punase katusega kirikutorn ja vabrikukorsten.
8920.de: A building in Gothic style; on the right a ruined tower. In the background on the right a church tower with a red roof and a factory chimney can be seen.

8923.dm: kõrgus: 148.3 cm (II, vm.   ); laius: 86.3 cm (I, vm.   ); laius: 58.3 cm (II, vm.   ); kõrgus: 148.5 cm (I, vm.   )
8923.d: Parempoolses servas, vertikaalselt peaaegu kogu pildi ulatuses otsekui metallist peaga, suure kõvera noka ja pungis silmaga lind (pea profiilis). Foon ülalt sinine.
8923.de: On the right-hand edge, vertically almost the entire extent of the picture, a bird as if with a metal head, a large curved beak and a bulging eye (head in profile). The background blue at the top.

8924.d: Esiplaanil vasakul männid, silmapiiril mets. Keskel õlgkatusega talukompleks ja lattaed.
8924.de: In the foreground on the left pines, forest on the horizon. In the middle a straw-roofed farmstead complex and a pole fence.

8929.d: Ees keskel rohtunud puudest ümbritsetud lagendikul väike suvemaja. Vasakul puude all seisvaid ja istuvaid figuure.
8929.de: In front, in the middle, on a grassy clearing surrounded by trees, a small summer house. On the left, figures standing and sitting under the trees.

8933.d: Esiplaanil rangeilmelise talupoja poolfiguur, püss käes. Tema kõrval kaks poissi ja tagapool tütarlaps. Keskel ratsanik, kõrval sõjaväelasi jala ja ratsa, paremal talupojad. Kogu pind kaetud eredate lillakate ja sinakate laikudega, silmapiiril punane triip.
8933.de: In the foreground a half-figure of a stern-looking peasant, gun in hand. Beside him two boys and, further back, a girl. In the middle a horseman, beside him soldiers on foot and on horseback, on the right peasants. The whole surface covered with bright purplish and bluish patches, on the horizon a red stripe.

8943.dm: lehe kõrgus: 34.7 cm; lehe laius: 46.7 cm
8943.d: Eest tahapoole kõrgenev mäekallas suure kaljurahnuga vasakul. Kaljurahnu ääres väike osmik, roigastara ja laialeheliste taimede ribaga. Ees paremal teravnurgana väike veenire.
8943.de: A hillside rising from the front backwards, with a large boulder on the left. Beside the boulder a small hut, a pole fence and a strip of broad-leaved plants. In front on the right a small sharp-angled stream.

8944.d: Esiplaanil paremal kaljurahnud, taga veekogu ja lumine mäestik.
8944.de: In the foreground on the right, boulders, behind a body of water and a snowy mountain range.

8945.dm: lehe kõrgus: 36.0 cm; lehe laius: 50.5 cm
8945.d: Ees veekogu kitsa kivise kaldaribaga. Vasakult taha paremale kulgeb kallast moodustav mägede ahelik.
8945.de: In front, a body of water with a narrow rocky strip of shore. From left to right in the background runs a mountain range forming the shore.

8948.d: Lageda maastiku taustal noormehe poolfiguur külgvaates paremale, kes hoiab vastu rinda seljakotti, millest kõvera nokaga lind välja upitamas. Mehel pikemad ülepea kammitud juuksed, muigel nägu suunatud linnule, seljas roostepruun särk. Realistlikult kujutatud, summutatud beežikaspruunid toonid.
8948.de: Against the background of an open landscape, the half-figure of a young man in side view facing right, holding against his chest a backpack, out of which a bird with a curved beak is peeking. The man has longer hair combed back over the head, his smiling face turned towards the bird, wearing a rust-brown shirt. Realistically depicted, subdued beigish-brown tones.

8949.d: Kõhna näoga keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, parem õlg pisut tõstetud, kõverdatud käes sigaret. Mehel must barett kuklas, tumeda pintsaku alt paistmas punakas särk, sinine sviiter. Valdavalt lillakashallid, roostepruunid toonid.
8949.de: Half-figure of a gaunt-faced, middle-aged man, in a half-turn to the left, right shoulder slightly raised, cigarette in his bent hand. The man wears a black beret pushed to the back of his head, a reddish shirt showing beneath his dark jacket, blue jumper. Predominantly lilac-grey, rusty-brown tones.

8957.d: Kiilaspäise, tumedasse rõivastatud mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega paremale helesinisel foonil. Paremal osa teisest figuurist, kelle väljasirutatud, lõpuni maalimata käsi ulatub esimese rinna kohale.
8957.de: Half-figure of a bald-headed man in dark clothing, in a slight turn to the right, on a light blue background. On the right part of another figure, whose outstretched, unfinished arm reaches to above the first figure's chest.

8960.d: Pildi servades esiplaanil madalad, kerakujuliste kapiteelidega sinised sambad ja nende taga helesinised, rohekate varjudega, koonilised põõsatse siluetid. Keskel paarikaupa oranžid-punased-pruunid meeste ja naiste laialivalguvate piirjoontega grotesksed siluetid. Taustaks tumesinine taevas veidi heledamate rünkpilvedega.(eesti)
8960.de: At the edges of the picture in the foreground, low blue columns with spherical capitals, and behind them light blue, greenish-shadowed, conical silhouettes of bushes. In the middle, in pairs, grotesque silhouettes of men and women in orange-red-brown tones with blurred outlines. The background is a dark blue sky with slightly lighter cumulus clouds.

8970.d: Esiplaanil madal liivarand üksikute rohutuustidega. Rannal liikumas mehi ja naisi. Veepiirile veetud paate, nende juures askeldavaid inimesi. Paatide lähedal rannas lõkke ääres inimesi.
8970.de: In the foreground a low sandy beach with scattered tufts of grass. Men and women moving about on the beach. Boats pulled up to the waterline, people busying themselves around them. Near the boats, people around a campfire on the beach.

8972.d: Vasakult paremale kulgeva aia taga suured lehtpuud (ca 4/5 lõuendist aia ja puude all).
8972.de: Behind a fence running from left to right, large deciduous trees (approx. 4/5 of the canvas under the fence and trees).

8975.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres lambakari. Eemal metsariba. Taevas kollakais - punakais toonides.
8975.de: In the foreground a flock of sheep by a body of water. A strip of forest in the distance. Sky in yellowish-reddish tones.

8977.dm: laius: 36.0 cm (lm.); kõrgus: 20.2 cm (km.); kõrgus: 20.9 cm (lm.); laius: 36.0 cm (km.)
8977.d: Suvine lehtpuumaastik lageda niiduga vasemal, mille taga kaks hobust metsa taustal. Paremal esiplaanil näha suure puu ees tüvi, latv ulatub pildi pinnast välja.(eesti)
8977.de: Summer deciduous landscape with open meadow on the left, behind which two horses against a forest background. On the right in the foreground the trunk of a large tree can be seen, its top extending beyond the picture surface.

8978.d: Visand kaheksast õunast: viis punast ja kolm kollakat.
8978.de: Sketch of eight apples: five red and three yellowish.

8979.d: Esiplaanil veekogu pruuni ja rohelise sillakaarega. Ülal, tumesinise taeva taustal, hooned ja tehasekorstnad.
8979.de: In the foreground, a body of water with a brown and green bridge arch. Above, against a dark blue sky, buildings and factory chimneys.

8981.d: Esiplaanil üksikud põõsad ja muru; taga puude vahel maja.
8981.de: In the foreground single bushes and grass; behind, a house among trees.

8982.d: Esiplaanil kurruline niit üksikute põõsastega. Taamal kaugel horisondil metsaviirg.
8982.de: In the foreground a furrowed field with isolated bushes. In the distance on the horizon a strip of forest.

8985.d: Keskel ees üle oja viiv sild mehe ja koeraga, taga kingukesel vesiveski; selle kõrval vasemal veskitamm. Hoone otsaseinas oleva ukse ees üks seisev ja paar istuvat figuuri; koer ja kanad. Taga mets, paremal ees suur puu jändriku tüviga.
8985.de: In the centre foreground a bridge over a stream with a man and a dog, behind on a hillock a water mill; beside it on the left a mill dam. In front of the door in the gable wall of the building one standing and a couple of sitting figures; a dog and chickens. Behind, forest, in front on the right a large tree with a gnarled trunk.

8990.d: Esiplaanil veekogu saarekestega. Taga madal rohtunud kallas taluhoonetega.
8990.de: In the foreground a body of water with small islands. Behind, a low grassy bank with farm buildings.

8992.d: Tänava ääres madal kollane punase viilkatusega maja antenniga katusel. Vasakult paistmas kõrgema kivimaja otsafassaad.
8992.de: A low yellow house with a red gable roof and an antenna on the roof, by the street. On the left, the end façade of a taller stone building can be seen.

8993.d: Madalad majad tänava ääres. Esiplaanil punane puumaja, millest vasakul, taraga piiratud õuel, kaks lehtpuud.
8993.de: Low houses along a street. In the foreground a red wooden house, to the left of which, in a fenced yard, two deciduous trees.

8997.d: Kõrge kaelusega mundrikuues noormehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale.
8997.de: Bust portrait of a young man in a high-collared uniform coat, in half-profile to the right.

9001.d: Mustas, punaste revääridega vormikuues, tugitoolis istuva heledajuukselise, vurrudega mehe põlvpilt en face. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule.
9001.de: Knee-length portrait of a fair-haired, moustached man sitting in an armchair, en face, wearing a black uniform coat with red lapels. Body with a slight turn to the left.

9002.d: Vasakul veeloik, keskel tee suurte tammede all sammuva naise figuuriga selgvaates.
9002.de: On the left a puddle, in the middle a road under large oaks with the figure of a walking woman in clear view.

9003.d: Esiplaanil madala puukai ääres purjelevad ja paadid. Vasakul, kaldal näha hoonete katuseid.
9003.de: In the foreground, sailing boats and boats by a low wooden pier. On the left, rooftops of buildings visible on the shore.

9004.d: Heledapäise, lokkisjuukselise, pruunis rüüs viiuldava tütarlapse põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas suured inglitiivad. Pea ümber oreool. Foon helesinine.
9004.de: Knee-length portrait of a fair-haired, curly-haired girl in a brown robe playing the violin, in half-profile to the right. Wearing large angel wings on her back. A halo around her head. Background light blue.

9006.d: Kitsas vanalinna tänav. Vasakul avatud akende ja rippsildiga maja, paremal madalad aknaluukidega majad, mille kohal jupike linnamüüri poolümara katuseta torniga. Domineerivad hallikaspruunid toonid, eriti müür ja majade katused pastoosselt maalitud. (eesti)
9006.de: A narrow old-town street. On the left a house with open windows and a hanging sign, on the right low houses with window shutters, above which a piece of the town wall with a semicircular, roofless tower. Greyish-brown tones dominate, especially the wall and the roofs of the houses painted in a pastose manner.

9011.d: Visandlikult antud vanema naise rinnaportree. Naise tumedad juuksed on keskel lahku kammitud ja kuklasse kokku pandud, ninal peente kuldsete raamide ja väikeste ümarate klaasidega prillid. Seljas tume kleit, samast riidest krae on tagant üles tõstetud, rinnal kamee. Suurem osa kleidist ja foon lõpetamata.
9011.de: A sketchily rendered bust portrait of an elderly woman. The woman's dark hair is parted in the middle and gathered at the back of the head, on her nose glasses with thin gilt frames and small round lenses. Wearing a dark dress, a collar of the same fabric raised at the back, a cameo on the chest. Most of the dress and the background left unfinished.

9012.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur, poolprofiilis vasakule, punases baretis ja halli karusnahkse kraega.
9012.de: Half-figure of a girl, in half-profile to the left, wearing a red beret and a grey fur collar.

9013.d: Keskel, madala kiviaia taga kündja (mees). Adra ees kaks hobust. Kiviaia vasakul ja paremal raagus puud.
9013.de: In the centre, behind a low stone wall, a ploughman (a man). Two horses in front of the plough. Bare trees to the left and right of the stone wall.

9016.d: Heledate kahlus juustega madruseülikonnas poisikese rinnapilt en face.
9016.de: Bust portrait, en face, of a boy in a sailor suit with light bushy hair.

9017.dm: kõrgus: 44.7 cm (pm); laius: 30.8 cm (km); kõrgus: 22.8 cm (km); laius: 58.7 cm (pm)
9017.d: Esiplaanil väljak monumendiga vasemal, mingid lauad, inimfiguurid. Taga katedraal, paremal kõrge maja nurk, nende vahelt paistab kaugemalt tornikesega ehitis.
9017.de: In the foreground a square with a monument on the left, some tables, human figures. Behind, a cathedral, on the right the corner of a tall building, between them, farther away, a building with a small tower can be seen.

9018.d: Kahekorruseliste majade ja puukuuride vahel hoov. Taevas valkjas - hall.
9018.de: A courtyard between two-storey houses and woodsheds. The sky whitish-grey.

9020.d: Maali keskel Vanemuine kandlega punases rüüs, puutüve taustal. Vasakul tütarlaps profiilis pikkade juustega, valges kleidis, sinises rüüs. Paremal lehm ja lambad, jänes, kaks luike, vasakul pruunikas kukk.
9020.de: In the centre of the painting, Vanemuine with a kannel in a red robe, against the background of a tree trunk. On the left a girl in profile with long hair, in a white dress, in a blue robe. On the right a cow and sheep, a hare, two swans, on the left a brownish rooster.

9022.d: Neli meest laua ümber, kaks vasakul, kaks teisel pool lauda, üks neist karvamütsis. Laual pudelid ja tubakakotid, täidetud klaasid tõstetud. Hallikal seinal nagi jalutuskepiga.
9022.de: Four men around a table, two on the left, two on the other side of the table, one of them wearing a fur hat. On the table bottles and tobacco pouches, filled glasses raised. On the greyish wall a coat hook with a walking stick.

9025.d: Mustas frakis noormehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale.
9025.de: Knee-length portrait of a young man in a black tailcoat, in half-profile to the right.

9026.d: Pastoosselt, laiade jämedate pintslitõmmetega maalitud maastik kirgastes värvitoonides, mille ümardatud vorme piiritlevad põhitooniga hele - tumeduselt kontrasteeruvad jämedad kontuurid. Vaatepunktiga kõrgemalt kui silmade kõrgus vaade üle sinepikollase rohumaa, millele esiplaanil langevad ümarad värvikirkad puudevarjud. Tagaplaanil vasakul suurte võradega lehtpuude taustal punakaspruun ait nurgaga vaataja poole.
9026.de: A landscape painted pastosely, with broad, thick brushstrokes, in bright colour tones, whose rounded forms are delimited by thick contours contrasting in light-dark with the base tone. From a viewpoint higher than eye level, a view over a mustard-yellow meadow, onto which, in the foreground, fall the round, brightly coloured shadows of trees. In the background on the left, against the background of deciduous trees with large crowns, a reddish-brown barn with its corner facing the viewer.

9027.d: Pruunil alusel küljeli olev anum, millest välja kukkunud: (paremal) kimp sibulaid pealsetega, (vasakul) kapsapea. Pilt rohelises, pruunis koloriidis.
9027.de: A vessel lying on its side on a brown base, from which have fallen: (right) a bunch of onions with tops, (left) a head of cabbage. Picture in a green, brown colour scheme.

9028.d: Vasakul alumises nurgas kaarsild, millest eespool kraanad ja kaks kollast liivahunnikut, taamal linna siluett. Paremal betooniga ääristatud kaldarinnatis, tee, mis kauguses lõppeb ümmarguse aiamajakesega. Kahel pool teed puuderida (raagus). Paremal kolmnurkne kaldpind, mille taga tumeroheline kuppel. Taevas helesinine, vasakus ülemises nurgas kollaselt kumav. Puude võrad, liivahunnikud, tee pastoosselt, paksu värvikihiga maalitud, õrn läbipaistev üldkoloriit.(eesti)
9028.de: In the lower left corner an arched bridge, in front of which cranes and two yellow sand heaps, in the distance the silhouette of a city. On the right a concrete-edged embankment parapet, a path that ends in the distance at a round garden pavilion. On both sides of the path a row of trees (bare). On the right a triangular sloping surface, behind which a dark green dome. The sky is light blue, glowing yellow in the upper left corner. The crowns of the trees, the sand heaps, and the path are painted impasto, with a thick layer of paint, the overall colour range delicate and transparent.

9029.d: Ees keskel kuplitaoline mäeküngas kahe jändriku männiga tipul. Künka jalal lõkketule ääres kaks meest, vanker, rohtusööv hobune. Paremal, tagapool, küün. Muu ümbrus kuni silmapiirini lage tasandik. 3/4 tööst kuust valgustatud taeva all.(eesti)
9029.de: In the front center a dome-like hillock with two gnarled pines at its top. At the foot of the hill by a campfire two men, a cart, a horse grazing on grass. On the right, further back, a barn. The rest of the surroundings up to the horizon a bare plain. 3/4 of the work under a sky lit by the moon.

9030.d: Esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal rühm rohekates ja pruunides palitutes, teravatipuliste kübaratega, muhvidega ja boadega naisi. Tagaplaanil teatri interjöör peeglitega: vasakul aktiskulptuur, paremal sinakasrohelises õhtukleidis, paljaste õlgadega ja punaste juustega daam, kelle selg peegeldub ta selja taga asuvas peeglis. Fooniosa külmades sinistes, rohelistes ja lillades toonides.
9030.de: In the foreground, on the left and right, a group of women in greenish and brown coats, with sharply pointed hats, muffs, and boas. In the background a theatre interior with mirrors: on the left a nude sculpture, on the right a lady in a bluish-green evening gown, with bare shoulders and red hair, whose back is reflected in the mirror behind her. The background area in cold blue, green, and lilac tones.

9034.dm: lehe kõrgus: 21.6 cm; lehe laius: 30.0 cm
9034.d: Ees vasakul oleva täiskuust valgustatud veekogu ääres kaks vaaraode kolossaalset skulptuuri. Nende juures tule ümber inimfiguure. Taamal paremal templi varemed, vasakul sammastike read.
9034.de: In the front, beside a body of water lit by a full moon on the left, two colossal sculptures of pharaohs. Around them, near a fire, human figures. In the distance on the right, ruins of a temple, on the left rows of colonnades.

9035.d: Esiplaanil, sinakashallil veekogul paat. Paremal: kraanad ja telliskivipunane kuuritaoline ehitis, mille taga kivisöe hunnik (?). Vasakul kaks maja.
9035.de: In the foreground, on a bluish-grey body of water, a boat. On the right: cranes and a brick-red shed-like building, behind which a pile of coal (?). On the left two houses.

9036.d: Põskhabemega mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Peakatteks punakat tooni, halli ääristusega kottmüts, mille sopp ulatub rätitaoliselt rippuvana õlgadeni. Riietuseks pintsakülikond heleda särgiga, mille rinnaesisel näha tumedat värvi pikk kaelaside.
9036.de: Chest portrait of a man with side-whiskers in three-quarter profile to the left. As headwear, a reddish-toned, grey-trimmed fur cap, whose flap hangs down to the shoulders like a shawl. Clothing consists of a suit jacket with a light shirt, on the front of which a long dark-coloured necktie can be seen.

9039.d: Osa tänavast majadegrupiga ääres. Esiplaanil keskel raagus puu. Taustaks terashall taevas.
9039.de: Part of a street with a group of houses along it. In the foreground in the middle a bare tree. Steel-grey sky as background.

9043.de: Ruins in the foreground. Mountains at the back left.

9047.d: Pruunijuukselise noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Ümber õlgade mässitud sinine rüü.
9047.de: Bust portrait of a young brown-haired woman in half-profile facing right. A blue robe wrapped around her shoulders.

9048.d: Mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale, tugitoolis istuvana; põlvede vahel valge rinna ja käppadega koer.
9048.de: Full figure of a man in half-profile to the right, sitting in an armchair; between his knees a white-chested and white-pawed dog.

9049.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Pitsidega tanu pikad lindid ulatuvad sinisele, dekolteega kleidil kantavale pruunikas toonis mantlile.(eesti)
9049.de: Bust portrait of a woman in half-profile to the left. The long ribbons of a lace-trimmed bonnet reach onto a brownish-toned coat worn over a blue dress with a décolleté.

9056.d: Valged lamedate katustega astmelised hooned laugjal mäenõlval. Maastik lillas - rohelises - pruunis koloriidis, taevas sinine.
9056.de: White, flat-roofed, stepped buildings on a gently sloping hillside. Landscape in a colour scheme of lilac - green - brown, sky blue.

9061.d: Pealtvaade värvikatele viilkatustega majadele, paremal kirikutorn. Tagaplaanil vasakul lahesopp tumeda, rohekassinise taeva all. Maalitud hoogsalt, visandlikult.
9061.de: A bird's-eye view of houses with colourful gable roofs, on the right a church tower. In the background on the left a bay under a dark, greenish-blue sky. Painted boldly, sketchily.

9067.d: Ees keskel Petserimaa rahvarõivais naise ja mehe täisfiguurid. Taga paremal Petseri kloostri motiiv.
9067.de: In the front centre, full figures of a woman and a man in Petserimaa folk costume. In the back on the right, a motif of the Petseri monastery.

9076.d: Veidi vasakule tõusval lamedal nõlvakul esiplaanil koonusekujuline pruunikas heinakuhi, tagapool kolm kuhja. Silmapiiril, rünkpilvise taeva foonil vasakul kähar puu, paremal metsatriip. Maalitud lühikeste jõuliste pintslilöökidega.
9076.de: On a flat slope rising slightly to the left, in the foreground a conical brownish haystack, with three stacks behind. On the horizon, against a cumulus-clouded sky, a curly tree on the left, a strip of forest on the right. Painted with short, vigorous brushstrokes.

9077.d: Musta-rohelise-punase-sinise-lilla-roosa triibulisel riidel kuus kooritud kartulit.
9077.de: On a black-green-red-blue-purple-pink striped cloth, six peeled potatoes.

9092.de: Portrait of a man with pince-nez, in half-profile to the right.

9095.d: Tumedas rõivastuses istuva naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Paremal pool naise süles kollakas rõivastuses laps.
9095.de: Half-figure of a seated woman in dark clothing, in a slight turn to the right. On the right, in the woman's lap, a child in yellowish clothing.

9100.d: Esiplaanil põõsad, mille taga paremal paistab plank ja kahe aknaga viilkatusega maja ots. Vasakul näha punane katus. Keskel üksik puu. Vasakus nurgas lilled.
9100.de: In the foreground bushes, behind which on the right a fence and the gable end of a house with two windows can be seen. On the left a red roof is visible. A solitary tree in the centre. Flowers in the left corner.

9105.d: Pruunikas-kollastes toonides, võrdlemisi lagedal külamaastikul aiaga ääristatud külavahetee, millel kõndimas kaks lehma. Paremal pool visandlikult markeeritud kooguga kaev ning hobusevanker kaevu juures. Kõrval ka taluhoone. Taamal kummalgil pool teed puudesalud ning hoone.
9105.de: In brownish-yellow tones, a fairly open village landscape with a fenced village road, on which two cows are walking. On the right side a sketchily marked well with a sweep and a horse cart by the well. Beside it also a farm building. Further back on both sides of the road groves of trees and a building.

9113.d: Kuklasse kammitud juustega vana naise pea poolprofiilis paremale. Taustaks maastik kirikutorniga.
9113.de: Head of an old woman with hair combed back, in semi-profile to the right. Landscape with a church tower as background.

9115.d: Esiplaanil merel kalapaat allalastud purjedega, paadis istuv naisfiguur, punane rätt peas ja püstiseisev habemik mees, laiaäärelises kübaras ja pikkades kalurisaabastes võrku veest välja tõmbamas. Paadil vööris märk: DL. 23. Taamal näha mitmesuguses kauguses asuvaid purjepaate ning vasakult ja paremalt pildi keskosa suunas silmapiirilt kaduv mägine kaldaviirg, mille kohal vasakul näha tõusva päikese ketas.
9115.de: In the foreground at sea a fishing boat with lowered sails, in the boat a seated female figure with a red kerchief on her head, and a standing bearded man in a wide-brimmed hat and long fisherman's boots pulling a net out of the water. On the bow of the boat a mark: DL. 23. In the distance sailing boats at various distances are visible, and from left and right toward the centre of the picture a mountainous coastline vanishing on the horizon, above which on the left the disc of the rising sun is visible.

9116.d: Laual kõrges klaasist vaasis ja vaasi kõrval lebamas punased nelgid.
9116.de: On the table, in a tall glass vase and lying beside the vase, red carnations.

9117.d: Esiplaanil keskel tee, paremal suur kivi, taamal talumaja keskel ja puud.
9117.de: In the foreground in the middle a road, on the right a large stone, in the distance a farmhouse in the middle and trees.

9118.d: Esiplaanil tasane rohumaa põõsastega. Tagapool mets.
9118.de: In the foreground flat grassland with bushes. Behind it a forest.

9119.d: Ees vasakul kivine rand kahe kaldale tõmmatud venega. paremal meri. (Mere ja ranna piirjoon jookseb diagonaalselt paremast nurgast vasakule keskele).
9119.de: In the foreground left a rocky shore with two boats pulled up onto the bank, right the sea. (The outline between sea and shore runs diagonally from the right corner to the centre left).

9121.d: Ees, kõrgete kividega servistatud kallaste vahel väike veekogu. Tagaplaanil tihe segamets.
9121.de: In front, a small body of water between banks edged with tall stones. Dense mixed forest in the background.

9122.d: Tumedas maani riietuses istuv naine, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Heleda kandiga rätik langeb pikalt õlgadele, süles hoiab punast raamatut ja heledat salli; seeliku alt ulatuvad välja punased kingad. Vasemal punane vaas, milles pildi ülemise servani ulatuv punaste õitega taim. Taevas kuu.
9122.de: A woman sitting in dark floor-length clothing, gaze directed at the viewer. A shawl with a light-coloured edge falls long over her shoulders, on her lap she holds a red book and a light-coloured scarf; red shoes peek out from under her skirt. On the left a red vase, in which a plant with red flowers reaches to the upper edge of the picture. In the sky a moon.

9124.d: Kollastest, lilladest, sinakashallidest ja mustadest värvilaikudest moodustuv inimese nägu. (eesti)
9124.de: A human face formed of yellow, purple, bluish-grey and black patches of colour.

9131.d: Trapetsikujuline roheline pilt, millele on maalitud sinine nelinurk. Viimased kaks teineteise suhtes diagonaalselt asetsevat nurka on ära lõigatud.
9131.de: A trapezoidal green picture, on which a blue quadrangle is painted. The latter's two diagonally opposite corners have been cut off.

9134.d: Ees paremal sanatooriumi hoone lehtpuude taustal. Vasakul eest taha kulgev teerada ja üksikud suured puud.
9134.de: In the foreground on the right, a sanatorium building against a background of deciduous trees. On the left, a path running from front to back and solitary large trees.

9136.dm: laius: 39.6 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 26.8 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 27.0 cm (arm.   ); laius: 37.7 cm (vm.   )
9136.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud, pool-metsik aed vana lehtpuuga paremal. Taga keskel valge kivihoone.
9136.de: In the foreground an overgrown, semi-wild garden with an old deciduous tree on the right. Behind in the middle a white stone building.

9137.d: Veekogu ääres kolm valget hobust, kahel neist ratsanik seljas, üht hoiab alasti mehefiguur suistest. Neljas valge hobune alasti ratsanikuga seisab vees. Paremal kaldal istub valgel linal alasti tumedapäine naine ja lamab valge, pruunide laikudega koer. Paremas ülanurgas üldistatud massiividena antud puud ja põõsad, ülal pilves taevas. Nii inimeste kui hobuste kehad on valguse ja varju abil üksikasjalikult modelleeritud. Rohekashallid ja kollakaspruunid värvitoonid.
9137.de: By a body of water, three white horses, two of them with riders on their backs, one held by the bridle by a naked male figure. A fourth white horse with a naked rider stands in the water. On the right bank, a dark-haired naked woman sits on a white cloth, and a white dog with brown spots lies. In the upper right corner, trees and bushes given as generalised masses, above a cloudy sky. Both the bodies of the people and of the horses are modelled in detail with the help of light and shadow. Greenish-grey and yellowish-brown colour tones.

9140.dm: lehe kõrgus: 45.8 cm; lehe laius: 36.5 cm
9140.d: Heledate, lokkis, rinnale langevate juustega noore neiu rinnapilt. Nägu otse, keha pöördes vasakule.
9140.de: Bust portrait of a young girl with light, curly hair falling onto her chest. Face turned straight ahead, body turned to the left.

9141.dm: lehe kõrgus: 19.0 cm; lehe laius: 24.5 cm
9141.d: Öises maastikus grupp ratsutajaid jooksvatel kaamelitel. Taamal taevas särab täht.
9141.de: In a night landscape, a group of riders on running camels. In the distance a star shines in the sky.

9142.dm: lehe kõrgus: 44.1 cm; lehe laius: 34.0 cm
9142.d: Naise poolfiguur-akt en face, pea kallutatud paremale. Vasak käsi asetatud rinnale, parem tõstetud kõrvale üles.
9142.de: Woman's half-figure nude en face, head tilted to the right. Left hand placed on the chest, right raised up to the side.

9143.dm: lehe kõrgus: 39.8 cm; lehe laius: 32.3 cm
9143.d: Esiplaanil paremal vees ja vasakul kaldaserval kolm fantastilist poollamavat figuuri. Vastaskaldal lamav naisakt, üle niuete heidetud helesinine läbipaistev rätik.
9143.de: In the foreground, on the right in the water and on the left at the edge of the shore, three fantastical, half-reclining figures. On the opposite shore a reclining female nude, a light blue transparent cloth thrown over the hips.

9144.dm: lehe laius: 19.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 30.0 cm
9144.d: All servas ülespööratud peadega figuurid. Ülal kuusirbil istuv alasti naisfiguur.
9144.de: At the bottom edge figures with upturned heads. Above, a nude female figure sitting on a crescent moon.

9145.dm: lehe kõrgus: 29.8 cm; lehe laius: 33.5 cm
9145.d: Paremal veekogu. Vasakul, kaldal istuva naise akt (akt asetatud diagonaalile vasakpoolsest ülanurgast all paremale). Üle naise põlvede kerge kollane rüü. Akti kõrval laiali tiibadega luik.
9145.de: On the right a body of water. On the left, the nude of a woman sitting on the bank (the nude placed on a diagonal from the upper left corner down to the lower right). Over the woman's knees a light yellow drape. Beside the nude a swan with outspread wings.

9146.dm: lehe laius: 30.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 25.6 cm
9146.d: Esiplaanil naise figuur, kelle seljale toetub kihvade ja habemega mehe pea.
9146.de: In the foreground the figure of a woman, against whose back rests the head of a man with tusks and a beard.

9147.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.0 cm; lehe laius: 46.5 cm
9147.d: Vasakul poollängu kasvanud suure puu all kaks ebamäärast figuuri. Paremal istuv figuur.
9147.de: On the left, under a large tree grown at a slant, two indistinct figures. On the right a seated figure.

9157.dm: lehe kõrgus: 20.3 cm; lehe laius: 13.6 cm
9157.d: Alasti seisev naisfiguur interjööris. Taustaks läbi ukseava paistev aknaga sein. Akna all diivanil kaks istuvat figuuri.
9157.de: A standing nude female figure in an interior. Background of a wall with a window visible through a doorway. Under the window, two seated figures on a sofa.

9158.dm: lehe kõrgus: 15.8 cm; lehe laius: 14.7 cm
9158.d: Ees keskel interjööris seisev alasti naisfiguur en face, käed kuklal. Taga, akna juures kahe naise ja ühe mehe figuurid.
9158.de: In the middle foreground, a standing nude female figure en face, hands behind the head. Behind, by the window, figures of two women and one man.

9159.d: Esiplaanil lumised aiad üksikute suurte raagus puudega. Tagapool majad.
9159.de: In the foreground, snowy gardens with individual large bare trees. Houses behind.

9160.d: Rohumaal kaks valge - pruunikirjut lehma söömas. Fooniks pilvine taevas.
9160.de: On a meadow two white-and-brown-spotted cows grazing. Background of cloudy sky.

9164.d: Kasukas karusnahkse mütsiga, vurrude ja lõuahabemega vanema mehe rinnapilt peaaegu en face.
9164.de: Bust portrait of an older man almost en face, in a fur coat with a fur hat, with a moustache and a chin beard.

9166.d: Hallidest, mustadest, kollastest geomeetrilistest pindadest kompositsioon. All servas keskel must tütarlapse rinnasiluett profiilis, sellest paremal noormehe hall siluett en face. Sama fragment kordub vähendatult paremal, ülemises neljandikus.
9166.de: Composition of gray, black, yellow geometric surfaces. At the bottom edge in the center a black chest-silhouette of a girl in profile, to its right a gray silhouette of a young man en face. The same fragment repeats in reduced size on the right, in the upper quarter.

9170.d: Esiplaanil kaks istuvat figuuri. Keskel vasakul ja paremal suured puud, mille kroonid ülal moodustavad võlvi. Neist pisut tagapool, vee ääres õitseva põõsastiku taustal valges rüüs seisev ja punases rüüs istuv naisefiguur.
9170.de: In the foreground two seated figures. In the centre, on the left and right, large trees whose crowns form a vault above. A little further back, against a background of flowering shrubbery by the water, a female figure standing in a white robe and one sitting in a red robe.

9171.d: Kõrgel mäekallakul, ees rohul istuv figuur. Taga kõrgemal, naisfiguur kahe musta põlevasilmse kassiga.
9171.de: On a high mountain slope, in front a figure sitting on the grass. Behind, higher up, a female figure with two black cats with burning eyes.

9172.d: Töö joonistatud kahte ossa: ülemine 3/4, alumine 1/4. Ülal merest välajulatuval ebamäärasel mereelukal (või kivil) üks istuv ja üks seisev alasti naise figuur. All, merepõhjas kaks ebamäärast figuuri.
9172.de: The work is drawn in two parts: the upper 3/4, the lower 1/4. Above, on an indeterminate sea creature (or rock) emerging from the sea, one sitting and one standing nude female figure. Below, on the sea floor, two indeterminate figures.

9173.d: Ees tohutul kaljurahnul ja jõekaldal kolm lamavat, kolm kalju vastu toetuvat alasti inimfiguuri. Paremal, jõel purjepaat.
9173.de: In the foreground on an enormous rocky boulder and riverbank, three reclining and three leaning nude figures against the rock. On the right, a sailboat on the river.

9174.d: Esiplaanil vees seisev alasti naisfiguur. Tema taga kaldal lamavad ja istuvad naisfiguurid.
9174.de: In the foreground, a nude female figure standing in the water. Behind her on the shore, female figures lying and sitting.
