9175.d: Vasakul tõmmude figuuride keskel paremal seisvale mehele karikat ulatav alasti naine. Taga paremal vesi.
9175.de: On the left, among swarthy figures, a naked woman offering a goblet to a man standing on the right. Water in the background on the right.

9179.d: Vasakul puu all kaldal istuv naisakt luigega. Üle põlvede laotatud kollane läbipaistev linik.
9179.de: On the left under a tree on the bank a seated female nude with a swan. A yellow transparent cloth spread over her knees.

9180.dm: lehe kõrgus: 86.2 cm; lehe laius: 55.0 cm
9180.d: Habemes alasti mehe täisfiguur peaaegu en face, pea kerge pöördega paremale. Käed ristamisi rinnal.
9180.de: Full figure of a bearded naked man almost en face, head turned slightly to the right. Arms crossed on the chest.

9182.d: Harkisjalu alasti naisfiguur eestvaates. Pea kerge pöördega vasakule. Käed toetavad reitele.
9182.de: Full figure of a nude woman standing with legs apart, frontal view. Head turned slightly to the left. Hands resting on the thighs.

9183.d: Esiplaanil muru, keskel paremal ja vasakul lehtpuude rühmi mille vahelt paistab taamal valge hoone.
9183.de: Grass in the foreground, groups of deciduous trees in the middle right and left, a white building visible beyond between them.

9187.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kolm sammuvat meest, käed püksitaskuis, pintsakud õlgadel. Kahel peas sonimütsid, ühel barett. Eemal veel rühm tööriietuses mehi ja suitsevate korstnatega tehasehooned.
9187.de: In the foreground on the left three striding men, hands in trouser pockets, jackets over their shoulders. Two wearing sonim caps, one a beret. Further away another group of men in work clothes and factory buildings with smoking chimneys.

9193.d: Esiplaanil üksikud puud ja tara, paremal talumaja, keskel oruniidul kari, taamal nõlvakuil sügisvärvides mets.
9193.de: In the foreground solitary trees and a fence, on the right a farmhouse, in the middle a herd on a valley meadow, further back a forest in autumn colours on the slopes.

9194.dm: laius: 45.5 cm; kõrgus: 35.0 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 36.5 cm; laius: 44.2 cm (vm.   )
9194.d: Esiplaanil keskel madalas sinises vaasis mitmevärvilised lilled, paremal vaasi kõrval kaks astriõit. Ees vaasi ja astriõite peegeldus. Taust pruunikais toonides.
9194.de: In the foreground, in the centre, in a low blue vase, multicoloured flowers, on the right beside the vase two aster blooms. In front, the reflection of the vase and the asters. Background in brownish tones.

9201.d: Paremast nurgast diagonaalselt vasakule suunduv tükike randa põõsaste ja lootsikutega. Kaugemal jõel üksik paat sõudjaga.
9201.de: A stretch of shore with bushes and small boats running diagonally from the right corner to the left. Farther away on the river a solitary boat with a rower.

9202.d: Tugitoolis istuva mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale. Parem käsi toetatud tooli käetoele, vasak põlvele. Taustaks tumeroheline sein kuldraamis maaliga paremal.
9202.de: Knee-length portrait of a man sitting in an armchair, in half-profile to the right. Right hand resting on the armrest, left hand on the knee. Background is a dark green wall with a painting in a gold frame on the right.

9206.d: Grupp madalaid punaste viilkatustega kivimaju, mille ees kuuritaoline ehitis. Vasakul osa kollasest hoonest. Taevas lillas - punases koloriidis.
9206.de: A group of low stone houses with red gable roofs, with a shed-like structure in front. On the left, part of a yellow building. Sky in a purple - red colouring.

9212.d: Talvine vaade uuslinna tänavaristmikule õhtul. Esiplaanil lumega ääristatud rohekashall autotee, värviliste liiklusmärkidega laigud paremal. Kaugusesse koonduvad laternapostid, heledad majadeblokid sinkjasrohelise taeva foonil. Maalitud hoogsalt, eskiislikult.
9212.de: A winter view of a street crossing in a new town in the evening. In the foreground a greyish-grey car road bordered with snow, patches with coloured traffic signs on the right. Lamp posts converging into the distance, light-coloured blocks of houses against a bluish-green sky background. Painted boldly, in a sketchy manner.

9217.d: Roosakaspunastes ja rohalistes toonides figuraalne kompositsioon: keskel suletud silmadega alasti naisefiguur, Berenike all vasakul hoiab ekstaasis mehefiguur naise kätt. Mõlemat keskset figuuri ümbritsevad peamiselt alastifiguuridena antud mütoloogilised olevused või inimjäsemete puntrad. Berenike kohal maskis, rohelisse rõivastunud mees, kellel kaelal ratsutab alasti naisefiguur. Allservas paremal kolm loori hoidvat graatsiat, vasakul hoiab loori alasti mees, selg vaataja poole.(eesti)
9217.de: A figural composition in pinkish-red and greenish tones: in the centre, an alasti [nude] female figure with closed eyes, Berenice; lower left, a man's figure in ecstasy holds the woman's hand. Both central figures are surrounded mainly by nude figures given as mythological creatures or clusters of human limbs. Above Berenice, a man in a mask, dressed in green, on whose neck rides a nude female figure. In the lower part on the right, three graces holding a veil, on the left a nude man holds a veil, his back to the viewer.

9229.d: Ülaltvaade kaubasadamale. Esiplaanil paremal suitsu- ja aurupilvedes sadamakai ääres kolm laeva, kraanad, masinad. Vasakult läheb rong, vagunite-masinate vahel kaks inimese siluetti. Tagaplaanil paremal hallis vines taeva taustal Oleviste kirik, vasakul Toompea tornid.
9229.de: A bird's-eye view of a cargo harbour. In the foreground on the right, three ships by the harbour quay amid clouds of smoke and steam, cranes, machines. A train runs from the left, with two human silhouettes between the wagons and machines. In the background on the right, against a grey hazy sky, St. Olaf's Church, on the left the towers of Toompea.

9230.d: Süngetes lillades ja rohelistes toonides temaatiline kompositsioon kalurite elust. Esiplaanil grupp kalureid võrgud või muud kalapüügiriistad õlal. Nende taga tühjad võrguvaiad ja post laternaga. Vasakul viilkatusega maja, tuli aknast kumamas, taamal võrgukuivatamise vaiade taga viis kuuri. Taamal keskel kergelt lainetav taevas. Kohati maalitud tihedate sapsivate pintslilöökidega.(eesti)
9230.de: A thematic composition in sombre purple and green tones about the life of fishermen. In the foreground a group of fishermen with nets or other fishing gear on their shoulders. Behind them empty net stakes and a post with a lantern. On the left a house with a gable roof, light glowing from a window, further back, behind the net-drying stakes, five sheds. In the middle background a slightly rippling sky. Painted in places with dense, jagged brushstrokes.

9232.d: Tänava ääres helesinise taeva taustal madalad puu - ja kivimajad. Majedegrupi taga viilkatusega torn kukega katusel. Esiplaanil paremal puu.
9232.de: Along the street low wooden and stone houses against a light blue sky background. Behind the group of houses a gabled tower with a rooster on the roof. On the right in the foreground a tree.

9233.d: Esiplaanil kollakal alusel olevas klaasvaasis kolm roosat tulpi. Tagapool paremal vaas kollaste lilledega. Taust tumesinine.
9233.de: In the foreground, three pink tulips in a glass vase on a yellowish stand. Behind on the right a vase with yellow flowers. The background dark blue.

9235.d: Rohtunud künklik maastik vasakul üksiku lehtpuu, paremal lehtpuude grupiga. Taamal mets.
9235.de: A grassy hilly landscape with a solitary deciduous tree on the left, a group of deciduous trees on the right. Forest in the distance.

9238.d: Kolme - ja neljakorruselised punakaspruunid majad tänavanurgal. Taevas hele.
9238.de: Three- and four-storey reddish-brown houses on a street corner. Sky bright.

9245.d: Pildil esiplaanil vasakul kihutav inimenevalgel hobusel. Ratsaniku kostüüm kollastes toonides, peakate rohekassinine. Taustaks loodus väga rikkalikes värvitoonides.
9245.de: In the foreground on the left of the picture a person galloping on a white horse. The rider's costume in yellow tones, the headwear greenish-blue. The background nature in very rich colour tones.

9249.d: Taraga piiratud ühe - ja kahekorruselised viilkatusega majad tänava ääres. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks prügiurni.
9249.de: One- and two-storey gabled houses along a street, enclosed by a fence. In the foreground on the left, two rubbish bins.

9251.d: Kerajas vaasis kimp valgeid kollasesüdamelisi õisi.(eesti)
9251.de: A bunch of white yellow-hearted flowers in a spherical vase.

9255.d: Murtud, muldjates toonides maalitud vanalinna siseõu eelhoovi ja tagahooviga, mida lahutab plank väravapoolteta läbikäiguga keskel. Tagaplaanil keskteljest veidi vasakul kõrge viiluga keskaegse maja otsakülg kõrge korstnaga paremal pool katusel. Selle ees veidi vasemal samasugune madalam maja. Esiplaanil vasakul osa rohekashalli maja fassaadist, kahe uksega, teisel korrusel ühe aknaga. Keskplaanil paremal ookerkollane klassitsistlikus stiilis kahekorruseline maja suure varikatusega vaatajapoolsel küljel, selle all hobuvanker. Esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes õuel vanker.
9255.de: Broken, earth-toned painting of an old town courtyard with a front yard and back yard, separated by a fence with a gateless passage in the middle. In the background, slightly left of the central axis, the end wall of a high-gabled medieval house with a tall chimney on the right side of the roof. In front of it, slightly to the left, a similar lower house. In the foreground on the left, part of the façade of a greenish-grey house, with two doors, and one window on the second floor. In the middle ground on the right, an ochre-yellow, classicist-style two-storey house with a large canopy on the side facing the viewer, with a horse-drawn cart beneath it. In the foreground, in the golden section on the left, a cart in the yard.

9256.d: Tänavanurk lehtpuu ja valgustiga. Tänava ääres madalad lamedate katustega hooned, mille tagant paistmas kahe kõrgema maja otsafassaadid.
9256.de: A street corner with a deciduous tree and a lamp post. Along the street low buildings with flat roofs, behind which the end façades of two taller houses are visible.

9257.d: Kiilaspäise keskealise mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates, pea kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel seljas helesinine särk ja pruun pintsak, ees pruun lips.
9257.de: Bust of a bald middle-aged man in frontal view, head slightly turned to the right. The man wears a light blue shirt and a brown jacket, with a brown tie in front.

9258.d: Istuva mehe täisfiguur otsevaates, pea pööratud kergelt paremale. Õlgadel tume mantel.
9258.de: Full figure of a seated man in frontal view, head turned slightly to the right. Dark coat on the shoulders.

9259.d: Kivisel maapinnal üksikuid madalaid puid ja põõsaid. Maalitud kergete pintslitõmmetega heledates hallides, kollakas-pruunides toonides.
9259.de: A rocky ground with a few low trees and bushes. Painted with light brush strokes in light grey, yellowish-brown tones.

9260.d: Tänavanurk kahekordsete majadega. Ärklikorrusega roosa kivimaja ees suur lehtpuu.
9260.de: A street corner with two-storey houses. In front of a pink stone house with an attic storey a large deciduous tree.

9262.d: Esiplaanil vasemal hoone nurk kolme talumehega; paremal kaks tahapoole jooksvat hobust - ühel ratsanik, parempoolse hobuse kõrval jookseb mees; keskel mees.(eesti)
9262.de: In the foreground on the left, the corner of a building with three farmhands; on the right two horses running backward - one with a rider, a man running beside the right-hand horse; a man in the middle.

9266.d: Osa tänavast kolme kahekorruselise majaga. Paremal taraga ümbritsetud muruplats, mille taga madalamad majad.
9266.de: Part of a street with three two-storey houses. On the right a fenced lawn, behind which are lower houses.

9271.d: Hõbehalliga summutatud värvivalikuga küps suvemaastik: keskel, vertikaalsest keskjoonest paremal mäkke suunduv teerada. Sellest esiplaanil, kahel pool hallid kivid ja lopsakad kirevad lillepuhmad. Ülal kahel pool rada tuhmkollased viljapõllud, silmapiiril vasakul talumaja paari puuga, paremal kaks väikest halli maja ja tuulik.
9271.de: A mature summer landscape in a muted silver-grey colour palette: in the centre, to the right of the vertical midline, a path leading up a hill. In the foreground of it, grey stones and lush colourful flower clumps on both sides. Above, on both sides of the path, dull yellow grain fields, on the horizon a farmhouse with a couple of trees on the left, on the right two small grey houses and a windmill.

9275.d: Esiplaanil ülestõusjate relvastatud grupid. Taga vasakul ja paremal taluhooned talvemaastikus.(eesti)
9275.de: In the foreground armed groups of insurgents. Behind, on the left and right, farm buildings in a winter landscape.

9277.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres kõrkjate sees rebane ja neli põgenendes lendu tõusvat parti.
9277.de: In the foreground, by a body of water among sedges, a fox and four ducks taking flight while fleeing.

9279.dm: kõrgus: 106.0 cm (tervik, arm.   ); laius: 87.5 cm (tervik, arm.   )
9279.d: Poisi poolfiguur, poolprofiilis vasemale, XVII sajandi riietuses, rinnaturvisega. Parem käsi toetub kepile, vasak mõõgapidemele.(eesti)
9279.de: Half-figure of a boy, in half-profile to the left, in 17th-century attire, with a breastplate. Right hand resting on a staff, left hand on a sword hilt.

9280.d: Ovaalis vanema mehe rinnaportree vaatega vasakule. Heledad siledad ja lühikesed juuksed, heledad silmad, valgel kaelasidemel helepunase paela otsas orden. Taust ühtlaselt tume.
9280.de: Oval bust portrait of an older man, looking to the left. Light, smooth and short hair, light eyes, an order on a bright red ribbon on a white necktie. Background uniformly dark.

9281.d: Tiheda, taevast varjava lehestikuga tammik, mille tüvedele paistab vasakult päikesevalgus.
9281.de: An oak grove with dense foliage shading the sky, sunlight shining on the tree trunks from the left.

9283.d: Esiplaanil istuv rahvarõivais naine - karjus kitse ja kolme lehmaga (kaks magamas). Tagaplaanil põllud viljarõukudega, vasemal metsasaludega palistatud järv ja agulimajad; paremal vaade Viljandi linnale. Taevas pilves, serv roosakas.
9283.de: In the foreground, a seated woman in folk costume - a herder with a goat and three cows (two sleeping). In the background, fields with grain stacks, on the left a lake fringed with groves of trees and suburban houses; on the right a view of the town of Viljandi. The sky cloudy, the edge pinkish.

9286.d: Aknalaual vaas suure kimbu lillade sirelitega. Vasakul paistab aknast heleda taeva taustal sinakas maja siluett.
9286.de: On the windowsill a vase with a large bunch of purple lilacs. On the left, through the window, the bluish silhouette of a house is visible against a light sky.

9287.d: Sinises kleidis prillidega naise rinnafiguur otsevaates. Taust hallikas - rohekaspruun.
9287.de: A bust of a woman in a blue dress with glasses, in a frontal view. The background is greyish-greenish-brown.

9290.d: Esiplaanil sügavusse suunduv kõnnitee jalgrattaga, paremal hooned, vasemal kaldaäär. Vihmane päev.
9290.de: In the foreground a footpath running into the depth with a bicycle, on the right buildings, on the left a riverbank. A rainy day.

9293.d: Eest vasakult kerge pöördega paremale alla orgu laskuval teel seljakoti ja kepiga mehe figuur (en face); paremal künka harjal grupp puid. Kaugemal org ja järsud kaljuahelikud. Mägede jalamil lahtpuude vöönd kahe madala hoonega vasakul.
9293.de: In front, on a path descending with a slight turn from left to right into a valley, the figure of a man with a backpack and a stick (en face); on the right, on the crest of a hillock, a group of trees. Further away a valley and steep rocky ridges. At the foot of the mountains a belt of deciduous trees, with two low buildings on the left.

9296.dm: kõrgus: 34.7 cm (lm. kuni aluspapi servani); laius: 24.4 cm (lm. kuni aluspapi servani)
9296.d: Ees laua ääres kaks täisprofiilis kaarte mängivat munka. Nende taga kaks seisvat munka.
9296.de: In front, at a table, two monks in full profile playing cards. Behind them two standing monks.

9297.d: Sinise veekogu ääres murul telgid. Vastaskallas laugjas.
9297.de: Tents on the grass by a blue body of water. The opposite shore is gently sloping.

9298.d: Ees lumisel künkakaldal kaks maani seelikus tütarlast (en face). Taga keskel torn ja okasmets. Taamal kõrged mäeahelikud.
9298.de: In the foreground on a snowy hillside two girls in floor-length skirts (en face). Behind in the middle a tower and coniferous forest. In the distance high mountain ranges.

9299.d: Klaasist vaas roosade tulpidega. Vaasi kõrval vasemal banaanid. Tagapõhi sinepikollane.
9299.de: A glass vase with pink tulips. Bananas next to the vase on the left. The background is mustard yellow.

9301.d: Peamiselt hallides ja valgetes, pastelltoonides abstraktne, ekspressiivsetest veiklevatest värvilaikudest kompositisoon.
9301.de: An abstract composition, mainly in grey and white pastel tones, of expressive flickering patches of colour.

9305.d: Esialal lausik rohtmaa, mida taustana piirab lehtpuumets.
9305.de: In the foreground flat grassland, bordered in the background by deciduous forest.

9307.d: Osa tänavast madalate majadega ääres. esiplaanil raagus puu. Selle taga taraga ümbritsetud punane kollase otsafassaadiga maja. Taevas terashall.
9307.de: Part of a street lined with low houses. In the foreground a bare tree. Behind it a red house with a yellow end façade, surrounded by a fence. Sky steel-grey.

9310.d: Laual prantsuse ajaleht, pudel ja klaas punase draperii taustal.
9310.de: On the table a French newspaper, a bottle and a glass, against a red drapery background.

9312.d: Vaade vanalinna katustele, millede keskelt töö keskosas kerkib esile kirikutorn. Taga meri. Ees vasakul üksiku kõrge puu tüvi ja osa krooni.(eesti)
9312.de: A view of the roofs of the Old Town, from the middle of which a church tower rises in the central part of the work. Behind, the sea. In front on the left, the trunk of a single tall tree and part of its crown.

9313.d: Osa tänavast roosas - pruunis - kollases koloriidis madalate majade ja heleda taevaga.
9313.de: Part of a street in pink-brown-yellow colouring with low houses and a light sky.

9314.d: Vanema naise rinnapilt profiilis paremale, valges rüüžidega tanus ja samasuguse kraega.
9314.de: Bust of an older woman in profile to the right, in a white ruffled bonnet and matching collar.

9315.d: Hämar, hallide seinte ja madala laega kõrtsituba kuueruudulise aknaga tagaseinas. Ruumi keskel pruun kõrtsilett pudelitega. Leti taga heledas valguses kõrtsmik ja kaks klaasustega kappi. Vasakul uks, mille kohal pilt. Uksest vaatab sisse talumees. Paremal madal uks pildiga selle kohal, ukse ees istuvad üks vana mees kepiga ja noorem laiaäärelises kübaras mees jutuhoos. Keskel vestlevad seljaga kõrtsiletile toetudes kaks kuubedes talumeest, vestlejaist vasakul olev talumees on küljega ja toetub küünarnukkidega letile. Vasakul allservas puupink riiete ja puunõuga. Akna all üksteise otsa laotud korvid pudelitega. Laes põleb suure ümmarguse kupliga õlilamp.
9315.de: A dim tavern room with grey walls and a low ceiling, with a six-paned window in the back wall. In the middle of the room a brown tavern counter with bottles. Behind the counter, in bright light, the innkeeper and two glass-doored cupboards. On the left a door, above which hangs a picture. A peasant is looking in through the doorway. On the right a low door with a picture above it; in front of the door sit an old man with a cane and a younger man in a wide-brimmed hat, engaged in conversation. In the middle two peasant men in coats converse leaning with their backs against the tavern counter; of the two conversing, the one on the left is shown side-on, leaning on the counter with his elbows. In the lower left corner a wooden bench with clothes and a wooden vessel. Under the window, baskets with bottles stacked on top of one another. From the ceiling hangs a burning oil lamp with a large round shade.

9317.d: Tänavanurk kolme raagus puu  ja rohelise katusega kuulutuste tulbega. Kaugemal kollased mitmekorruselised majad.
9317.de: A street corner with three bare trees and a green-roofed advertisement pillar. Further away, yellow multi-storey houses.

9318.d: Peamiselt sinistes, kollastes ja lillakasroosades toonides antud panoraamne maastik: paremal servas kaarjas rannajoon, vasakul liivane järsak valge majaga selle serval. Silmapiiri kohal ülal roosalt kumav taevas. Maastik on visandatud peaaegu abstraktsete värvilaikude kombinatsioonina.
9318.de: Panoramic landscape rendered mainly in blue, yellow and pinkish-lilac tones: on the right edge a curved coastline, on the left a sandy bluff with a white house at its edge. Above the horizon a sky glowing pink. The landscape is sketched as an almost abstract combination of patches of colour.

9329.d: Osa valge riidega kaetud kirstust. Rüüžidega padjal, roosakaist õitest pärjaga ümbritsetud noore naise pea.
9329.de: Part of a coffin covered with white cloth. On a ruffled pillow, the head of a young woman surrounded by a wreath of pinkish flowers.

9336.d: Esiplaanil lagendik põõsastega, selle keskel jõgi. Üle jõe hooned ja Pirita kloostri varemed. Koloriit hall-rohekas, tugevad pintslitõmbed.
9336.de: In the foreground a clearing with bushes, with a river in its centre. Across the river, buildings and the ruins of Pirita Convent. Colouring grey-greenish, strong brushstrokes.

9342.dm: lehe kõrgus: 26.2 cm; lehe laius: 35.2 cm
9342.d: Ees kaljusel teekurvil vanamees ja poisike koormat kandva eesliga. Taamal naine lapsega. Ümberringi kõrged mäed. Taevas pilvine.
9342.de: In front, on a rocky bend of the road, an old man and a boy with a load-carrying donkey. In the distance a woman with a child. High mountains all around. Cloudy sky.

9343.d: Ees, paremalt taha keskele suunduva jõe ääres naised pesu loputamas. Vasakul hobune reega. Taga kõrgeneval kaldal raagus metsatukk. Paremal jõekallas hõreda metsaga.
9343.de: In front, along a river leading from the right to the centre background, women rinsing laundry. On the left a horse with a sledge. Behind, on a rising bank, a bare clump of forest. On the right a riverbank with sparse forest.

9346.d: Esiplaanil fantastilised figuurid. Taustaks mitmesugust värvi tornid.
9346.de: Fantastic figures in the foreground. Towers of various colours as background.

9347.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 15.8 cm; kujutise laius: 14.7 cm
9347.d: a) Noore mehe poolfiguur rohelises pintsakus. Istuv asend. Vasak käsi toetub toolikorjule. Pea poolprofiilis vasakule.
9347.de: a) Half-figure of a young man in a green jacket. Seated position. Left hand resting on the back of a chair. Head in half-profile to the left.

9349.d: Tumedas kuues pikkade, üle pea kammitud juustega keskealise mehe rinnapilt (poolprofiilis paremale).
9349.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in a dark coat with long hair combed back over the head (in half-profile to the right).

9351.d: Ees järv piiratud vasemalt ja paremalt kõrgete järskude mägedega. All, järvekaldal maju, pisut kõrgemal nõlval puid.
9351.de: In front, a lake bordered on the left and right by high steep mountains. Below, on the lakeshore, houses, and slightly higher on the slope, trees.

9354.d: Vasakul avatud ahjuuks, kus põlevad puuhalud. Ahi hallidest kividest. Paremal ahjuroop seina najal.
9354.de: On the left an open stove door with burning firewood logs. Stove of grey stones. On the right a poker leaning against the wall.

9356.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu, vasakul madal kallas kalurionni ja puudega. Onni juures kaks inimkogu. Paremal paistab üle vee sinav kaldaviirg.
9356.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water, on the left a low shore with a fisherman's hut and trees. By the hut two human figures. On the right a bluish strip of shore is visible across the water.

9358.d: Keskel meres kaks putot ratsutamas delfiinidel. Parempoolse puto pea on kallutatud vasakule ja vasakus käes on ohjaharu. Vasakpoolse puto väljasirutatud paremas käes on teine ohjaharu. Putode vahel on punane rätik.
9358.de: In the centre, in the sea, two putti riding on dolphins. The head of the right putto is tilted to the left and in his left hand is a rein. In the outstretched right hand of the left putto is another rein. Between the putti is a red scarf.

9364.d: Laual ümarik vaagen roheliste ja siniste viinamarjadega. Vaagna taga vaas roosidega. Ees laua serval aprikoosid ja kimp roosasid ja punaseid nelke.
9364.de: On a table a round platter with green and blue grapes. Behind the platter a vase with roses. In front, at the edge of the table, apricots and a bouquet of pink and red carnations.

9365.d: Ees paremal rohtunud jõekäär liivase kaldaga. Vasakul ja tagapool keskel mättaline rohumaa põõsastega. Taga paremal kõrgel nõlvakul lehtpuumetsa siluett. Üle maastiku pilvine taevas.
9365.de: In the front right a grassy river bend with a sandy shore. On the left and behind in the center a tussocky meadow with bushes. Behind on the right on a high slope the silhouette of a deciduous forest. A cloudy sky over the landscape.

9366.d: Ees vasakul kivine kiduva taimestikuga mäenõlvak. Paremal kitsas orus üksikud okspuud. Üle puude latvade näha teist nõlvakut lossi siluetiga selle harjal. Üle maastiku pilvine taevas.
9366.de: In front on the left a stony mountain slope with sparse vegetation. On the right, in a narrow valley, solitary branchy trees. Above the treetops another slope is visible with the silhouette of a castle on its ridge. A cloudy sky over the landscape.

9367.d: Ees (2/5 tööst) meri arvukate purjepaatidega. 3/5 tööst pilvist taevast.
9367.de: In front (2/5 of the work) sea with numerous sailing boats. 3/5 of the work cloudy sky.

9374.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paremale suunduv tänav madalate majade ja inimestega. Taga paistab tornidega kirik. Vasakult paremale telefoni postid traatidega.(eesti)
9374.de: In the foreground a street running diagonally to the right, with low houses and people. Behind, a church with towers can be seen. From left to right, telephone poles with wires.

9378.d: Diagonaalselt kaheks jaotatud maalipind: alumine osa ja parempoolne serv sidrunkollased, ristuvate kollaste joonte abil nelinurkadeks jaotatud. Ülaosas sirelililla pind, mida jaotavad nelinurkadeks kuldsed ja roosakaslillad ristuvad jooned.
9378.de: Painted surface divided diagonally into two: the lower part and the right-hand edge lemon yellow, divided into rectangles by intersecting yellow lines. In the upper part a lilac surface, divided into rectangles by intersecting golden and pinkish-lilac lines.

9387.d: Punakaspruunist foonist otsekui ilmutusena eralduv mehe pea: pikad pruunid juuksed, sirge nina, väikesed vuntsid ja habe, terane puuriv pilk, kulm kergelt kortsus. Pildi pind kohati pastoosne, maalitud ühe punakaspruuni tooni astmestikku kasutades.(eesti)
9387.de: A man's head emerging as if an apparition from a reddish-brown background: long brown hair, straight nose, small moustache and beard, a keen piercing gaze, brow slightly furrowed. The surface of the picture is in places pastose, painted using a gradation of a single reddish-brown tone.

9389.dm: lehe laius: 35.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 42.0 cm
9389.d: Töö ülaosas, vee kohal jämedal puuoksal lebab alasti naine, pilk suunatud puu all olevaile krokodilli kehaga inimpeaga olenditele.
9389.de: At the top of the work, above the water, a naked woman lies on a thick tree branch, her gaze directed at the crocodile-bodied, human-headed creatures beneath the tree.

9390.dm: lehe laius: 42.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 31.0 cm
9390.d: Ees paremal istuv mehe figuur. Vasakul alasti meesfiguur; keskel paremal istuvale mehele karikat ulatav alasti naisfiguur.
9390.de: In the front on the right a seated male figure. On the left a nude male figure; in the middle, on the right, a nude female figure offering a goblet to the seated man.

9391.dm: lehe kõrgus: 27.0 cm; lehe laius: 21.2 cm
9391.d: Vasakut kätt puusal hoidev naisakt, keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Pea en face.
9391.de: A female nude holding her left hand on her hip, body slightly turned to the left. Head en face.

9392.dm: lehe kõrgus: 34.0 cm; lehe laius: 22.0 cm
9392.d: Esiplaanil paadisillal seisev ja istuv naisefiguur. Paremal vesi. Vasakul ja taga heinamaa.
9392.de: In the foreground, a female figure standing and sitting on a boat pier. Water on the right. Meadow on the left and behind.

9393.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.0 cm; lehe laius: 30.8 cm
9393.d: Ees vasakul kaldapervel poolistukil magav akt. Tema õla kõrgusel, vee kohal, ebamäärasel alusel küljeli lamav naisakt.
9393.de: In front, on the left on the edge of the bank, a sleeping nude in a half-sitting position. At the height of her shoulder, above the water, a female nude lying on its side on an indeterminate base.

9394.dm: lehe kõrgus: 43.0 cm; lehe laius: 33.6 cm
9394.d: Seisva naise alasti täisfiguur kerge pöördega paremale, parem käsi tõstetud kuklasse.
9394.de: Full figure of a standing nude woman with a slight turn to the right, right hand raised to the nape of the neck.

9395.dm: kujutise laius: 25.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 43.6 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 43.6 cm; lehe laius: 29.3 cm
9395.d: Müüri taustal seisva alasti naise täisfiguur otsevaates. Üle müüri näha lehestikku.
9395.de: Full figure of a nude woman standing against a wall, frontal view. Foliage visible over the wall.

9396.dm: lehe kõrgus: 27.5 cm; lehe laius: 28.0 cm
9396.d: Lehestiku taustal paljastatud õla ja rinnaga istuv naine, keha poolprofiilis paremale, pea vaatega vasakule. Seljatagant embab teda alasti mehefiguur.
9396.de: Against a background of foliage a sitting woman with a bared shoulder and breast, body in half-profile to the right, head looking to the left. A naked male figure embraces her from behind.

9397.d: Vasakul mererannikul kasvava jämedatüvelise puu otsas niuete ümber mähitud punase rätikuga alasti naisfiguur. Ülakeha all kummardatud. All paremal tumedanahalise mehe poolfiguur. Paremal taga meri.
9397.de: On the left, at the top of a thick-trunked tree growing on the seashore, a naked female figure with a red kerchief wrapped around her hips. The upper body bent downward. Below, on the right, the half-figure of a dark-skinned man. In the background, on the right, the sea.

9398.dm: lehe kõrgus: 32.0 cm; lehe laius: 18.0 cm
9398.d: Naise pea alt üles vaadatuna profiilis vasakule. Pea osas taust tumepruun.
9398.de: A woman's head seen from below in profile to the left. The background around the head is dark brown.

9408.dm: kujutise laius: 9.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 15.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 12.0 cm; lehe laius: 10.6 cm
9408.d: Avatud ukse taustal kaks alasti naisfiguuri; esimene poolprofiilis paremale, tagumine en face.
9408.de: Against the background of an open door two nude female figures; the first in half-profile to the right, the one behind en face.

9409.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 32.7 cm; lehe laius: 22.8 cm
9409.d: Naise alasti poolfiguur: pea en face (nägu täiesti väljamaalimata), õlad ja rind pööratud paremale.
9409.de: Nude half-figure of a woman: head en face (face left completely unpainted), shoulders and chest turned to the right.

9410.d: Punakaspruun hobune (profiilis vasakule) seismas plangu ääres.
9410.de: A reddish-brown horse (in profile to the left) standing by a fence.

9415.d: Esiplaanil veeloik ja lagendik karjaga. Keskel antiikse akvedukti varemed, mis pika sammastereana ulatuvad  tagaplaanil asuvate sinetavate mägedeni.(eesti)
9415.de: In the foreground a puddle and a clearing with a herd. In the middle the ruins of an antique aqueduct, which extend as a long row of columns in the background to bluish mountains.

9416.d: Tänavapilt Toompealt. Vasakult tänavaäärse aiamüüri nurk laternaga, üle müüri ulatuvate lehtpuuokstega, paremal tänavaäärseid maju. Tänaval inimesi. Taamal üle risttänavat piiravate majade katuste paistab Niguliste kiriku torni ülemine osa kuni kiivri poole kõrguseni.
9416.de: Street view from Toompea. On the left, the corner of a garden wall along the street with a lantern, with leafy tree branches extending over the wall, on the right houses along the street. People on the street. In the distance, above the roofs of the houses bordering the cross street, the upper part of St. Nicholas' Church tower is visible up to about the height of its spire.

9422.d: Vasakult paremale liikuv kolmik: vana, halli habemega mees kahe tütarlapse vahel.
9422.de: A trio moving from left to right: an old man with a grey beard between two young girls.

9423.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 31.0 cm; lehe laius: 25.3 cm; kujutise laius: 21.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.8 cm
9423.d: Ees kõrgendikul lamava alasti naise kohal õhus hõljuv tiibadega poisi figuur. Taustaks põõsastik.
9423.de: In front, above a naked woman lying on a rise of ground, the winged figure of a boy hovering in the air. Shrubbery in the background.

9424.dm: lehe kõrgus: 10.8 cm; lehe laius: 8.5 cm
9424.d: Põõsastikuga ääristatud rohumaal taustal lille murdmiseks kummardunud naise figuur.
9424.de: Figure of a woman bending down to pick a flower on a grassy area bordered with bushes in the background.

9426.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres lamav alasti figuur. Tagapool teine lamav figuur.
9426.de: In the foreground a nude figure lying by a body of water. Further back another lying figure.

9427.d: Pruuni joonega eraldatud töö ülaosas musta loori mähitud alakehaga kaljule toetuv naine. Töö alumises osas jõel ujuv purjepaat.
9427.de: In the upper part of the work, separated by a brown line, a woman leaning against a cliff, her lower body wrapped in a black veil. In the lower part of the work, a sailboat floating on a river.

9428.d: Ees lillas kleidis kummuli naisfiguur. Parem, taha sirutatud käsi tagapool seisva meesfiguuri käte vahel. Taustaks mets.
9428.de: In the foreground a female figure in a purple dress bent over. The right arm, stretched backward, is between the arms of a male figure standing behind. Background of forest.

9429.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 15.8 cm; lehe laius: 22.7 cm; kujutise laius: 20.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 16.6 cm
9429.d: Ees vee ääres lebav alasti naisfiguur, parem jalg põlvest saadik vees.
9429.de: In the foreground, a naked female figure reclining at the water's edge, her right leg in the water up to the knee.

9433.de: Grassland in the foreground. Dense shrubbery behind.

9437.de: Flat meadow in the foreground. Forest behind.

9439.d: 9 alasti meesfiguuri allservast kuni ülaservani punasel taustal ruudulisel põrandal. Vasakul avaneb kitsast aknast vaade maastikule puu ja kõrgete lumiste mägedega.(eesti)
9439.de: 9 naked male figures from the bottom edge to the top edge on a red background on a chequered floor. At left a view opens through a narrow window onto a landscape with a tree and high snowy mountains.

9441.d: Tumedal ultramariinsel kergelt lainetaval merel 9 kalapüügileva. Taevas sinakas-hallides pilvedes, paremal silmapiiri lähedal kollane.(eesti)
9441.de: On a dark ultramarine, slightly rippling sea, 9 fishing boats. Sky in bluish-grey clouds, yellow near the horizon on the right.

9444.d: Künklik maastik veekoguga paremal. Maapind kollakas-rohekates toonides, majad heledad. Tagaplaanil puid. Maalitud pastoosselt.
9444.de: Hilly landscape with a body of water on the right. Ground in yellowish-greenish tones, houses light-coloured. Trees in the background. Painted pastosely.

9448.d: Esiplaanil keskel diagonaalselt vasakult paremale suunduv kivide rida. Nendest vasakul tagaplaanil ranna ääres järsu kalju jalal kivid.
9448.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a row of stones running diagonally from left to right. To their left in the background, at the foot of a steep cliff by the shore, stones.

9450.dm: laius: 71.5 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 60.0 cm; kõrgus: 58.0 cm (vm.   ); laius: 73.0 cm
9450.d: Esiplaanil mitmekesine taimestik, tagaplaanil üksikud puud, tara ja paremal majanurk. Kaugemal puid.
9450.de: In the foreground varied vegetation, in the background single trees, a fence and on the right the corner of a house. Trees further away.

9451.d: Keskel eest tahapoole suunduv tänav. Vasakul müür ja majad, paremal majad ja nende tugev vari langemas tänavale.
9451.de: In the middle a street running from front to back. On the left a wall and houses, on the right houses and their strong shadow falling onto the street.

9454.d: Esiplaanil üksikud suured puud. Nende vahelt paremal näha üksik roosakas hoone. Taga vasakul puud.
9454.de: In the foreground solitary large trees. Between them on the right a single pinkish building is visible. Behind on the left, trees.

9458.d: Rohekas-sinine ümmarguna vaas, milles suur kimp roosakas-lillasid krüsanteeme. Foon kergelt pruunikas-beež.
9458.de: A greenish-blue round vase with a large bunch of pinkish-purple chrysanthemums. Background slightly brownish-beige.

9466.d: Esiplaanil paremal pruunid kaljurahnud, keskel lagendik asulaga, taga lumiste tippudega mäeahelik.
9466.de: In the foreground on the right brown rocky boulders, in the centre a clearing with a settlement, behind a mountain range with snowy peaks.

9467.dm: lehe kõrgus: 38.3 cm; lehe laius: 49.5 cm
9467.d: Ees paremal mägedevaheline org. Vasakul ees mäeahelik üksikute puukestega, selle taga kaljuplatool varemed. Silmapiiril mäed.
9467.de: In front on the right a valley between mountains. On the left in front a mountain range with individual small trees, behind it ruins on a rocky plateau. On the horizon mountains.

9476.d: Paremal ja vasemal valkja taeva taustal suured majad. Keskel madalam garaazisarnane ehitus.
9476.de: On the right and left, large houses against a whitish sky background. In the middle a lower, garage-like building.

9483.d: Vanema inimese ja noore kollasejuukselise tütarlapse rinnafiguurid otsevaates. Lapsel seljas punane kleit, käes lilleõis. Vanema inimese riietus roheline.
9483.de: Bust figures of an elderly person and a young girl with yellow hair, in full-face view. The child wears a red dress, holding a flower blossom in her hand. The elderly person's clothing is green.

9489.d: Värviplekkide virvenduses eraldub ristilöödu figuur ja näod - üks üleval, teine keskel vasemal, kolmas all paremal.
9489.de: Amid the flickering of colour patches, the figure of the crucified one and faces emerge - one at the top, another in the centre left, a third at the bottom right.

9490.d: Eest keskelt taha suunduv suurte lehtpuudega palistatud tee. Vasakpoolsete puude vahelt näha veekogu.
9490.de: A road lined with large deciduous trees leading from the front centre into the depth. A body of water visible between the trees on the left.

9491.d: Hall veekogu paadisilla ja paatidega. Esiplaanil tükike rohuga kaetud kallast. Samas, paadisilla ääres, seismas allalastud purjedega paadid. Vastaskallas laugjas.
9491.de: Grey body of water with a boat pier and boats. In the foreground a piece of grass-covered bank. At the same place, by the pier, boats standing with lowered sails. Opposite bank sloping.

9497.d: Visand kahest õunast ja kahest banaanist.
9497.de: Sketch of two apples and two bananas.

9501.d: Esiplaanil lillepott kolme valge tulbiga, taga männioks.
9501.de: In the foreground a flowerpot with three white tulips, a pine branch behind it.

9508.d: Esiplaanil lage väli, paremal madalad talumajad. Vasakul kiviveski. Taga silmapiiril lage maastik.
9508.de: In the foreground an open field, on the right low farmhouses. On the left a stone mill. Behind, on the horizon, an open landscape.

9513.d: Künklik maastik jõega: paremal künkaharjal puude vahel väike maja ja tamm kukkuva veega. Sellest tagapool künkal tuuleveski varemed.
9513.de: A hilly landscape with a river: on the right, on a hill ridge among trees, a small house and an oak with falling water. Beyond it on a hill the ruins of a windmill.

9515.d: Tumedate, pea ligi kammitud juustega keskealise naise rinnapilt; keha kerge pöördega vasakule, pea paremale. Seljas tume, sügavalt dekolteeritud kleit. Ümber õlgade punane sall.(eesti)
9515.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged woman with dark hair combed close to the head; the body with a slight turn to the left, the head to the right. Wearing a dark, deeply décolleté dress. A red shawl around the shoulders.

9517.d: Keskealise põskhabemega mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas tume ülikond kõrgelt suletava vestiga, mille ülemised nööbid lahti; valge särk pehme rinnaesisega ja "Vatermörder" tüüpi krae ristseosega kaelasidemega.
9517.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with side whiskers, in half-profile to the left. Wearing a dark suit with a high-closing waistcoat, the upper buttons of which are undone; a white shirt with a soft front and a "Vatermörder" type collar with a cross-tied necktie.

9520.d: Varakevadine maastik sulalumega, vasakul raagus puudealune, keskplaanil oja, punane majakatus metsatuka taga, keskel sinetav veekogu.
9520.de: Early spring landscape with thawing snow, on the left an area under bare trees, in the middle ground a stream, a red house roof behind a small grove, in the centre a bluish body of water.

9521.d: Esiplaanil kahelt küljelt latt - taraga piiratud loiguline tänav; keskosas paremal õlgkatusega taluhooneid, keskel tiibadeta hollandi tuuliku kere ja vasakul punase katusega kivihoone. Taustaks pilves taevas.
9521.de: In the foreground, a puddle-filled street bordered on both sides by fences; in the middle section on the right, thatched-roof farm buildings, in the centre the body of a wingless Dutch windmill, and on the left a stone building with a red roof. Background a cloudy sky.

9523.d: Esiplaanil tahapoole ahenev, paremal kaldal asuvate puude taha kaduv jõgi, mille vasakpoolsel tagapool tõusval kaldal mets. Taevas pilvine.
9523.de: In the foreground a river narrowing towards the back, disappearing behind trees on the right bank, behind which, on the left, on a rising bank, a forest. The sky is cloudy.

9525.d: Esiplaanil kartulipõld. Vasakul õlgkatusega palkhoone, mille taga kõrged puud. Paremal kaugemal teine madal õlgkatusega hoone.
9525.de: In the foreground a potato field. On the left a thatched log building, behind which tall trees. Further on the right another low thatched building.

9526.d: Keskel klaasist vaas aprikoosidega. Vasakul maisipea. Paremal viinamarjad ja õunad.
9526.de: In the center a glass vase with apricots. On the left a corn cob. On the right grapes and apples.

9537.d: Sinepikollases punase kaelusega riietuses musta peakattega naise rinnafiguur profiilis vasakule.
9537.de: Bust of a woman in mustard-yellow clothing with a red collar and a black headdress, in profile to the left.

9539.d: Ees veekogu keskel vaataja poolt vette tungiv maanina üksiku suure puuga. Paremal paat sõudjatega. Taga vasakul kallas hoonete ja kaljusse raiutud loss - kindlusega.
9539.de: In front, in the middle of a body of water, a spit of land jutting into the water towards the viewer with a single large tree. On the right a boat with rowers. Behind on the left a bank with buildings and a castle - a fortress - carved into the cliff.

9540.d: Hollandlik öine maastik. Vasakule jääb suur lehtpuu, aia sees olev maja ning üksik teekäija. Paremal jõgi ja tagaplaanil paistev tuulik. Taevas täiskuu. Maal kaetud paksu, tumeda lakikihiga.
9540.de: A Dutch-style nocturnal landscape. On the left a large deciduous tree, a house within a garden, and a lone traveller. On the right a river and a windmill visible in the background. Full moon in the sky. The painting is covered with a thick, dark layer of varnish.

9544.dm: laius: 310.0 cm; kõrgus: 130.0 cm; kõrgus: 170.0 cm
9544.d: Paremale tõusev kolmeastmeline kompositsioon erivärvilistest, erinevate võtetega teostatud maalipindadest. Lõuendile on kleebitud rebitud servadega pappi, kortustatud paberit jm. Maalitud kohati voolavate värvidega.
9544.de: A three-step composition rising to the right, made of painted surfaces of different colours and different techniques. Cardboard with torn edges, crumpled paper etc. glued onto the canvas. Painted in places with flowing paints.

9545.dm: laius: 33.3 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 43.1 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 44.2 cm (arm.   ); laius: 32.1 cm (vm. )
9545.d: Poollangetatud laugudega naise poolfiguur, poolprofiilis vasemale, rinnakõrgusel kokkupandud kätega, peas lai must rätt valge äärega otsaesisel, valge kaelus, valged kätised.
9545.de: Half-length figure of a woman with half-lowered eyelids, in half-profile to the left, hands clasped at chest height, wearing a wide black headscarf with a white edge on the forehead, a white collar, white cuffs.

9546.d: Katuse all paat pukkidel, eemal madalad hooned.
9546.de: A boat on trestles under a roof, low buildings in the distance.

9552.d: Seitse sinistes toonides heeringat pruunil võrgul. Ülal võrguserv kollaste ujukorkidega. Võrgu piirkonnas värvikihti risti-rästi kraabitud võrgusilmi markeerivad jooned. Pruunides, mustades, tumerohelistes toonides foon.(eesti)
9552.de: Seven herrings in bluish tones on a brown net. Above, the edge of the net with yellow floats. In the area of the net, lines scratched crosswise through the paint layer marking the meshes of the net. Background in brown, black, dark green tones.

9555.d: Maali kesksel kohal kollastes toonides seisva naisakti kolmveerandfiguur. Ülesvaatava pea ümber peene kollase joonega aura. Rinnad veidi reljeefsed. Ülalt paremast nurgast alla vasaku nurgani ebakorrapärase diagonaalina moduleeritud kollastes toonides värvipind. Paremal keskel musta värvigammaga punaste aktsentidega nelinurk, millest voolab välja sinistes ja rohelistes toonides kosk. Maali ülaosas, vasakul sinisel taustal kollasega markeeritud nelinurk. Üldmõjult maal veidi abstraktsionistlik ning kohati pastoosselt maalitud.
9555.de: At the centre of the painting stands a three-quarter figure of a female nude in yellow tones. Around her upward-looking head is an aura marked by a thin yellow line. The breasts are slightly relief-like. From the upper right corner to the lower left corner runs an irregular diagonal area of colour modulated in yellow tones. On the right in the middle is a rectangle in a black colour scheme with red accents, from which flows a waterfall in blue and green tones. In the upper part of the painting, on the left, on a blue background, is a rectangle marked in yellow. The overall effect of the painting is somewhat abstractionist and in places painted pastosely.

9557.d: Esiplaanil, paremal ja keskel madal jõekallas. Tagapool vasakul kulgevat jõge palistavad üksikud raagus kased. kaugemal, paremal, kahekorde eluhoone otsavaade. Taamal mäeahelik.
9557.de: In the foreground, on the right and in the middle, a low riverbank. Further back on the left, solitary bare birches line the flowing river. In the distance, on the right, the end view of a two-storey dwelling house. In the distance, a mountain range.

9561.d: Poisi rinnapilt en face, blondide juustega, valge krae pööratud sinakale pluusile.
9561.de: Chest-portrait of a boy en face, with blond hair, a white collar turned over a bluish blouse.

9564.d: Naise rinnafiguur musta ahviga paremal õlal. Naise džemper kirsipunane, heledad lühikesed lokkis juuksed, ahvil seljas oranž jakk. Taust maalitud värviliste laikudena.
9564.de: Bust of a woman with a black monkey on her right shoulder. The woman's sweater is cherry red, light short curly hair, the monkey wears an orange jacket. The background is painted as coloured patches.

9572.d: Musta mütsi ja punase salliga naise rinnafiguur otsevaates, pilk suunatud paremale. Taust pruunis - rohelises koloriidis.
9572.de: Bust figure of a woman in a black hat and red shawl, in direct view, gaze directed to the right. Background in brown-green coloring.

9578.d: Ees keskel Virumaa rahvarõivais seisva mehe ja naise täisfiguurid. Ülal, paremal nurgas talumaja.
9578.de: In the front centre full figures of a man and a woman standing in Virumaa folk costume. Above, in the right corner, a farmhouse.

9579.d: Järvamaa rahvarõivais seisva neiu ja noormehe täisfiguurid. Ülal paremal kirik.
9579.de: Full figures of a young woman and a young man standing in Järvamaa folk costume. A church in the upper right.

9581.d: Roosakas - lillakas kleidis istuva naise kolmveerandfiguur, kerges pöördes paremale. Pilk suunatud otse ette; vasak käsi tõstetud kleidikaeluse juurde. Foon sinakates, rohekates toonides. Maalitud hoogsate pintslilöökidega, mis osaliselt hajutavad figuuri piirded, sulatades need taustaga ühte.
9581.de: Three-quarter figure of a woman seated in a pinkish-purplish dress, in a slight turn to the right. Gaze directed straight ahead; left hand raised to the neckline of the dress. Background in bluish, greenish tones. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes that partly dissolve the contours of the figure, blending them into the background.

9590.d: Vanema naise pea otsevaates, helepruun valge kaelusega riietus. Tagapõhi pruun.
9590.de: Head of an older woman in frontal view, light brown clothing with a white collar. Brown background.

9598.d: Vanema naise rinnapilt en face. Tume kleit valge äärisega kaelusel, tumedatel juustel pitstanu. Lõua all piklik rinnanõel.
9598.de: Bust portrait of an older woman en face. Dark dress with a white-edged collar, a lace cap on dark hair. Below the chin an elongated brooch.

9604.d: Ees paremal veekogu, keskel inimfiguur karjaga, vasakul ja tagaplaanil puud. Kavand.
9604.de: In front on the right a body of water, in the centre a human figure with a herd, on the left and in the background trees. Sketch.

9608.d: Päikesepaistes halli plangu foonil istuv lillakasse kuube ja sonimütsi riietatud poisike (vaatab pildist välja). Tema ümber seisavad kolm kitse. Vasemal väike valge kitsetall, keskel hall kits ninaga poisi poole. Paremal suur valge kits vaatab ettepoole üle halli selja.(eesti)
9608.de: In sunshine, against a grey fence background, a boy dressed in a purplish coat and a knitted cap sits (looking out of the picture). Around him stand three goats. On the left, a small white kid; in the middle, a grey goat with its nose towards the boy. On the right, a large white goat looks forward over a grey back.

9618.d: Paremalt taha keskele suunduval teel kaks selgvaates inimkogu. Teest paremal künka kaldal väike majake ja lehtpuugrupp; vasakul rohtunud lagendikul üksikud kased. Taamal mets. Üle maastiku pilvine taevas.
9618.de: On a path leading from the right to the back center, two clearly visible human figures. To the right of the path, on the slope of a hill, a small house and a group of deciduous trees; on the left, on a grassy clearing, solitary birches. In the distance a forest. Over the landscape a cloudy sky.

9619.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu, mille madalad kaldad kaetud koltunud muruga. Samas üksikuid sügisvärvides puid. Taamal mets.
9619.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water, its low banks covered with yellowed grass. Also individual trees in autumn colours. In the distance a forest.

9620.d: Ees veekogu vasemalt keskelt taha paremale ulatuva kalda ja männimetsa peegeldusega. Silmapiiril kaldajoon metsaga.
9620.de: In front a body of water with the reflection of a shore and pine forest extending from left-centre back to the right. On the horizon a shoreline with forest.

9621.d: Ees vasakul veekogu. Paremal lagendik üksikute hoonetega. Vasakul raagus puud.
9621.de: In front on the left a body of water. On the right a clearing with individual buildings. On the left bare trees.

9622.d: Esiplaanil rannik suurte kividega. Tagapool lainetav meri. Horisondil saare siluett.
9622.de: In the foreground a coastline with large stones. Behind it a rippling sea. On the horizon the silhouette of an island.

9623.d: Maali keskel suure puu all istub valgete juuste ja habemega punases pikas rüüs mees. Parem käsi sirutatud üles, vasak hoiab kannelt. Temast paremal inimhulk püsti ja istuvas asendis, vasakul jõe kaldal neljast inimesest koosnev grupp. Sellest grupist vasakul paadi kõrval üksik inimene istumas. Esiplaanil keskel selgvaates tütarlaps murul istumas, paremal seisab ema lapsega. Ema kohal profiilis ettepoole kallutatud, nägu pööratud vasakule. Pilk on suunatud tema külge klammerdunud lapsele.
9623.de: In the centre of the painting, under a large tree, sits a man with white hair and beard, in a long red robe. His right hand is stretched upward, his left holds a kannel [Estonian zither]. To his right, a crowd of people standing and sitting, on the left, on the riverbank, a group of four people. To the left of this group, beside a boat, a single person sitting. In the foreground in the centre, seen frontally, a girl sitting on the grass, on the right stands a mother with a child. Above the mother, in profile, leaning forward, her face turned to the left. Her gaze is directed at the child clinging to her.

9627.d: Heledal pruunikal foonil noorema naise rinnafiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Naisel peal punane rätik, mille alt paistab salk tumedaid juukseid. Riietatud tumedamais pruunides toonides.
9627.de: On a light brownish background, the chest figure of a younger woman in a slight turn to the right. The woman wears a red kerchief, from under which a shock of dark hair shows. Dressed in darker brown tones.

9628.d: Suurte lehtpuude taustal ümmargune peenar punaste lilledega, selle keskel lilledega täidetud aiavaas kõrgel alusel.
9628.de: Against the backdrop of large deciduous trees, a round flowerbed with red flowers, in its centre a garden vase filled with flowers on a tall stand.

9630.d: Neljakandiline, erinevate küljepikkustega pilt. Rohelisele foonile maalitud sinine nelinurk, mille parempoolsed nurgad on ära lõigatud.
9630.de: A quadrangular picture with sides of different lengths. A blue quadrangle painted on a green background, whose right-hand corners are cut off.

9631.d: Pruunides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon, mis koosneb vasakult paremale liikuvast meesteväest ja nendega koos kõndivast tähnilisest leopardist vasakul all. Leopardi vasak esikäpp üles tõstetud. Meestel seljas pruunid püksid ja kuued, esimesena sammuval mehel on kuub ruuduline. Kõigi astujate pilgud suunatud diagonaalselt üles. Vasakult foon tume, punaste laikudega; paremalt paistavad sinised madalad mäed ja hall taevas nende kohal.(eesti)
9631.de: A figural composition in brown tones, consisting of a host of men moving from left to right, accompanied by a spotted leopard walking with them at the lower left. The leopard's left front paw is raised. The men wear brown trousers and coats; the man walking foremost has a checked coat. All the walkers' gazes are directed diagonally upward. On the left, the background is dark with red patches; on the right, low blue mountains and a grey sky above them are visible.

9632.d: Tööst 1/3 maastiku, 2/3 taeva all. Mäeahelike vahelt, keskelt, näha kiriku torni ja suitsu. Vasakpoolse aheliku külg kaetud metsaga. Taevas äikesepilved. Paremal äärel sadav vihm.
9632.de: The work is 1/3 landscape, under 2/3 sky. Between the mountain ranges, in the centre, a church tower and smoke are visible. The side of the left-hand range is covered with forest. Thunderclouds in the sky. On the right edge, falling rain.

9639.dm: lehe kõrgus: 24.0 cm; lehe laius: 40.0 cm
9639.d: Ees vasakul ja keskel kaljuseina ääres neli seisvat figuuri. Paremal lamav figuur, vaade veekogule. Üsna kalda lähedal purjelaev (ühemastiline paat).
9639.de: In front, on the left and in the centre by a rock face, four standing figures. On the right a reclining figure, gazing at a body of water. Quite close to the shore a sailing ship (a single-masted boat).

9640.dm: lehe kõrgus: 16.3 cm; lehe laius: 10.4 cm
9640.d: Ees keskel, valge samba taustal püssiga seisev figuur.
9640.de: In the center foreground, a figure standing with a rifle against a white column.

9641.dm: kujutise laius: 51.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 40.7 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 36.0 cm; lehe laius: 54.0 cm
9641.d: Ees keskel suurte puude all veekogu, mille paremal kaldal poolalasti kivil istuv naine; vasakul kükitav triton.
9641.de: In front, in the middle, under large trees a body of water, on the right bank of which a half-naked woman sits on a stone; on the left a crouching triton.

9642.dm: lehe laius: 43.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.5 cm
9642.d: Keskel ülestõusmine, külgedel stseenid "Simsonist ja Delilast".
9642.de: In the centre the Resurrection, on the sides scenes from "Samson and Delilah".

9643.dm: lehe kõrgus: 23.5 cm; lehe laius: 34.3 cm
9643.d: Vasakul, kitsal astmestikul istuv tume figuur. Tema ees profiilis seisev alasti naisfiguur.
9643.de: On the left, a dark figure sitting on a narrow flight of steps. In front of it, a naked female figure standing in profile

9644.dm: lehe kõrgus: 21.5 cm; lehe laius: 41.8 cm
9644.d: Diivanil lamava naise alasti täisfiguur. Nägu peidetud käsivarte vahele.
9644.de: Full-length nude figure of a woman lying on a sofa. Face hidden between the arms.

9656.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.2 cm; lehe laius: 27.6 cm
9656.d: Istuv alasti naisfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, parem jalg üle vasaku. Ülakeha painutatud sügavalt ette.
9656.de: A sitting female nude in half-profile to the left, right leg over the left. Upper body bent deeply forward.

9658.d: Vanalinna tihedalt majadest ümbritsetud tagahoov: vasakul ja paremal madalad hallid majad, vasakul viib puutrepp katuse alla, parempoolse maja mitme ukse ja kõrge korstnaga alumine osa läheb üle kõrgemaks punase katuse, valgeks krohvitud seinte ja säärvatidega majaks. Tagaplaanil kolmekorruseline halli katusega ja pisut kõrgem punakaspruuni katusega maja. Viimase kangialusest paistab valgus. Paremal hoovinurgas väike puu, ülaservas tinahall taevas. Pastoosselt maalitud.
9658.de: A backyard in the old town, densely surrounded by houses: on the left and right, low grey houses, on the left a wooden staircase leads under the roof, the lower part of the house on the right, with several doors and a tall chimney, turns into a taller building with a red roof, white-plastered walls and shutters. In the background, a three-storey house with a grey roof and a slightly taller house with a reddish-brown roof. From under the latter's gateway/passage light is showing. On the right, in the corner of the yard, a small tree, at the upper edge a tin-grey sky. Painted in a pastose manner.

9661.d: Talvine vaade. Esiplaanil vasakul lillakas-sinine merelaht, paremal kollakas-valkjas rand. Tagaplaanil kollakas-valkjas tõusev rand, keskel sinajas mets, paremal tumeroheline mets. Taevas helesinise, kollakas-valkjate pilvedega.
9661.de: Winter view. In the foreground on the left a purplish-blue sea bay, on the right a yellowish-whitish shore. In the background a yellowish-whitish rising shore, in the middle bluish forest, on the right dark green forest. Sky light blue, with yellowish-whitish clouds.

9666.d: Esiplaanil kolm suurt, tuulest sasitud kaske. Nende vahelt vasakult paistmas hoone nurk.
9666.de: In the foreground three large birches tousled by the wind. Between them a corner of a building visible on the left.

9667.d: Ees vasakul längus puule toetuv alasti naise figuur. Paremal profiilis istuv alasti mees figuur. Puu otsas madu.
9667.de: In front on the left, a nude female figure leaning against a slanted tree. On the right a nude male figure sitting in profile. A snake at the top of the tree.

9668.d: Lillaka maastiku kohal kollastel pilvedel kolm kihutavat ratsurit: kollane, punane ja tumehall.
9668.de: Above a purplish landscape, on yellow clouds, three galloping riders: yellow, red and dark grey.

9669.d: Esiplaanil vees kaks ebamäärast figuuri. Tagapool vasakul kaljurahnul, hobuse seljas alasti naise figuur.
9669.de: In the foreground in the water two indistinct figures. Behind, on a rock on the left, a naked female figure on horseback.

9670.d: Mere kohal, oranži-lillaka taeva foonil viis lendavat lindu.
9670.de: Above the sea, against an orange-purplish sky, five flying birds.

9671.d: Paremal roheline meri, vasakul taimkatteta punakad kaljud.
9671.de: Green sea on the right, reddish rocks without vegetation on the left.

9672.dm: kõrgus: 24.9 cm (vm.   ); lehe laius: 33.4 cm; laius: 27.6 cm (vm.); lehe kõrgus: 26.2 cm
9672.d: Naise pea lamavas asendis, profiil vasakule.
9672.de: Woman's head in a lying position, profile facing left.

9673.d: Tumedajuukselise, rinnale langetatud peaga naise akt (poolfiguur). Keha en face, pea pöördega vasakule.
9673.de: Nude of a dark-haired woman with head lowered to the chest (half-figure). Body en face, head turned to the left.

9674.d: Tänavanurk. Esiplaanil oleval kollasel majal silt "Toiduained", vasakul hoovivärav.
9674.de: A street corner. On the yellow house in the foreground a sign "Toiduained", on the left a courtyard gate.

9678.d: Vasakul tumedanahaliste ebamääraste inimfiguuride grupi keskel paremal istuvale tumedas rüüs mehele karikat ulatav naisakt.
9678.de: On the left, in the middle of a group of vaguely rendered dark-skinned human figures, a female nude on the right hands a goblet to a man in a dark robe who is sitting.

9679.d: Ees lamaval hülgel istuv naine, ülakeha paljastatud; ümber puusade ja jalgade punane loor. Taustaks meri.
9679.de: In front, a woman sitting on a reclining seal, upper body exposed; a red veil around the hips and legs. Background of sea.

9683.d: Vees istuv naine otsevaates, lühikeses aluskleidis. Üle õlgade tuules lendlev supelmantel. Taustaks meri.
9683.de: A woman sitting in the water, in frontal view, in a short undergarment. A bathing coat fluttering in the wind over her shoulders. Background of sea.

9690.d: Kõrge kaljune kallas asulaga rannal tumesinise vee ääres.(eesti)
9690.de: A high rocky shore with a settlement on the bank by dark blue water.

9694.d: Paremal esiplaanilt taha suunduv tee, mis kahelt poolt ääristatud vanade raagus puudega. Maapind kaetud lumega, millel puude sinakad varjud.
9694.de: On the right a path leading from the foreground to the back, bordered on both sides by old bare trees. The ground covered with snow, on which bluish shadows of the trees.

9696.d: Keskealise mehe pea, kerges pöördes vasemale. Pikad juuksed, valge püstkrae. Tume riietus.
9696.de: Head of a middle-aged man, slightly turned to the left. Long hair, white stand-up collar. Dark clothing.

9699.d: Mererannal vasakul hoone nurk ja paadid. Esiplaanil kitsas rannariba, millel võitlushoos talupojad punase lipu ja relvadega lahinguks valmistumas. Taevas pooleldi pilvedega kaetud.
9699.de: On a sea shore, on the left the corner of a building and boats. In the foreground a narrow strip of shore, on which peasants in the heat of battle are preparing for combat with a red flag and weapons. The sky partly covered with clouds.

9702.d: Linnavaade (Tallinna vanalinnast). Esiplaanil väravaga lõppev umbtänav. Paremal äärt piirav majanurk, keskel kivi ja pappkatusega maja. Nende üle paistvaid lehtpuid ja taamal taeva foonil teravaviiluline katus.
9702.de: A city view (of Tallinn's Old Town). In the foreground, a dead-end street ending in a gate. On the right, the corner of a building bordering the edge, in the middle a house with a stone and cardboard roof. Above them, deciduous trees visible, and in the distance, a sharp-gabled roof against the sky.

9703.d: Vasakult paremale taha suunduv tänav vanade madalate kivimajadega.
9703.de: A street with old low stone houses receding from left to right.

9709.d: Esiplaanil jõekallas palgivirnadega. Tagapool vasakul müüri taga maju ja kirikutorne. Paremal üle puuplangu paistmas ühekordseid äärelinna maju ja paljude sibulakujuliste kuplitega tornidega kirik.(eesti)
9709.de: In the foreground a riverbank with piles of logs. Further back on the left, houses and church towers behind a wall. On the right, above a wooden fence, single-storey suburban houses and a church with towers of many onion-shaped domes can be seen.

9710.dm: kõrgus: 96.0 cm (vm   ); laius: 200.0 cm (arm); laius: 199.0 cm (vm   ); kõrgus: 97.0 cm (arm   )
9710.d: Esiplaanil vasakule kihutavat kaks meeskondadega varustatud tanki, vasakul teeääres süttinud saksa tank. Tagaplaanil vahutavais laines lahesopp, millest vasemal kolletav mets. Tagaplaanil Tallinna siluett.
9710.de: In the foreground two tanks equipped with crews racing to the left, on the left by the roadside a burning German tank. In the background a bay inlet in foaming waves, to the left of which a yellowing forest. In the background the silhouette of Tallinn.

9712.d: Üle lihtsate pintslitõmmetega vihjamisi antud madala horisondiga maastiku, millel paremal aimata varemeid ja põõsapuhmast, laiub rünkpilvis taevas, kattes ca 85% pildipinnast.
9712.de: Over a landscape with a low horizon, suggested by simple brush strokes, on the right ruins and a bush can be discerned, spreads a sky of cumulus clouds, covering about 85% of the picture surface.

9717.dm: lehe kõrgus: 43.8 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm
9717.d: Ees paremal rohtunud kaljuplatoo üksikute põõsaste ja puudega eespool, kahe hoone ja varemetega tagapool kaljujärsakutel. Vasakul ja taga mäed.
9717.de: In the foreground on the right a grassy rocky plateau with sparse bushes and trees, further back two buildings and ruins on rocky cliffs. Mountains on the left and in the background.

9718.dm: lehe kõrgus: 20.0 cm; lehe laius: 29.9 cm
9718.d: Ees, keset lagendikku paremal oleva veekogu ääres kõrge kaljurahn. Lagendikulk hajutatult üksikuid hoonete gruppe. Tagaplaanil mäed.
9718.de: In front, in the middle of a clearing, by a body of water on the right, a tall rock boulder. Scattered across the clearing, isolated groups of buildings. Mountains in the background.

9719.dm: lehe kõrgus: 26.6 cm; lehe laius: 36.0 cm
9719.de: Steep-walled rocky boulders with shrubbery in the crevice on the right.

9720.dm: lehe kõrgus: 23.4 cm; lehe laius: 31.5 cm
9720.d: Vaade alt üles lõhenenud kaljukaldale. Ülal servas näha rippumas üksikuid rohututte.
9720.de: View from below upward at a cracked rocky bank. At the top edge solitary tufts of grass can be seen hanging.

9731.d: Vasakul, puude vahelt paistas taraga ümbritsetud madal kollase otsafassaadiga elumaja. Paremal majapidamishooned.
9731.de: On the left, through the trees, a low dwelling house with a yellow gable front, surrounded by a fence, was visible. On the right, farm buildings.

9735.d: Esiplaanil lagendik. Tagapool vasakul mansardkatusega elamu, paremal rida hooneid üksikute puudega. Keskel ja paremal servas kuused.
9735.de: In the foreground a clearing. Behind it, on the left, a dwelling with a mansard roof, on the right a row of buildings with individual trees. In the centre and on the right edge, spruce trees.

9737.d: Lillas turbanis üles suunatud pilguga noore naise rinnapilt. Tema ees laual anum, millest tõstab tangidega mitmesuguseid ebamäärase kujuga tükke.
9737.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in a lilac turban, gaze directed upward. In front of her on the table a vessel from which she lifts various indeterminately shaped pieces with tongs.

9740.d: Roosakas - punase linaga kaetud väikesel ümmargusel laual on kesksel kohal suur ümarik pruun vaas erkoranžide - kollaste saialilledega. Vaasist paremal kaks kollakas toonis karbikest, vasakul väike jalgadega hõbejas toos. Tagaplaanil pruunil seinal ripuvad kolm maali. Kahte alumist varjab peaaegu täielikult lillebukett, keskmine ülal kujutab valget hobust ratsanikuga. All paremas servas on suur rohelise polstriga tooli seljatugi ning näha veidi ka käetuge.
9740.de: On a small round table covered with a pinkish-red cloth, a large round brown vase with bright orange-yellow marigolds occupies the central place. To the right of the vase two yellowish-toned little boxes, to the left a small silver footed container. In the background, on a brown wall, three paintings hang. The two lower ones are almost entirely hidden by the flower bouquet, the middle one above depicts a white horse with a rider. In the lower right corner, the backrest of a large chair with green upholstery is visible, along with a bit of the armrest.

9746.d: Kaks alasti naisratsurit. Vasem - punasel, parempoolne valgel hobusel. Hobused jalgupidi vees.
9746.de: Two nude female riders. The left one on a red horse, the right one on a white horse. The horses standing in water up to their legs.

9747.d: Esiplaanil lage rannaäärne heinamaa üksikute suuremate kividega esiplaanil ja siniste puudega silmapiiril. Vasakul meri, ülal suuremat osa pildist enda alla võttev tihedalt pilvedega kaetud taevas. Maalitud hõredalt, lõuendit alt paista lastes.(eesti)
9747.de: In the foreground, open coastal meadow with a few larger stones in the foreground and blue trees on the horizon. On the left, the sea, above, a densely cloud-covered sky taking up most of the picture. Painted sparsely, letting the canvas show through underneath.

9754.d: Nelja sambaga portikusega hoone puude vahel. Paremal taga osa punasest lameda katusega kivimajast.
9754.de: A building with a four-column portico among trees. On the right behind, part of a red flat-roofed stone house.

9756.d: Lahesopp kahe purjekaga külgvaates. Neist esimesel näha kaks inimfiguuri.Vasakul ees kitsas kaldariba, kaugemal pikalt merre ulatuv neemik, mille tagant paistab laevamaste.
9756.de: A bay inlet with two sailboats in side view. On the first of them two human figures can be seen. On the left in the foreground a narrow strip of shore, further away a headland extending far into the sea, behind which a ship's masts appear.

9757.d: Esiplaanil valge hobune kahe ahviga seljas. Paremal kloun punases kostüümis, vasakul haukuv koer. Tagaplaanil kaks pruuni hobust tagantvaates.
9757.de: In the foreground a white horse with two monkeys on its back. On the right a clown in a red costume, on the left a barking dog. In the background two brown horses seen from behind.

9758.d: Helehall veekogu paadisilla ja paatidega. Esiplaanil liivane kallas. Taamal kallas halli ribana.
9758.de: A light-grey body of water with a boat landing and boats. In the foreground a sandy shore. In the distance the far bank as a grey strip.

9760.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Esindusmundris, narmasõlakutega, parem käsi vööl.
9760.de: Half-figure of a bearded man in half-profile to the left. In formal uniform with braided epaulettes, right hand on his belt.

9763.d: Suure habemega mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis poolpöördes paremale. Keha veidi tahapoole kallutatud. Toetudes istme seljatoele paremas käes pintsel, vasakus palett. Paremas servas üleval näha kuldraamis maali vasak serv.
9763.de: Half-figure of a man with a large beard, seated, in half-turn to the right. Body leaning slightly backward. Leaning on the back of the seat, a brush in his right hand, a palette in his left. In the upper right corner the left edge of a painting in a gilt frame is visible.

9764.d: Linnavaade Tallinna vanalinnast. Diagonaalis vasakult paremale kulgeval vasakul tänavapoolel kõrge terava otsaviilu ja gooti portaaliga kivimaja. Selle kõrval madalamad kivihooned.
9764.de: A city view of Tallinn's Old Town. On the street side to the left, running diagonally from left to right, a stone house with a high pointed gable end and a Gothic portal. Next to it lower stone buildings.

9766.d: Noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates, laps kätel. Naisel peas punane rätt, kõrvas kõrvarõngad, kaelas pärlikee. Heledajuukselisel lapsel (otsevaates( käes kaks viinamarjakobarat. Taustaks kahel pool asuvate lehtpuude vahelt paistev pilvine taevas.
9766.de: Half-figure of a young woman in frontal view, a child in her arms. The woman wears a red kerchief on her head, earrings in her ears, a pearl necklace round her neck. The fair-haired child (in frontal view) holds two clusters of grapes in its hands. The background shows a cloudy sky visible between deciduous trees standing on either side.

9773.d: Naise poolfiguur otsevaates, õlgadele rippuvate juustega. Vasakul pott suureõielise lillega.
9773.de: Half-figure of a woman in frontal view, with hair falling onto the shoulders. On the left a pot with a large-flowered plant.

9777.d: Esiplaanil paremal jäme jändrik mustjas-pruun puutüvi. Puu taga väike lumine kallak hõreda raagus võsaga. Tagaplaanil keskel väike punaka katusega maja. Ülal erksinine taevas.
9777.de: In the foreground on the right a thick, gnarled blackish-brown tree trunk. Behind the tree a small snowy slope with sparse bare scrub. In the background in the centre a small house with a reddish roof. Above, a bright blue sky.

9779.d: Kollakasrohelistes, hallides ja punastes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon dünaamilises värvilaikude liikumises.
9779.de: Abstract composition in yellowish-green, grey and red tones in a dynamic movement of colour patches.

9784.d: Mustajuukselise, põskhabeme ja prillidega keskealise mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega vasakule.
9784.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with black hair, side-whiskers and glasses, slightly turned to the left.

9785.d: Vaas valge sirelioksaga ja kollaste, punaste, roosade tulpidega valgel alusel. Samas vasakul kuldpruun kohvitass, paremal karp. Taust hele.
9785.de: A vase with a white lilac branch and yellow, red, pink tulips on a white base. In the same scene, on the left a golden-brown coffee cup, on the right a box. The background is light.

9787.d: Esiplaanil vasakule pöörduv linnatänav, kõnniteel inimesi. Keskel tänavaäärseid maju, tagaplaanil Olevimäe nõlvakul paremal linnamüüri torn ja rida maju, mille tagant paistab Oleviste kiriku torn.
9787.de: In the foreground a city street turning to the left, people on the pavement. In the middle street-side houses, in the background on the slope of Oleviste Hill on the right a city wall tower and a row of houses, behind which the tower of St. Olaf's Church is visible.

9788.d: Kahekorruseline, osaliselt mustaks, osaliselt kollaseks värvitud maja tänava ääres. Paremal tara taga raagus puud.
9788.de: A two-storey house, painted partly black, partly yellow, by the roadside. On the right, bare trees behind a fence.

9789.d: Laual, vasakul punutud korv siniste viinamarjadega, paremal lahtilõigatud arbuus. Vasakul, laua nurgal nuga.
9789.de: On a table, on the left a woven basket with blue grapes, on the right a cut-open watermelon. A knife at the corner of the table on the left.

9792.d: Esiplaanil meri, keskel suur purilaev, tagaplaanil rand laevade ja mägedega, pilvede vahel täiskuu.
9792.de: In the foreground the sea, in the middle a large sailing ship, in the background a shore with ships and mountains, a full moon among the clouds.

9797.d: Vaade portjääriga uksest heledasti valgustatud ruumi, milles skulptuur postamendil.
9797.de: View through a portièred door into a brightly lit room, in which a sculpture on a pedestal.

9798.d: Paremal kaks aurikut ahtrist kaile rippuvate trossidega, teist mehed värvimas veepinnal, vasakul kai ääres mees, tagapool laevad ja suitsud heledal taeva foonil.(eesti)
9798.de: On the right two steamers with ropes hanging from the stern to the quay, on one men painting at the waterline, on the left a man by the quay, further back ships and smoke against a light sky background.

9800.d: Esiplaanil kaljul kotkas kalaga, tagapool laht, paremal kaldariba hoonetega.(eesti)
9800.de: In the foreground on a cliff an eagle with a fish, further back a bay, on the right a strip of shore with buildings.

9801.d: Kollane teetamm elektriliiniga, kaugemal majad ja kraanad.
9801.de: Yellow road embankment with an electric line, houses and cranes further away.

9805.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduv rühm muistses relvastuses mehi, sõjakalt zhestikuleerimas. Paremal linnuse värav, mida osa mehi püüab lõhkuda. Tagapool keskel näha mehi müüri najale toetatud redelitelt ründamas müüril asuvaid ristirüütleid.(eesti)
9805.de: In the foreground, a group of men in ancient armament moving from left to right, gesturing belligerently. On the right, the gate of a fortress, which some of the men are trying to break down. Further back in the middle, men can be seen attacking, from ladders leaning against the wall, the crusader knights positioned on the wall.

9807.d: Esiplaanil paremal madal rand sügiseselt kolletavate vahtrapuudega, mis kaarjalt haarab vasakult poolelt keskele ulatuvast lahesoppi üksiku, madalas kaldavees seisva lootsikuga. Tagapool järsult kõrgenev maastik, milles näha üksikuid hooneid (Tallinna Maarjamäe rajoon). Vasakul, silmapiiril, sinav Pirita rand.
9807.de: In the foreground on the right a low shore with autumn-yellowing maple trees, curving from the left side to a bay inlet reaching to the centre, with a single boat standing in shallow shore water. Behind it a landscape rising steeply, in which single buildings are visible (the Maarjamäe district of Tallinn). On the left, on the horizon, the bluish Pirita beach.

9809.d: Esiplaanil keskel eest taha suunduv veekogu, mille kaldail hõre mets. Metsa all lumelaike.
9809.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a body of water receding into the distance, its shores lined with sparse forest. Patches of snow beneath the forest.

9810.d: Ees vasakul veekogu, paremal ja taga metsad, keskel inimfiguur.
9810.de: In front on the left a body of water, on the right and behind forests, in the centre a human figure.

9815.d: Paremalt vasakule suundub rongkäik, taustaks paremal kindluse siluett, vasemal mets.(eesti)
9815.de: A procession moves from right to left, with the silhouette of a fortress in the background on the right, forest on the left.

9816.d: Hallipäise esindusliku välimusega mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel pisut taandnud juustepiir, tihedad vuntsid ja väike kolmnurkne lõuahabe. Mehel seljas must pintsak, valge kõrge kraega särk ja must ristlips. Foon ühtlaselt tume.
9816.de: Bust portrait of a gray-haired, distinguished-looking man, slightly turned to the right. The man has a somewhat receded hairline, a thick mustache and a small triangular chin beard. The man wears a black jacket, a white high-collared shirt and a black cross tie. The background uniformly dark.

9817.d: Roosakassinise taeva all kollastes, kirsipounastes toonides lagendik puudega. Maalitud lühikeste, täppivate pintslilöökidega.(eesti)
9817.de: Under a pinkish-blue sky, a clearing with trees in yellow, cherry-brown tones. Painted with short, dabbing brushstrokes.

9821.d: Interjööris istuva keskealise mehe 4/5 figuur veerandpöördes vasakule, pea pööratud paremale. Mehel kõrge laup, sirge nina, pisut tõstetud kulmude vahel sügav korts. Vasak käsi toetub toolileenile, parem lauanurgale, millel vaasid, raamat, linoollõikenoad. Allpool asetseval laual hulk värvikate kaantega raamatuid. Mehel seljas laiade revääridega rohekashall kuub, jalas pruunikad püksid. Vasak jalg üle teise.
9821.de: In an interior a 4/5 figure of a middle-aged man seated, turned three-quarters to the left, head turned to the right. The man has a high forehead, a straight nose, a deep furrow between slightly raised eyebrows. His left hand rests on the back of a chair, the right on the corner of a table on which there are vases, a book, linocut-cutting knives. On a lower table a number of books with colourful covers. The man wears a greenish-grey coat with wide lapels, brownish trousers. Left leg crossed over the other.

9839.d: Esiplaanil bassein, mille tagaosast tõuseb astmeliselt fontäänide rida kuni tagaplaanil kõrgemal terrassil asetseva barokse lossini. Keskosas vasemal terrassiline pargimaastik, domineerivalt okaspuudega.
9839.de: In the foreground a pool, from the rear of which a row of fountains rises in steps up to a baroque castle situated on a higher terrace in the background. In the central part on the left a terraced park landscape, dominated by conifers.

9844.dm: laius: 13.5 cm; paksus: 3.5 cm (raamat); kõrgus: 21.0 cm
9844.d: Ruuduliste lehtedega raamat, musta emulsioonkattega kaanele maalitud habemes kühmus karikeerne kuju, ümbritsetud ristimärkidega.
9844.de: A book with checkered pages, on the cover with a black emulsion coating painted a bearded hunched caricature-like figure, surrounded by cross marks.
