9846.d: Kujutatud metsatalu põlemist. Keskel rookatusega hoone suitsus, sädemeid ja tulekuma ümberringi. Esiplaanil, keskmest paremal talumehe kolmveerandfiguur ähmi täis näoga, paokil suu. Tema ees metsaräga, kaks karjaaia posti tulest valgustatud.
9846.de: Depicts the burning of a forest farmstead. In the middle, a thatched-roof building in smoke, sparks and a glow of fire all around. In the foreground, right of centre, a three-quarter figure of a farmer with a face full of alarm, mouth agape. In front of him a wattle fence, two pasture-fence posts lit by the fire.

9853.d: Laual kõrvits, apelsinid, korvpudel ja korv viinamarjadega.
9853.de: A pumpkin, oranges, a wicker bottle and a basket with grapes on a table.

9862.d: Ees vasakul veekogu karjaga selle parempoolsel kaldal. Ümber lage maastik. Taga mets.
9862.de: In front on the left a body of water with a herd on its right-hand bank. Open landscape around. Forest behind.

9863.d: Eest keskelt taha paremale suunduv tee. Paremal müüre üle selle ulatuva lehtpuukrooniga. Vasakul ees väike veekogu (lomp). Selle taga park lehtpuudega.
9863.de: A path leading from the front center to the back right. On the right, walls with a deciduous tree crown extending above them. In front on the left a small body of water (puddle). Behind it a park with deciduous trees.

9864.d: Keset lõuendit kõrgete rohtunud kallaste vahel vasakult diagonaalselt paremale kulgev jõgi. Teiselpool jõge lehtpuu tukkade tagant näha okasmetsa tumedat ladvikut.
9864.de: In the middle of the canvas, a river running diagonally from left to right between high grassy banks. On the other side of the river, the dark treetops of a coniferous forest are visible behind the crowns of deciduous trees.

9865.dm: laius: 23.0 cm (arm.   ); kõrgus: 30.2 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 28.8 cm (arm.   ); laius: 23.7 cm (vm.  )
9865.d: Mehe rinnapilt peapöördega vasakule. Käed vaheliti rinnal. Riietus: tsaristliku vene tumesinine, punasega ääristatud vormikuub narmasõlakutega. Rinnas rida ordeneid.
9865.de: Bust portrait of a man with the head turned to the left. Hands crossed on the chest. Attire: a tsarist Russian dark blue uniform coat trimmed with red, with tasselled fastenings. On the chest a row of orders.

9867.d: Esiplaanilt taha lookleva kiviaia taga grupp õlgkatusega taluhooneid palkidest. All ja paremal servas rohi üksikute kividega, külavahetee ja puu. Ülal hallikate pilvedega kaetud taevas.
9867.de: Behind a winding stone wall running from the foreground into the distance, a group of thatched-roof farm buildings made of logs. Below and on the right edge, grass with scattered stones, a village road and a tree. Above, a sky covered with greyish clouds.

9870.de: At the top left a branch with clusters of white currants, a cluster of red currants and two gooseberries. In the middle a radish with leaves. On the right a lingonberry branch, a peach below.

9871.d: Poolpikkade juustega noormehe rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule, käed ees tõstetud palveks. Seljas punase-kollase ornamendiga rüü, põimitud võrk kaeluses, merekarpidega kaunistus rinnal, õlgadel. Noormehe pea tagant rohelist draperiid kujutav osa, tema ees osa loodusmotiividega.
9871.de: A bust portrait of a young man with shoulder-length hair, turned three-quarters to the left, hands raised in front of him in prayer. He wears a robe with a red-and-yellow ornament, a woven net at the neckline, decoration with sea shells on the chest and shoulders. Behind the young man's head a part depicting a green drapery, in front of him a part with nature motifs.

9876.d: Kaks õitsvat ja marjadega (viljadega) kartulikasvu oksa.
9876.de: Two flowering potato plant branches with berries (fruits).

9878.de: A view from above of the rooftops of houses in Tallinn's Old Town. Roofs of different colours interweave into complex surface structures. In the background a group of trees amid the houses and churches. Strong blue and dark red tones dominate.

9879.d: Taraga piiratud kollane elumaja ja majapidamishooned. Õuel paremal raagus puu.
9879.de: A yellow dwelling house and farm buildings enclosed by a fence. In the yard on the right a bare tree.

9889.de: On the left riverbank sits one female nude, the other is lying down. On the right, a river.

9894.d: Seisev täisfiguur, poolprofiilis paremale. Käed selja taga, pea langetatud alla. Taust rohekas-pruun.

9901.de: A nude female figure in a dance pose, leaning on her left knee and bending backwards. On the right, behind a bush, a figure playing a flute.

9906.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest kaheosaline maal. Kujundid moodustavad tasapinnalisi ja ruumilisi struktuure, milles: vasakpoolse tiiva alumises parempoolses nurgas skitseeritud naisenägu, mõlemat tiiba läbib horisontaalsest keskjoonest pisut allpool magamisasendis alakeha, parema tiiva paremas servas ülal naise poolakt. Lõuendi pind kohati värviga katmata.
9906.de: A two-part painting made of coloured geometric shapes. The shapes form planar and spatial structures, in which: in the lower right corner of the left-hand wing a sketched woman's face, through both wings, slightly below the horizontal centre line, runs a lower body in a lying position, in the upper right edge of the right-hand wing a woman's half-nude. The canvas surface is in places left uncovered by paint.

9911.d: Petseri kloostri vaade kolme puuga keskel.(eesti). Asukoht objektil: lõuendi tagaküljel
9911.de: View of the Petseri monastery with three trees in the centre. Location on object: on the reverse of the canvas

9913.d: Horisont väga madal. Esiplaanil soojas rohelises toonis aas ja kollakas-pruunikas põld viljarõukudega. Tagaplaanil vasakul kauguses asula, selle taga tume viirg. Paremal silmapiiril kirikutorn. Sinisel taeval horisondile lähenedes kollakas, seejärel lillakas varjund. Rohkesti kiudpilvi ja lindude parved.(eesti)
9913.de: The horizon is very low. In the foreground a meadow in warm green tones and a yellowish-brown field with grain stacks. In the background on the left, in the distance, a settlement, behind it a dark streak. On the right, on the horizon, a church tower. In the blue sky, approaching the horizon, a yellowish, then a purplish tinge. Many cirrus clouds and flocks of birds.

9919.d: Valgel linal apelsinid ja banaanid. Õun, rõigas ja kuivatatud viinamarjad.
9919.de: Oranges and bananas on a white cloth. An apple, a radish and dried grapes.

9921.d: Esiplaanil paremal majanurk, vasakul lumelörtsine tänav, vasakul plank, taamal kahe korstnaga maja.
9921.de: In the foreground on the right a corner of a house, on the left a slushy street, on the left a fence, in the distance a house with two chimneys.

9927.d: Laual vasakul taldrik lahtilõigatud granaatõunaga, keskel viinamarjakobar, paremal teokarp, selle taga kastikene, millel seisab viinaklaas ja viinamarjad.
9927.de: On the table on the left a plate with a cut-open pomegranate, in the middle a bunch of grapes, on the right a snail shell, behind it a small box on which stands a wine glass and grapes.

9928.d: Vanema naise rindportree otsevaates, juuksed siledaks kammitud.
9928.de: Frontal chest portrait of an older woman, hair combed smooth.

9940.d: Moodsa suurlauda sisemuses latrite rivi sees asuvate musta - kirjude lehmadega. Parempoolses äärmises latris asuva lehma juures valges kitlis lüpsja, kinnitamas lüpsiaparaati udara külge. Lehma kohal tagaseinas aken.
9940.de: Inside a modern large barn, with black-and-white cows in a row of stalls. By the cow in the outermost stall on the right, a milkmaid in a white smock attaching the milking machine to the udder. Above the cow, in the back wall, a window.

9941.d: Esiplaanil teel naise figuur helepunases seelikus. Vasakul rohelised, paremal punakais toonides puud. Tagaplaanil sinised mäed.
9941.de: In the foreground, on the road, a female figure in a light red skirt. On the left green trees, on the right trees in reddish tones. Blue mountains in the background.

9945.de: In the middle of the park a small body of water, on the right a building with a reddish roof, surrounded by trees.

9972.de: In the middle bare trees, whose bluish shadows fall on the snow in front. Behind, farm buildings.

9980.d: Eskiis temaatilisele kompositisoonile: keskel surnukeha ümber koondunud talveriietes inimeste grupp. Meestel peas läkiläkid, püssid õlal või käes, naistel villased rätikud. Esiplaanil vasakus nurgas hauda kaevavad mehed, tagaplaanil talvine mets ja inimesed puude vahel.(eesti)
9980.de: Sketch for a thematic composition: in the middle, a group of people in winter clothing gathered around a corpse. The men wear caps with earflaps, rifles on their shoulders or in their hands, the women woollen headscarves. In the foreground in the left corner, men digging a grave, in the background a winter forest and people among the trees.

9981.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired little girl in three-quarter profile to the left; in a seated position. The collar of the red dress and the ends of the short sleeves with a narrow white trim.

9983.d: Lumine hoov vanalinnas: paremal lai madala katusega maja, mille kõrval varikatuse all vanker. Vasakul tagaplaanil kõrgete teravatipuliste katuste ja pikkade korstnatega kivimajad, mille juurest viib esiplaanil olevast hoovist värav. Väravaavast paistavad kaks lumist puud. Pruunikaskollane üldkoloriit, kohati pastoosne.

In the background on the left, stone houses with high pointed roofs and long chimneys, from which a gate leads out of the courtyard in the foreground. Through the gate opening two snowy trees can be seen. Overall brownish-yellow colour scheme, in places pastose.

9986.de: In the foreground an open field, behind it a deciduous forest.

9992.de: A body of water with boats. The opposite bank is low-lying. Painted thinly in a whitish-blue colour scheme.

9996.d: Esiplaanil majade vahel õu. Taamal majade katused ja kirikutornid.
9996.de: In the foreground, a courtyard between houses. In the distance, roofs of houses and church towers.

9997.d: Pargi vaade hõredalt kasvavate jämedamate ja peenemate lehtpuudega. Ees vasakul suur kivi.

10003.de: In the middle of a rolling sea the head of a sea dragon turned to the right. Right paw stretched forward. To the right of it, further back, a second sea dragon. Cloudy sky with a light strip on the horizon.

10005.d: Keskealise naise rinnafiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Mustade juustega ja prillidega naisel seljas sinine kleit, kaelas kirju rätt. Taust tume.

10006.d: Esiplaanil mees märsiga kätel, tema taga lilla hobune.
10006.de: In the foreground a man with a knapsack in his hands, behind him a purple horse.

10007.de: A domed round building in Neo-Gothic style.

10009.d: Heledate, laines üle pea ja õlgade langevate juustega Kristuse pea, helepruunid vuntsid ja habe, kollakad silmad, kitsas kahvatu näoovaal. Seljas tumepunane ja roheline rüü, mille all valge särk, servas ornamenteeritud pael. Kristuse pea ümber nimbus, mille sees punane õis. Kroonlehtede vahel taimelehed. Foon sinine, klaasile maalitud mustad taimemotiivid.
10009.de: The head of Christ with light, wavy hair falling over the head and shoulders, light brown moustache and beard, yellowish eyes, a narrow pale oval face. Wearing a dark red and green robe, under which a white shirt, with an ornamented ribbon at the edge. Around Christ's head a nimbus, inside which a red blossom. Plant leaves between the petals. The background is blue, black plant motifs painted on glass.

10010.d: Vaade sillutatud siseõuele. Üle majade paistmas koonusekujuline mägi. Taevas sinine. Mäed mererohelises - lillas koloriidis.
10010.de: View of a paved courtyard. A cone-shaped mountain visible above the houses. The sky is blue. The mountains in a sea-green - purple coloration.

10015.d: Põõsastega ääristatud rohuplatsil vanaaegses rõivastuses meeste ja naiste poolringi keskel sulgedega kübaras naise ja kaabut kergitava mehe figuur.
10015.de: In the middle of a semicircle of men and women dressed in old-fashioned clothing on a grass plot bordered by bushes, the figures of a woman in a feathered hat and a man lifting his hat.

10020.d: Esiplaanil, üle kogu pildi laiuse ulatuselt, väeüksus ratsa. Enamik mehi täishabemega. Relvastus koosneb piigist, püssist ja mõõgast. Taustaks mäed.
10020.de: In the foreground, spanning the entire width of the picture, a mounted military unit. Most of the men are fully bearded. Armament consists of a pike, a rifle and a sword. Mountains as background.

10025.d: Ees keskel, keset jõge väikesel saarel linnud. Taga, vastaskaldal hoonete rida, mille tagant algab järsuseinaline kaljumäestik kindluslinnuse varemetega keskmisel kaljuplatool.(eesti)
10025.de: In front, in the middle, birds on a small island in the middle of a river. Behind, on the opposite bank, a row of buildings, behind which begins a steep-walled rocky mountain range with the ruins of a fortress-town on the middle rocky plateau.(eesti)

10027.d: Vanema daami poolfiguur, veerandprofiilis vasakule, mustas kleidis valge krae ja tanuga, vasakul käel punasekirjaline rätik.
10027.de: Half-figure of an elderly lady, in three-quarter profile to the left, in a black dress with a white collar and bonnet, in her left hand a scarf with red writing.

10030.d: Avar maastikuvaade: esiplaanil kollakates ja punakaspruunides toonides ülesküntud põld, mille taga keskel kasesalu ja üksikuid puudegruppe viimasest vasakul ja paremal. 10030.de: A broad landscape view: in the foreground a ploughed field in yellowish and reddish-brown tones, behind it in the middle a birch grove and isolated groups of trees to the left and right of it. On the horizon a bluish-green strip of forest, above which a bright blue sky in yellow and pink tones is rendered with small low clouds. A dense, choppy brush technique.

10032.d: Vertikaalselt lõhestab pildi pinda sinine kujund, mis allservas kasvab üle punaseks, mannekeeni õlapartiid meenutavaks osas. Sinise kujundi ülaosas piiravad seda punane, kollane ja valge triip. Vertikaalsest keskjoonest paremal kollane, ühe musta silmaga ja oranži juuksepahmakaga nägu. Foon tumehall.
10032.de: A blue shape vertically splits the surface of the picture, which at the bottom grows over into a red section resembling the shoulder part of a mannequin. At the top of the blue shape it is bordered by a red, yellow and white stripe. To the right of the vertical centre line, a yellow face with one black eye and a tousled orange mop of hair. The background is dark grey.

10035.d: Pildil umbes viisteist astmeliselt kerkivat hoonet. Esiplaanil vasakul raudkividest müür ja trepp, paremal palm.
10035.de: The picture shows about fifteen buildings rising in tiers. In the foreground on the left a wall of fieldstones and a staircase, on the right a palm tree.

10037.d: Esiplaanil vasakul lillakas kleidis, paremal rooskaskleidis tütarlaps, taustaks meri ja mäed.
10037.de: In the foreground on the left a girl in a purplish dress, on the right a girl in a pink dress, with the sea and mountains as background.

10038.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Teisel pool veekogu maastik üksikute lehtpuude ja taluhoonetega. Horisondil mets ja üksik krikutorn vasakul.
10038.de: In the foreground a body of water. On the other side of the water, a landscape with individual deciduous trees and farm buildings. On the horizon a forest and a solitary wooden watchtower on the left.

10040.d: Esiplaanil vesi, vasakul hoone puudega, tagapool tornidega loss, taamal kõrged mäetipud.
10040.de: In the foreground water, on the left a building with trees, behind it a castle with towers, in the distance tall mountain peaks.

10045.d: Veekogu, esiplaanil kaks paati ja väike laev, kaugemal sillakaared.
10045.de: A body of water, in the foreground two boats and a small ship, further away bridge arches.

10056.de: Grass in the foreground, on the left a narrow path leads to castle ruins, solitary trees and bushes in front of the ruins.

10057.d: Veekogu paadisilla ja paatidega. Vastaskaldal roosad majad roheliste puude vahel.
10057.de: A body of water with a boat pier and boats. On the opposite bank pink houses among green trees.

10058.d: Palja lagipeaga ja prillidega mehe rinnafiguur profiilis vasakule. Taust hele.
10058.de: Bust of a bald, bespectacled man in profile facing left. Light background.

10059.d: Esiplaanil poolummistunud külatänav hoonete reaga vasakul ja paremal.(eesti)
10059.de: In the foreground a half-blocked village street with a row of buildings on the left and right.

10060.d: Talvine hoovi vaade lumiste majadega. Vasakul raagus puu.
10060.de: Winter view of a yard with snowy houses. On the left a bare tree.

10062.d: Keskel laastudest korv õunte ja viinamarjadega, paremal klaas punase mahlaga, taustaks punane drapeering.

10200.d: Tihedasti üksteise kõrvale surutud inimestest figuraalne kompositsioon, mille peamine raskuspunkt jääb horisontaalsest keskjoonest pisut paremale, sest peamine osa inimmassist on koondunud sinna. Inimeste näod kas ähmaselt antud või puuduvad üldse. Iseloomustuseks on antud kas erksas toonis või iseäralik riietusese (barett, džemper, kübar). Vasakul tumedasse riietatud, hallide pükstega mees, ajaleht käes. Foon vasakult valge lubjatud seina meenutav, paremalt tumehall. Valitsevad tuhmid, väljasuretatud toonid.
10200.de: A figural composition of people pressed tightly against one another, whose main point of gravity falls slightly to the right of the horizontal centre line, since the main part of the mass of people is gathered there. The faces of the people are either given vaguely or are entirely absent. Characterisation is given either through bright tone or a peculiar item of clothing (beret, jumper, hat). On the left a man dressed in dark clothing, with grey trousers, a newspaper in hand. The background resembles a white limewashed wall on the left, dark grey on the right. Dull, faded tones predominate.

10203.d: Esiplaanil lumel lamavad hukatud talupoegade kehad. Tagaplaanil neli seisvat sõjaväelast. Taevas tumesinine, lumi heledam.

10261.de: A yellow house with an attic storey, its gable facing the street. In front on the right a low building with a tall chimney. The sky is gloomy.

10262.d: Esiplaanil asuva balustraadi taga istuva ja vasema käsivarrega balustraadile nõjatuva tumedajuukselise noormehe portree, suunaga vasemale; pea poolprofiilis vasemale. Käte vahel raamat. Paažisoengul madal barett. Taustaks sammasarhitektuur ja läbi aknaava paistev maastik. Balustraadi äärel paremal medaljon ja ringi asetatult MDX  AXXV  DOMINICUS
10262.de: Portrait of a dark-haired young man sitting behind a balustrade in the foreground and leaning with his left forearm on the balustrade, facing left; head in half-profile to the left. A book between his hands. Low beret with a page hairstyle. Background of column architecture and a landscape visible through a window opening. On the right at the edge of the balustrade a medallion with, arranged in a circle, MDX AXXV DOMINICUS

10268.d: Helesinistes ja kollakates toonides merevaade sadamaga esiplaanil: pildi allservas kai kastide, tünnide, gaasiballoonidega. Kai ääres on ankrus mitmed väiksemad kalalaevad. Taamal lahesopp veest väljaulatuvate kividega. Ülal helesinine horisontaalne valge pilvetriibuga teavas.(eesti)
10268.de: A seascape in light blue and yellowish tones with a harbour in the foreground: at the bottom edge of the picture a quay with boxes, barrels, gas cylinders. Several smaller fishing boats are anchored by the quay. In the background a bay inlet with rocks protruding from the water. Above, a light blue horizontal sky with a white cloud stripe.

10269.d: Tumedajuukselise, suurte kõrvarõngastega keskaelise naise rinnapilt. Paeaegu en face. Seljas sinine tumeoranži kraega kleit.(eesti)
10269.de: Bust of a dark-haired, middle-aged woman with large earrings. Almost en face. Wearing a blue dress with a dark orange collar.

10276.d: Spordidressis noormehe põlvpilt en face. Kaenlas suusad.
10276.de: Knee-length portrait of a young man in a sports tracksuit, en face. Skis under his arm.

10277.d: Lopsakalt täppivas laadis maalitud varakevadine maastik: esiplaanil väikesed, laiguti lumega kaetud künkad. Taamal lopsakad männid, ülal hallikassinine taevas. Maalitud tumedated rohelistes ja ookritoonides.
10277.de: An early spring landscape painted in a lushly dabbed manner: in the foreground small hills covered patchily with snow. In the distance lush pine trees, above a greyish-blue sky. Painted in dark green and ochre tones.

10279.d: Esiplaanil tükati lumega kaetud põld, üksikute viljarõukudega. Taga horisondil mets.
10279.de: In the foreground a field partly covered with snow, with solitary grain stacks. Behind, on the horizon, a forest.

10280.d: Tänavanurk madalate majadega, mille tagant paistmas koonusekujuline torn. Paremal kõrged lehtpuud.
10280.de: A street corner with low houses, behind which a cone-shaped tower can be seen. On the right tall leafy trees.

10282.d: Tumerohelises vaasis roosa- ja valgeõieliste segalillede bukett, kus domineerivad suured punased moonid. Paremal vaasi ees üks valge õis. Foon rohekais toonides. Pastoosne lai pintsli löök.
10282.de: Bouquet of mixed flowers with pink and white blossoms in a dark green vase, in which large red poppies dominate. On the right in front of the vase one white blossom. Background in greenish tones. Pastose, broad brushstroke.

10292.de: Four nude female figures on a sea-green background.

10294.d: Esiplaanil vasakul lahekääruna paremale ulatuv järv, millesse paremalt sissetungiva neemiku ninas keskaegses ehituslaadis linnus. Linnusesse viib paremalt poolt kõrgenavalt kaldalt väravaga kindlustatud sildtee. Paremal, kaldaäärsel rajal jahimees koeraga. Vasakult paistab üle järve lumise tipuga mägi. Kergelt pilvises ehapunane taevas peegeldub järve peegelpinnal ja annab süngele linnusele osaliselt rõõmsa punaka värvuse.
10294.de: In the foreground on the left a bay-like inlet of a lake extending to the right, with a castle in medieval architectural style at the tip of a headland intruding from the right. A causeway fortified with a gate leads to the castle from the rising shore on the right. On the right, on a path along the shore, a huntsman with a dog. On the left a mountain with a snowy peak is visible across the lake. A slightly cloudy, sunset-red sky is reflected on the mirror-like surface of the lake, giving the gloomy castle a partly cheerful reddish colouring.

10298.d: Keskealise mehe rinnapilt otsevaates. Heledad juuksed ja vurrud. Valge rinnaesine, kaelaside ja püstkrae. Must kuub.
10298.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in frontal view. Light hair and moustache. White shirt front, cravat and stand-up collar. Black coat.

10301.d: Ees hiigelsuure lehtpuu all grupp inimesi einestamas. Nende taga laiuvad küpsest viljast kollendavad põllud. Tagapool, paremal, grupp kummargil viljasidujaid.
10301.de: In front, under a huge deciduous tree, a group of people having a meal. Behind them stretch fields yellow with ripe grain. Farther back, on the right, a group of sheaf-binders bent over.

10302.d: Maali keskel seisab mees merel. Parem käsi üles tõstetud, vasemaga puudutab pildi paremas nurgas vees lamava mehe pead. Tagaplaanil paremal purjelaevad.
10302.de: In the centre of the painting a man stands on the sea. His right hand is raised, with his left he touches the head of a man lying in the water in the right corner of the picture. In the background on the right, sailing ships.

10303.d: Tänava ääres kahekorruselised majad. Vasakpoolne, ärklikorrusega maja taraga piiratud.
10303.de: Two-storey houses along the street. The one on the left, with an attic floor, is enclosed by a fence.

10304.d: Naisakt, parem käsi tõstetud rinnale. Labakäsi puudub. Pea kallutatud paremale. Vasakul serval ornamentaalne joonistus.
10304.de: Female nude, right hand raised to the chest. The hand is missing. Head tilted to the right. On the left edge, an ornamental drawing.

10310.d: Esiplaanil keskel madal roheline diagonaalse katusega hoone, mida kolmest küljest ümbritsevad kahekorruselised viilkatusega kivimajad. Taevas hele.
10310.de: In the foreground in the middle a low green building with a diagonal roof, surrounded on three sides by two-storey gabled stone houses. The sky is light.

10317.d: Pikkade pruunide juuste ja vurrudega keskealise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale.(eesti)
10317.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man with long brown hair and a moustache, in half-profile to the right.

10324.d: Ees vasakul lage maastik, paremal nõlvak ja eest taha paremale suunduv tee kahe kihutava ratsanikuga.
10324.de: Open landscape on the left in the foreground, a slope on the right and a road leading from the front to the right into the depth with two galloping riders.

10325.d: Hallide juuste, terava nina ja lõuaga tumedas jakis vana naise rinnaportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Ninal peenete tumedate raamidega prillid, mille helkivate klaaside tagant on vaevu silmi näha. Maalitud pühkivas, kontuurehajutavas maneeris.
10325.de: Bust portrait of an old woman with grey hair, a sharp nose and chin, in a dark jacket, in a quarter-turn to the left. Spectacles with thin dark frames on the nose, through whose glinting lenses the eyes are barely visible. Painted in a sweeping, contour-blurring manner.

10326.d: Esiplaanil oja kaldal vasakul ja paremal kased, tagaplaanil mets.
10326.de: In the foreground birches on the left and right bank of a stream, forest in the background.

10329.d: Künklik panoraammaastik: esiplaanil paremal kaks pruuni katusega maja, nende taga puud. Majadest paremalt kulgeb küngaste vahele tee. Mäekuplite vahel rohelised metsatukad, silmapiiril keskel suurem metsaga kaetud mägi. Taevas tume ja pilvine. Maalitud tumedates külmrohelistes ja hallides toonides, "sezannistlikult".
10329.de: A hilly panoramic landscape: in the foreground on the right two houses with brown roofs, trees behind them. From the houses a road runs to the right between the hills. Green clumps of forest between the hill tops, a larger forest-covered mountain in the centre of the horizon. The sky dark and cloudy. Painted in dark cold-green and grey tones, in a "Cézannist" manner.

10331.d: Hall veekogu laevaga esiplanil, mille vari langeb veepinnale. Samas paate, kaugemal purjekaid. Vastaskallas laugjas.
10331.de: Grey body of water with a boat in the foreground, its shadow falling on the water's surface. Also boats, sailboats further away. Opposite shore is flat.

10332.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasemale. Juustel diadeem, sügava dekolteega kleidil poolkuukujuline rinnanõel.
10332.de: Bust portrait of a woman in half-profile to the left. A diadem in her hair, on her deep-cut dress a crescent-shaped brooch.

10333.d: Halli fooni taustal on lauale asetatud kaks vaasi kirjute lillede ja okstega. Vaasidest eespool kaks rohelist õuna. Väga pastoosne maalimismaneer, määrdunud-summutatud värvitoonid.(eesti)
10333.de: Against a grey background, two vases with colourful flowers and branches are placed on a table. In front of the vases two green apples. Very pastose painting manner, dirty-muted colour tones.

10335.d: Esiplaanil lage veepind, taga künklik kallas metsaga.
10335.de: In the foreground an open water surface, behind it a hilly shore with forest.

10337.d: Tumedajuukselise, hõreda põskhabemega keskealise mehe rinnapilt en face.
10337.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with dark hair and sparse side-whiskers, en face.

10341.d: Ühtlaselt sügavpunaseks maalitud foonil keskel ema, laps süles. Maalitud räigetes sinistes, kollastes, rohelistes toonides äärmiselt ekspressiivsete laiade pastoossete pintslilöökidega figuure ja nägusid markeerides. Punasel foonil väljaspool figuure abstraktsed pastoossed värvilaigud.
10341.de: On a uniformly deep-red painted background, in the middle a mother with a child on her lap. Figures and faces painted in glaring blue, yellow and green tones with extremely expressive broad pastose brushstrokes. On the red background outside the figures, abstract pastose patches of colour.

10342.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kivine lahesopp üksiku paadiga kalda lähedal, selle juures inimfiguur, paremal veepiiri lähedalt liivane rannariba kivide vahele kaldale veetud paadiga. Paremal keskel niidul üksik suurem puu ja vasakule suunduv roigasaed, mille lõpp-punktiks õlgkatusega hoone. Vasakul horisondil piirab lahesoppi sinav rannaviirg.
10342.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky bay with a lone boat near the shore, beside it a human figure; on the right, near the waterline, a sandy strip of shore with a boat pulled ashore among the stones. In the middle right, on a meadow, a single larger tree and a pole fence leading to the left, ending at a thatched-roof building. On the left the horizon is bordered by a bluish coastal strip closing off the bay.

10343.d: Paremal meri, vasakul kivine rand paadiga ja võrgukuivatamise puudega.
10343.de: On the right the sea, on the left a rocky shore with a boat and net-drying poles.

10345.d: Rohekates toonides, pastoosselt maalitud fooni taustal väikest kübarat kandva pruunide, õlgadele langevate juustega noore naise rinnaportree, poolpöördes vasakule. Paremas käes heleroosa roos. Maalipind pastoosene; koloriit rohalistes toonides.(eesti)
10345.de: Bust portrait of a young woman wearing a small hat, with brown hair falling to her shoulders, in three-quarter turn to the left, against a pastosely painted background in greenish tones. In her right hand a light pink rose. The paint surface is pastose; the colouring is in greenish tones.

10347.d: Valge astmeline lameda katusega maja sinise taeva taustal.
10347.de: White stepped flat-roofed house against a blue sky background.

10349.d: Pastoosselt, laiade jämedate pintslitõmmetega maalitud maastik kirgastes värvitoonides. Geometriseeritud vormid on maalitud pea ühe pintslitõmbega, ümardatud vormid (puudekroonid) aga piiritletud põhitooniga kontrasteeruvates värvitoonides jämedate kontuuridega. Esiplaanil kergelt künklik taluõu mitme värvitooniga ning varjuga rohukattega. Tagaplaanil frontaalselt vaatajaga, vasakul tihe salu kaharate ümarate kroonidega lehtpuudest, paremal osa punakaspruunides toonides aidast mustade ukse- ja aknaavadega.
10349.de: A landscape painted pastosely, with broad, thick brushstrokes in bright colour tones. The geometricized forms are painted with almost a single brushstroke, while the rounded forms (tree crowns) are delineated with thick contours in colour tones contrasting with the main tone. In the foreground, a slightly hilly farmyard with grass cover in several colour tones and shadow. In the background, facing the viewer, on the left a dense grove of deciduous trees with broad rounded crowns, on the right part of a barn in reddish-brown tones with black door and window openings.

10351.d: Esiplaanil madalad hooned, mille taga lehtpuud. Eemal sinakashall veekogu, millel jahid. Vastaskallas laugjas.
10351.de: In the foreground low buildings, behind which deciduous trees. In the distance a bluish-grey body of water with yachts. The opposite shore is low.

10352.d: Esiplaanil keskel suurte tumeroheliste puude grupp, mille taga lillakassinine jõgi. Jõe ääres, puudest paremal, üksik kübaras mees kala püüdmas. Taamal metsatukad ja niidud, vasakul grupp valgeid punaste katustega maju. Silmapiiril tumesinine viirg, ülal tume, ähvardavailmeline taevas.
10352.de: In the foreground, centre, a group of large dark green trees, behind which a purplish-blue river. By the river, to the right of the trees, a solitary man in a hat fishing. In the distance, patches of forest and meadows, on the left a group of white houses with red roofs. On the horizon a dark blue streak, above a dark, ominous-looking sky.

10353.d: Veekogu kitsa madala poolsaarega, millel grupp inimesi. Ees paremal tükike rohu ja põõsastega kaetud kallast. Veekogul purjekad. Vastaskallas laugjas.
10353.de: A body of water with a narrow low peninsula on which a group of people stands. In the foreground on the right a piece of shore covered with grass and bushes. Sailboats on the water. The opposite shore is gently sloping.

10355.d: Laes rippuvast suuremõõdulise varjuga varustatud lambist valgustatud rohelise kattega kaardilaua ümber neli mängijat; vasemal hallika lõuahabemega mees profiilis paremale; keskel selgvaates naine, tema vastas otsevaates teine naine, paremal teenistusvormis ohvitser profiilis vasakule käes olevaid kaarte uurimas.
10355.de: Four players sit around a card table covered with green cloth, lit by a lamp with a large shade hanging from the ceiling; on the left a greyish man with a chin beard in profile facing right; in the centre a woman seen in a clear view, opposite her another woman in a frontal view, on the right an officer in service uniform in profile facing left, studying the cards in his hand.

10374.d: R ARõude kogust No 1. Asukoht objektil: tagapapil all vasakul
10374.de: From R. Rõude's collection No 1. Location on the object: on the backing board, lower left

10383.d: Avara hallikassinise taeva all abstraktne mereäärne maastik. Silmapiiril taeva taustal veski.
10383.de: An abstract seaside landscape under a spacious greyish-blue sky. On the horizon against the sky a windmill.

10407.d: Pastoosselt maalitud abstraktne kompositsioon, milles võib aimata mägesid, maju, merd.
10407.de: An abstract composition painted in an impasto manner, in which mountains, houses, and the sea can be discerned.

10426.d: Esiplaanil lumises talvemaastikus pasteldes ja kerjakotiga talumehe rõivas mees ja viiskudega poiss, vasakul valge-mustakirju koer. Taustal raagus puud ja paremal servas tuuleveski.
10426.de: In the foreground, in a snowy winter landscape, a man in pastel-colored, bast-shoe-clad peasant's clothing with a beggar's bag, and a boy in bast shoes, on the left a white-and-black spotted dog. In the background bare trees and on the right edge a windmill.

10434.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 34.0 cm; lehe laius: 53.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 46.5 cm; kujutise laius: 41.0 cm
10434.d: a) Vaade allpool avanevale maastikule,mida piiravad vasakult käharad rohelised puhmad, paremalt raagus kõrged puud. Nende vahelt paistmas valged, punased hooned maastikus. Silmapiiril sinine metsatriip hallika määrdunud taeva all.
10434.de: a) View of a landscape opening up below, bounded on the left by curly green shrubs, on the right by tall bare trees. Between them, white and red buildings visible in the landscape. On the horizon a blue strip of forest under a greyish, murky sky.

10449.d: Veekogu ääres aimatavad punaste ja oranzhide katustega majad, mille taga trapetsikujuline kalju. Taevas rohekas.
10449.de: By a body of water, houses with red and orange roofs can be discerned, behind which a trapezoidal cliff. The sky greenish.

10459.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 61.0 cm; lehe laius: 50.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 65.0 cm; kujutise laius: 48.0 cm
10459.d: Pruunikate toonidega markeerivalt kujutatud puude, põõsaste vahel vasakul  üks, paremal kaks erkpunase katusega heledat maja.Puukroonide taga üksikute säpsudega taeva osa. Rahutu kujutamisviis, hele aluspind läbi kumamas.
10459.de: In brownish tones, sketchily depicted, among trees and bushes, on the left one and on the right two light-coloured houses with bright red roofs. Behind the treetops a part of sky with scattered dabs. A restless manner of depiction, the light ground showing through.

10461.d: Sinise taeva ja üksikute puudega suvine maastik, vasakul teekäänak. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
10461.de: Summer landscape with a blue sky and solitary trees, a bend in the road on the left. Expressive painting style.

10521.d: Lühikeste tumedate juustega noore naise portree otsevaates - seljas punane pluus, pilk suunatud vasakule kaugusesse. Pea pisut kallutatud, nukker.
10521.de: Portrait of a young woman with short dark hair, in a frontal view - wearing a red blouse, gaze directed into the distance to the left. Head slightly tilted, mournful.

10536.d: Heinrich Otto Zoege von Manteuffel/geb: 9 Dec 1779/...1818/gest:10 Sept 1833(saksa). Asukoht objektil: lõuendil maali tagaküljel
10536.de: Heinrich Otto Zoege von Manteuffel/geb: 9 Dec 1779/...1818/gest:10 Sept 1833 (German). Location on object: on the canvas, on the reverse of the painting

10583.d: Maastikuvaade  lookleva jõega keskel. Taamal jõe mõlemal kaldal mets, esiplaanil vasakul üksik puuvõra, paremal kolm põõsast peegeldumas vees.
10583.de: Landscape view with a winding river in the middle. In the distance forest on both banks of the river, in the foreground on the left a solitary treetop, on the right three bushes reflected in the water.

10607.dm: lehe laius: 31.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 26.7 cm
10607.d: Roosaka taeva taustal rehehoone, taamal paistmas hobune.
10607.de: A threshing barn against a pinkish sky, a horse visible in the distance.

10613.d: Kivi peal istuva naise ja mehe täisportree. Blondil mehel käes kirves, peas müts ja jalas räbaldunud lühikesed püksid, rind paljas. Naisel seljas valge kleit punaste lehtedega ja punane peapael. Nende vahel valge riidega kaetud korv, mille seest paistab roheline pudel. Neist paremal küüni uks ja vasakul auto.
10613.de: Full-length portrait of a woman and a man sitting on a stone. The blond man holds an axe, wears a cap and tattered short trousers, his chest bare. The woman wears a white dress with red leaves and a red headband. Between them a basket covered with white cloth, from which a green bottle shows. To their right the door of a barn and to the left a car.

10625.d: Varakevadine lumine maastikuvaade talutare ja üksiku inimfiguuriga. Esiplaanil kaks lähestikku seisvat kõrget mändi, taamal üksik raagus puu. Taamal veel üksikuid taresid ja mände, taustal päikeseloojangu ja linnuparvega õhtutaevas.
10625.de: An early-spring snowy landscape view with a farmhouse and a solitary human figure. In the foreground two tall pines standing close together, further back a solitary bare tree. Further off a few more farmhouses and pines, in the background an evening sky with sunset and a flock of birds.

10645.d: Rohelistes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes rohelistest, lilladest ja sinistest värvipindadest koosnev siluett valgel taustal.
10645.de: Abstract composition in green tones, at its centre a silhouette made up of green, purple and blue colour surfaces on a white background.

10651.d: Rohekates-pruunikates toonides metsavaade kõrgemate puude ja palmidega.
10651.de: Forest view in greenish-brown tones with taller trees and palms.

10654.d: Öine linnavaade väljaku ja majadega, millel kollaažitehnikas reklaampildid.
10654.de: Night cityscape with a square and houses, on which advertising images in collage technique.

10692.d: Esiplaanil soisel maastikul tihedat võsa, mille üle näha soojärvi tiheda metsa taustal. Vasakul liivaseljandikul põgenev hunt, metsas puude vahel kolm jahimeest.
10692.de: In the foreground, on a marshy landscape, dense scrub, above which a marsh lake can be seen against the background of a dense forest. On the left, on a sandy ridge, a fleeing wolf, in the forest among the trees three huntsmen.

10704.d: Maalilise üldistusega edasi antud maastikuvaade järve ja künklike maastikuvormidega. Esiplaanil järv, mille kaldaäärsel kaks punast maja. Taamal tumedad künklikud maastikuvormid ja heledad majad.
10704.de: A landscape view rendered with painterly generalization, with a lake and hilly landforms. In the foreground a lake, on whose shore stand two red houses. Further back, dark hilly landforms and light-coloured houses.

10705.d: Vaade neljast hoonest koosnevale talukompleksile. Vasakul ja paremal pool talukompleksi kasvavad männid. Talu poole kõnnivad kaks naist, mõlemal peas valge rätik, seljas must pluus ja  punane seelik. Taustal hele taevas ja metsaviirust koosnev horisont.
10705.de: A view of a farm complex consisting of four buildings. Pine trees grow on the left and right of the farm complex. Two women are walking toward the farm, both with white kerchiefs on their heads, wearing black blouses and red skirts. In the background a light sky and a horizon made up of a strip of forest.

10735.d: Kompositsiooni all keskel suur kauss ja lusikas. Paremal istub valge figuur ja vasakul seisab sinine. Kausi kohal mustade ja lillade pindadega vorm.
10735.de: At the bottom centre of the composition a large bowl and a spoon. On the right a white figure sits and on the left a blue one stands. Above the bowl a form with black and purple surfaces.

10737.d: Tumedal taustal mehe rindportree, silmavaatega vasakule, üks käsi rinnale tõstetud.
10737.de: Chest portrait of a man on a dark background, gaze to the left, one hand raised to the chest.

10747.de: Full portrait of a seated young woman in folk costume.

10761.d: Heledapäise poisi en face poolfiguur. Seljas linased valged rõivad; sinakas taust.
10761.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired boy en face. Wearing white linen clothes; bluish background.

10769.dm: lehe laius: 27.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.5 cm
10769.d: Naise tantsiv figuur, pea profiilis paremal. Pikad patsid kõrval lehvimas, parem käsi lehega ülal, vasem üle rinna parema käe kõrval. Seljas lai seelik, kitsas pihik ja puhvitud varrukatega pluus. All maastiku piirjooned.
10769.de: Dancing figure of a woman, head in profile on the right. Long braids fluttering to the side, right hand raised with a leaf, left hand across the chest next to the right hand. Wearing a wide skirt, a narrow bodice and a blouse with puffed sleeves. Below, the outlines of a landscape.

10797.d: Kollakasrohelistes toonides suletud silmadega kahvatu tüdruku rinnaportree. Kogu figuur on otsekui tuulehoost haaratud, heledad juuksed lehvivad, ülestõstetud käsi on rinna kohal peopesaga vaataja poole pööratud.
10797.de: Bust portrait of a pale girl with closed eyes, in yellowish-green tones. The whole figure appears as if seized by a gust of wind, the light hair fluttering, a raised hand above the chest turned palm towards the viewer.

10815.d: Töö keskel on pabernukku meenutav figuur, keda on kujutatud alla kallutatud ülakehaga ning tõstetud kätega. Kompositsiooni taust on jagatud diagonaalselt tumehalliks seinaks ja helehalliks põrandaks.
10815.de: In the middle of the work is a figure resembling a paper doll, depicted with the upper body tilted downward and raised hands. The background of the composition is divided diagonally into a dark grey wall and a light grey floor.

10818.d: Rannikuvaade, mida piirab paremalt poolt kaks neoonoranži kaljut. Taamal näha merepiiri, maastik on künklik. Kompositsiooni vasakus servas seisab seljaga vaataja poole mehike.
10818.de: A coastal view bordered on the right by two neon-orange cliffs. In the distance the sea's edge can be seen, the landscape is hilly. In the left edge of the composition stands a small man with his back to the viewer.

10881.d: Helerohelisel taustal noore mehe pea profiilis vasakule.
10881.de: On a light green background the head of a young man in profile to the left.

10910.d: Beežil taustal istuva mehe portree veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel seljas pruun mantel, punakas särk, peas kaabu, käes pintsel.
10910.de: Portrait of a seated man against a beige background, in a three-quarter turn to the right. The man is wearing a brown coat, a reddish shirt, a hat on his head, a brush in his hand.

10924.d: Sassispäise habemiku vanamehe rindpilt. Seljas rohekas vammus. Käte vahel nokkmüts.
10924.de: Chest portrait of a tousle-headed bearded old man. Wearing a greenish jerkin. A peaked cap between his hands.

10925.d: Vasakul poolenisti kaldale tõmmatud kalapaadid, millede taga heledal liival kolm pikkades seelikutes naist. Kaldal kalakuurid, lipuvarras, keskele jääb kõrge kallas, paremal meri. 3/4 pildipinnast pilvine taevas.
10925.de: On the left, fishing boats half-drawn onto the shore, behind which, on light sand, three women in long skirts. On the shore, fish sheds, a flagpole, a high bank remains in the middle, on the right the sea. Three quarters of the picture surface is cloudy sky.

10937.d: Noore naise vööni kujutis kerges pöördes vasakule, pea veidi taha kallutatud, pikad pruunid juuksed, mis langevad õlgadele varjates käsi. Kleidi kaelus ääristatud valgega.
10937.de: Waist-length depiction of a young woman in a slight turn to the left, head tilted slightly back, long brown hair falling onto the shoulders, hiding the hands. The dress collar is trimmed with white.

10938.d: Halli habeme ja juustega mehe rindportree 3/4 pöördes paremale. Tumepruun pintsak.
10938.de: Chest-portrait of a man with grey beard and hair, in a 3/4 turn to the right. A dark brown jacket.

10940.d: Esialal vasakult paremale kulgev jõgi kaldaäärse teega. Sellel kaks töömeest jõeäärset kaitsetara parandamas. Keskel kolm ratsanikku, neist kaugemal rühm jalutajaid. Tagaalal, mõlemal pool jõge, järskudest mäenõlvadest piiratud asula.
10940.de: In the foreground a river running from left to right with a road along the bank. On it two workmen repairing a protective fence along the riverbank. In the centre three horsemen, further away from them a group of walkers. In the background, on both sides of the river, a settlement bounded by steep mountain slopes.

10941.d: Madalal diivanil kaks inimest istumas; paremal tumeda habemega hommikumaalane jalad ristatult ees, vasak käsi põlvedel asuval sooblil. Tema kõrval vasakul noor naine, täisprofiilis, nõjatumas mehele, käed žestikuleerivas poosis. Taustaks paremal drapeering, vasakul läbi arkaadide vaade maastikku.
10941.de: Two people sitting on a low sofa; on the right an oriental man with a dark beard, legs crossed in front, left hand on a sable resting on his knees. Beside him on the left a young woman, in full profile, leaning against the man, hands in a gesturing pose. Background on the right drapery, on the left a view of a landscape through arcades.

11044.d: Šatään-juustega, põskhabemega tumedas ülikonnas keskealise mehe rinnapilt. Kuu revääri küljes ordenipael.
11044.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with chestnut hair and side-whiskers, in a dark suit. A decoration ribbon on the moon lapel.

11045.d: Pingil istuva noore mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis vasakule; ohvitseri mundris. Paremas kinnastatud käes vasaku käe kinnas. Vasak käsivars toetatud pingi külgtoele, sõrmede vahel müts. Taustaks maastik.
11045.de: Knee-length portrait of a young man seated on a bench, in half-profile to the left; in officer's uniform. In his right gloved hand, the glove of the left hand. Left forearm resting on the side support of the bench, a cap between the fingers. Landscape in the background.

11046.d: Pea ligi, keskelt lahku kammitud juustega tütarlapse poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule.
11046.de: Close-up half-figure of a girl with hair parted in the middle, in half-profile to the left.

11047.d: Keskel Kristus risti kandmas, vasemal kaks meest, paremal kolm naist.
11047.de: Christ carrying the cross in the centre, two men on the left, three women on the right.

11048.dm: lehe laius: 24.0 cm (lehemõõt); lehe kõrgus: 33.3 cm
11048.d: Maani valges kleidis, peas pika seljale langeva looriga peegli ees sisva noore naise põlvpilt, profiilis paremale. Taustaks pruunikas draperii. Vasakul avatud aknast vaade merele.
11048.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman in a floor-length white dress, with a long veil falling down her back, dreaming in front of a mirror, in profile to the right. Background a brownish drapery. On the left, from an open window, a view of the sea.

11050.d: Esiplaanil naise täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas pikk sügavpunane seelik ja valge pluus (itaallanna rahvusrõivais). Ületõstetud kätel laps. Vasemal pingikese kõrval tamburiin. Taustaks maastik, paremal müüriosa.
11050.de: In the foreground the full figure of a woman in half-profile to the right. Wearing a long deep red skirt and a white blouse (in Italian national costume). A child in her raised arms. On the left next to a small bench a tambourine. Background a landscape, on the right a section of a wall.

11051.d: Valge kollakate lontis kõrvadega kollase rinnaesisega koer lamamas punasel padjal.
11051.de: A white dog with yellowish floppy ears and a yellow chest, lying on a red pillow.

11052.d: Esiplaanil keskel lagunenud tara, vasakul loigu ääres seisev naine kõhule asetatud kätega. Keskplaanil jõgi. Jõe parempoolsel kaldal hanekari. Nende taga võsastik. Taamal üle jõe puud. Horisondil mets. Taevas pilves.
11052.de: In the foreground in the middle a dilapidated fence, on the left a woman standing by a puddle with her hands placed on her stomach. In the middle ground a river. On the right bank of the river a flock of geese. Behind them scrub. Beyond, trees across the river. On the horizon a forest. Cloudy sky.

11053.d: Vanema täidlase naise rindportree. Peas must tanu, seljas must kleit valge krae ja värvilise kinnitus-nõelaga. Taustaks punane drapeering, mille taga vasakul maastikupilt.
11053.de: Bust portrait of an elderly stout woman. A black bonnet on the head, wearing a black dress with a white collar and a coloured fastening pin. Background of red drapery, behind which on the left a landscape picture.

11054.d: Ovaalne kompositsioon. Paremal profiilis lokkis juustega noormees, kes hoiab oma käte vahel punases kleidis tütarlast suudeldes teda põsele. Tütarlapse otsevaates pea kallutatud vasakule. Kujutatud antud poolfiguuridena.
11054.de: An oval composition. On the right, in profile, a curly-haired young man holding a girl in a red dress between his arms, kissing her on the cheek. The girl's head, seen frontally, is tilted to the left. Depicted as half-figures.

11055.d: Väänlevate okstega viigipuude juures istub, keha toetatud paremale käele, valges särgis ning lühikestes pükstes, punase mütsiga noormees. Taamal, silmapiiril sinine merelaht ja mäed.
11055.de: By fig trees with twisting branches sits a young man, body resting on his right hand, wearing a white shirt and short trousers, with a red cap. In the distance, on the horizon, a blue sea bay and mountains.

11056.d: Mägede foonil terrass, kus vasakul istuvad naine, mees, nende ees laps. Paremal seisab selgvaates naine ja laps. Maal poolik, toonitud vasakpoolne alumine osa.
11056.de: Terrace against a background of mountains, where on the left a woman and a man are sitting, with a child in front of them. On the right a woman and a child stand in clear view. The painting is unfinished, the lower left part is toned.

11057.dm: lehe laius: 35.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 25.8 cm
11057.d: Mägine maastik kaljuastanguga vasakul. Tagapool ja paremal puud ja kidur taimestik. Maalitud siledalt tumedais pruunides, hallides toonides.
11057.de: A mountainous landscape with a rock ledge on the left. Behind and on the right trees and sparse vegetation. Painted smoothly in dark brown and gray tones.

11058.dm: lehe laius: 53.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 37.5 cm
11058.d: Paremal nõlvakul vanad keerduvate tüvedega lehtpuud, vasakul üksikud puud-põõsad. Taamal lage maastik mägedega silmapiiril. Maal detailitäpne, hallikaspruun, rohekas koloriit.
11058.de: On the right slope old deciduous trees with twisted trunks, on the left solitary trees and bushes. Further back an open landscape with mountains on the horizon. The painting is detailed and precise, in a greyish-brown, greenish colour scheme.

11059.d: Kaks visandit Itaalia rahvariietes naistest. Vasakul naise pea valges peakattes. Paremal lillega naise poolfiguur rohelisel foonil.
11059.de: Two sketches of women in Italian folk costume. On the left the woman's head in a white headdress. On the right a half-figure of a woman with a flower against a green background.

11060.d: Esiplaanil rand, paremal inimeste gruppe, taamal lainetav meri kahe purjekaga.
11060.de: In the foreground a beach, on the right groups of people, in the distance a rippling sea with two sailboats.

11061.d: Ees paremal puud, vasakul ja taamal vesi ning kõrged mäed.
11061.de: Trees in front on the right, water and high mountains on the left and in the distance.

11062.dm: lehe laius: 18.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 12.2 cm
11062.d: Ees (ca pool kogu tööst) vesi (kanal). Paremal paadisilla nurk. Kanalil paate. Vastaskaldal üksikud hooned, aiad, puud.
11062.de: In front (about half of the whole work) water (a canal). On the right, the corner of a boat pier. Boats on the canal. On the opposite bank, single buildings, gardens, trees.

11063.d: Meri purjekaga, vasemal ees liivane rannariba, taga rannaviir.
11063.de: Sea with a sailing boat, sandy strip of beach in front on the left, shoreline behind.

11064.d: Kaluri täisfiguur rannaliival külgvaates paremale. Hoiab õlal püügiriista. Taamal meri. Selge taevas.
11064.de: Full figure of a fisherman on the beach sand, in side view to the right. Holding a fishing tool on his shoulder. Sea in the distance. Clear sky.

11067.d: Mägede astangul paremal astmeliselt asetsevad hooned. Vasakul järsak, taamal lamedad mäed, silmapiir kõrge. Maal hallikasbeežides toonides.
11067.de: On a mountain terrace, buildings arranged in tiers on the right. On the left a precipice, in the distance flat mountains, a high horizon. The painting is in greyish-beige tones.

11069.d: Esialal vasakul mere äärest kerkiv paekallas, mille platool leht- ja okaspuude rühmi ning jalutavaid ja puhkavaid ning lõkketule ümber askeldavaid inimfiguure gruppides. Paekalda all vasakul meri, keskel ja paremal madal maastik puudesaludega. Horisondil Tallinna siluett kaugvaates lääne poolt. Taevas pilvine.
11069.de: In the foreground on the left a limestone bank rising from the seashore, on whose plateau groups of deciduous and coniferous trees and figures of walking and resting people, and people busying themselves around a bonfire, in groups. Below the limestone bank on the left the sea, in the centre and on the right a low landscape with groves of trees. On the horizon the silhouette of Tallinn in a distant view from the west. The sky is cloudy.

11072.d: Vanema naise poolfiguur peaaegu otsevaates. Lahku kammitud mustad juuksed, peas must tanu. Tumepruun kleit valge krae ja kätistega. Käed kõhul risti.
11072.de: Half-length figure of an older woman, almost in a frontal view. Black hair combed apart, a black bonnet on her head. Dark brown dress with a white collar and cuffs. Hands crossed on her stomach.

11074.d: Kahel pool lillakaspruunid talvised puud, lumine nõlvak keskel. Nõlvaku kohal eresinine taevas. Maalitud hoogsalt, kohati väga pastoosselt.
11074.de: On both sides, purplish-brown winter trees, a snowy slope in the centre. Above the slope, a bright blue sky. Painted vigorously, in places very impasto.

11193.dm: kõrgus: 33.0 cm; sügavus: 2.0 cm; laius: 23.0 cm

11193.de: Standing young male figure of athletic build, right leg on the back of a reclining lion, right hand holding a spear, left hand a bow, a robe thrown over the right shoulder

11208.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man, smooth hair parted on the right, smooth face, loosely tied necktie, lapels

11214.de: A girl feeding birds, against a background of a building with poultry and pigeons

11215.de: Portrait relief of a man in profile facing left, side whiskers, short hairstyle, clean-shaven face

11218.de: Portrait bust of an older man with a receding hairline, long curly beard, the lapel of his work coat draped over his right shoulder, shirt collar showing beneath the beard.

11219.de: Bust of a middle-aged man, incised eyes, harmonious facial features, curly hair combed to the side.

11232.d: vana naise portreepea, peas lahtiselt langev rätik, kompositsioon püramidaalne
11232.de: portrait head of an old woman, a loosely falling scarf on her head, pyramidal composition

11242.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with soft-lined face, front view, wavy hairstyle combed over the head and fastened at the nape, a fringe of hair on the forehead, round wide collar, pleated dress

11402.de: A man with bare torso, bent forward, holding a bar, legs apart

11506.de: Half-length portrait of a man on a balustrade, lush sideburns, civilian clothing, necktie

11520.de: A representative bust portrait of a young woman with an aristocratic oval face, a high hairstyle, a tiara and neck jewellery on a square décolletage. On the bust embroidery (braids) of the costume. Depicted is the last Empress of Russia, Alexandra Feodorovna)

11537.dm: kõrgus: 35.0 cm; sügavus: 33.0 cm; laius: 56.5 cm
11537.d: Keskealise mehe büst balustril Vana-Vene valitseja peakattes, mille tipus rist, ümber peakatte kalliskivid (Monomahhi müts).Kaelas rist, seljas vanavene üliku kaunistustega rüü.
11537.de: Bust of a middle-aged man on a baluster, wearing the headgear of an Old Russian ruler topped with a cross, with precious stones around the headgear (Cap of Monomakh). A cross on his neck, wearing a robe with Old Russian noble decorations.

11541.dm: kõrgus: 45.5 cm; sügavus: 6.0 cm; laius: 36.0 cm

11541.de: Relief portrait of a man in profile to the left, short beard, moustache, short hair receded from the forehead, combed back over the head, lapels, tie.

11553.de: Bust portrait of a young man with a small moustache, view to the right. On his shoulders a draped cloak fastened on the right shoulder, curly hair, a laurel wreath on his head. The bust stands on a round baluster-shaped bronze base. Belonging together with the work is a polished round column of red-veined granite on a grey granite plinth.

11561.de: Figure of a woman sitting on a rock, a wreath on her head, an animal skin around her shoulders

11567.d: Nooremas keskeas mehe portree Vene tsaariarmee ohvitserimundris ordenite ja epolettidega, lühike soeng, vurrud ja lühike habe.
11567.de: Portrait of a man in his early middle age in a Russian tsarist army officer's uniform with orders and epaulettes, short hairstyle, moustache and short beard.

11573.de: cylindrical model with six pilasters and three figural classicist figural reliefs and three texts, the upper part surrounded by a balustrade

11575.de: The standing full figure of a winged woman in a niche, in a long robe, the right hand pointing to the portrait relief of an older woman on the wall, the left hand hanging freely holds a wreath

12268.d: Elektrooniline kolmemõõtmeline teos, Siniseks värvitud (berliini sinine) puust püstjas risttahukakujuline korpus,  mille esiküljel ülal asubvad huumlambid: kolm lampi vahelduvate numbritega. Numbrilampide all paikneb rombikujuline kogum 24 sinisest elektrilambist.  Korpusest kostub elektrooniline kellamäng (F. Liszt "Armuunemlad"). Korpuse sisemuses  elektrimootor, releed, elektroonika (3 nelinurkpinge generaatorit,transistorskeemid, mikroskeemid)(eesti)
12268.de: An electronic three-dimensional work, an upright rectangular parallelepiped-shaped wooden body painted blue (Berlin blue), on the front of which, at the top, are humming lamps: three lamps with alternating numbers. Below the number lamps is a diamond-shaped cluster of 24 blue electric lamps. An electronic chime sounds from within the body (F. Liszt, "Liebesträume"). Inside the body an electric motor, relays, electronics (3 square-wave generators, transistor circuits, microcircuits)

21695.d: Seinavaip. Erinevaid kangatehnikaid kasutades kootud vaip mitmesugustest erineva jämedusga villastest lõngadest. Pruunikate värvidega põhjal tumepruun lattvärav. Värava kõrval kollastes-punastes- rohelistes värvides kaks puud. Vaiba tagaküljele liimitud heledast riidest tükk, millel andmed kunstniku kohta ja valmistamise aasta 1985.
21695.de: Wall hanging. A tapestry woven using various fabric techniques from woollen yarns of differing thicknesses. On a brownish-toned ground a dark brown pole gate. Beside the gate, in yellow, red and green colours, two trees. On the back of the tapestry a piece of light-coloured fabric is glued on, bearing information about the artist and the year of production, 1985.

25290.d: Maali esiplaanil põldu kündev tuledes tarktor - sõitmas diagonaalselt - all vasakul servas ülesküntud põllusiil. Taustaks õhtune taevas lauskmaa ja 2 tuledes traktorit põldu kündmas. Maalitud lillakates, pruunides, hallides toonides. Taevas kollakas oranz üksikute pilvedega.(eesti)
25290.de: In the foreground of the painting, a tractor with lights ploughing a field, moving diagonally - at the bottom left edge a ploughed field strip. In the background, an evening sky over flat land and 2 tractors with lights ploughing the field. Painted in purplish, brown, grey tones. The sky is yellowish orange with a few clouds.

25291.d: Järvemaastik. Esiplaanil lehtpuude grupp - vasakul roosa oranži tooniga. Puude taga järv, silmapiiril järves olevad madalad kaljud. Silmapiir ühtlaselt tumehall. Taevas 1/5 pildi pinnast hall - ebaühtlaselt.(eesti)
25291.de: Lake landscape. In the foreground a group of deciduous trees - on the left in pinkish-orange tones. Behind the trees a lake, on the horizon low cliffs within the lake. The horizon evenly dark grey. The sky occupies 1/5 of the picture surface, grey - unevenly.

25299.dm: laius: 61.1 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 51.2 cm (koos raamiga)
25299.d: Maali esiplaanil, vasakul pool, üle pildi pinna pooleks murdunud paat (puust). Paremal pool all 2 meremehe mütsi ja päästerõngas nende vahel vees. Maalitud hoogsate pintslilöökidega, taust sulatatud värvid - kirju.(eesti)
25299.de: In the foreground of the painting, on the left, across the picture surface, a boat (wooden) broken in half. On the right below, 2 sailor's caps and a lifebuoy between them in the water. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes, the background blended colours - motley.

25301.dm: laius: 52.7 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 62.4 cm (koos raamiga)
25301.d: Maali vasakul pool üle kogu pinna kujutatud koos ülekehaga naisterahva portree, portreteeritava vasak käsi on rusikas, ülestõstetud näo juurde. Ilme on agressiivne, suu pärani lahti. Maalitud tumedates intensiivsetes toonides.Domineerib must, tumelilla, oranž ja punane värv.(eesti)
25301.de: On the left side of the painting, covering the whole surface, a portrait of a woman together with her upper body, the portrayed woman's left hand is a fist, raised to her face. Her expression is aggressive, mouth wide open. Painted in dark, intense tones. Black, dark purple, orange and red colours dominate.

25302.dm: laius: 49.9 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 60.0 cm (koos raamiga)
25302.d: Kollasel oranžikal toonil madruse näoportree. Maalitud hoogsalt lakoonilises laadis peamiselt musta tooniga siluetti ja kontuuri rõhutades. Madruse parempoolne näopool maalitud helesiniselt. Rinnal madruse pluusi alt paistmas kolm sinist madruse särgi triipu. Portreteeritaval on peas madruse müts.(eesti)
25302.de: A face portrait of a sailor in yellowish-orange tones. Painted boldly in a laconic manner, emphasising mainly the black-toned silhouette and contour. The right half of the sailor's face is painted light blue. On the chest, under the sailor's blouse, three blue stripes of a sailor's shirt are visible. The sitter is wearing a sailor's cap.

25303.dm: laius: 48.9 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 62.3 cm (koos raamiga)
25303.d: Esiplaanil sõdur hobusel. Sõdur hoiab vasakus käes automaati. Hobuse kael ja pea pööratud sõduri poole, sõdur omakorda kogu näo ja ülakehaga on pöördunud otse, vaataja poole. Parema käega toetab hobuse tagumikkule. Maali foon kirju, vasakul ülal punane ja veidi all pool kollane värvi laik.(eesti)
25303.de: In the foreground a soldier on a horse. The soldier holds a submachine gun in his left hand. The horse's neck and head are turned toward the soldier, while the soldier in turn has his whole face and upper body turned directly toward the viewer. With his right hand he supports the horse's rear. The painting's background is colourful, upper left a red and, a little lower, a yellow patch of colour.

25311.dm: laius: 52.8 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 62.3 cm (koos raamiga)
25311.d: Esiplaanil vaskul üle pildi pinna kuus - kuuseoksad. Pildi keskel, kuuse taga kõrge lehtpuu (vaher?), mille taga omakorda paistab veetorni ülemine osa. Maali paremalt küljelt ulatub välja valge hoone kõrge kellatorniga (Viljandi raekoda).(eesti)
25311.de: In the foreground on the left, a spruce - spruce branches across the picture surface. In the centre of the picture, behind the spruce, a tall deciduous tree (maple?), behind which in turn the upper part of a water tower is visible. From the right side of the painting, a white building with a tall bell tower extends (Viljandi Town Hall).

25324.d: Esiplaanil paremale pöörduv jõekäänd, keskplaanil kummalgi kaldal traktorkraana  töötamas, tagapool jõekaldal traktor-buldooser. Taamal vasakul metsa servas 10 inimese siluetti.(eesti)
25324.de: In the foreground a river bend turning to the right, in the middle ground a crane tractor working on each bank, further back on the riverbank a tractor bulldozer. In the distance on the left at the edge of the forest 10 human silhouettes.

25498.d: Graafiline leht Milaano Santa Maria delle Grazie kloostris asetseva tuntud fresko Püha õhtusöömaaeg (1495-97) põhjal. Suures hämaras ruumis on heleda linaga kaetud pikk laud, mille taha on istunud Jeesus koos oma kaheteistkümne jüngriga. Keskel, teistest veidi eraldi istub Jeesus mõlemad käed välja sirutatud. Tema mõlemil käel istuvad jüngrid sümmeetriliselt gruppeerituna kolmemehelistesse rühmadesse, nad on omavahel ühendatud pooside ja diskussiooniga. Kõik vestlevad ägedalt, ainult Jeesus on rahulik. Tema vasakul käel asuv Juudas Iskariot hoiab käes hõbeseeklitega koti suud. Laual on leivakesed ja veiniklaasid. Tagaseinas kolm ava, millest avaneb maastikuvaade. (eesti)
25498.de: Print based on the well-known fresco The Last Supper (1495-97) located in the monastery of Santa Maria delle Grazie in Milan. In a large dim room stands a long table covered with a light-coloured cloth, behind which sit Jesus and his twelve disciples. In the middle, seated slightly apart from the others, is Jesus with both hands outstretched. The disciples on either side of him are seated symmetrically grouped into groups of three, connected to one another by their poses and discussion. All are conversing heatedly, only Jesus is calm. Judas Iscariot, seated on his left, holds the mouth of a bag of silver shekels in his hand. On the table are small loaves of bread and wine glasses. In the back wall three openings, through which a landscape view opens.
