Ribbed hoof, gilded on the inside. On the upper edge of the cup there is an engraved coat of arms with an image of Kanut and the text: J. E. Born, Böttcher, G. A. Michelson ?,
H. L.  Koch, Böttcher, C. E. Sopha Instrumentmacher 1846.
On the edge of the hoof the master's mark GW WULF.

64785.dm: lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 44.5 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 28.5 cm; lehe laius: 67.5 cm
64785.d: "Rahutus" on Eduard Wiiralti üks viimaseid suuremaid töid ning seda võib pidada tema luigelauluks, mida Wiiralt hakkas kavandama juba 1949. aastal ja mille kallal töötas ta aastatel 1950-1952. "Rahutus" on teostatud  segatehnikas (nimetatud ka sünteetiliseks tehnikaks), mis oli Wiiralti loomingule iseloomulik juba 1949. aastast ning baseerus peamiselt pehmelakil. Arvestades teose krestomaatilist iseloomu on Eesti Kunstimuuseumi jaoks oluline säilitada lehe erinevaid seisundeid ja esimesed tõmmised tiraažist.
64785.de: "Rahutus" ("Unrest") is one of Eduard Wiiralt's last major works and can be considered his swan song, which Wiiralt began to plan already in 1949 and on which he worked in the years 1950-1952. "Rahutus" is executed in a mixed technique (also called a synthetic technique), which had been characteristic of Wiiralt's work already from 1949 and was based mainly on soft-ground etching. Given the canonical nature of the work, it is important for the Art Museum of Estonia to preserve various states of the sheet and the first prints from the edition.

64809.dm: lehe laius: 51.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 71.1 cm
64809.d: Ülal keskel nägu profiilis paremale, ülal paremal aken vaatega veekogule ja pilvedele
64809.de: Above in the centre a face in profile to the right, above on the right a window with a view of a body of water and clouds

64810.dm: lehe laius: 51.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 71.7 cm
64810.d: Erivärvilistest segmentidest, kolm- ja nelinurkadest kompositsioon. Paremal keskel vaade merele
64810.de: A composition of differently coloured segments, triangles and quadrangles. In the centre right a view of the sea

64833.d: Kere silinderjas, kaas profileeritud. Kere küljes eemaldatav puidust käepide, mille otsas väike vandlist nupp. Eemaldatava käepideme ühenduskoha kujunduses on näha veel rokokoo mõju.
64833.de: The body is cylindrical, the lid profiled. On the side of the body a removable wooden handle, at its end a small knob of bone. In the design of the joint of the removable handle the influence of Rococo is still visible.

64839.d: Kere alumine osa, jalg ja tüvese krae on kaunistatud rõõnetega. S-kujuliste sangade ülemises otsas reljeefne tilgamotiiv ja spiraal, alumises otsas reljeefne lilleõis. Puidust kaanenupp musta värvi, kaane servas segmendikujuline lusikaava.
64839.de: The lower part of the body, the foot and the collar of the stem are decorated with gadroons. At the upper end of the S-shaped handles a relief drop motif and a spiral, at the lower end a relief flower blossom. Wooden lid knob in black, a segment-shaped spoon groove at the edge of the lid.

64843.d: Esiküljele on graveeritud profiilis mehebüst, peas loorberipärg – eeskujuks on olnud Preisi kuninga Friedrich II (1740–1786) münt. Tagaküljele on graveeritud vapp.
64843.de: On the obverse is engraved a male bust in profile, wearing a laurel wreath – the model has been a coin of the Prussian king Friedrich II (1740–1786). On the reverse a coat of arms is engraved.

64844.d: Esikülje keskel on graveeritud profiilis naisebüst, tagaküljel keeruka ornamendiga ristimotiiv.
64844.de: In the centre of the front side a woman's bust in profile is engraved, on the back a cross motif with intricate ornament.

64846.d: Sõle servas kuppude rida ja nööritaoline äärevits, vits ümbritseb ka sõlesuud. Kuhiku graveeritud dekoori seas domineerivad neli lilleõietaolist rosetti. Sõlesuu ümber on graveeritud, vaheldumisi kolmnurkadest ja ovaalidest koosnev preesi meenutav kujund.
64846.de: On the edge of the brooch a row of bosses and a cord-like edging rod, the rod also surrounds the mouth of the brooch. Among the engraved decoration of the cone four flower-blossom-like rosettes dominate. Around the mouth of the brooch an engraved figure resembling a brooch, consisting alternately of triangles and ovals.

64850.d: Harude all on kilbikujuline ava. Varre otsas reljeefne Ungern-Sternbergide vapp.
64850.de: Beneath the branches there is a shield-shaped opening. At the end of the stem a relief coat of arms of the Ungern-Sternbergs.

64851.d: Välja saetud ja graveeritud taimornamendiga labidaosa keskel on kullatud kala kujutis, kala soomused ja uimed graveeritud. Labida ja varre ühenduskohas reljeefne palmett. Hõbedast varre ots profileeritud.
64851.de: In the middle of the cut-out and engraved shovel part with plant ornament is a gilded depiction of a fish, the fish's scales and fins engraved. At the junction of the shovel and the handle a relief palmette. The end of the silver handle is profiled.

64852.d: Labidaosa kaunistavad välja saetud ja graveeritud väänlevad taimelehed. Varre keskosa profileeritud.
64852.de: The blade of the spade is decorated with cut-out and engraved winding plant leaves. The middle part of the shaft is profiled.

64853.d: Tangide otsad on kujundatud reljeefsete merikarpidena
64853.de: The ends of the tongs are shaped as relief seashells

64854.d: Haaradel reljeefne väänlev taimornament, tangide otsad on kujundatud reljeefsete merikarpidena.
64854.de: On the handles a relief of winding plant ornament, the ends of the tongs are shaped as relief seashells.

64855.d: Haarade keskel ažuurne paelornament, nende ühenduskohal graveeritud taimelehed, mille keskel asuval lindil on initsiaalid AM.
64855.de: In the middle of the bows, an openwork ribbon ornament, at their junction engraved plant leaves, in the middle of which, on a ribbon, are the initials AM.

64856.d: Rõngad kujutavad oma saba neelavat madu, maonahk on kujundatud graveeritud rombidena. Madude silmadeks tumepunased granaadid
64856.de: The rings depict a snake swallowing its own tail, the snake's skin is formed as engraved rhombuses. The snakes' eyes are dark red garnets

64857.d: Rõngad kujutavad oma saba neelavat madu, maonahk on kujundatud graveeritud rombidena. Madude silmadeks tumepunased granaadid
64857.de: The rings depict a snake swallowing its own tail, the snake's skin is formed as engraved rhombuses. The snakes' eyes are dark red garnets

64859.d: Ovaalne sõrmusekilp on kaetud põikisuunaliste triipudega. Võru otsad on lahtised.
64859.de: The oval ring bezel is covered with transverse stripes. The ends of the hoop are open.

64861.d: Ümmargustest aukudest moodustub sõela põhjale kaheksaleheline õis. Varreotsale on graveeritud taimemotiiv ja diagonaalne lint, millel nimetähed A. v. S.
64861.de: Round holes form an eight-petaled flower on the bottom of the sieve. On the end of the handle a plant motif is engraved and a diagonal ribbon, on which the initials A. v. S.

64863.de: Sieve part oval, shaped like a walnut.

64864.d: Keskosa kaunistab välja saetud ja graveeritud paelornament, mille vahel on üksikud taimemotiivid.
64864.de: The central part is decorated with a fretwork and engraved ribbon ornament, between which are single plant motifs.

64865.dm: kõrgus: 7.8 cm; diameeter: 5.1 cm; diameeter: 7.4 cm
64865.d: Kergelt koonilise kujuga peekrit kaunistab graveeritud lillornament. Esiküljel keeruka kujuga kilp, mis on jäetud tühjaks.
64865.de: A slightly conical beaker decorated with an engraved floral ornament. On the front a shield of intricate shape, left blank.

64866.dm: kõrgus: 8.7 cm; diameeter: 13.5 cm; diameeter: 6.7 cm
64866.d: Nii tassile kui ka alustassile on graveeritud Tartu vaated: tassil domineerib raekoda koos Raekoja platsi hoonetega, taldriku serval Inglisild. Lisaks Tartu vaadetele kaunistab taldriku serva graveeritud paelornament ja kaks lillemotiivi. Taldriku põhja alt on maha hõõrutud kolmerealine tekst, millest on näha üksikuid tähti. Huvitaval kombel on Nagel kasutanud tassil ja taldrikul erineva kujundusega meistrimärki: taldrikul on gooti, tassil antiikva tähed.
64866.de: Both the cup and the saucer are engraved with views of Tartu: the cup is dominated by the town hall together with the buildings of Town Hall Square, and the rim of the plate by the Inglisild (English Bridge). In addition to the views of Tartu, the rim of the plate is decorated with an engraved ribbon ornament and two floral motifs. A three-line text has been rubbed off from the underside of the plate, of which only individual letters are visible. Interestingly, Nagel has used differently designed maker's marks on the cup and the plate: on the plate Gothic letters, on the cup antiqua letters.

64875.dm: kõrgus: 16.5 cm; diameeter: 9.5 cm; diameeter: 9.0 cm
64875.d: Kergelt ülespoole laieneva kupa alumine osa on liigendatud kuueks kumeraks pinnaks. Kupa ülemisele, siledale osale on graveeritud Rehbinderite vapp (3 kroonitud madu ja 10 tähte). Pungis jaguneb samuti kuueks kumeruseks, kabi on kuuesiiruline, iga kahe siiru järel väike teravnurk.
64875.de: The lower part of the slightly upward-widening bowl is articulated into six convex surfaces. On the upper, smooth part of the bowl is engraved the Rehbinder coat of arms (3 crowned serpents and 10 stars). The knop is likewise divided into six convexities, the foot is hexagonal, with a small sharp point after every two facets.

64880.de: an engraved plant motif at the end of the shaft

64892.d: Kausi serva ümber graveeritud stiliseeritud taim- ja geomeetriline ornament.
64892.de: Stylised plant and geometric ornament engraved around the rim of the bowl.

64893.d: Seppade tsunftile kuulunud asümmeetrilise kujuga silti kaunistavad kohrutatud ja osaliselt ažuursed teokarbi- ja taimemotiivid.
64893.de: The sign of asymmetrical shape belonging to the blacksmiths' guild is decorated with scrolled and partly openwork shell- and plant motifs.

64895.d: Kolmele kuuljalale toetuvaid peekreid kaunistavad kohrutatud ja graveeritud akantusväädid.
64895.de: Beakers resting on three lion's paws are decorated with embossed and engraved acanthus scrolls.

64915.d: Kere allosa, tila ja kaas kaunistatud rõõnetega, ka madal jalg rõõnestatud. Kere keskosas ornamendiriba stiliseeritud taimelehtedega. Jala ja kere ühenduskohal kitsas ornamendiriba meandriga.
64915.de: The lower part of the body, the spout and the lid decorated with fluting, the low foot also fluted. In the middle section of the body an ornamental band with stylised plant leaves. At the junction of the foot and body a narrow ornamental band with a meander.

64921.d: Sõela lainelist serva kaunistab kitsas stantsitud ornamendiriba keerduvate lehtede ja teokarbimotiividega. Sõela põhi liigendub kaheksaks õielehekujuliseks väljaks, augud on ümmargused. Varreotsal reljeefne palmett.
64921.de: The wavy edge of the sieve is decorated with a narrow stamped ornamental band with twisting leaves and shell motifs. The bottom of the sieve is divided into eight petal-shaped fields, the holes are round. A relief palmette at the end of the handle.

64922.de: Sieve with round holes, handle undecorated.

64925.d: Käepidemel on graveeritud taimornament ja ristuvad lindid.
64925.de: A plant ornament and crossing ribbons are engraved on the handle.

64926.d: Urnikujulisel nõul on kaks kõrget sanga. Toosi ülaserva ja kaant ning kere ja jala ühenduskohta kaunistab helmisnöör. Kaas tipneb odakujulise nupuga. Kaane serval lusikaava. Toosi ümarat jalga ümbritseb reljeefne loorberipärg, jalg toetub omakorda nelinurksele siledale baasile.
64926.de: The urn-shaped vessel has two tall handles. The upper edge of the box and the lid, and the junction of the body and the foot, are decorated with a beaded cord. The lid tapers to a spear-shaped knob. There is a spoon groove on the edge of the lid. The rounded foot of the box is surrounded by a relief laurel wreath, the foot in turn resting on a smooth rectangular base.

64935.d: Varrele graveeritud stiliseeritud taimornament, varreotsal asuva kilbikujulise kartuši sisse graveeritud nimetähed R M L ja aastaarv 1809.
64935.de: A stylised plant ornament engraved on the stem, with the initials R M L and the year 1809 engraved into a shield-shaped cartouche at the end of the stem.

64937.d: Ovaalset silti ümbritseb lehepärg, keskel asub graveeritud saabas.
64937.de: An oval label is surrounded by a leaf wreath, with an engraved boot in the centre.

64938.d: Kaheksatahuline käepide on kaunistatud graveeritud ornamendiga.
64938.de: The octagonal handle is decorated with engraved ornament.

64939.dm: laius: 16.5 cm; paksus: 4.5 cm; pikkus: 10.1 cm
64939.d: Kaanele on graveeritud kaks Tallinna vaadet: Rüütli tänav (taustal Kiek in de Kök) ja Pikk jalg (taustal Oleviste kirik).
64939.de: On the cover two views of Tallinn are engraved: Rüütli Street (with Kiek in de Kök in the background) and Pikk jalg (with St. Olaf's Church in the background).

64940.d: Stiliseeritud õie kujulise kaha keskel reljeefne palmett, kaha ja varre ühenduskohale on kinnitatud valatud taimelehed. Puidust varre otsas luust nupp. Ühe lusika vart on parandatud. Lusikate täpne otstarve pole selge, ent peenike puidust vars viitab sellele, et neid kasutati millegi kuuma, ent samas võrdlemisi kerge (nt kastme, lihaleeme või magustoidu) tõstmiseks.
64940.de: In the middle of a stylised flower-shaped bowl a relief palmette, at the junction of the bowl and the stem cast plant leaves are attached. At the end of the wooden stem a bone knob. The stem of one spoon has been repaired. The exact purpose of the spoons is not clear, but the thin wooden stem suggests that they were used for lifting something hot yet relatively light (e.g. sauce, broth or dessert).

64941.d: Stiliseeritud õie kujulise kaha keskel reljeefne palmett, kaha ja varre ühenduskohale on kinnitatud valatud taimelehed. Puidust varre otsas luust nupp. Ühe lusika vart on parandatud. Lusikate täpne otstarve pole selge, ent peenike puidust vars viitab sellele, et neid kasutati millegi kuuma, ent samas võrdlemisi kerge (nt kastme, lihaleeme või magustoidu) tõstmiseks.

64946.de: A stylised plant ornament is engraved on the end of the shaft, barely visible due to wear. The handle part is likewise heavily worn.

64947.d: Lusika kollakas toon viitab madalakvaliteedilisele hõbedasulamile.
64947.de: The yellowish tone of the spoon indicates a low-quality silver alloy.

64963.d: Varreotsal reljeefne ornament: kaks posti ümber keerduvat lind-madu, mida ümbritseb taimornament, keskel keerduvate otstega tühi lint.
64963.de: Relief ornament at the end of the shaft: two bird-serpents coiling around posts, surrounded by a plant ornament, in the center an empty ribbon with coiled ends.

64965.d: Varre tagaküljele graveeritud: Thomas Clayhills & Son in Reval 1820. Varreotsale on löödud ovaalne tempel omaniku monogrammiga GL.
64965.de: Engraved on the back of the handle: Thomas Clayhills & Son in Reval 1820. On the end of the handle an oval stamp with the owner's monogram GL is struck.

64971.de: The ring is designed as a belt with a buckle, engraved with the initials E. v. S. The end of the belt is decorated with a flower motif.

64972.d: Labidaosale on graveeritud läbipõimunud taim- ja paelornament.
64972.de: The blade part is engraved with an interlaced plant and ribbon ornament.

64973.d: Tangide otsad on kolmiklehekujulised, ažuursed haarad kaunistatud põimuva lehtornamendiga.
64973.de: The ends of the tongs are trefoil-shaped, the openwork grips decorated with interlacing leaf ornament.

64975.de: Relief flower blossom at the end of the stem.

64976.de: The tongs have ends shaped like seashells, with a winding stylized leaf ornament engraved on the arms, a smooth oval at the joint of the arms.

64987.de: The handle of the spoon is triangular at the end and surrounded by a collar.

64988.de: Monogram AP on the end of the stem. Belongs to the same set as the next item (or at least has belonged to the same owner).

64991.d: Ovaalse kausi serv looklev, ebakorrapärase kujuga. Ülaosa liigendatud vagudega, nendevahelistel siledatel pindadel teokarbimotiivid. Kausi keskel eenduvate rombidega ornamendiriba. Tüves sile, jala alumist osa liigendavad looklevad paarisvaod.
64991.de: The rim of the oval bowl is winding, of irregular shape. The upper part is articulated with grooves, with shell motifs on the smooth surfaces between them. In the middle of the bowl a band of ornament with projecting rhombuses. The stem is smooth, the lower part of the foot articulated with winding paired grooves.

64992.d: Varreotsal reljeefne palmetimotiiv ja graveeritud nimetähed J. B.
64992.de: A relief palmette motif at the end of the shaft and engraved initials J. B.

64993.d: Ovaalset silti ümbritseb rombidest koosnev ornamendiriba, keskosale on graveeritud savipott.
64993.de: An oval label is surrounded by a decorative band consisting of rhombuses; a clay pot is engraved on the central part.

65003.d: Pokaalil neli rida poolkerajaid kühme, nende vahel reljeefne abstraktne ornament, tüvise mõlemal otsal ažuurne lehtornament. Pokaali üleval äärel graveeritud: HER BENGT HORN GVVERNEIVR 1659. Kaanel rida poolkerajaid kühme ja azuurne lillekimp vaasiga. Jala alla on servale punkteeritud: 39 1/4 L. 1786. Meistrimärk pokaali üleval äärel HE.
65003.de: On the goblet, four rows of hemispherical bosses, between them a relief abstract ornament, at both ends of the stem an openwork leaf ornament. On the upper rim of the goblet, engraved: HER BENGT HORN GVVERNEIVR 1659. On the lid, a row of hemispherical bosses and an openwork bouquet of flowers with a vase. On the base, at the edge, punched: 39 1/4 L. 1786. Maker's mark on the upper rim of the goblet HE.

65005.d:
8-kandiline, jalusel. Ülemisel äärel ja kaanel punkteeritud abstraktne ornament. Tüvisel azuurne lehtornament, kaane keskel azuurne neljast õiest koosnev kimp. Jala alumisel äärel graveeritud tekst: Christian Magnus Schroder, Valentin Schröder ja punkteeritud: 14 ⅛ L.
1786.
65005.de:
8-sided, on a foot. On the upper rim and lid a stippled abstract ornament. On the stem an azure leaf ornament, in the middle of the lid an azure bouquet of four flowers. On the lower rim of the foot an engraved text: Christian Magnus Schroder, Valentin Schröder and stippled: 14 ⅛ L.
1786.

65031.de: The central ornamental band of the box consists of perforated diamonds.

65032.d: Ümar toos toetub kolmele profileeritud jalakesele.
65032.de: The round box rests on three profiled little legs.

65033.d: Kühvlikujulise kaha servad kergelt lainelised. Varreotsale on graveeritud stiliseeritud taimornament.
65033.de: The edges of the scoop-shaped bowl are slightly wavy. A stylised plant ornament is engraved on the end of the handle.

65036.d: Kausi allosa ja kaane keskosa on kaunistatud rõõnetega. Nõu sangadeks on rõngad, mida hoiavad noka vahel laialisirutatud tiibadega luiged.
65036.de: The lower part of the bowl and the middle part of the lid are decorated with fluting. The handles of the vessel are rings held in the beaks of swans with widely outstretched wings.

65037.d: Ovaalse nõu kaanel on ümarplastiline mütoloogiline loom – hobuse pea ja kala sabaga hippokamposmerihobu. Nõu sangadeks on eenduvad kotkapead, noka vahel rõngas. Kausi ülaserv ja jalg rõõnestatud. Keret ümbritseb graveeritud ornamendiriba lintide ja taimdekooriga, keskel tühjaks jäetud kilp. Kere allosas graveeritud kolmnurkadest ja varre otsas asuvatest nuppudest ornament. Kaane serval reljeefsed viinapuulehed.
65037.de: On the lid of an oval vessel is a fully modelled mythological creature – a hippocampus, a sea-horse with a horse's head and a fish's tail. The handles of the vessel are formed as projecting eagle heads, with a ring between the beaks. The upper rim and foot of the bowl are fluted. The body is encircled by an engraved ornamental band with ribbons and stylised plant decoration, with an empty shield left in the centre. On the lower part of the body an ornament of engraved triangles, and on the end of the stem, knobs. On the edge of the lid, relief vine leaves.

65082.d: Ümar sõel jaotub 8 siiluks, augud ümmargused, serv rõõnestatud.
65082.de: The round sieve is divided into 8 sections, the holes are round, the edge is scalloped.

65084.d: Sile, kastrulikujuline toos, sangad kandilised, kinnituskohtadel kaheharulised. Võlvuva kaane tipus käbikujuline nupp.
65084.de: Smooth, pot-shaped case, handles rectangular, two-pronged at the attachment points. At the top of the arched lid a cone-shaped knob.

65162.dm: lehe kõrgus: 30.9 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 32.6 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 25.0 cm; lehe laius: 36.8 cm
65162.d: Agathe Veeberi (1901-1988), Tartus 1939. aastal kunstikool Pallase  lõpetanud, 1944. aastal Eestist lahkunud ja hiljem Ameerika kunstielus tunnustatud graafiku teosed on väärtuslikuks täienduseks Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogule. Veeberi estambid (osaliselt EKM kogu seisukohalt ainueksemplarid), monotüüpia ning 12 originaaljoonistust võimaldavad tema ülevaatlikku tööde kogumit Eesti Kunstimuuseumi graafikakogus veelgi täiendada.
65162.de: The works of Agathe Veeber (1901-1988), a printmaker who graduated from the Pallas art school in Tartu in 1939, left Estonia in 1944, and later gained recognition in American art life, are a valuable addition to the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia. Veeber's estampes (some of which are unique copies within the EKM collection), a monotype and 12 original drawings make it possible to further supplement the comprehensive body of her works in the print collection of the Art Museum of Estonia.

65298.d: Visandi näol on tegemist eeltööga Vive Tolli 1960. aasta gravüürile "Võrguparandajad eided". Autori sõnul on visand tehtud Toila rannas, kiirelt skitseeritud tabavad joonistused iseloomustavad kunstniku tööstiili. Visandil on ka elemendid, mida lõppteosel pole (koer, mehed). Randlaste töö teemal valminud akvatintagravüür "Võrguparandajad eided" on suurepärane näide Vive Tolli varasest käekirjas omas ajastus.
65298.de: The sketch is a preliminary work for Vive Tolli's 1960 print "Võrguparandajad eided" ["Old Women Mending Nets"]. According to the artist, the sketch was made on the beach at Toila; the quickly sketched, striking drawings characterise the artist's working style. The sketch also contains elements not found in the final work (a dog, men). The aquatint print "Võrguparandajad eided", created on the theme of the work of coastal dwellers, is an excellent example of Vive Tolli's early style of her time.

65345.dm: lehe kõrgus: 35.4 cm; laius: 55.8 cm; kõrgus: 45.7 cm; lehe laius: 45.3 cm
65345.d:
Gunnar Neeme (1918-2005) teosed ja arhiiv saabusid Austraaliast Eestisse projekti "Rahvuskaaslaste programm" toel. Koos tema maalidega saabus Eesti Kunstimuuseumisse ka neli paberalusel teost. Need on heaks täienduseks eesti eksiilkunsti kogule.
1949. aastal Austraaliasse asunud Gunnar Neeme oli nimekas raamatuillustraator (eriti oluline on tema poolt eepose „Kalevipoeg“ tõlgendus), maalija, graafik, rakenduskunstnik ja skulptor. Neeme oli ka Melbourne'i kunstnike organisatsiooni Victorian Artist Society liige, selle kuukirjas ilmusid Neeme kunstikriitilised ja filosoofilised kirjutised.
65345.de:
The works and archive of Gunnar Neeme (1918-2005) arrived in Estonia from Australia with the support of the "Compatriots Programme" project. Along with his paintings, four works on paper also arrived at the Art Museum of Estonia. These are a fine addition to the collection of Estonian exile art.
Gunnar Neeme, who settled in Australia in 1949, was a well-known book illustrator (his interpretation of the epic "Kalevipoeg" is especially significant), painter, graphic artist, applied artist and sculptor. Neeme was also a member of the Melbourne artists' organisation Victorian Artists Society, and his art-critical and philosophical writings were published in its monthly journal.

Veeberi estambid (osaliselt EKM kogu seisukohalt ainueksemplarid), monotüüpia ning 12 originaaljoonistust võimaldavad tema ülevaatlikku tööde kogumit Eesti Kunstimuuseumi graafikakogus veelgi täiendada.
65365.de: The works of Agathe Veeber (1901-1988), a printmaker who graduated from the Pallas art school in Tartu in 1939, left Estonia in 1944, and later gained recognition in American art life, are a valuable addition to the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia. Veeber's estampes (some of which are unique copies within the EKM collection), a monotype and 12 original drawings make it possible to further supplement the comprehensive body of her works in the print collection of the Art Museum of Estonia.

65366.dm: lehe laius: 19.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 13.2 cm
65366.d: a) Esiplaanil pukkveski - tuuliku kujutis avatud luugiga. Paremal madal taluhoone ja veskikeeraja. Vasakul veekogu, mille vastaskaldal taluhooneid ja lehtpuid, kaugemal pukkveskeid.
65366.de: a) In the foreground a post mill - depiction of a windmill with an open hatch. On the right a low farm building and the miller turning the mill. On the left a body of water, on whose opposite bank there are farm buildings and deciduous trees, further away post mills.

65456.dm: graafikaplaadi laius: 26.4 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 39.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 49.4 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 30.0 cm
65456.d: Agathe Veeberi (1901-1988), Tartus 1939. aastal kunstikool Pallase lõpetanud, 1944. aastal Eestist lahkunud ja hiljem Ameerika kunstielus tunnustatud graafiku teos on väärtuslikuks täienduseks Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogule. Veeberi tõmmis täiendab hästi põhikogus olevat eksiilis valminud Veeberi loomingut.
65456.de: The work of Agathe Veeber (1901-1988), who graduated from the Pallas art school in Tartu in 1939, left Estonia in 1944, and later was recognized in American art life as a printmaker, is a valuable addition to the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia. Veeber's print complements well the artist's work created in exile, which is present in the core collection.

65458.d: Teosed täiendavad Johannes Võerahansu hilisperioodi loomingut EKMi kogus, sisaldades mitmeid joonistustel vähekajastatud teemasid, nagu arheoloogia ja Eesti lähiajalugu. Joonistused mõjuvad Võerahansule omaselt väga maaliliselt ja võisid olla mõeldud maalide eeltöödeks.
65458.de: The works complement Johannes Võerahansu's late-period oeuvre in the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia, containing a number of themes little represented in the drawings, such as archaeology and Estonia's recent history. As is characteristic of Võerahansu, the drawings have a very painterly effect and may have been intended as preliminary studies for paintings.

65464.dm: lehe kõrgus: 54.2 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 45.0 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 39.7 cm; lehe laius: 61.7 cm
65464.d: Kaljo Põllu (1934-2010) oli üks legendaarsemaid eesti kultuuritegelasi, kelle elutöös on oluline koht 1970. ja 1980. aastatel loodud mütoloogilistel graafikasarjadel „Kodalased“ ning "Kalivägi". Nendel teostel oli rahvuslik ning omas ajas ka maailmavaateline tähenduskoormus. Tänapäeval kõnetavad Kaljo Põllu graafikasarjad tänu kunstilisele kõrgtasemele väga unikaalsel moel ka rahvusvahelist kunstipublikut. Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogusse vastuvõetavate teoste näol on tegemist Põllu loominguga, mis seni puudub Eesti avalike muuseumide kogudest. Mõned lehed on ka unikaalsed ainueksemplarid - kunstniku ideekavandite varased proovitrükid.
65464.de: Kaljo Põllu (1934-2010) was one of the most legendary figures of Estonian culture, in whose life's work an important place is held by the mythological print series "Kodalased" and "Kalivägi", created in the 1970s and 1980s. These works carried a national significance and, in their time, also a worldview-related weight. Today, thanks to their high artistic level, Kaljo Põllu's print series speak in a very unique way also to an international art audience. The works being accepted into the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia represent works by Põllu that have so far been absent from the collections of Estonian public museums. Some sheets are also unique single copies - early proof prints of the artist's idea sketches.

65491.d: Eesti tuntud graafiku Berta Mägeri (1918-1999) pärandist omandatud terviklik mapp kahekümne nelja šaržiga aastatest 1946-1968  sisaldab vaimukaid portreid autori eakaaslastest, kelle seas on nimekaid skulptoreid, maalijaid, graafikuid jt. Sellisena on Berta Mägeri sari heaks lisaks vastava žanri kogule Eesti Kunstimuuseumis ja leiab kindlasti eelkõige kultuurilooliste tekstide illustreerimisel kasutust.
65491.de: A complete portfolio acquired from the estate of the well-known Estonian graphic artist Berta Mäger (1918-1999), containing twenty-four caricatures from the years 1946-1968, includes witty portraits of the author's contemporaries, among them notable sculptors, painters, graphic artists and others. As such, Berta Mäger's series is a fine addition to the corresponding genre collection at the Art Museum of Estonia and will certainly find use, above all, in illustrating texts on cultural history.

65523.dm: kujutise laius: 23.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 16.5 cm
65523.d: Mart Pert (Pärt)(1898-1993) oli dekoratsioonikunstnik ja joonistusõpetaja, kes  õppis aastatel 1915 kuni 1921 Riigi Kunsttööstuskoolis, kust talle anti 1938. aastal rakenduskunstniku tunnistus dekoratsiooni maalimise alal. 1920. aastatel rajas ta Eesti Haridusliidu juurde dekoratsioonide valmistamise keskuse, kus valmisid dekoratsioonid ligi 200 lavastusele. 1935. aastast töötas ta Eesti Kodukaunistamise Seltsi kunstilise juhina, 1945. aastast töötas ta Aruküla koolis joonistuse ja käsitöö õpetajana. Perti 20. sajandi alguse illustratsioonid ja graafika on huvitavad näited ajastu kunstiloomest, mis suhestuvad tugevasti Wiiralti ja teiste omaaegsete kunstnike loominguga.
65523.de: Mart Pert (Pärt) (1898-1993) was a set designer and drawing teacher, who studied from 1915 to 1921 at the State School of Applied Art, from which he was given, in 1938, a certificate of applied artist in the field of set painting. In the 1920s he founded a centre for the production of stage sets at the Estonian Education Union, where sets were made for nearly 200 productions. From 1935 he worked as the artistic director of the Estonian Home Embellishment Society, and from 1945 he worked as a teacher of drawing and handicraft at the Aruküla school. Pert's illustrations and graphic art from the early 20th century are interesting examples of the artistic creation of the era, which relate strongly to the oeuvre of Wiiralt and other artists of the time.

65568.dm: lehe kõrgus: 61.0 cm; kujutise laius: 49.7 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 49.9 cm; lehe laius: 54.0 cm
65568.d: Leonhard Lapini (s. 1947) graafika geomeetriline puhas minimalism viitab tema arhitektimõttele ja -kogemusele, aga ka autori sügavale kiindumusele tühjuse ja ruumi problemaatikasse. Graafikatehnikas teostatud kompositsioonidele eelnesid joonistused, mis hiljem kujunesid tiražeeritud graafika prototüüpideks. Nende hulka kuuluvad ka ofsettrükis teostatud lehed „Produktsioon“ ja „Multiplikatsioon“, mis täiendavad hästi suprematistlikus vaimus valminud teoseid Eesti Kunstimuuseumi graafikakogus, esindades samuti siin seni puuduvat sarja.
65568.de: The geometrically pure minimalism of Leonhard Lapin's (b. 1947) graphic art refers to his architectural thinking and experience, but also to the author's deep attachment to the problematics of emptiness and space. The compositions executed in print technique were preceded by drawings, which later developed into prototypes of editioned prints. Among these are also the sheets „Produktsioon“ and „Multiplikatsioon“ executed in offset print, which complement well the works created in the suprematist spirit in the print collection of the Art Museum of Estonia, also representing a series hitherto missing here.

65604.d: Huvitava vormiga hõbenõu on heaks näiteks Tallinna meistri Leopold Eduard Michelseni mitmekülgsest loomingust. Puitlaudu imiteeriv dekoor on haruldane Eesti hõbetööde seas ning kann on seetõttu oluline täiendus Eesti muuseumide kogus.
65604.de: This interestingly shaped silver vessel is a good example of the versatile oeuvre of the Tallinn master Leopold Eduard Michelsen. The decor imitating wooden boards is rare among Estonian silverworks, and the jug is therefore an important addition to the collections of Estonian museums.

65633.dm: lehe laius: 42.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 55.0 cm
65633.d: Anna Elisabeth von Maydell (1861-1944) oli baltisaksa maalija ja tarbekunstnik, kelle loomingust kuuluvad Eesti Kunstimuuseumi (EKM) graafikakogusse kaks 20. sajandi algusest pärinevat mööblikavandit. Käesolev töö seostub samuti Anna von Maydelli huviga tarbekunsti vastu ja tõuseb teiste EKMi kogusse kuuluvate lehtede kõrval esile oma läbitöötatuse astmega, täiendades nii kunstniku enda kui laiemalt baltisaksa naiskunstnike loomingut EKMi kogus.
65633.de: Anna Elisabeth von Maydell (1861-1944) was a Baltic German painter and applied artist, from whose oeuvre two furniture designs from the early 20th century belong to the print collection of the Art Museum of Estonia (EKM). The present work is likewise connected with Anna von Maydell's interest in applied art and stands out among the other sheets in the EKM collection for its degree of elaboration, thus complementing both the artist's own oeuvre and, more broadly, the work of Baltic German women artists in the EKM collection.

65651.dm: lehe laius: 31.9 cm; lehe kõrgus: 21.0 cm
65651.d: Raamatuillustraatori ja karikaturisti Elle Tikerpäe karikatuurid täiendavad hästi nimetatud valdkonna esindavat kollektsiooni Eesti Kunstimuuseumi graafikakogus. Olles mõtteliseks jätkuks Eesti Vabariigi algusaastatel kujunenud satiiriliste piltide traditsioonile (Gori, Otto Krusteni jt), lahkavad need (nt Heinz Valgu šaržide kõrval) oma ajastu ühiskonna aktuaalseid probleeme - liikudes nõukogude ja Eesti taasiseseisvumise aegse konteksti juurde, kus on eraldi koht kunstiteemalistel karikatuuridel.
65651.de: The caricatures of book illustrator and caricaturist Elle Tikerpää complement well the collection representing the field in question in the graphic art collection of the Art Museum of Estonia. As a conceptual continuation of the tradition of satirical images formed in the early years of the Republic of Estonia (Gori, Otto Krusten and others), they dissect (e.g. alongside Heinz Valk's caricatures) the topical social problems of their era - moving on to the context of the Soviet period and the time of Estonia's regained independence, where a separate place is given to caricatures on art-related themes.

Olles mõtteliseks jätkuks Eesti Vabariigi algusaastatel kujunenud satiiriliste piltide traditsioonile (Gori, Otto Krusteni jt), lahkavad need (nt Heinz Valgu šaržide kõrval) oma ajastu ühiskonna aktuaalseid probleeme - liikudes nõukogude ja Eesti taasiseseisvumise aegse konteksti juurde, kus on eraldi koht kunstiteemalistel karikatuuridel.
65670.de: The caricatures of book illustrator and caricaturist Elle Tikerpää complement well the collection representing the field in question in the graphic art collection of the Art Museum of Estonia. As a conceptual continuation of the tradition of satirical images formed in the early years of the Republic of Estonia (Gori, Otto Krusten and others), they dissect (e.g. alongside Heinz Valk's caricatures) the topical social problems of their era - moving on to the context of the Soviet period and the time of Estonia's regained independence, where a separate place is given to caricatures on art-related themes.

65685.dm: lehe kõrgus: 39.0 cm; kujutise laius: 23.2 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 32.6 cm; lehe laius: 31.0 cm
65685.d: Mart Pert (Pärt)(1898-1993) oli dekoratsioonikunstnik ja joonistusõpetaja, kes  õppis aastatel 1915 kuni 1921 Riigi Kunsttööstuskoolis, kust talle anti 1938. aastal rakenduskunstniku tunnistus dekoratsiooni maalimise alal. 1920. aastatel rajas ta Eesti Haridusliidu juurde dekoratsioonide valmistamise keskuse, kus valmisid dekoratsioonid ligi 200 lavastusele. 1935. aastast töötas ta Eesti Kodukaunistamise Seltsi kunstilise juhina, 1945. aastast töötas ta Aruküla koolis joonistuse ja käsitöö õpetajana. Perti 20. sajandi alguse illustratsioonid ja graafika on huvitavad näited ajastu kunstiloomest, mis suhestuvad tugevasti Wiiralti ja teiste omaaegsete kunstnike loominguga.
65685.de: Mart Pert (Pärt) (1898-1993) was a set designer and drawing teacher, who studied from 1915 to 1921 at the State School of Applied Art, from which he was given, in 1938, a certificate of applied artist in the field of set painting. In the 1920s he founded a centre for the production of stage sets at the Estonian Education Union, where sets were made for nearly 200 productions. From 1935 he worked as the artistic director of the Estonian Home Embellishment Society, and from 1945 he worked as a teacher of drawing and handicraft at the Aruküla school. Pert's illustrations and graphic art from the early 20th century are interesting examples of the artistic creation of the era, which relate strongly to the oeuvre of Wiiralt and other artists of the time.

65805.de: Ott Kangilaski's early self-portrait is a rare example of a grotesque (self-)treatment in Estonian graphic art of the period in question.

65833.d: Tallinna Kunsttööstuskoolis õppinud Peeter Sink loobus Vabadussõjas läbielatu tagajärjel kunstnikukutsest ja pühendus edaspidises elus vaimuliku ametile. Kunstiga tegeles Sink siitpeale vabal ajal, luues portreid ja maastikuvaateid perekonna suvituspaikades ja kohtades, kuhu teda tõid teenistuskohustused. Singi loomingus on tunda resonantsis olekut 20. sajandi alguse Eesti modernistidega, eelkõige Nikolai Triigi ja Roman Nymaniga. Teosed annetas Eesti Kunstimuuseumile Peeter Singi perekond.
65833.de: Peeter Sink, who studied at the Tallinn School of Applied Art, gave up the artist's profession as a result of what he experienced in the War of Independence and devoted himself in his subsequent life to the clergy. From then on Sink engaged with art in his free time, creating portraits and landscape views in the family's summer places and in locations to which his service duties brought him. In Sink's work one can sense a resonance with the Estonian modernists of the early 20th century, above all Nikolai Triik and Roman Nyman. The works were donated to the Art Museum of Estonia by Peeter Sink's family.

65924.d: Natalie Mei varasest loomeperioodist pärinev teos, mis peegeldab tema suurepärast joonistaja-annet ja isikupärast stiili ning täiendab 20. sajandi alguse esimeste Eesti professionaalsete naiskunstnike loomingut Eesti Kunstimuuseumi kogus
65924.de: A work from Natalie Mei's early creative period, which reflects her excellent talent for drawing and her distinctive style, and supplements the oeuvre of the first Estonian professional women artists of the early 20th century in the collection of the Art Museum of Estonia

65929.d: Natalie Mei hilisemasse loomeperioodi kuuluv arvatavalt autoportreelise sisuga humoorikas akvarell, mis täiendab autori vabaloomingulist pärandit rohkete kostüümikavandite ja lavakujunduste kõrval.
65929.de: A humorous watercolour belonging to the later creative period of Natalie Mei, presumably of self-portrait character, which complements the author's free creative legacy alongside numerous costume designs and stage sets.

65958.d: Esimese eesti päritolu professionaalse kunstniku portree, mis on arvatavasti valminud foto järgi ja teostatud ajastule omaselt populaarses puugravüüri tehnikas. Teos peegeldab 19. sajandi teisele poolele iseloomulikke visuaalkultuuri protsesse.
65958.de: The portrait of the first professional artist of Estonian origin, presumably made after a photograph and executed in the woodcut technique popular in its time. The work reflects visual culture processes characteristic of the second half of the 19th century.

66103.d: Marje Üksise varajane graafikasari erineb oma visuaalse keele poolest autori hilisemate loomeperioodide töödest, kujutades endast unikaalset kunstikatsetust. Samuti on selle väärtus terviklikus kujundi- ja teemadekäsitluses, mis jätkuvad nii Üksise kui tema mõttekaaslaste graafikas ka hiljem.
66103.de: Marje Üksi's early graphic series differs in its visual language from the artist's works of later creative periods, representing a unique artistic experiment. Its value also lies in its coherent treatment of imagery and themes, which continue in the graphic art of both Üksi and her like-minded contemporaries later on.

66471.d: Marje Üksise varajane graafikasari erineb oma visuaalse keele poolest autori hilisemate loomeperioodide töödest, kujutades endast unikaalset kunstikatsetust. Samuti on selle väärtus terviklikus kujundi- ja teemadekäsitluses, mis jätkuvad nii Üksise kui tema mõttekaaslaste graafikas ka hiljem.
66471.de: Marje Üksi's early graphic series differs in its visual language from the artist's works of later creative periods, representing a unique artistic experiment. Its value also lies in its coherent treatment of imagery and themes, which continue in the graphic art of both Üksi and her like-minded contemporaries later on.

The work was exhibited at the EKKM show titled Insanity in 2008, and thereafter, was donated to the EKKM collection by the authors. However, the authors have meanwhile brought their product to level 2.1 – a further development of the original version. Therefore, EKKM proudly presents Polyphonic passport photo v.2.1: Listen to Your Image!

The visitor first adjusts his or her hairdo and collar, and thereafter sits at the proper height. The visitor initiates the process, by inserting a euro coin into the machine. Throughout the process, instructions are displayed on the screen. A photographic image is made of the visitor. The information on three color channels – red, green and blue — is deciphered from the image. A histogram is created based thereon, which is the graphic representation of the pictorial information and is visually similar to the graphic image of a sound wave. The histogram includes information on two axes and based thereon the sound is created, which the visitor hears on site while the machine prints out the picture. The printed image consists of the portrait that has been made and three separate histograms. This photo cannot be used as a document photo. An address is printed on it, from which the picture can be viewed and “listened to” again at any time in the future. 78889.d:
is a work consisting of a 24-hour sound composition, which repeats continuously throughout the exhibition period. The sound is played through megaphones mounted on a wooden pole, connected to a transmission network. The composition is based on sound recordings collected over a two-week period in the immediate surroundings of the installation. In order to avoid overwhelming the site acoustically, the performance frequency of the recorded sound fragments corresponds to the natural soundscape of the location. The installation reflects the site’s characteristic sound environment while simultaneously extending and subtly shifting it. Additional keywords include public and private space, noise pollution, and the low-cost functionalist aesthetics of transmission networks.

Raul Keller: “The creation of the original work happened to coincide with the April 2007 riots in Tallinn, commonly referred to as the ‘Bronze Night’. As a result, the installation’s sound programme included recordings of the events, which were then played back regularly for approximately two weeks. After the exhibition at Tallinn Art Hall ended, the pole with the megaphones (without the sound component) was never removed, gradually becoming an almost invisible artwork. It remained in place for years and was only dismantled later, when the communication infrastructure in front of Tallinn Art Hall was upgraded.”
